n't.t: 缩写 not 的缩略形式，如 don't

e.en: I do{n't} think we should leave just yet.
e.zh: 我觉得我们现在还不该走。

e.en: She has{n't} answered any of my messages today.
e.zh: 她今天一条消息都没回我。

e.en: "{Naa}, I'm good, thanks," he said, waving the offer away.
e.zh: “不用啦,谢了,”他摆手谢绝了。

e.en: "{Naa}, that movie wasn't really my thing," she shrugged.
e.zh: “不咋样,那电影我不太喜欢,”她耸耸肩。

naafi.t: n. 英军海陆空军小卖部

e.en: The soldiers grabbed coffee at the {NAAFI} before drills.
e.zh: 士兵们在训练前去军中合作社买了咖啡。

e.en: Old veterans still reminisce about {NAAFI} canteen meals abroad.
e.zh: 老兵们至今仍怀念海外军中合作社餐厅的伙食。

e.en: We ordered butter chicken with garlic {naan} on the side.
e.zh: 我们点了奶油咖喱鸡,配蒜味烤饼。

e.en: Fresh {naan} straight from the tandoor is incredibly soft.
e.zh: 刚出炉的烤饼非常柔软。

e.en: Police managed to {nab} the suspect at the airport.
e.zh: 警方在机场成功抓获了嫌疑人。

e.en: Hurry if you want to {nab} the last sale tickets.
e.zh: 想抢到最后的特价票就得快点。

nabisco.t: n. 纳贝斯克（美国食品公司）

e.en: {Nabisco} is the company behind Oreos and Ritz crackers.
e.zh: 纳贝斯克是奥利奥和乐之饼干的母公司。

e.en: My grandfather worked at the {Nabisco} factory for thirty years.
e.zh: 我爷爷在纳贝斯克工厂工作了三十年。

nablus.t: n. 纳布卢斯（巴勒斯坦城市）

e.en: The old soap factories of {Nablus} are famous worldwide.
e.zh: 纳布卢斯的老肥皂工厂闻名世界。

e.en: {Nablus} sits between two mountains in the West Bank.
e.zh: 纳布卢斯坐落在约旦河西岸的两山之间。

e.en: The tech {nabob} bought another mansion in Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 那位科技大亨又在硅谷买了一座豪宅。

e.en: He returned from India a wealthy {nabob} of the empire.
e.zh: 他从印度回来,成了帝国的富豪权贵。

e.en: {Nabokov} wrote Lolita in English, not his native Russian.
e.zh: 纳博科夫用英语而非母语俄语写下了《洛丽塔》。

e.en: Few writers play with language as inventively as {Nabokov}.
e.zh: 很少有作家像纳博科夫那样花样地玩弄语言。

nac.t: (罕用) 常作缩写，如网络准入控制

e.en: Doctors gave him {NAC} to help protect his liver.
e.zh: 医生给他用乙酰半胱氨酸来保护肝脏。

e.en: {NAC} football club plays in the Dutch Eredivisie league.
e.zh: NAC足球俱乐部征战荷兰甲级联赛。

nacelle.t: n. 发动机舱；引擎短舱

e.en: Engineers inspected the engine {nacelle} for any cracks.
e.zh: 工程师检查发动机舱有没有裂纹。

e.en: The wind turbine's {nacelle} houses the gearbox and generator.
e.zh: 风力发电机的机舱里装着齿轮箱和发电机。

nacho.t: n. 墨西哥玉米片（配奶酪）

e.en: I ordered a giant plate of {nacho} chips with extra cheese.
e.zh: 我点了一大盘玉米片,多加芝士。

e.en: He grabbed one last {nacho} before the bowl was empty.
e.zh: 他在盘子空之前抢走了最后一片玉米片。

e.en: Ordinary table salt is chemically just {NaCl}.
e.zh: 普通食盐的化学成分就是氯化钠。

e.en: The IV bag contained a sterile {NaCl} solution.
e.zh: 输液袋里装的是无菌氯化钠溶液。

nacreous.t: adj. 珍珠般的；有虹彩的

e.en: The inside of the shell had a {nacreous}, rainbow sheen.
e.zh: 贝壳内侧泛着珍珠般的彩虹光泽。

e.en: Rare {nacreous} clouds shimmered above the polar horizon.
e.zh: 罕见的贝母云在极地地平线上闪着光。

nad.t: n. 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（辅酶）

e.en: Some supplements claim to boost {NAD} levels and slow aging.
e.zh: 有些保健品声称能提升NAD水平并延缓衰老。

e.en: {NAD} plays a key role in cellular energy production.
e.zh: NAD在细胞能量生成中起着关键作用。

e.en: The 2008 crash marked the {nadir} of his career.
e.zh: 2008年的崩盘是他事业的最低谷。

e.en: Sales hit their {nadir} during the second pandemic year.
e.zh: 销售额在疫情第二年跌到了谷底。

nadu.t: n. 纳德（如 Tamil Nadu 泰米尔纳德邦）

e.en: Chennai is the capital of Tamil {Nadu} in southern India.
e.zh: 金奈是南印度泰米尔纳德邦的首府。

e.en: Tamil {Nadu} is famous for its ancient temple architecture.
e.zh: 泰米尔纳德邦以古老的寺庙建筑闻名。

nae.t: adv. 不（苏格兰方言 = no/not）

e.en: "There's {nae} bother at all," the Scotsman said cheerfully.
e.zh: “一点都不麻烦,”那位苏格兰人爽快地说。

e.en: "I've got {nae} idea where she went," he muttered.
e.zh: “我压根不知道她去哪儿了,”他嘟囔道。

naff.t: adj. 俗气的；不时髦的（英式口语）

e.en: Those plastic flamingos look a bit {naff} in the garden.
e.zh: 花园里那些塑料火烈鸟看起来有点土气。

e.en: He thought the wedding favors were absolutely {naff}.
e.zh: 他觉得那些婚礼小礼物俗气透了。

nafta.t: n. 北美自由贸易协定

e.en: {NAFTA} was replaced by the USMCA trade deal in 2020.
e.zh: 《北美自由贸易协定》在2020年被《美墨加协定》取代。

e.en: Many factories moved to Mexico after {NAFTA} took effect.
e.zh: 《北美自由贸易协定》生效后许多工厂搬到了墨西哥。

nag.t:
v. 唠叨；不停抱怨
n. 老马

e.en: My mom keeps {nag}ging me to clean my room.
e.zh: 我妈一直唠叨我去收拾房间。

e.en: A small doubt continued to {nag} at the back of my mind.
e.zh: 一丝疑虑一直在我心里挥之不去。

e.en: {Nagasaki} has rebuilt itself into a beautiful port city.
e.zh: 长崎已重建成一座美丽的港口城市。

e.en: We visited the peace memorial in {Nagasaki} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天参观了长崎的和平纪念馆。

nagging.t: adj. 唠叨的；烦人的（疼痛、疑虑）

e.en: He has a {nagging} pain in his lower back.
e.zh: 他下背部一直隐隐作痛。

e.en: I had a {nagging} feeling that I'd forgotten something important.
e.zh: 我总有种忘了什么要紧事的感觉。

e.en: {Nagoya} is known for its hearty miso-based cuisine.
e.zh: 名古屋以浓郁的味噌料理而闻名。

e.en: Toyota's headquarters sits just outside {Nagoya}, Japan.
e.zh: 丰田总部就在日本名古屋郊外。

e.en: "{Nah}, I'll just stay home tonight," she texted back.
e.zh: “算了,我今晚就待家里,”她回信息说。

e.en: "{Nah}, that's too expensive for what it is," he replied.
e.zh: “不值,这东西卖这么贵太离谱,”他回道。

nahum.t: n. 那鸿（圣经人物/经卷）

e.en: The book of {Nahum} foretells the fall of Nineveh.
e.zh: 《那鸿书》预言了尼尼微城的覆灭。

e.en: {Nahum} is one of the shorter Old Testament prophets.
e.zh: 那鸿是《旧约》中较短的先知书之一。

nail.t:
n. 钉子；指甲
v. 钉住；搞定

e.en: Try not to hit your thumb when hammering the {nail}.
e.zh: 钉钉子时小心别砸到大拇指。

e.en: She practiced for weeks to {nail} the job interview.
e.zh: 她准备了好几周,就为了搞定那次面试。

nailed.t: v. 钉牢；（口语）完美完成

e.en: She {nailed} the presentation and got a standing ovation.
e.zh: 她演讲表现出色,赢得全场起立鼓掌。

e.en: The carpenter {nailed} the boards together quickly and neatly.
e.zh: 木匠迅速整齐地把木板钉在了一起。

e.en: A pneumatic {nailer} makes framing walls much faster.
e.zh: 用气动钉枪搭墙骨架快多了。

e.en: Borrow a {nailer} from the hardware store for the deck job.
e.zh: 装露台时从五金店借把钉枪用吧。

e.en: The leather chair was trimmed with brass {nailhead} studs.
e.zh: 那把皮椅边沿镶着黄铜钉头装饰。

e.en: She loved the vintage {nailhead} detailing on the armchair.
e.zh: 她很喜欢那把扶手椅复古的钉头装饰。

e.en: She got her {nails} done before the wedding.
e.zh: 她在婚礼前去做了指甲。

e.en: The box came with screws and {nails} included.
e.zh: 盒子里附带了螺丝和钉子。

nairn.t: n. 奈恩（苏格兰地名/人名）

e.en: {Nairn} is a quiet seaside town in the Scottish Highlands.
e.zh: 奈恩是苏格兰高地一座安静的海滨小镇。

e.en: We spent the weekend golfing in {Nairn} last August.
e.zh: 上个八月我们在奈恩打了个高尔夫周末。

nairobi.t: n. 内罗毕（肯尼亚首都）

e.en: {Nairobi} is the bustling capital of Kenya.
e.zh: 内罗毕是肯尼亚繁华的首都。

e.en: Our flight landed in {Nairobi} just before sunrise.
e.zh: 我们的航班在日出前抵达内罗毕。

e.en: It was {naive} of me to trust him so quickly.
e.zh: 我那么快就信任他,真是太天真了。

e.en: Don't be {naive} about how the housing market actually works.
e.zh: 别对房地产市场的真实运作太天真。

e.en: She {naively} assumed everyone would play by the rules.
e.zh: 她天真地以为人人都会守规矩。

e.en: I {naively} clicked the link without checking the sender.
e.zh: 我没核实发件人就天真地点了那个链接。

e.en: His {naivete} about office politics nearly cost him the job.
e.zh: 他对办公室政治的天真差点让他丢了工作。

e.en: There's a charming {naivete} in the way she tells stories.
e.zh: 她讲故事的方式带着一种可爱的天真。

e.en: His early {naiveties} about politics faded after the campaign.
e.zh: 竞选过后，他对政治的种种天真想法逐渐消失了。

e.en: The novel exposes the {naiveties} of small-town life.
e.zh: 这部小说揭示了小镇生活中的种种天真。

e.en: Her {naivety} about online scams cost her money.
e.zh: 她对网络骗局的天真让她损失了钱。

e.en: There's a charming {naivety} in his early paintings.
e.zh: 他早期的画作中有一种迷人的天真。

e.en: Mr. {Nakajima} leads the engineering team in Tokyo.
e.zh: 中岛先生在东京领导工程团队。

e.en: Professor {Nakajima} published a paper on quantum optics.
e.zh: 中岛教授发表了一篇量子光学论文。

e.en: You can see Saturn's rings with the {naked} eye sometimes.
e.zh: 有时候用肉眼就能看到土星环。

e.en: The toddler ran {naked} through the sprinklers laughing.
e.zh: 小孩光着身子在洒水器中笑着跑来跑去。

nakedly.t: adv. 赤裸地；毫不掩饰地

e.en: He spoke {nakedly} about his struggles with depression.
e.zh: 他毫无掩饰地谈起自己与抑郁症的抗争。

e.en: The ad appealed {nakedly} to people's fear of aging.
e.zh: 这则广告赤裸裸地利用了人们对衰老的恐惧。

e.en: The painting captures the {nakedness} of human emotion.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了人类情感最赤裸的一面。

e.en: She covered her {nakedness} with a thin sheet.
e.zh: 她用一条薄床单遮住了赤裸的身体。

nalgo.t: n. 英国地方政府职员工会（缩写）

e.en: My uncle joined {NALGO} before it merged into UNISON.
e.zh: 我叔叔在 NALGO 并入 UNISON 之前就加入了该工会。

e.en: {NALGO} once represented thousands of local government workers.
e.zh: NALGO 曾经代表着数千名地方政府工作人员。

naloxone.t: n. 纳洛酮（阿片解毒药）

e.en: Paramedics gave the patient {naloxone} to reverse the overdose.
e.zh: 急救人员给病人注射了纳洛酮以逆转药物过量。

e.en: Many pharmacies now sell {naloxone} without a prescription.
e.zh: 许多药店现在无需处方就可销售纳洛酮。

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {naltrexone} to help curb alcohol cravings.
e.zh: 医生给她开了纳曲酮以帮助抑制对酒精的渴望。

e.en: {Naltrexone} blocks the brain's opioid receptors effectively.
e.zh: 纳曲酮能有效阻断大脑中的阿片受体。

nam.t: n. 越南（Vietnam 的口语缩写）

e.en: My grandfather served in {Nam} during the late sixties.
e.zh: 我祖父在六十年代末曾在越南服役。

e.en: Veterans of {Nam} gathered for the annual memorial service.
e.zh: 越战老兵聚在一起参加每年的纪念仪式。

name.t:
n. 名字；名称
v. 命名

e.en: What's the {name} of that café we tried yesterday?
e.zh: 我们昨天去的那家咖啡馆叫什么名字？

e.en: They plan to {name} the baby after her grandmother.
e.zh: 他们打算用她外婆的名字给宝宝起名。

named.t:
v. 命名；点名
adj. 有名字的

e.en: She {named} her cat after a famous astronaut.
e.zh: 她用一位著名宇航员的名字给她的猫命名。

e.en: A startup {named} Acme just raised twenty million dollars.
e.zh: 一家叫 Acme 的初创公司刚融资两千万美元。

e.en: A {nameless} dread crept over her as night fell.
e.zh: 夜幕降临时，一种说不出的恐惧悄悄向她袭来。

e.en: The donation came from a {nameless} benefactor downtown.
e.zh: 这笔捐款来自市中心一位不愿透露姓名的恩人。

e.en: Three players stood out, {namely} Sara, Tom, and Lin.
e.zh: 有三名球员表现突出，即萨拉、汤姆和林。

e.en: One thing matters most, {namely} how customers feel.
e.zh: 最重要的一点就是顾客的感受。

e.en: His office door has a polished brass {nameplate}.
e.zh: 他办公室门上有一块擦得发亮的铜质名牌。

e.en: The desk {nameplate} read "Senior Engineer" in clean letters.
e.zh: 办公桌上的名牌用工整的字体写着"高级工程师"。

names.t:
n. 名字（复数）
v. 命名

e.en: Please write your {names} clearly on the sign-in sheet.
e.zh: 请在签到表上清楚地写下你们的名字。

e.en: The app {names} every star you point your phone at.
e.zh: 这款应用能为你手机指向的每颗星星报出名字。

e.en: The restaurant's {namesake} dish is its famous lobster roll.
e.zh: 这家餐厅与店同名的招牌菜是它有名的龙虾卷。

e.en: She was named after her grandmother, her beloved {namesake}.
e.zh: 她以她敬爱的祖母为名，是祖母的同名后辈。

e.en: Every volunteer wore a bright yellow {nametag} at the event.
e.zh: 活动现场每位志愿者都戴着鲜黄色的名牌。

e.en: My {nametag} fell off somewhere during the conference.
e.zh: 我的名牌在会议期间不知掉到哪里去了。

e.en: We saw incredible sand dunes during our trip to {Namibia}.
e.zh: 我们在纳米比亚旅行时看到了令人惊叹的沙丘。

e.en: {Namibia} gained independence from South Africa in 1990.
e.zh: 纳米比亚于1990年脱离南非独立。

namibian.t:
adj. 纳米比亚的
n. 纳米比亚人

e.en: My new colleague is a talented {Namibian} photographer.
e.zh: 我的新同事是一位才华横溢的纳米比亚摄影师。

e.en: The {Namibian} desert is one of the oldest on Earth.
e.zh: 纳米比亚沙漠是地球上最古老的沙漠之一。

naming.t:
n. 命名
v. 给……取名

e.en: {Naming} variables clearly is half the battle in coding.
e.zh: 清晰地命名变量是编程中至关重要的一部分。

e.en: They're holding a {naming} ceremony for the new ship Saturday.
e.zh: 周六他们将为这艘新船举行命名仪式。

nan.t: n. 奶奶（口语）；印度烤饼

e.en: My {nan} bakes the best apple pie in the village.
e.zh: 我奶奶烤的苹果派是村里最好吃的。

e.en: The function returned {NaN} because of a bad input.
e.zh: 由于输入有误，该函数返回了 NaN。

e.en: {Nana} always sneaks me cookies before dinner.
e.zh: 外婆总是在晚饭前偷偷塞给我饼干。

e.en: We're driving up to visit {Nana} this weekend.
e.zh: 我们这周末要开车去看外婆。

e.en: {Nanjing} served as China's capital during several dynasties.
e.zh: 南京曾是中国数个朝代的首都。

e.en: We took the high-speed train from Shanghai to {Nanjing}.
e.zh: 我们坐高铁从上海到了南京。

e.en: Historians still study the tragedy of {Nanking} in 1937.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在研究1937年的南京惨案。

e.en: The Treaty of {Nanking} ended the First Opium War.
e.zh: 《南京条约》结束了第一次鸦片战争。

e.en: They hired a live-in {nanny} to help with the twins.
e.zh: 他们雇了一位住家保姆来帮忙照顾双胞胎。

e.en: Our {nanny} takes the kids to the park every morning.
e.zh: 我们的保姆每天早上带孩子们去公园。

nano.t: adj. 纳米的；极小的（前缀）

e.en: He still uses the old iPod {nano} when he runs.
e.zh: 他跑步时还在用那台旧的 iPod nano。

e.en: The chip operates on a {nano} scale invisible to eyes.
e.zh: 这块芯片在肉眼看不到的纳米级别上运作。

e.en: Researchers built a {nanobot} that can deliver drugs precisely.
e.zh: 研究人员制造出一种能精准递送药物的纳米机器人。

e.en: Each {nanobot} is smaller than a single human cell.
e.zh: 每个纳米机器人都比一个人体细胞还要小。

e.en: The museum displayed several iPod {nanoes} from past decades.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了过去几十年间的几台 iPod nano。

e.en: He collects vintage {nanoes} alongside other Apple gadgets.
e.zh: 他收藏着各种古董 iPod nano 和其他苹果设备。

nanogram.t: n. 纳克（十亿分之一克）

e.en: The lab can detect a single {nanogram} of the toxin.
e.zh: 该实验室能检测出仅一纳克的毒素。

e.en: Even one {nanogram} of the hormone affects the test result.
e.zh: 哪怕只有一纳克的激素也会影响检测结果。

e.en: Scientists designed a {nanomachine} that walks along DNA strands.
e.zh: 科学家设计了一种能沿着 DNA 链行走的纳米机器。

e.en: This tiny {nanomachine} can sort molecules one by one.
e.zh: 这种微型纳米机器能逐个分拣分子。

e.en: The new chip uses a three-{nanometer} manufacturing process.
e.zh: 这款新芯片采用三纳米的制造工艺。

e.en: A typical virus measures around one hundred {nanometer} across.
e.zh: 一种典型的病毒直径约为一百纳米。

e.en: Each {nanoparticle} carries the drug straight to the tumor.
e.zh: 每个纳米粒子都将药物直接送往肿瘤部位。

e.en: Sunscreen often contains zinc oxide as a {nanoparticle}.
e.zh: 防晒霜中常含有作为纳米颗粒的氧化锌。

e.en: Her PhD focuses on {nanoscience} applied to clean energy.
e.zh: 她的博士研究专注于将纳米科学应用于清洁能源。

e.en: {Nanoscience} is reshaping medicine, electronics, and materials.
e.zh: 纳米科学正在重塑医学、电子学和材料学。

nanosecond.t: n. 纳秒（十亿分之一秒）

e.en: The signal traveled the cable in just one {nanosecond}.
e.zh: 信号在电缆中只用了一纳秒就走完了。

e.en: In a {nanosecond}, the algorithm rejected millions of options.
e.zh: 算法在一纳秒内就排除了数百万种选项。

e.en: This {nanostructure} gives the surface its self-cleaning property.
e.zh: 这种纳米结构使表面具有自洁的特性。

e.en: They imaged the {nanostructure} using an electron microscope.
e.zh: 他们用电子显微镜对这种纳米结构进行了成像。

e.en: The {nanostructured} coating reflects almost all incoming sunlight.
e.zh: 这种纳米结构涂层能反射几乎所有入射的阳光。

e.en: Engineers developed a {nanostructured} battery with longer life.
e.zh: 工程师们研发出了一种寿命更长的纳米结构电池。

e.en: {Nanotechnology} could revolutionize how we deliver cancer treatment.
e.zh: 纳米技术可能彻底改变我们治疗癌症的方式。

e.en: The startup raised funding to commercialize its {nanotechnology}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司融资以将其纳米技术商业化。

e.en: Carbon {nanotube} fibers are stronger than steel by weight.
e.zh: 按重量算，碳纳米管纤维比钢还要坚固。

e.en: Each {nanotube} conducts electricity along its hollow length.
e.zh: 每根纳米管都能沿其中空管身导电。

e.en: A single silicon {nanowire} can act as a tiny sensor.
e.zh: 一根单独的硅纳米线就能充当微型传感器。

e.en: They grew the {nanowire} array on a thin glass substrate.
e.zh: 他们在一块薄玻璃基底上培养了纳米线阵列。

e.en: Our build script uses {NAnt} to compile the legacy modules.
e.zh: 我们的构建脚本使用 NAnt 来编译遗留模块。

e.en: He maintained the {NAnt} configuration files for years.
e.zh: 他多年来一直维护着 NAnt 的配置文件。

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring the city of {Nantes}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个长周末游览南特这座城市。

e.en: The Edict of {Nantes} granted French Protestants religious freedom.
e.zh: 《南特敕令》给予了法国新教徒宗教自由。

e.en: The {NAO} robot greeted visitors at the museum entrance.
e.zh: NAO 机器人在博物馆入口处迎接参观者。

e.en: Students program the {NAO} to dance and tell jokes.
e.zh: 学生们给 NAO 编程，让它跳舞和讲笑话。

e.en: Add a few drops of {NaOH} to neutralize the acid.
e.zh: 加几滴 NaOH 来中和酸液。

e.en: {NaOH} is a strong base commonly called caustic soda.
e.zh: NaOH 是一种强碱，俗称烧碱。

nap.t:
n. 小睡
v. 打盹

e.en: I take a quick {nap} after lunch most workdays.
e.zh: 工作日午饭后我大多会小睡一会儿。

e.en: The toddler refused to {nap} despite being clearly tired.
e.zh: 小孩明显已经很累了，却还是不肯午睡。

napa.t: n. 纳帕（美国加州葡萄酒产区）

e.en: We toured several wineries in {Napa} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在纳帕参观了几家酒庄。

e.en: This stir-fry tastes best with fresh {napa} cabbage.
e.zh: 这道炒菜用新鲜的大白菜做最好吃。

e.en: The documentary describes the horror of {napalm} attacks vividly.
e.zh: 这部纪录片生动地描述了凝固汽油弹攻击的恐怖。

e.en: International treaties now restrict the use of {napalm} in war.
e.zh: 国际条约如今限制了凝固汽油弹在战争中的使用。

e.en: He kissed her gently on the {nape} of her neck.
e.zh: 他在她的后颈轻轻地吻了一下。

e.en: A small tattoo sat just below the {nape} of his neck.
e.zh: 在他的后颈下方有一个小小的纹身。

e.en: The refinery sells {naphtha} as feedstock for plastic production.
e.zh: 这家炼油厂将石脑油作为塑料生产的原料出售。

e.en: He cleaned the engine parts with a small amount of {naphtha}.
e.zh: 他用少量石脑油清洗了发动机零件。

naphthalene.t: n. 萘（化学物质，樟脑丸成分）

e.en: Old wardrobes often smell strongly of {naphthalene} mothballs.
e.zh: 老衣柜里常常散发着浓重的萘樟脑丸味。

e.en: {Naphthalene} crystals slowly evaporate, releasing their distinctive odor.
e.zh: 萘晶体会慢慢挥发，释放出其独特的气味。

e.en: John {Napier} invented logarithms in the early 17th century.
e.zh: 约翰·纳皮尔在17世纪初发明了对数。

e.en: The math textbook explains {Napier}'s bones for multiplication.
e.zh: 这本数学课本讲解了用于乘法的纳皮尔算筹。

e.en: She wiped her mouth with a paper {napkin}.
e.zh: 她用一张纸巾擦了擦嘴。

e.en: He sketched the business idea on a {napkin}.
e.zh: 他在一张餐巾纸上勾画出这个商业点子。

e.en: Please grab some {napkins} from the counter.
e.zh: 请去柜台拿几张餐巾纸来。

e.en: The waiter folded the cloth {napkins} into swans.
e.zh: 服务员把布餐巾叠成了天鹅形状。

naples.t: n. 那不勒斯（意大利城市）

e.en: We ate the best pizza of our lives in {Naples}.
e.zh: 我们在那不勒斯吃到了此生最棒的披萨。

e.en: {Naples} sits in the shadow of Mount Vesuvius.
e.zh: 那不勒斯坐落在维苏威火山脚下。

e.en: {Napoleon} was finally defeated at the Battle of Waterloo.
e.zh: 拿破仑最终在滑铁卢战役中战败。

e.en: For dessert she ordered a chocolate {napoleon}.
e.zh: 她点了一份巧克力拿破仑酥作为甜点。

napoleonic.t: adj. 拿破仑的，拿破仑时代的

e.en: The museum displays uniforms from the {Napoleonic} era.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了拿破仑时代的军服。

e.en: Critics accused the CEO of {Napoleonic} ambitions.
e.zh: 评论家指责这位首席执行官有拿破仑式的野心。

napoli.t: n. 那不勒斯（意语地名）

e.en: {Napoli} won the Serie A title that season.
e.zh: 那不勒斯队在那个赛季赢得了意甲冠军。

e.en: He flew to {Napoli} for a wedding last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他飞去那不勒斯参加婚礼。

e.en: The cat is {napping} on the warm windowsill.
e.zh: 猫正在温暖的窗台上打盹。

e.en: I caught my coworker {napping} at his desk.
e.zh: 我撞见同事在办公桌上打瞌睡。

e.en: The baby needs a fresh {nappy} before bed.
e.zh: 宝宝睡前需要换一片干净的尿布。

e.en: His hair was {nappy} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他的头发乱糟糟的。

naproxen.t: n. 萘普生（消炎止痛药）

e.en: The doctor recommended {naproxen} for her back pain.
e.zh: 医生建议她服用萘普生缓解背痛。

e.en: Take {naproxen} with food to protect your stomach.
e.zh: 服用萘普生时要随餐吃以保护胃。

e.en: Short afternoon {naps} can boost your productivity.
e.zh: 午后小睡一会儿能提高工作效率。

e.en: The toddler still {naps} for two hours daily.
e.zh: 这个小宝宝每天还要午睡两个小时。

e.en: We stopped in {Narbonne} on our drive through southern France.
e.zh: 我们驾车穿越法国南部时在纳博讷停留。

e.en: {Narbonne} was an important Roman colony in Gaul.
e.zh: 纳博讷曾是高卢地区重要的罗马殖民地。

narc.t:
n. 缉毒警
v. 告密

e.en: Don't be such a {narc} and tell the teacher.
e.zh: 别那么爱告状,跑去告诉老师。

e.en: An undercover {narc} infiltrated the drug ring.
e.zh: 一名卧底缉毒警察渗透进了贩毒集团。

e.en: Yellow {narcissi} bloomed across the spring meadow.
e.zh: 黄色的水仙花开遍了春日的草地。

e.en: She arranged white {narcissi} in a crystal vase.
e.zh: 她把白色水仙插在水晶花瓶里。

e.en: Social media seems to encourage everyday {narcissism}.
e.zh: 社交媒体似乎在助长日常的自恋风气。

e.en: His {narcissism} made it impossible to work with him.
e.zh: 他的自恋让人根本没法和他合作。

e.en: My ex turned out to be a complete {narcissist}.
e.zh: 我的前任原来是个十足的自恋狂。

e.en: A true {narcissist} rarely admits any wrongdoing.
e.zh: 真正的自恋者很少会承认自己有错。

e.en: His {narcissistic} behavior pushed away all his friends.
e.zh: 他自恋的行为把朋友们都推开了。

e.en: Therapists often see {narcissistic} traits in such patients.
e.zh: 治疗师常在这类病人身上看到自恋型特征。

e.en: The Greek myth of {Narcissus} warns against vanity.
e.zh: 希腊神话中纳西索斯的故事警示人们莫要自负。

e.en: A single white {narcissus} bloomed by the pond.
e.zh: 池边开着一朵洁白的水仙花。

e.en: Netflix released a new series about {narco} cartels.
e.zh: 网飞推出了一部关于贩毒集团的新剧。

e.en: The town was terrorized by {narco} violence for years.
e.zh: 这座小镇多年来饱受毒枭暴力的恐吓。

narcolepsy.t: n. 嗜睡症，发作性睡病

e.en: People with {narcolepsy} can fall asleep without warning.
e.zh: 嗜睡症患者可能毫无预兆地睡着。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {narcolepsy} in her twenties.
e.zh: 她在二十多岁时被确诊患有嗜睡症。

narcoleptic.t:
adj. 嗜睡症的
n. 嗜睡症患者

e.en: His {narcoleptic} episodes made driving too dangerous.
e.zh: 他的嗜睡发作让开车变得太危险。

e.en: The {narcoleptic} patient takes medication every morning.
e.zh: 这位嗜睡症患者每天早上都要服药。

e.en: Deep-sea divers must watch for nitrogen {narcosis}.
e.zh: 深海潜水员必须警惕氮麻醉。

e.en: The patient slipped into {narcosis} after the injection.
e.zh: 病人在注射后陷入了麻醉状态。

narcotic.t:
n. 麻醉药，毒品
adj. 催眠的

e.en: Doctors prescribe this {narcotic} only for severe pain.
e.zh: 医生只在剧痛时才开这种麻醉性止痛药。

e.en: The soft music had an almost {narcotic} effect.
e.zh: 轻柔的音乐有种近乎麻醉般的效果。

e.en: Nobody on the block trusts a {nark}.
e.zh: 街区里没人会信任一个告密者。

e.en: His constant whining really {nark}s me.
e.zh: 他不停地抱怨真的让我恼火。

e.en: Morgan Freeman will {narrate} the new documentary.
e.zh: 摩根·弗里曼将为这部新纪录片配音解说。

e.en: Could you {narrate} what happened that night?
e.zh: 你能讲述一下那晚发生了什么吗?

e.en: David Attenborough {narrated} the wildlife series.
e.zh: 大卫·爱登堡为这部野生动物剧集担任解说。

e.en: She {narrated} her travels with vivid detail.
e.zh: 她生动细致地讲述了自己的旅行经历。

narrates.t: v. 叙述（第三人称单数）

e.en: The audiobook {narrates} the story in the author's own voice.
e.zh: 这本有声书由作者亲自朗读故事。

e.en: A retired detective {narrates} each episode of the podcast.
e.zh: 一位退休侦探为每集播客担任旁白。

e.en: Grandpa loves {narrating} stories from his army days.
e.zh: 爷爷喜欢讲述他在军队时的故事。

e.en: She is {narrating} the new audiobook this month.
e.zh: 她这个月正在录制这本新有声书的旁白。

e.en: The film's {narration} ties the scenes together beautifully.
e.zh: 影片的旁白把各个场景巧妙地串联了起来。

e.en: Her calm {narration} made the documentary captivating.
e.zh: 她平静的解说让纪录片引人入胜。

e.en: The novel uses unusual {narrational} techniques throughout.
e.zh: 这部小说通篇使用了不寻常的叙述手法。

e.en: Critics praised the film's bold {narrational} structure.
e.zh: 评论家称赞了这部影片大胆的叙事结构。

narrative.t:
n. 叙事，故事
adj. 叙述性的

e.en: The media often controls the {narrative} around politics.
e.zh: 媒体常常掌控着政治议题的叙事走向。

e.en: Her novel weaves a powerful personal {narrative}.
e.zh: 她的小说编织出一段动人的个人叙事。

e.en: The film works {narratively} but lacks emotional depth.
e.zh: 这部影片叙事上说得通,但缺乏情感深度。

e.en: {Narratively}, the second season felt rushed.
e.zh: 从叙事上看,第二季显得仓促。

e.en: Different cultures share strikingly similar creation {narratives}.
e.zh: 不同文化的创世叙事惊人地相似。

e.en: Politicians push competing {narratives} about the economy.
e.zh: 政客们就经济问题推动着相互竞争的叙事。

e.en: The unreliable {narrator} makes the novel fascinating.
e.zh: 这位不可靠的叙述者让小说妙趣横生。

e.en: A soothing {narrator} guides listeners through the meditation.
e.zh: 一位声音温柔的旁白引导听众完成冥想。

e.en: The author's {narratorial} voice feels warm and intimate.
e.zh: 作者的叙述者口吻显得温暖而亲切。

e.en: Scholars analyzed the book's complex {narratorial} perspective.
e.zh: 学者们分析了这本书复杂的叙述视角。

narrators.t: n. 叙述者，旁白者（复数）

e.en: The novel switches between three different {narrators}.
e.zh: 这部小说在三位不同的叙述者之间切换。

e.en: Audiobook {narrators} can make or break a story.
e.zh: 有声书的朗读者能成就或毁掉一个故事。

narrow.t:
adj. 狭窄的
v. 变窄，缩小

e.en: The {narrow} alley barely fit a single car.
e.zh: 这条狭窄的小巷勉强能通过一辆车。

e.en: He won the election by a {narrow} margin.
e.zh: 他以微弱优势赢得了选举。

e.en: She {narrowed} her eyes suspiciously at the stranger.
e.zh: 她眯起眼睛狐疑地打量着陌生人。

e.en: We {narrowed} the candidates down to three finalists.
e.zh: 我们把候选人缩减到了三位最终入围者。

narrowing.t:
v. 变窄，缩小（进行时）
n. 收窄

e.en: The gap between the two teams is {narrowing}.
e.zh: 两支队伍之间的差距正在缩小。

e.en: We're {narrowing} our search to apartments downtown.
e.zh: 我们正把找房范围缩小到市中心的公寓。

e.en: The cyclist {narrowly} avoided being hit by the truck.
e.zh: 那位骑车人险些被卡车撞上。

e.en: The bill passed {narrowly} in the senate yesterday.
e.zh: 该法案昨天在参议院以微弱优势通过。

e.en: The {narrowness} of the bridge made driving stressful.
e.zh: 桥面的狭窄让开车变得很紧张。

e.en: His critics pointed out the {narrowness} of his views.
e.zh: 批评者指出了他观点的狭隘之处。

narrows.t:
n. 海峡，狭窄水道
v. 变窄

e.en: The river {narrows} sharply near the old bridge.
e.zh: 这条河在旧桥附近骤然变窄。

e.en: Their boat sailed carefully through the rocky {narrows}.
e.zh: 他们的船小心翼翼地穿过多岩的海峡。

e.en: Visitors gathered in the {narthex} before the service began.
e.zh: 礼拜开始前,访客们聚集在教堂前厅。

e.en: The cathedral's {narthex} features stunning mosaic floors.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的前厅有着惊艳的马赛克地面。

e.en: The {narwhal} is famous for its long spiral tusk.
e.zh: 独角鲸以其长长的螺旋形长牙而闻名。

e.en: Researchers tracked a {narwhal} pod through the Arctic ice.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪一群独角鲸穿越北极冰层。

e.en: He left without {nary} a word of goodbye.
e.zh: 他离开时连一句告别的话都没有。

e.en: There was {nary} a cloud in the sky.
e.zh: 天空中没有一丝云彩。

nas.t: n. 网络附加存储（Network Attached Storage）

e.en: {Nas} dropped one of hip-hop's greatest debut albums.
e.zh: Nas 发行了嘻哈史上最伟大的处女专辑之一。

e.en: I back up all my photos to a home {NAS}.
e.zh: 我把所有照片都备份到家里的网络存储设备上。

nasa.t: n. 美国国家航空航天局

e.en: {NASA} announced plans to return astronauts to the moon.
e.zh: 美国国家航空航天局宣布了让宇航员重返月球的计划。

e.en: Her dream job is working as a {NASA} engineer.
e.zh: 她梦寐以求的工作是当一名NASA工程师。

e.en: He has a slightly {nasal} voice when he sings.
e.zh: 他唱歌时声音略带鼻音。

e.en: Try a saline {nasal} spray to relieve congestion.
e.zh: 试试用生理盐水鼻喷剂来缓解鼻塞。

e.en: He spoke {nasally} because of his bad cold.
e.zh: 因为重感冒,他说话带着浓重的鼻音。

e.en: The medication is administered {nasally} twice a day.
e.zh: 这种药物每天经鼻给药两次。

e.en: The {nascent} startup is already attracting major investors.
e.zh: 这家新生的初创公司已经吸引了大投资者。

e.en: She felt a {nascent} interest in classical music.
e.zh: 她对古典音乐萌生了一丝兴趣。

e.en: The Battle of {Naseby} marked a turning point in the English Civil War.
e.zh: 纳斯比战役是英国内战的转折点。

e.en: Tourists visit {Naseby} village to see the historic battlefield.
e.zh: 游客们前往纳斯比村参观那片历史战场。

e.en: John {Nash} won the Nobel Prize for his work on game theory.
e.zh: 约翰·纳什因其博弈论研究获得了诺贝尔奖。

e.en: The film about {Nash} portrays his struggle with schizophrenia.
e.zh: 那部关于纳什的电影刻画了他与精神分裂症的抗争。

nashville.t: n. 纳什维尔（美国城市）

e.en: {Nashville} is famous as the heart of country music.
e.zh: 纳什维尔以乡村音乐之都而闻名。

e.en: She moved to {Nashville} to pursue a singing career.
e.zh: 她搬到纳什维尔去追寻歌唱事业。

e.en: The patient was fed through a {nasogastric} tube after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后病人通过鼻胃管进食。

e.en: Nurses must check the {nasogastric} tube position regularly.
e.zh: 护士必须定期检查鼻胃管的位置。

e.en: The doctor took a {nasopharyngeal} swab for the COVID test.
e.zh: 医生为了新冠检测采集了鼻咽拭子。

e.en: {Nasopharyngeal} cancer is more common in parts of Asia.
e.zh: 鼻咽癌在亚洲部分地区较为常见。

e.en: The {nasopharynx} connects the nasal cavity to the throat.
e.zh: 鼻咽部连接鼻腔与喉咙。

e.en: Inflammation of the {nasopharynx} can cause persistent coughing.
e.zh: 鼻咽部发炎可能导致持续咳嗽。

e.en: Cruise ships dock daily in {Nassau}, the capital of the Bahamas.
e.zh: 游轮每天停靠在巴哈马首都拿骚。

e.en: We spent a sunny week in {Nassau} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天我们在拿骚度过了阳光明媚的一周。

nastily.t: adv. 令人讨厌地，恶劣地

e.en: He spoke {nastily} to the waiter and embarrassed everyone.
e.zh: 他对服务员说话很刻薄,让大家都很尴尬。

e.en: She fell {nastily} on the icy sidewalk and broke her wrist.
e.zh: 她在结冰的人行道上重重摔倒,摔断了手腕。

e.en: The {nastiness} of online comments can really hurt people.
e.zh: 网络评论的恶毒真的会伤害到人。

e.en: There was a certain {nastiness} in the way she said goodbye.
e.zh: 她道别的方式带着一种刻薄。

e.en: She planted {nasturtium} seeds along the garden border.
e.zh: 她沿着花园边缘种下了旱金莲的种子。

e.en: The salad was decorated with bright orange {nasturtium} flowers.
e.zh: 沙拉上点缀着鲜艳的橙色旱金莲花。

e.en: That was a really {nasty} thing to say about your friend.
e.zh: 那样说你的朋友太刻薄了。

e.en: He got a {nasty} cut on his hand while chopping vegetables.
e.zh: 他切菜时手被割了一个很深的口子。

nat.t: n. 网络地址转换（Network Address Translation）

e.en: My friend {Nat} is coming over for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我的朋友纳特今晚要过来吃饭。

e.en: The router uses {NAT} to share one IP address among devices.
e.zh: 路由器用网络地址转换让多台设备共用一个IP地址。

e.en: She returned to her {natal} village after twenty years abroad.
e.zh: 在国外二十年后,她回到了出生的村庄。

e.en: The hospital provides excellent {natal} care for new mothers.
e.zh: 这家医院为新妈妈提供出色的产期护理。

e.en: {Natation} is excellent exercise for people with joint problems.
e.zh: 游泳对关节有问题的人来说是极好的锻炼。

e.en: The school added {natation} to its physical education curriculum.
e.zh: 学校把游泳课加入了体育课程中。

e.en: The university built a new Olympic-sized {natatorium} last year.
e.zh: 大学去年新建了一座奥林匹克标准的室内游泳馆。

e.en: Swim practice is held at the campus {natatorium} every morning.
e.zh: 游泳训练每天早上在校园室内泳馆进行。

e.en: The whole {nation} watched the World Cup final on television.
e.zh: 全国人民都在电视上观看世界杯决赛。

e.en: Climate change is a challenge facing every {nation} today.
e.zh: 气候变化是当今每个国家都面临的挑战。

national.t:
adj. 国家的，全国的
n. 国民

e.en: The {national} anthem played before the football match began.
e.zh: 足球比赛开始前奏响了国歌。

e.en: This park is a popular {national} tourist destination.
e.zh: 这座公园是热门的国家级旅游景点。

e.en: The {nationalisation} of the railways was a major political debate.
e.zh: 铁路国有化曾是一场重大的政治辩论。

e.en: Many countries considered {nationalisation} of their banks during the crisis.
e.zh: 许多国家在危机期间考虑过将银行国有化。

nationalise.t: v. 收归国有（英式拼写）

e.en: The government plans to {nationalise} the failing energy company.
e.zh: 政府计划将濒临破产的能源公司国有化。

e.en: Some politicians want to {nationalise} the entire healthcare system.
e.zh: 一些政客希望将整个医疗系统国有化。

e.en: The country {nationalised} its oil industry in the 1970s.
e.zh: 该国在七十年代将石油工业收归国有。

e.en: Britain's railways were {nationalised} after the Second World War.
e.zh: 二战后,英国铁路被收归国有。

nationalism.t: n. 民族主义，国家主义

e.en: Rising {nationalism} has reshaped politics across many countries.
e.zh: 民族主义的兴起重塑了许多国家的政治格局。

e.en: His speech promoted economic {nationalism} and protectionist policies.
e.zh: 他的演讲宣扬经济民族主义和保护主义政策。

nationalist.t:
n. 民族主义者
adj. 民族主义的

e.en: The {nationalist} party won a surprising victory in the election.
e.zh: 民族主义政党在选举中赢得了意外的胜利。

e.en: He gave a passionate {nationalist} speech at the rally.
e.zh: 他在集会上发表了一场激情澎湃的民族主义演讲。

e.en: The film has a strong {nationalistic} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影自始至终都带有强烈的民族主义色调。

e.en: Their {nationalistic} rhetoric worried many international observers.
e.zh: 他们的民族主义言论让许多国际观察人士感到担忧。

e.en: The {nationalists} organized a large rally in the capital.
e.zh: 民族主义者在首都组织了一场大型集会。

e.en: Many {nationalists} opposed joining the European trade agreement.
e.zh: 许多民族主义者反对加入欧洲贸易协定。

e.en: Students from over forty {nationalities} attend our university.
e.zh: 我们大学有来自四十多个国家的学生。

e.en: The conference brought together people of many different {nationalities}.
e.zh: 这次会议汇集了许多不同国籍的人。

e.en: Please write your full name and {nationality} on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上写下你的全名和国籍。

e.en: She holds dual {nationality} in Canada and Italy.
e.zh: 她拥有加拿大和意大利的双重国籍。

e.en: The {nationalization} of major banks sparked international concern.
e.zh: 主要银行的国有化引发了国际社会的关注。

e.en: Workers welcomed the {nationalization} of the steel industry.
e.zh: 工人们欢迎钢铁工业的国有化。

e.en: The president threatened to {nationalize} foreign-owned oil companies.
e.zh: 总统威胁要将外资石油公司国有化。

e.en: Few governments today choose to {nationalize} private businesses.
e.zh: 如今很少有政府会选择将私营企业国有化。

nationalized.t:
adj. 已国有化的
v. nationalize 的过去式

e.en: The airline was {nationalized} after years of financial losses.
e.zh: 在多年亏损后,这家航空公司被国有化了。

e.en: China {nationalized} much of its heavy industry during that era.
e.zh: 中国在那个年代将许多重工业收归国有。

nationally.t: adv. 全国性地；在全国范围内

e.en: The new policy will be implemented {nationally} starting next month.
e.zh: 新政策将从下个月起在全国范围内实施。

e.en: Her novel became {nationally} famous within just a few weeks.
e.zh: 她的小说在短短几周内就闻名全国。

e.en: Foreign {nationals} must register with the embassy upon arrival.
e.zh: 外国公民抵达后必须到大使馆登记。

e.en: The team won the swimming {nationals} for the third year running.
e.zh: 该队连续第三年赢得了全国游泳锦标赛。

nationhood.t: n. 国家地位；民族身份

e.en: The country celebrates its {nationhood} every July with parades.
e.zh: 这个国家每年七月用游行庆祝立国。

e.en: Independence brought a strong sense of {nationhood} to the people.
e.zh: 独立给人民带来了强烈的国家归属感。

e.en: Many {nations} signed the climate agreement in Paris.
e.zh: 许多国家在巴黎签署了气候协议。

e.en: The United {Nations} held an emergency session this week.
e.zh: 联合国本周召开了紧急会议。

nationwide.t:
adj. 全国性的
adv. 遍及全国

e.en: The retailer launched a {nationwide} sale to clear old inventory.
e.zh: 这家零售商发起了全国性大促销以清理旧库存。

e.en: The protest spread {nationwide} within just two days.
e.zh: 抗议活动在短短两天内蔓延至全国。

native.t:
adj. 本地的；原生的
n. 本地人

e.en: She speaks English like a {native} despite being born abroad.
e.zh: 虽然在国外出生,但她说英语像母语者一样地道。

e.en: This plant is {native} to the rainforests of Brazil.
e.zh: 这种植物原产于巴西的雨林。

e.en: The app runs {natively} on both iPhone and Android devices.
e.zh: 这款应用在iPhone和安卓设备上都能原生运行。

e.en: She speaks French {natively} and learned English at school.
e.zh: 她的母语是法语,英语是在学校学的。

e.en: The {natives} of the island live mainly by fishing.
e.zh: 这座岛屿上的原住民主要以捕鱼为生。

e.en: Digital {natives} grew up surrounded by smartphones and the internet.
e.zh: 数字原住民是在智能手机和互联网环绕中长大的。

nativism.t: n. 本土主义；排外主义

e.en: {Nativism} influenced immigration policy throughout the early twentieth century.
e.zh: 本土主义在二十世纪初影响着移民政策。

e.en: Critics warned that rising {nativism} threatens diverse communities.
e.zh: 批评人士警告说,日益增长的本土主义威胁着多元社区。

nativist.t:
n. 本土主义者
adj. 本土主义的

e.en: The candidate's {nativist} rhetoric alienated many immigrant voters.
e.zh: 这位候选人的本土主义言论疏远了许多移民选民。

e.en: {Nativist} movements often gain support during economic downturns.
e.zh: 本土主义运动往往在经济低迷时期获得支持。

e.en: The children performed a {nativity} play at the Christmas service.
e.zh: 孩子们在圣诞礼拜中表演了耶稣降生剧。

e.en: A small {nativity} scene was set up beneath the tree.
e.zh: 圣诞树下摆放着一个小型的耶稣降生场景。

nato.t: n. 北大西洋公约组织

e.en: Several Eastern European countries joined {NATO} after the Cold War.
e.zh: 冷战后,几个东欧国家加入了北约。

e.en: {NATO} members met in Brussels to discuss defense spending.
e.zh: 北约成员国在布鲁塞尔开会讨论国防开支。

natter.t:
v. 闲聊；唠叨
n. 闲谈

e.en: The two old friends sat down for a long {natter} over tea.
e.zh: 两位老朋友坐下来一边喝茶一边长聊。

e.en: Stop {nattering} and finish your homework already.
e.zh: 别再唠叨了,赶快把作业做完。

e.en: He arrived at the party {nattily} dressed in a tailored suit.
e.zh: 他穿着一身剪裁合体的西装,潇洒地出现在派对上。

e.en: The waiter was {nattily} dressed in a black bow tie.
e.zh: 服务员系着黑色领结,穿得十分整洁时髦。

e.en: Grandfather always wore a {natty} fedora when going out.
e.zh: 祖父出门时总戴着一顶时髦的浅顶呢帽。

e.en: He looked quite {natty} in his new pinstriped suit.
e.zh: 他穿着新的细条纹西装,看起来很潇洒。

natural.t:
adj. 自然的；天然的
n. 天生好手

e.en: It's perfectly {natural} to feel nervous before a big interview.
e.zh: 在重要面试前感到紧张是再自然不过的事。

e.en: The shampoo contains only {natural} ingredients from plants.
e.zh: 这款洗发水只含有来自植物的天然成分。

naturalise.t: v. 使入籍；使归化（英式拼写）

e.en: After living here for ten years, she decided to {naturalise}.
e.zh: 在这里生活十年后,她决定加入该国国籍。

e.en: Gardeners often {naturalise} bulbs across the lawn for spring color.
e.zh: 园丁常把球茎自然地种在草坪上,以营造春天的色彩。

naturalised.t: adj. 已入籍的；已归化的

e.en: He became a {naturalised} citizen of Australia last year.
e.zh: 他去年入籍成为了澳大利亚公民。

e.en: The plant has {naturalised} along streams throughout the region.
e.zh: 这种植物已在该地区的溪流沿岸自然生长开来。

naturalism.t: n. 自然主义（文艺流派）

e.en: Zola's novels are famous examples of literary {naturalism}.
e.zh: 左拉的小说是文学自然主义的著名典范。

e.en: The painting shows a remarkable {naturalism} in its details.
e.zh: 这幅画在细节上展现出非凡的自然主义风格。

naturalist.t: n. 博物学家；自然主义者

e.en: Charles Darwin was the most influential {naturalist} of his century.
e.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文是他那个世纪最有影响力的博物学家。

e.en: The {naturalist} spent years studying birds in the Amazon.
e.zh: 那位博物学家花了多年时间在亚马逊研究鸟类。

naturalistic.t: adj. 自然主义的；逼真的

e.en: The actor gave a wonderfully {naturalistic} performance in the film.
e.zh: 那位演员在影片中演出了非常自然真实的表演。

e.en: She painted in a {naturalistic} style that captured every detail.
e.zh: 她以自然写实的风格作画,捕捉到了每一个细节。

naturalistically.t: adv. 自然主义地；逼真地

e.en: The film portrays village life {naturalistically}, without any dramatic flourishes.
e.zh: 这部电影自然主义地呈现了乡村生活，没有任何戏剧化渲染。

e.en: She acted {naturalistically}, as if the camera weren't there.
e.zh: 她表演得很自然，仿佛摄像机根本不存在。

e.en: He passed the {naturalization} test and became a citizen last week.
e.zh: 他通过了入籍考试，上周成为了公民。

e.en: The {naturalization} of certain plants has changed the local ecosystem.
e.zh: 某些植物的归化已经改变了当地的生态系统。

e.en: It took eight years for him to {naturalize} as a citizen.
e.zh: 他花了八年时间才入籍成为公民。

e.en: These tulips will {naturalize} and spread across the lawn.
e.zh: 这些郁金香会自然繁衍并蔓延到整片草坪。

naturalized.t: adj. 已入籍的；已归化的

e.en: She is a {naturalized} American who was born in Vietnam.
e.zh: 她是出生在越南的归化美国公民。

e.en: Many {naturalized} plants now grow wild in the countryside.
e.zh: 许多归化植物如今在乡间野生生长。

e.en: Her hair is {naturally} curly and she rarely styles it.
e.zh: 她的头发是天生卷的，很少做造型。

e.en: {Naturally}, everyone wanted to know what happened next.
e.zh: 自然地，每个人都想知道接下来发生了什么。

e.en: The actor's {naturalness} on camera made the scene feel real.
e.zh: 那位演员在镜头前的自然让这场戏显得很真实。

e.en: I love the {naturalness} of her writing style.
e.zh: 我喜欢她写作风格中的那种自然感。

e.en: The essay compares the different {naturalnesses} of various acting styles.
e.zh: 这篇文章比较了不同表演风格各自的自然程度。

e.en: Critics debated the {naturalnesses} found in modern portrait photography.
e.zh: 评论家们讨论现代肖像摄影中各种自然感的表现。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking and enjoying {nature}.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在徒步，享受大自然。

e.en: It's not in her {nature} to lie about anything.
e.zh: 撒谎不符合她的本性。

natured.t: adj. 具某种性情的（常构成合成词）

e.en: He's a good-{natured} guy who never holds a grudge.
e.zh: 他是个性格好的人，从不记仇。

e.en: Their ill-{natured} comments online really hurt her feelings.
e.zh: 他们在网上那些恶意的评论真的伤了她的心。

naturist.t: n. 裸体主义者；天体爱好者

e.en: The beach is popular with {naturist} groups during summer.
e.zh: 这片海滩在夏天很受裸体主义团体欢迎。

e.en: He's been a {naturist} for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他做裸体主义者已经超过二十年了。

e.en: She visited a {naturopath} for help with her chronic fatigue.
e.zh: 她去看了一位自然疗法师，希望治疗慢性疲劳。

e.en: The {naturopath} recommended dietary changes instead of medication.
e.zh: 那位自然疗法师建议改变饮食而不是吃药。

e.en: The clinic offers {naturopathic} treatments alongside conventional medicine.
e.zh: 该诊所在常规医疗之外还提供自然疗法治疗。

e.en: He's studying to earn a {naturopathic} medicine degree.
e.zh: 他正在攻读自然疗法医学学位。

natwest.t: n. 英国国民西敏寺银行

e.en: I opened my first checking account at {NatWest} years ago.
e.zh: 我多年前在国民西敏寺银行开了第一个支票账户。

e.en: {NatWest} announced new mobile banking features for its customers.
e.zh: 国民西敏寺银行为客户推出了新的手机银行功能。

naught.t:
n. 零；无
pron. 毫无

e.en: All his careful planning came to {naught} in the end.
e.zh: 他所有精心的计划最终都化为乌有。

e.en: Her efforts to save the project were for {naught}.
e.zh: 她为挽救这个项目所做的努力都白费了。

e.en: The puppy's {naughtiness} kept everyone laughing all afternoon.
e.zh: 小狗的调皮捣蛋让大家笑了一整个下午。

e.en: There was a hint of {naughtiness} in her smile.
e.zh: 她的笑容中带着一丝俏皮。

naughty.t: adj. 淘气的；顽皮的；下流的

e.en: The {naughty} kids hid their mom's car keys as a joke.
e.zh: 那些调皮的孩子把妈妈的车钥匙藏起来当作恶作剧。

e.en: She gave him a {naughty} look across the dinner table.
e.zh: 她隔着餐桌向他投来一个俏皮的眼神。

e.en: {Nauru} is one of the smallest countries in the world.
e.zh: 瑙鲁是世界上最小的国家之一。

e.en: The team from {Nauru} arrived for the Pacific Games.
e.zh: 瑙鲁代表队抵达参加太平洋运动会。

e.en: The medication can cause {nausea} and dizziness in some patients.
e.zh: 这种药物可能让一些患者感到恶心和头晕。

e.en: She felt a wave of {nausea} during the boat ride.
e.zh: 乘船时她突然一阵恶心。

e.en: The smell of fish can {nauseate} her during pregnancy.
e.zh: 怀孕期间鱼腥味会让她反胃。

e.en: His arrogant comments {nauseate} everyone in the office.
e.zh: 他傲慢的言论让办公室里每个人都感到恶心。

e.en: She felt {nauseated} after reading the disturbing news article.
e.zh: 看完那篇令人不安的新闻后她感到一阵恶心。

e.en: The strong perfume left him feeling {nauseated} all morning.
e.zh: 那股浓烈的香水味让他整个上午都觉得恶心。

nauseating.t: adj. 令人作呕的；令人厌恶的

e.en: The {nauseating} smell from the trash bin filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 垃圾桶里散发的恶臭充满了整个厨房。

e.en: His {nauseating} flattery made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那令人作呕的奉承让每个人都很不自在。

e.en: The cake was {nauseatingly} sweet and nobody finished a slice.
e.zh: 那蛋糕甜得令人作呕，没人吃完一整块。

e.en: He was {nauseatingly} polite to his boss in every meeting.
e.zh: 他在每次会议上对老板都礼貌得让人反胃。

nauseous.t: adj. 恶心的；令人作呕的

e.en: I felt {nauseous} after eating that suspicious leftover sushi.
e.zh: 吃了那盒可疑的剩寿司后我感到恶心。

e.en: The rocking boat made several passengers {nauseous}.
e.zh: 摇晃的船让好几个乘客觉得想吐。

e.en: The restaurant has a {nautical} theme with anchors and rope decorations.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以航海为主题，装饰着船锚和绳索。

e.en: The ship traveled at twenty {nautical} miles per hour.
e.zh: 这艘船以每小时二十海里的速度航行。

e.en: The {nautilus} has a beautiful spiral shell with chambers inside.
e.zh: 鹦鹉螺有着美丽的螺旋形外壳，里面有一个个腔室。

e.en: He photographed a live {nautilus} during his diving trip.
e.zh: 他在潜水旅行中拍到了一只活鹦鹉螺。

e.en: The car's {nav} system rerouted us around heavy traffic.
e.zh: 汽车的导航系统帮我们绕开了拥堵路段。

e.en: Click the {nav} bar to jump to the settings page.
e.zh: 点击导航栏即可跳转到设置页面。

e.en: The Hindu word {nava} means new or fresh in Sanskrit.
e.zh: 印地语词nava在梵语中意为新的或新鲜的。

e.en: {Nava} is a common name element in many South Asian languages.
e.zh: nava是许多南亚语言中常见的名字组成部分。

navajo.t: n. 纳瓦霍族；纳瓦霍语

e.en: The {Navajo} Nation covers parts of Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah.
e.zh: 纳瓦霍族保留地横跨亚利桑那、新墨西哥和犹他州的部分地区。

e.en: She bought a beautiful handwoven {Navajo} rug at the market.
e.zh: 她在集市上买了一条漂亮的手工纳瓦霍地毯。

e.en: His son joined the {naval} academy right after high school.
e.zh: 他儿子高中毕业后就进了海军学院。

e.en: The two countries held joint {naval} exercises last week.
e.zh: 两国上周举行了联合海军演习。

navarre.t: n. 纳瓦拉（西班牙地区）

e.en: {Navarre} is a beautiful region in northern Spain known for wine.
e.zh: 纳瓦拉是西班牙北部美丽的地区，以葡萄酒闻名。

e.en: We drove through {Navarre} on our way to the Pyrenees.
e.zh: 我们前往比利牛斯山时途经纳瓦拉。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through stained glass into the cathedral's {nave}.
e.zh: 阳光透过彩色玻璃洒进大教堂的中殿。

e.en: The choir gathered at the front of the {nave} to sing.
e.zh: 唱诗班聚集在中殿前方歌唱。

e.en: The yoga instructor told us to focus on our {navel}.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师让我们把注意力集中在肚脐上。

e.en: She bought a bag of sweet {navel} oranges from the farmer.
e.zh: 她从农民那里买了一袋甜甜的脐橙。

e.en: The world's largest {navies} held drills in the Pacific Ocean.
e.zh: 世界上最强大的几支海军在太平洋举行了演习。

e.en: Modern {navies} rely heavily on submarines and aircraft carriers.
e.zh: 现代海军非常依赖潜艇和航空母舰。

navigable.t: adj. 可通航的；可导航的

e.en: The river is only {navigable} during the rainy season.
e.zh: 这条河只有在雨季才能通航。

e.en: Their website is clean and easily {navigable} on mobile devices.
e.zh: 他们的网站很简洁，在手机上也容易浏览。

e.en: It's hard to {navigate} this app without reading the tutorial.
e.zh: 不看教程的话很难操作这个应用。

e.en: She had to {navigate} a difficult conversation with her boss.
e.zh: 她不得不应对一场与老板的棘手谈话。

e.en: He {navigated} the busy streets of Tokyo using only Google Maps.
e.zh: 他仅凭谷歌地图就走遍了东京繁忙的街道。

e.en: She skillfully {navigated} the complicated office politics.
e.zh: 她巧妙地周旋于复杂的办公室政治之中。

navigates.t: v. 导航（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {navigates} you to the nearest charging station automatically.
e.zh: 这个应用会自动导航到最近的充电站。

e.en: He {navigates} family conflicts with patience and grace.
e.zh: 他以耐心和优雅化解家庭冲突。

e.en: {Navigating} a foreign city without internet can be quite challenging.
e.zh: 在没有网络的情况下游览陌生城市相当有挑战性。

e.en: She's {navigating} a tough divorce while raising two kids.
e.zh: 她一边抚养两个孩子，一边应对艰难的离婚。

e.en: Turn on {navigation} so we don't miss the highway exit.
e.zh: 打开导航，免得错过高速公路出口。

e.en: The website's {navigation} is confusing and needs a redesign.
e.zh: 这个网站的导航很混乱，需要重新设计。

e.en: Modern ships rely on advanced {navigational} systems for safety.
e.zh: 现代船舶依靠先进的导航系统来确保安全。

e.en: The app uses {navigational} cues to guide first-time users.
e.zh: 这款应用使用导航提示来引导初次使用的用户。

e.en: Multiple {navigations} between pages can slow down the app.
e.zh: 页面间多次跳转可能会让应用变慢。

e.en: The book describes early ocean {navigations} by Polynesian sailors.
e.zh: 这本书描述了波利尼西亚水手早期的远洋航行。

e.en: Our car's {navigator} kept rerouting us through small back roads.
e.zh: 我们车上的导航不停地把我们引到小路上。

e.en: She acted as the {navigator} during their cross-country road trip.
e.zh: 在那次横跨全国的公路旅行中她担任领航员。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {navvy} on the railway in Britain.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在英国铁路上当筑路工人。

e.en: The old {navvy} told stories of digging canals by hand.
e.zh: 那位老筑路工人讲述着用手挖运河的故事。

navy.t:
n. 海军
adj. 藏青色的

e.en: He served in the {navy} for eight years before retiring.
e.zh: 他在海军服役了八年才退役。

e.en: She wore a {navy} blue dress to the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 她穿着一条藏青色连衣裙参加婚礼。

e.en: "{Naw}, I don't feel like going out tonight," he said.
e.zh: "不啦，我今晚不太想出去，"他说。

e.en: "{Naw}, that's not really my style," she replied with a shrug.
e.zh: "不要，那不太是我的风格，"她耸耸肩说。

e.en: The {nawab} ruled the province with great wealth and influence.
e.zh: 那位太守以巨大的财富和影响力统治着这个省份。

e.en: Tourists visit the palace once owned by a powerful {nawab}.
e.zh: 游客们参观这座曾属于一位权势太守的宫殿。

naxos.t: n. 纳克索斯（希腊岛屿）

e.en: We spent a week swimming on the beaches of {Naxos}.
e.zh: 我们在纳克索斯岛的海滩上游泳度过了一周。

e.en: {Naxos} is the largest island in the Cyclades, Greece.
e.zh: 纳克索斯是希腊基克拉泽斯群岛中最大的岛屿。

nay.t:
adv. 否；不
n. 反对票

e.en: The senator voted {nay} on the controversial new tax bill.
e.zh: 那位参议员对这项有争议的新税法案投了反对票。

e.en: The proposal was difficult, {nay}, almost impossible to implement.
e.zh: 这项提议很困难，不，几乎不可能执行。

e.en: Critics will always {naysay} bold new ideas at first.
e.zh: 批评者总是会先对大胆的新想法说不。

e.en: Don't {naysay} her dreams before she's even tried.
e.zh: 她还没尝试之前别急着否定她的梦想。

e.en: Every {naysayer} told him the startup would fail within months.
e.zh: 每个唱反调的人都说他的创业公司几个月内就会失败。

e.en: Ignore the {naysayer} and focus on building something great.
e.zh: 别理那些唱反调的人，专注做出色的东西。

e.en: The painting depicts Jesus the {Nazarene} preaching to a crowd.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了拿撒勒人耶稣向人群讲道的场景。

e.en: Many {Nazarene} churches host community outreach programs each weekend.
e.zh: 许多拿撒勒教会每个周末都会举办社区外展活动。

nazareth.t: n. 拿撒勒（以色列城市）

e.en: Tourists visit {Nazareth} to see sites linked to early Christianity.
e.zh: 游客前往拿撒勒参观与早期基督教相关的遗址。

e.en: He grew up in a small village near {Nazareth}.
e.zh: 他在拿撒勒附近的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: The {Nazca} lines are massive geoglyphs etched into the desert.
e.zh: 纳斯卡线条是刻在沙漠中的巨大地画。

e.en: Archaeologists still debate the purpose of the {Nazca} drawings.
e.zh: 考古学家仍在争论纳斯卡图画的用途。

nazi.t:
n. 纳粹分子
adj. 纳粹的

e.en: The museum documents crimes committed by the {Nazi} regime.
e.zh: 该博物馆记录了纳粹政权犯下的罪行。

e.en: Historians study how {Nazi} propaganda spread so effectively.
e.zh: 历史学家研究纳粹宣传是如何如此有效地传播的。

e.en: Schools teach the dangers of {Nazism} to prevent its return.
e.zh: 学校教导纳粹主义的危险,以防止其卷土重来。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on the rise of {Nazism} in Europe.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于纳粹主义在欧洲兴起的论文。

nbc.t: n. 美国全国广播公司

e.en: The show airs every Thursday night on {NBC}.
e.zh: 这档节目每周四晚在NBC播出。

e.en: {NBC} News covered the election results live overnight.
e.zh: NBC新闻通宵直播报道了选举结果。

e.en: The lab follows {NBS} guidelines for accurate measurement standards.
e.zh: 实验室遵循NBS指南以确保测量标准的准确性。

e.en: Older textbooks still reference {NBS} before it became NIST.
e.zh: 旧课本中仍提到NBS,后来它更名为NIST。

ncb.t: n. 机构缩写（如国家煤炭局）

e.en: The {NCB} regulates narcotics enforcement across the country.
e.zh: 国家麻醉品管制局负责全国的毒品执法监管。

e.en: Officers from the {NCB} seized a large drug shipment.
e.zh: NCB的官员查获了一批大量毒品。

ncc.t: n. 机构缩写（如全国委员会）

e.en: Many students join the {NCC} to receive military-style training.
e.zh: 许多学生加入NCC以接受军事化训练。

e.en: The {NCC} parade was held on Republic Day.
e.zh: NCC阅兵式在共和国日举行。

ncm.t: n. 缩写（如三元锂电池）

e.en: Most modern EVs use {NCM} batteries for higher energy density.
e.zh: 大多数现代电动车使用NCM电池以获得更高的能量密度。

e.en: Engineers compared {NCM} cells against lithium iron phosphate alternatives.
e.zh: 工程师们将NCM电池与磷酸铁锂替代品进行了比较。

e.en: The sergeant served as a respected {NCO} for twenty years.
e.zh: 这位中士担任受人尊敬的士官长达二十年。

e.en: Every {NCO} is responsible for training the junior soldiers.
e.zh: 每位士官都有责任训练年轻士兵。

e.en: The {NCP} won several seats in the recent state election.
e.zh: NCP在最近的邦选举中赢得了多个席位。

e.en: Drivers complained about high parking fees at the {NCP} lot.
e.zh: 司机们抱怨NCP停车场的停车费过高。

ncr.t: n. 美国国家收银机公司

e.en: Many tech firms have offices in the Delhi {NCR} region.
e.zh: 许多科技公司在德里国家首都辖区设有办公室。

e.en: The store still uses an old {NCR} cash register.
e.zh: 那家店还在使用一台旧的NCR收银机。

nct.t: n. 缩写（如韩国男团 NCT）

e.en: {NCT} released a new album that topped the charts globally.
e.zh: NCT发行了一张登上全球排行榜榜首的新专辑。

e.en: Fans waited hours to see {NCT} perform live in Seoul.
e.zh: 粉丝们等了几个小时只为在首尔现场观看NCT演出。

e.en: The {NDP} campaigned on healthcare and affordable housing reforms.
e.zh: 新民主党以医疗保健和保障性住房改革为竞选纲领。

e.en: Voters in the riding traditionally support the {NDP} candidate.
e.zh: 该选区的选民传统上支持新民主党候选人。

e.en: He's a {ne'er}-do-well who avoids honest work.
e.zh: 他是个游手好闲、不肯踏实工作的人。

e.en: In old poems, the lovers {ne'er} forget each other.
e.zh: 在古老的诗歌中,恋人们从未忘记彼此。

nea.t: n. 美国全国教育协会

e.en: The {NEA} funds artists and arts education across the country.
e.zh: 国家艺术基金会资助全国的艺术家和艺术教育。

e.en: Teachers union members rely on {NEA} for advocacy support.
e.zh: 教师工会成员依靠NEA提供倡导支持。

neandertal.t: n. 尼安德特人（Neanderthal 的异体）

e.en: Scientists sequenced the {Neandertal} genome from ancient bone fragments.
e.zh: 科学家从古老的骨片中测序出了尼安德特人的基因组。

e.en: Modern humans share some DNA with the extinct {Neandertal}.
e.zh: 现代人类与已灭绝的尼安德特人有一些共同的DNA。

neanderthal.t:
n. 尼安德特人
adj. 守旧的；粗野的

e.en: A {Neanderthal} skull was discovered in the cave last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天在那个山洞里发现了一个尼安德特人的头骨。

e.en: Don't be such a {Neanderthal} about modern technology.
e.zh: 别对现代科技这么守旧落伍。

neap.t:
n. 小潮，最低潮
adj. 小潮的

e.en: Boats can run aground during a {neap} tide.
e.zh: 船只在小潮期间可能会搁浅。

e.en: The fishermen waited for the {neap} tide to pass.
e.zh: 渔民们等着小潮过去。

neapolitan.t:
adj. 那不勒斯的
n. 那不勒斯人

e.en: The kids loved the {Neapolitan} ice cream with three flavors.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢那种有三种口味的那不勒斯冰淇淋。

e.en: Authentic {Neapolitan} pizza is baked in a wood-fired oven.
e.zh: 正宗的那不勒斯披萨是在柴火烤炉里烘烤的。

near.t:
adj. 近的
v. 接近，靠近

e.en: The cafe is {near} the subway station downtown.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆就在市中心地铁站附近。

e.en: We're {near} the end of the project timeline.
e.zh: 我们快到项目的截止时间了。

nearby.t:
adj. 附近的
adv. 在附近

e.en: There's a great bakery {nearby} if you're hungry.
e.zh: 如果你饿了,附近有家很棒的面包店。

e.en: She parked in a {nearby} lot and walked over.
e.zh: 她把车停在附近的停车场然后走了过来。

nearer.t: adj. 更近的（near 的比较级）

e.en: Move {nearer} to the camera so we can hear you.
e.zh: 再靠近摄像头一点,这样我们能听到你说话。

e.en: As the deadline grew {nearer}, the team worked overtime.
e.zh: 随着截止日期临近,团队开始加班。

nearest.t: adj. 最近的（near 的最高级）

e.en: The app shows the {nearest} gas station on the map.
e.zh: 这个应用在地图上显示最近的加油站。

e.en: Round the answer to the {nearest} whole number.
e.zh: 将答案四舍五入到最接近的整数。

e.en: I {nearly} missed the train this morning.
e.zh: 我今天早上差点没赶上火车。

e.en: The download is {nearly} complete, just a few seconds left.
e.zh: 下载几乎完成了,只剩几秒钟。

e.en: The {nearness} of the deadline made everyone anxious.
e.zh: 截止日期的临近让每个人都很焦虑。

e.en: She enjoyed the {nearness} of her family during the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里她很享受与家人的亲近。

nearside.t: n. 近侧，靠路边的一侧

e.en: Park along the {nearside} curb to avoid traffic.
e.zh: 沿着靠近行人道一侧的路边停车以避开车流。

e.en: The cyclist swerved into the {nearside} lane suddenly.
e.zh: 骑车人突然转入靠近路边的车道。

e.en: My son became {nearsighted} after years of staring at screens.
e.zh: 我儿子盯了多年屏幕后变得近视了。

e.en: {Nearsighted} drivers should always wear corrective glasses at night.
e.zh: 近视的司机晚上开车应该始终戴矫正眼镜。

e.en: Childhood {nearsightedness} has risen sharply in many Asian countries.
e.zh: 儿童近视率在许多亚洲国家急剧上升。

e.en: The doctor prescribed glasses to correct his {nearsightedness}.
e.zh: 医生开了眼镜来矫正他的近视。

neat.t: adj. 整洁的；简洁的；（口语）很棒的

e.en: Her desk is always {neat} and well-organized.
e.zh: 她的桌子总是整洁有序。

e.en: That's a really {neat} trick — how did you do it?
e.zh: 这招真酷,你是怎么做到的?

e.en: Let me {neaten} my hair before the video call.
e.zh: 我先整理一下头发再开视频会议。

e.en: Please {neaten} the stack of papers on your desk.
e.zh: 请把你桌上那叠纸整理一下。

neath.t: prep. 在…之下（beneath 的诗体缩写）

e.en: The cat curled up {neath} the warm blanket.
e.zh: 猫蜷缩在温暖的毯子下面。

e.en: Treasure was hidden {neath} the old oak tree.
e.zh: 宝藏藏在那棵老橡树下面。

e.en: The clothes were folded {neatly} inside the suitcase.
e.zh: 衣服被整齐地叠放在行李箱里。

e.en: Her argument {neatly} summarized everyone's concerns.
e.zh: 她的论点巧妙地概括了大家的关切。

e.en: The teacher praised the {neatness} of his handwriting.
e.zh: 老师称赞他书写工整。

e.en: {Neatness} matters when presenting your work to clients.
e.zh: 向客户展示作品时,整洁很重要。

neatnik.t: n. 爱整洁的人，洁癖者

e.en: My roommate is a total {neatnik} who alphabetizes the spices.
e.zh: 我室友是个超级洁癖,连香料都按字母排列。

e.en: As a {neatnik}, he can't sleep until the kitchen sparkles.
e.zh: 作为一个洁癖狂,他不把厨房擦得发亮就睡不着。

e.en: The bird used its sharp {neb} to crack open the seed.
e.zh: 那只鸟用尖利的喙啄开了种子。

e.en: Keep your {neb} out of other people's business.
e.zh: 别多管别人的闲事。

nebbish.t: n. 懦弱无能的人，窝囊废

e.en: The film's hero is a sweet {nebbish} who finds courage.
e.zh: 影片的主人公是个温柔懦弱却最终鼓起勇气的人。

e.en: Don't be such a {nebbish} — speak up for yourself.
e.zh: 别这么唯唯诺诺,为自己发声。

nebraska.t: n. 内布拉斯加州（美国）

e.en: My grandparents own a small farm in rural {Nebraska}.
e.zh: 我祖父母在内布拉斯加州的乡下有一个小农场。

e.en: {Nebraska} is famous for its vast cornfields and cattle ranches.
e.zh: 内布拉斯加州以广阔的玉米田和牛牧场而闻名。

e.en: The telescope captured a stunning image of the Orion {nebula}.
e.zh: 望远镜拍下了猎户座星云的壮观影像。

e.en: A {nebula} is a vast cloud of gas and dust in space.
e.zh: 星云是太空中由气体和尘埃组成的巨大云团。

e.en: The {nebular} hypothesis explains how our solar system formed.
e.zh: 星云假说解释了太阳系是如何形成的。

e.en: Astronomers studied the {nebular} gas clouds for years.
e.zh: 天文学家多年来一直研究星云气体云。

e.en: Faint {nebulosity} surrounds the bright young stars in the cluster.
e.zh: 星团中明亮的年轻恒星周围环绕着微弱的星云物质。

e.en: The image revealed faint {nebulosity} near the galaxy's core.
e.zh: 图像显示星系核心附近有微弱的星云气体。

e.en: His plans for the future remain rather {nebulous}.
e.zh: 他对未来的计划仍然相当模糊。

e.en: The contract used {nebulous} language that confused the lawyers.
e.zh: 合同使用了含糊不清的措辞,把律师们都搞糊涂了。

nec.t: abbr. necessary 的缩写；日本电气公司（NEC）

e.en: Every electrician must follow the {NEC} for safe installations.
e.zh: 每位电工都必须遵守国家电气规范以确保安装安全。

e.en: {NEC} manufactures projectors and large display screens worldwide.
e.zh: NEC在全球生产投影仪和大型显示屏。

e.en: Being expensive doesn't {necessarily} mean it's better quality.
e.zh: 价格昂贵并不一定意味着质量更好。

e.en: A high salary {necessarily} brings extra responsibility and stress.
e.zh: 高薪必然带来额外的责任和压力。

e.en: It's {necessary} to back up your files before updating.
e.zh: 更新之前备份文件是必要的。

e.en: Take whatever steps are {necessary} to finish on time.
e.zh: 采取一切必要的措施以按时完成。

e.en: Heavy rain may {necessitate} canceling the outdoor concert.
e.zh: 大雨可能迫使户外音乐会取消。

e.en: The new regulations {necessitate} additional staff training.
e.zh: 新规定要求进行额外的员工培训。

necessities.t: n. 必需品（necessity 的复数）

e.en: The shelter provides basic {necessities} like food and blankets.
e.zh: 收容所提供食物和毯子等基本生活必需品。

e.en: Pack only the {necessities} for a weekend backpacking trip.
e.zh: 周末徒步旅行只带必需品就够了。

e.en: The charity helps {necessitous} families afford winter heating.
e.zh: 该慈善机构帮助贫困家庭支付冬季取暖费用。

e.en: He grew up in {necessitous} circumstances but earned a scholarship.
e.zh: 他在贫困的环境中长大,但赢得了奖学金。

e.en: A reliable internet connection is a {necessity} for remote work.
e.zh: 可靠的网络连接是远程工作的必需品。

e.en: Out of {necessity}, she learned to cook simple meals.
e.zh: 出于必要,她学会了做简单的饭菜。

e.en: She wrapped a scarf around her {neck} before heading out.
e.zh: 她出门前在脖子上围了条围巾。

e.en: The {neck} of the bottle is too narrow for ice cubes.
e.zh: 瓶颈太窄，冰块塞不进去。

e.en: The shirt has a soft cotton {neckband} that won't itch.
e.zh: 这件衬衫的领口是柔软的纯棉，不会扎人。

e.en: She adjusted the embroidered {neckband} on her dress.
e.zh: 她整理了一下连衣裙上绣花的领口。

necked.t: adj. 有颈的（常用于合成词）

e.en: Giraffes are long-{necked} animals native to Africa.
e.zh: 长颈鹿是原产于非洲的长脖子动物。

e.en: She bought a V-{necked} sweater for the winter.
e.zh: 她买了一件 V 领毛衣过冬。

e.en: The scout tied a red {neckerchief} around his collar.
e.zh: 那名童子军在领口系了一条红色围巾。

e.en: She wore a silk {neckerchief} to complete her vintage look.
e.zh: 她系了一条丝质围巾来搭配复古造型。

e.en: He gave her a pearl {necklace} for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他在结婚纪念日送了她一条珍珠项链。

e.en: The gold {necklace} caught the light beautifully.
e.zh: 那条金项链在光线下闪闪发亮。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {necklaces} from local artisans.
e.zh: 这家店出售本地工匠手工制作的项链。

e.en: She keeps her {necklaces} organized in a velvet-lined box.
e.zh: 她把项链整齐地收在天鹅绒衬里的盒子里。

e.en: The dress has a low {neckline} that's perfect for summer.
e.zh: 这条裙子的低领口非常适合夏天穿。

e.en: She prefers a high {neckline} for professional meetings.
e.zh: 她在正式会议时更喜欢高领口的衣服。

e.en: The designer's statement {neckpiece} stole the runway show.
e.zh: 设计师那件夸张的颈饰成了走秀的焦点。

e.en: She paired a beaded {neckpiece} with her plain black dress.
e.zh: 她用一条串珠颈饰搭配那件简单的黑裙。

necks.t:
n. 脖子（复数）
v. 亲热（neck 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Swans have long, graceful {necks} that curve elegantly.
e.zh: 天鹅有着修长优雅、曲线柔美的脖子。

e.en: After the long drive, everyone's {necks} were stiff.
e.zh: 长途开车后，大家的脖子都僵了。

e.en: He loosened his {necktie} as soon as the meeting ended.
e.zh: 会议一结束他就松开了领带。

e.en: The store sells silk {necktie} sets for formal events.
e.zh: 这家店出售用于正式场合的丝质领带套装。

neckwear.t: n. 颈部服饰（领带、围巾等）

e.en: The boutique specializes in luxury men's {neckwear}.
e.zh: 这家精品店专营男士高级颈饰。

e.en: Bow ties and scarves are popular winter {neckwear}.
e.zh: 领结和围巾是冬季流行的颈部饰品。

e.en: In the game, the {necromancer} summons skeletons to fight.
e.zh: 在游戏里，亡灵法师会召唤骷髅作战。

e.en: The novel's villain is an ancient {necromancer} seeking power.
e.zh: 小说中的反派是一位渴求力量的远古通灵术士。

e.en: The wizard was banished for practicing forbidden {necromancy}.
e.zh: 那名巫师因施展禁忌的死灵术而被流放。

e.en: Most fantasy worlds treat {necromancy} as a dark art.
e.zh: 大多数奇幻世界都把通灵术视为黑暗法术。

e.en: The horror film was criticized for its disturbing {necrophilia} themes.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片因涉及恋尸癖等令人不安的主题而遭到批评。

e.en: Most legal systems classify {necrophilia} as a serious crime.
e.zh: 大多数法律体系都将恋尸行为列为重罪。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered an ancient {necropolis} beneath the city.
e.zh: 考古学家在城市下方发现了一座古代墓城。

e.en: The Egyptian {necropolis} contained dozens of royal tombs.
e.zh: 那座埃及墓城内有数十座王室陵墓。

necropsy.t:
n. (动物) 尸检
v. 解剖尸体

e.en: The vet performed a {necropsy} to determine the cause of death.
e.zh: 兽医做了一次尸检以确定死因。

e.en: Researchers ordered a {necropsy} on the stranded whale.
e.zh: 研究人员对那头搁浅的鲸鱼进行了尸检。

e.en: The doctor warned that untreated infection could cause tissue {necrosis}.
e.zh: 医生警告说感染若不治疗会导致组织坏死。

e.en: Frostbite can lead to {necrosis} of fingers and toes.
e.zh: 冻伤会导致手指和脚趾坏死。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {necrotic} tissue to save the patient's leg.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了坏死组织以保住病人的腿。

e.en: The wound showed signs of {necrotic} infection.
e.zh: 伤口出现了坏死性感染的迹象。

necrotizing.t: adj. 坏死性的（如坏死性筋膜炎）

e.en: {Necrotizing} fasciitis is a rare but deadly bacterial infection.
e.zh: 坏死性筋膜炎是一种罕见但致命的细菌感染。

e.en: Doctors raced to stop the {necrotizing} disease from spreading.
e.zh: 医生们争分夺秒阻止坏死性疾病扩散。

nectar.t:
n. 花蜜
n. 甘美的饮料

e.en: Bees collect {nectar} from flowers to make honey.
e.zh: 蜜蜂采集花蜜来酿造蜂蜜。

e.en: This peach juice tastes like pure {nectar}.
e.zh: 这桃汁喝起来就像纯粹的甘露。

e.en: She bit into a juicy {nectarine} on the picnic blanket.
e.zh: 她在野餐毯上咬了一口多汁的油桃。

e.en: The {nectarine} tree in our yard produces fruit each summer.
e.zh: 我们院子里的油桃树每年夏天都结果。

e.en: The juice bar offers tropical fruit {nectars} all summer.
e.zh: 这家果汁吧整个夏天都供应热带水果蜜饮。

e.en: Different flowers produce {nectars} with distinct flavors.
e.zh: 不同的花朵会产出风味各异的花蜜。

e.en: The children fed carrots to the gentle {neddy} on the farm.
e.zh: 孩子们在农场给那头温顺的小毛驴喂胡萝卜。

e.en: In the storybook, a stubborn {neddy} refuses to budge.
e.zh: 故事书里有一头倔强的小驴怎么都不肯动。

e.en: She studied design in {Nederland} for two years.
e.zh: 她在荷兰学习了两年设计。

e.en: Tulip fields in {Nederland} attract millions of tourists.
e.zh: 荷兰的郁金香花田每年吸引数百万游客。

nee.t: adj. 娘家姓为（用于已婚女性原姓前）

e.en: The invitation read: Mrs. Smith, {nee} Johnson.
e.zh: 请柬上写着：史密斯夫人，娘家姓约翰逊。

e.en: My grandmother, {nee} Chen, kept her maiden name privately.
e.zh: 我祖母娘家姓陈，私下里仍用着这个姓。

need.t:
v. 需要
n. 需求；必要

e.en: I {need} to charge my phone before the meeting.
e.zh: 我得在开会前给手机充电。

e.en: There's a real {need} for affordable housing in this city.
e.zh: 这座城市确实需要更多负担得起的住房。

needed.t:
v. 需要（过去式）
adj. 必需的

e.en: The team {needed} more time to finish the project properly.
e.zh: 团队需要更多时间才能把项目妥善完成。

e.en: She got the help she desperately {needed} from her friends.
e.zh: 她从朋友那里得到了急需的帮助。

e.en: Please do the {needful} and forward the documents today.
e.zh: 请按需处理，今天把文件转发出去。

e.en: The charity provides food to {needful} families each winter.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构每年冬天向贫困家庭提供食物。

needier.t: adj. 更贫困的；更渴求关爱的

e.en: Her cat became {needier} after the move to a new home.
e.zh: 搬到新家后，她的猫变得更黏人了。

e.en: The shelter prioritizes the {needier} families first.
e.zh: 救助站优先帮助更困难的家庭。

neediness.t: n. 贫困；对关爱的渴求

e.en: His constant texting revealed an underlying {neediness}.
e.zh: 他不停发短信暴露了内心的依赖感。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage feelings of {neediness} in relationships.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她处理在感情中过度依赖的情绪。

e.en: She woke up {needing} a strong cup of coffee.
e.zh: 她醒来时特别想来一杯浓咖啡。

e.en: The old house is {needing} major repairs this year.
e.zh: 这栋老房子今年需要大修。

needle.t:
n. 针；指针
v. 刺激；激怒

e.en: Be careful not to prick your finger with the {needle}.
e.zh: 小心别让针扎到手指。

e.en: The compass {needle} always points north.
e.zh: 指南针的指针始终指向北方。

needlepoint.t: n. 针绣花边；绣花工艺

e.en: Her grandmother taught her {needlepoint} when she was eight.
e.zh: 她八岁时祖母教她做绣花针绣。

e.en: The pillow features intricate {needlepoint} of a garden scene.
e.zh: 那个抱枕上有一幅精致的花园针绣图案。

needles.t:
n. 针（复数）
v. 刺激（第三人称）

e.en: Pine {needles} covered the forest floor in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天，松针铺满了林间地面。

e.en: The nurse prepared two clean {needles} for the vaccinations.
e.zh: 护士为接种疫苗准备了两根干净的针头。

e.en: The argument caused {needless} stress for everyone involved.
e.zh: 那场争吵给所有人都带来了不必要的压力。

e.en: {Needless} to say, the project was delayed again.
e.zh: 不用说，项目又被推迟了。

e.en: Don't worry {needlessly} about things you cannot control.
e.zh: 不要为你无法控制的事白白担心。

e.en: The contract was {needlessly} complicated for a simple agreement.
e.zh: 对于这么简单的协议，合同写得过于复杂。

needlewoman.t: n. 女裁缝；做针线活的女子

e.en: Her great-aunt was a skilled {needlewoman} in the village.
e.zh: 她的姑婆是村里手艺精湛的女裁缝。

e.en: The {needlewoman} embroidered the wedding gown by hand.
e.zh: 那位绣娘亲手绣制了那件婚纱。

e.en: The museum displays Victorian {needlework} from private collections.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自私人收藏的维多利亚时期刺绣作品。

e.en: She relaxes by doing {needlework} in the evenings.
e.zh: 她晚上以做针线活来放松心情。

e.en: Stop {needling} your brother about his haircut.
e.zh: 别再拿你弟弟的发型挖苦他了。

e.en: His constant {needling} finally made her snap.
e.zh: 他不停地挑刺终于让她爆发了。

needs.t:
n. 需求（复数）
v. 需要（第三人称）

e.en: Every child {needs} love, food, and a safe home.
e.zh: 每个孩子都需要爱、食物和安全的家。

e.en: The product addresses the basic {needs} of busy parents.
e.zh: 这款产品满足了忙碌父母的基本需求。

needy.t: adj. 贫困的；渴求关爱的

e.en: The charity collects donations for {needy} families during the holidays.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构在节假日为贫困家庭募捐。

e.en: My ex was emotionally {needy} and exhausting to date.
e.zh: 我前任在情感上太黏人，谈起恋爱让人精疲力竭。

e.en: {Neem} oil is a natural pesticide for organic gardens.
e.zh: 印楝油是有机花园常用的天然杀虫剂。

e.en: In India, {neem} leaves are traditionally used for skin care.
e.zh: 在印度，印楝叶传统上被用来护肤。

e.en: The hacker had {nefarious} plans to steal user data.
e.zh: 那名黑客图谋不轨，想要窃取用户数据。

e.en: Detectives uncovered the gang's {nefarious} smuggling operation.
e.zh: 侦探们揭露了该团伙邪恶的走私活动。

e.en: One bad review can {negate} months of hard work.
e.zh: 一条差评就能抵消几个月的辛苦付出。

e.en: Adding sugar would {negate} the health benefits of the drink.
e.zh: 加糖会抵消这款饮料的健康功效。

e.en: In English, "not" is the most common form of {negation}.
e.zh: 在英语中，"not"是最常见的否定形式。

e.en: His silence felt like a {negation} of everything he'd promised.
e.zh: 他的沉默就像否定了他曾经承诺的一切。

negative.t:
adj. 负面的；否定的
n. 负数；底片

e.en: The test came back {negative}, so she's not infected.
e.zh: 检测结果呈阴性，所以她没有感染。

e.en: Try not to dwell on {negative} thoughts before sleeping.
e.zh: 睡觉前尽量不要纠结于负面想法。

e.en: Lack of sleep affects mood {negatively} over time.
e.zh: 长期睡眠不足会对情绪产生负面影响。

e.en: The news was received {negatively} by most investors.
e.zh: 这条消息受到了大多数投资者的负面反应。

negatives.t: n. 负面因素；底片（复数）

e.en: Every job has its {negatives}, but I still love mine.
e.zh: 每份工作都有缺点，但我依然热爱我的工作。

e.en: She found her old film {negatives} in a dusty drawer.
e.zh: 她在一个落满灰尘的抽屉里找到旧胶片底片。

negativism.t: n. 消极主义；否定态度

e.en: Her constant {negativism} made it hard to plan anything.
e.zh: 她总是消极看待事情，让大家很难做任何计划。

e.en: The coach refused to tolerate {negativism} in the locker room.
e.zh: 教练绝不容忍更衣室里出现消极情绪。

e.en: Try to avoid {negativity} on social media before bed.
e.zh: 睡前尽量避免接触社交媒体上的负能量。

e.en: His {negativity} brought down the whole team's morale.
e.zh: 他的消极态度让整个团队士气低落。

negev.t: n. 内盖夫沙漠（以色列南部）

e.en: The {Negev} desert covers more than half of southern Israel.
e.zh: 内盖夫沙漠覆盖了以色列南部一半以上的地区。

e.en: They drove through the {Negev} on their way to Eilat.
e.zh: 他们驱车穿过内盖夫前往埃拉特。

neglect.t:
v. 忽视；疏忽
n. 疏忽；失职

e.en: Don't {neglect} your health while chasing career goals.
e.zh: 追求事业目标时不要忽视自己的健康。

e.en: The old building fell into {neglect} after the company moved out.
e.zh: 公司搬走后那栋旧楼便无人打理。

neglected.t:
adj. 被忽视的
v. 忽视（过去式）

e.en: He {neglected} to mention that the deadline had changed.
e.zh: 他没提到截止日期已经改了。

e.en: The garden looked {neglected} after months without care.
e.zh: 花园好几个月没人打理,显得荒废了。

neglectful.t: adj. 疏忽的；玩忽职守的

e.en: She felt {neglectful} for missing her son's recital.
e.zh: 她错过了儿子的演奏会,觉得很愧疚。

e.en: The report criticized {neglectful} parents in the case.
e.zh: 报告批评了案中那些疏于照管的父母。

e.en: He's been {neglecting} his emails for weeks.
e.zh: 他已经好几周没看邮件了。

e.en: By focusing on profit, the company is {neglecting} customer service.
e.zh: 公司只顾利润,忽视了客户服务。

e.en: She often {neglects} to lock the front door.
e.zh: 她常常忘记锁前门。

e.en: The article {neglects} important counterarguments.
e.zh: 这篇文章忽略了重要的反驳意见。

e.en: She wore a silk {negligee} to bed.
e.zh: 她穿着真丝睡袍上床。

e.en: The boutique sells lace {negligee} sets online.
e.zh: 这家精品店在网上出售蕾丝睡袍套装。

e.en: The hospital was sued for medical {negligence}.
e.zh: 这家医院因医疗过失被起诉。

e.en: His {negligence} caused the entire server to crash.
e.zh: 他的疏忽导致整个服务器崩溃。

e.en: The driver was found {negligent} in the accident.
e.zh: 司机被认定在事故中存在过失。

e.en: It would be {negligent} to ignore these warning signs.
e.zh: 忽视这些警示信号就是失职。

e.en: The contractor {negligently} left wires exposed in the wall.
e.zh: 承包商粗心地把电线裸露在墙里。

e.en: She tossed her keys {negligently} onto the table.
e.zh: 她随手把钥匙扔在桌上。

negligible.t: adj. 可忽略的；微不足道的

e.en: The performance difference between the two phones is {negligible}.
e.zh: 两款手机之间的性能差异微乎其微。

e.en: The risk of side effects is {negligible} at this dose.
e.zh: 在这个剂量下,副作用的风险可以忽略不计。

e.en: Battery life is {negligibly} affected by the new update.
e.zh: 新更新对电池续航的影响微乎其微。

e.en: Prices rose only {negligibly} over the past quarter.
e.zh: 过去一个季度价格只是微幅上涨。

negotiable.t: adj. 可协商的；可转让的

e.en: The salary is {negotiable} for the right candidate.
e.zh: 对合适的人选,薪水可以面议。

e.en: Our deadline is firm and not {negotiable}.
e.zh: 我们的截止日期是硬性规定,不能商量。

e.en: We need to {negotiate} better terms with the supplier.
e.zh: 我们得跟供应商谈个更好的条件。

e.en: The hikers had to {negotiate} a steep, rocky trail.
e.zh: 徒步者们必须小心走过一条陡峭多石的小路。

e.en: The two companies {negotiated} a merger last spring.
e.zh: 两家公司在去年春天谈成了合并。

e.en: She skillfully {negotiated} a higher starting salary.
e.zh: 她巧妙地谈到了更高的起薪。

negotiates.t: v. 谈判（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our agent {negotiates} contracts on behalf of the artists.
e.zh: 我们的经纪人代表艺术家们谈合同。

e.en: The app {negotiates} the connection automatically in the background.
e.zh: 该应用在后台自动协商连接。

negotiating.t:
v. 谈判（进行时）
adj. 谈判的

e.en: They are still {negotiating} the final price.
e.zh: 他们还在谈最终价格。

e.en: Diplomats spent weeks {negotiating} a ceasefire.
e.zh: 外交官们花了数周时间协商停火协议。

e.en: After hours of {negotiation}, they reached an agreement.
e.zh: 经过数小时谈判,他们达成了协议。

e.en: Salary {negotiation} can feel intimidating for new graduates.
e.zh: 对应届毕业生来说,薪资谈判可能令人发怵。

e.en: Trade {negotiations} between the two countries broke down.
e.zh: 两国之间的贸易谈判破裂了。

e.en: The union entered {negotiations} with management this morning.
e.zh: 工会今早开始与资方进行谈判。

e.en: She's the lead {negotiator} for our acquisition team.
e.zh: 她是我们并购团队的首席谈判代表。

e.en: A skilled hostage {negotiator} arrived at the scene.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的人质谈判专家到达了现场。

negress.t: n. 黑人女性（冒犯性旧词）

e.en: The term {negress} is now considered offensive and outdated.
e.zh: "negress"一词如今被视为冒犯且过时的称呼。

e.en: Older novels sometimes used the word {negress} for Black women.
e.zh: 早期小说有时用"negress"指代黑人女性。

negritude.t: n. 黑人文化认同（文学运动）

e.en: Senghor was a leading voice of the {Negritude} movement.
e.zh: 桑戈尔是黑人性运动的主要代表人物。

e.en: {Negritude} celebrated Black identity and African culture.
e.zh: 黑人性思潮颂扬黑人身份和非洲文化。

negro.t: n. 黑人（旧用，现多冒犯）

e.en: The word {Negro} is now mostly avoided in modern English.
e.zh: "Negro"一词在现代英语中大多避免使用。

e.en: Old census forms once listed {Negro} as a category.
e.zh: 旧的人口普查表上曾把"Negro"列为一个类别。

negroid.t: adj. 黑种人的（旧人类学术语）

e.en: The term {Negroid} is outdated and rarely used today.
e.zh: "Negroid"这个词已经过时,如今很少使用。

e.en: Older anthropology texts grouped people as {Negroid} or Caucasoid.
e.zh: 早期人类学文献把人群分为黑色人种或白色人种。

nehru.t: n. 尼赫鲁（印度首任总理）

e.en: {Nehru} served as India's first prime minister.
e.zh: 尼赫鲁是印度首任总理。

e.en: He wore a classic {Nehru} jacket to the ceremony.
e.zh: 他穿着一件经典的尼赫鲁式立领上衣出席典礼。

neigh.t:
v. 马嘶叫
n. 马的嘶鸣声

e.en: The horse let out a loud {neigh} from the stable.
e.zh: 那匹马在马厩里发出响亮的嘶鸣。

e.en: I could hear ponies {neigh} across the field at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨我能听见小马在田野那头嘶叫。

neighbor.t:
n. 邻居
v. 邻近；毗邻

e.en: My {neighbor} brought over cookies when we moved in.
e.zh: 我们搬来时邻居送来了饼干。

e.en: China is Japan's largest trading {neighbor}.
e.zh: 中国是日本最大的邻国贸易伙伴。

e.en: We just moved into a quiet {neighborhood} near the park.
e.zh: 我们刚搬进公园附近一个安静的小区。

e.en: The price is in the {neighborhood} of fifty dollars.
e.zh: 价格大约在五十美元上下。

e.en: Several {neighborhoods} were flooded after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后几个社区被淹了。

e.en: The app shows the safest {neighborhoods} for renters.
e.zh: 这款应用会显示最适合租房的安全社区。

e.en: Refugees crossed into {neighboring} countries seeking safety.
e.zh: 难民们越境进入邻国寻求庇护。

e.en: A fire spread quickly to the {neighboring} buildings.
e.zh: 大火迅速蔓延到旁边的建筑物。

e.en: The town is famous for its warmth and {neighborliness}.
e.zh: 这个小镇以热情和睦邻友好闻名。

e.en: A little {neighborliness} goes a long way in apartment life.
e.zh: 在公寓生活里,一点睦邻之情就大有助益。

e.en: It was very {neighborly} of him to shovel my driveway.
e.zh: 他帮我铲车道上的雪,真有邻里情。

e.en: They keep a {neighborly} relationship despite political differences.
e.zh: 尽管政见不同,他们仍保持着友好的邻里关系。

e.en: Our {neighbors} throw a barbecue every Fourth of July.
e.zh: 我们的邻居每年独立日都办烧烤聚会。

e.en: India and its {neighbors} signed a new trade deal.
e.zh: 印度和邻国签署了新的贸易协议。

e.en: My {neighbour} watered the plants while I was abroad.
e.zh: 我出国时邻居帮我浇了花。

e.en: France is the UK's closest European {neighbour}.
e.zh: 法国是英国最近的欧洲邻国。

neighbourhood.t: n. 街区；邻里（英式拼写）

e.en: This is the trendiest {neighbourhood} in London right now.
e.zh: 这是目前伦敦最潮的街区。

e.en: Property prices in our {neighbourhood} have doubled.
e.zh: 我们这一带的房价已经翻了一番。

e.en: Many London {neighbourhoods} have their own distinct character.
e.zh: 伦敦许多街区都有各自独特的风貌。

e.en: Police patrols increased in {neighbourhoods} hit by burglaries.
e.zh: 在频发入室盗窃的街区,警察加强了巡逻。

e.en: Smoke from the fire reached {neighbouring} towns.
e.zh: 火灾的浓烟飘到了邻近的城镇。

e.en: She works in a hospital in the {neighbouring} county.
e.zh: 她在邻郡的一家医院工作。

neighbourliness.t: n. 睦邻友好（英式拼写）

e.en: The village still values old-fashioned {neighbourliness}.
e.zh: 这个村子仍看重传统的睦邻情谊。

e.en: Sharing tools is a small act of {neighbourliness}.
e.zh: 互相借工具是一种小小的睦邻举动。

neighbourly.t: adj. 邻里友善的（英式拼写）

e.en: Lending us your ladder was very {neighbourly} of you.
e.zh: 把梯子借给我们,你真是有邻里之情。

e.en: They exchanged {neighbourly} greetings every morning.
e.zh: 他们每天早晨都友好地互致问候。

e.en: The {neighbours} complained about loud music last night.
e.zh: 邻居们抱怨昨晚音乐太吵。

e.en: Our new {neighbours} have two friendly dogs.
e.zh: 我们的新邻居养了两只很亲人的狗。

neither.t:
adv. 两者都不
conj. 既不…也不

e.en: {Neither} option really fits what we need.
e.zh: 两个选项其实都不太符合我们的需求。

e.en: I don't drink coffee, and {neither} does my wife.
e.zh: 我不喝咖啡,我太太也不喝。

e.en: The wrestler trapped his opponent in a half {nelson}.
e.zh: 那位摔跤手用半纳尔逊锁制住了对手。

e.en: Admiral {Nelson} is honored at Trafalgar Square in London.
e.zh: 伦敦特拉法加广场是为纪念纳尔逊将军而建。

e.en: Scientists study the {nematode} as a simple model organism.
e.zh: 科学家们把线虫作为一种简单的模式生物来研究。

e.en: A {nematode} infestation can quickly damage tomato roots.
e.zh: 线虫感染会很快损害番茄的根系。

e.en: Math has always been my academic {nemesis}.
e.zh: 数学一直是我学习上的天敌。

e.en: Batman finally confronted his old {nemesis}, the Joker.
e.zh: 蝙蝠侠终于直面他的老对头小丑。

nemo.t: n. 尼莫（常指电影《海底总动员》角色）

e.en: {Nemo} is the little clownfish in the famous Pixar film.
e.zh: 尼莫是皮克斯著名电影里那只小丑鱼。

e.en: Captain {Nemo} commands the Nautilus in Verne's novel.
e.zh: 在凡尔纳的小说中,尼莫船长驾驶着"鹦鹉螺号"。

e.en: The {nene} is the official state bird of Hawaii.
e.zh: 夏威夷雁是夏威夷州的州鸟。

e.en: Conservationists worked hard to save the {nene} from extinction.
e.zh: 环保人士努力让夏威夷雁免于灭绝。

e.en: {Neo} takes the red pill in the iconic Matrix scene.
e.zh: 在《黑客帝国》经典场景里,尼奥吞下了红色药丸。

e.en: The café has a fun {neo}-retro design.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有种有趣的新复古风设计。

e.en: The museum features a grand {neoclassic} façade with tall columns.
e.zh: 博物馆有一座带高大圆柱的宏伟新古典主义外立面。

e.en: His symphony has a clean, {neoclassic} feel.
e.zh: 他的交响曲有一种简洁的新古典主义韵味。

e.en: The capitol building is a fine example of {neoclassical} architecture.
e.zh: 国会大厦是新古典主义建筑的典范。

e.en: {Neoclassical} economics still dominates many university textbooks.
e.zh: 新古典经济学至今仍主导着许多大学教材。

neoclassicism.t: n. 新古典主义（艺术流派）

e.en: {Neoclassicism} drew inspiration from ancient Greek and Roman art.
e.zh: 新古典主义从古希腊罗马艺术中汲取灵感。

e.en: Stravinsky later embraced {neoclassicism} in his compositions.
e.zh: 斯特拉文斯基后来在创作中拥抱了新古典主义。

neocon.t: n. 新保守主义者（美国政治）

e.en: The article criticized {neocon} foreign policy ideas from the early 2000s.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了2000年代初的新保守派外交政策理念。

e.en: He's a former {neocon} who now writes for liberal magazines.
e.zh: 他曾是新保守派,如今为自由派杂志撰稿。

neoconservative.t:
n. 新保守主义者
adj. 新保守主义的

e.en: The {neoconservative} movement gained influence during the Bush administration.
e.zh: 新保守主义运动在布什政府时期获得了影响力。

e.en: She rejected the {neoconservative} approach to military intervention abroad.
e.zh: 她反对新保守派对外军事干预的做法。

e.en: The human {neocortex} handles language and abstract reasoning.
e.zh: 人类的新皮层负责语言和抽象推理。

e.en: Scientists study how the {neocortex} processes visual information.
e.zh: 科学家研究新皮层如何处理视觉信息。

e.en: Strong {neodymium} magnets are used in headphones and hard drives.
e.zh: 强力钕磁铁被用于耳机和硬盘中。

e.en: The factory imports {neodymium} for manufacturing wind turbine motors.
e.zh: 工厂进口钕用于制造风力涡轮机电机。

neoliberal.t:
adj. 新自由主义的
n. 新自由主义者

e.en: Critics argue {neoliberal} policies widened income inequality globally.
e.zh: 批评者认为新自由主义政策加剧了全球收入不平等。

e.en: The think tank promotes {neoliberal} ideas about free markets.
e.zh: 该智库推广关于自由市场的新自由主义理念。

neoliberalism.t: n. 新自由主义（经济思潮）

e.en: The book traces the rise of {neolialism} since the 1980s.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了自1980年代以来新自由主义的兴起。

e.en: Many scholars blame {neoliberalism} for shrinking public services.
e.zh: 许多学者将公共服务的萎缩归咎于新自由主义。

nested.t:
adj. 嵌套的（结构、代码）
v. 筑巢

e.en: The function uses several {nested} if statements.
e.zh: 该函数使用了多个嵌套的if语句。

e.en: Two eagles {nested} on the cliff last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天,两只老鹰在悬崖上筑了巢。

nester.t: n. 筑巢的动物；定居者

e.en: Empty {nester} parents often travel after their kids leave home.
e.zh: 空巢父母在孩子离家后常常去旅行。

e.en: He's a homebody, a real {nester} who loves decorating.
e.zh: 他是个宅男,真正喜欢布置家的居家型人。

nesting.t:
n. 嵌套（数据、结构）
v. 筑巢

e.en: Birds are {nesting} in the eaves of our roof.
e.zh: 鸟儿们正在我们屋檐下筑巢。

e.en: Avoid deep {nesting} of loops to keep code readable.
e.zh: 避免循环嵌套过深,以保持代码可读性。

e.en: The kittens {nestle} together for warmth.
e.zh: 小猫们依偎在一起取暖。

e.en: Small cottages {nestle} at the foot of the mountain.
e.zh: 小屋依偎在山脚下。

e.en: The village is {nestled} between two green hills.
e.zh: 这个村庄坐落在两座青山之间。

e.en: She {nestled} her head against his shoulder.
e.zh: 她把头依偎在他的肩膀上。

nestling.t:
n. 雏鸟
v. 依偎

e.en: The {nestling} chirped loudly for its mother.
e.zh: 那只雏鸟大声啁啾呼唤母亲。

e.en: The baby was {nestling} into her father's arms.
e.zh: 婴儿正依偎进父亲的怀里。

e.en: He's the {nestor} of modern jazz, respected by all.
e.zh: 他是现代爵士乐的泰斗,受所有人尊敬。

e.en: Professor Lee is the {nestor} of our research department.
e.zh: 李教授是我们研究部门的元老。

nests.t:
n. 鸟巢（复数）
v. 筑巢

e.en: Sea turtles return to the same beach to build their {nests}.
e.zh: 海龟会回到同一片海滩筑巢。

e.en: The hacker discovered several {nests} of malicious code.
e.zh: 黑客发现了几处恶意代码的藏匿点。

net.t:
n. 网；网络
adj. 净的（净额、净值）

e.en: The fisherman cast his {net} into the river.
e.zh: 渔夫把网撒入河中。

e.en: Her {net} salary after taxes is quite generous.
e.zh: 她税后的净工资相当可观。

netball.t: n. 无挡板篮球（英式运动）

e.en: She plays {netball} for her university team every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都为大学队打无挡板篮球。

e.en: {Netball} is hugely popular in Australia and New Zealand.
e.zh: 无挡板篮球在澳大利亚和新西兰非常流行。

e.en: Demons emerged from the {nether} regions of the cave.
e.zh: 恶魔从洞穴的下层区域出现。

e.en: In Minecraft, players travel to the {Nether} for rare resources.
e.zh: 在《我的世界》中,玩家前往下界获取稀有资源。

e.en: The novel "{Netherland}" explores immigrant life in New York.
e.zh: 小说《荷兰》探索了纽约的移民生活。

e.en: He bought a rare {Netherland} dwarf rabbit as a pet.
e.zh: 他买了一只稀有的荷兰侏儒兔当宠物。

e.en: Amsterdam is the capital of the {Netherlands}.
e.zh: 阿姆斯特丹是荷兰的首都。

e.en: Tulips and windmills are iconic symbols of the {Netherlands}.
e.zh: 郁金香和风车是荷兰的标志性象征。

nethermost.t: adj. 最下面的；最底层的

e.en: They explored the {nethermost} chambers of the ancient tomb.
e.zh: 他们探索了古墓最深处的墓室。

e.en: The submarine reached the {nethermost} depths of the trench.
e.zh: 潜艇抵达了海沟的最底层。

e.en: Greek myths describe Hades ruling the {netherworld}.
e.zh: 希腊神话描述哈迪斯统治着冥界。

e.en: The detective entered the city's criminal {netherworld}.
e.zh: 侦探深入了这座城市的犯罪黑社会。

e.en: Good {netiquette} means avoiding ALL CAPS in emails.
e.zh: 良好的网络礼仪意味着避免在邮件中全用大写字母。

e.en: The forum has clear {netiquette} rules for new members.
e.zh: 该论坛对新成员有明确的网络礼仪规则。

nets.t:
n. 网（复数）
v. 用网捕获

e.en: Fishermen mended their {nets} on the dock.
e.zh: 渔民们在码头上修补渔网。

e.en: The Brooklyn {Nets} won last night's basketball game.
e.zh: 布鲁克林篮网队赢得了昨晚的篮球比赛。

nett.t: adj. 净的（net 的英式拼写）

e.en: The {nett} weight of the package is 2 kilograms.
e.zh: 该包裹的净重为2公斤。

e.en: Calculate the {nett} profit after deducting all expenses.
e.zh: 扣除所有费用后计算净利润。

e.en: The investment {netted} him a tidy profit last year.
e.zh: 这项投资去年为他赚得了一笔可观的利润。

e.en: She {netted} a huge fish at the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天在湖边网到了一条大鱼。

e.en: He's a skilled {netter} who rarely misses a catch.
e.zh: 他是个熟练的网捕者,很少捕空。

e.en: The young {netter} won the local fishing competition.
e.zh: 那位年轻的捕鱼者赢得了当地的钓鱼比赛。

e.en: We covered the berries with {netting} to keep birds away.
e.zh: 我们用网罩住浆果以防鸟儿啄食。

e.en: The company is {netting} record profits this quarter.
e.zh: 该公司本季度获得了创纪录的净利润。

nettle.t:
n. 荨麻
v. 激怒

e.en: Don't touch that {nettle} or you'll get a rash.
e.zh: 别碰那株荨麻,否则你会起疹子。

e.en: His rude comments {nettle} her every time.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的评论每次都让她恼火。

e.en: The bug fix turned out to be quite {nettlesome}.
e.zh: 修复这个bug结果相当令人头疼。

e.en: Privacy laws are a {nettlesome} issue for tech companies.
e.zh: 隐私法对科技公司来说是个棘手的问题。

netware.t: n. 网络操作系统（Novell 产品）

e.en: Many older offices once relied on Novell {NetWare} servers.
e.zh: 许多老旧办公室曾经依赖Novell网络操作系统服务器。

e.en: {NetWare} was a dominant network OS in the 1990s.
e.zh: NetWare在1990年代是主流的网络操作系统。

network.t:
n. 网络
v. 建立人脉

e.en: The Wi-Fi {network} is down again this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上Wi-Fi网络又断了。

e.en: You should {network} more at industry conferences.
e.zh: 你应该在行业会议上多结识人脉。

networked.t:
adj. 联网的
v. 建立了人脉

e.en: All the office printers are {networked} for easy access.
e.zh: 所有办公室打印机都已联网,方便使用。

e.en: She {networked} aggressively at the startup conference.
e.zh: 她在创业大会上积极地拓展人脉。

networker.t: n. 善于建立人脉者；网络工作者

e.en: He's a natural {networker} who knows everyone in tech.
e.zh: 他是天生善于交际的人,认识科技圈的所有人。

e.en: Successful {networker} types build relationships before needing them.
e.zh: 成功的人脉达人会在需要之前就建立关系。

e.en: {Networking} events help job seekers find opportunities.
e.zh: 社交活动帮助求职者寻找机会。

e.en: He studied {networking} protocols for his certification exam.
e.zh: 他为认证考试学习了网络协议。

networks.t:
n. 网络（复数）
v. 联网

e.en: Social {networks} have transformed how we communicate.
e.zh: 社交网络改变了我们的沟通方式。

e.en: The company operates two private fiber {networks}.
e.zh: 该公司运营着两个私有光纤网络。

e.en: The font Helvetica {Neue} is widely used in design.
e.zh: Helvetica Neue字体在设计中被广泛使用。

e.en: "{Neue}" is German for "new" and appears in many brand names.
e.zh: "Neue"在德语中意为"新",出现在许多品牌名中。

neural.t: adj. 神经的；神经网络的

e.en: {Neural} networks power most modern AI systems.
e.zh: 神经网络驱动着大多数现代人工智能系统。

e.en: The injury damaged several {neural} pathways in his brain.
e.zh: 这次受伤损害了他大脑中的几条神经通路。

e.en: She suffers from chronic facial {neuralgia} after the surgery.
