e.zh: 手术后她患上了慢性面部神经痛。

e.en: The doctor prescribed medication for his {neuralgia}.
e.zh: 医生为他的神经痛开了药。

e.en: He felt sharp {neuralgic} pain shooting down his arm.
e.zh: 他感到剧烈的神经痛沿着手臂向下蔓延。

e.en: Cold weather often triggers her {neuralgic} symptoms.
e.zh: 寒冷天气常常引发她的神经痛症状。

e.en: Victorian doctors often diagnosed exhausted patients with {neurasthenia}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生常将疲惫的病人诊断为神经衰弱。

e.en: Modern psychology rarely uses the term {neurasthenia} anymore.
e.zh: 现代心理学几乎不再使用神经衰弱这个术语。

neurasthenic.t:
adj. 神经衰弱的
n. 神经衰弱者

e.en: The novel describes a {neurasthenic} young woman in 1890s Paris.
e.zh: 小说描写了一位1890年代巴黎的神经衰弱年轻女性。

e.en: He had a pale, {neurasthenic} look after months of overwork.
e.zh: 几个月的过度工作后,他面色苍白,神经衰弱。

e.en: Optic {neuritis} can cause sudden vision loss.
e.zh: 视神经炎可能导致突然的视力丧失。

e.en: The diabetic patient developed peripheral {neuritis} in his feet.
e.zh: 这位糖尿病患者的脚部发展为周围神经炎。

e.en: Medical students study {neuroanatomy} during their second year.
e.zh: 医学生在第二年学习神经解剖学。

e.en: Her research focuses on the {neuroanatomy} of memory formation.
e.zh: 她的研究专注于记忆形成的神经解剖学。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {neurobehavioral} disorders in children.
e.zh: 该诊所专门治疗儿童神经行为障碍。

e.en: Researchers studied the {neurobehavioral} effects of sleep deprivation.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了睡眠剥夺的神经行为影响。

e.en: Depression has clear {neurobiological} underpinnings, scientists say.
e.zh: 科学家说,抑郁症有明确的神经生物学基础。

e.en: The study explored {neurobiological} differences between twins.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了双胞胎之间的神经生物学差异。

e.en: The {neurobiologist} discovered a new type of brain cell.
e.zh: 这位神经生物学家发现了一种新型脑细胞。

e.en: She trained as a {neurobiologist} before joining the AI lab.
e.zh: 她在加入人工智能实验室之前接受过神经生物学家的训练。

e.en: Advances in {neurobiology} are revolutionizing mental health treatment.
e.zh: 神经生物学的进展正在革新心理健康治疗。

e.en: He earned his PhD in {neurobiology} at Stanford.
e.zh: 他在斯坦福大学获得了神经生物学博士学位。

neurochemical.t:
adj. 神经化学的
n. 神经化学物质

e.en: Serotonin is a {neurochemical} that affects mood.
e.zh: 血清素是一种影响情绪的神经化学物质。

e.en: Stress causes significant {neurochemical} changes in the brain.
e.zh: 压力会引起大脑中显著的神经化学变化。

e.en: Understanding {neurochemistry} is key to developing better antidepressants.
e.zh: 理解神经化学是开发更好抗抑郁药物的关键。

e.en: Her lab studies the {neurochemistry} of addiction.
e.zh: 她的实验室研究成瘾的神经化学。

e.en: Alzheimer's is a common {neurodegenerative} disease in older adults.
e.zh: 阿尔茨海默症是老年人常见的神经退行性疾病。

e.en: Researchers seek treatments for {neurodegenerative} conditions like Parkinson's.
e.zh: 研究人员正在寻找帕金森病等神经退行性疾病的治疗方法。

e.en: Autism is classified as a {neurodevelopmental} disorder.
e.zh: 自闭症被归类为神经发育障碍。

e.en: Early intervention helps children with {neurodevelopmental} delays.
e.zh: 早期干预有助于神经发育迟缓的儿童。

e.en: The hypothalamus plays a key role in the {neuroendocrine} system.
e.zh: 下丘脑在神经内分泌系统中起关键作用。

e.en: Doctors found a rare {neuroendocrine} tumor during the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描中发现了一个罕见的神经内分泌肿瘤。

e.en: The MRI revealed a small {neurofibroma} along the spinal nerve.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示脊神经旁有一个小的神经纤维瘤。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {neurofibroma} without damaging nearby nerves.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了神经纤维瘤，未损伤周围神经。

e.en: Her son was diagnosed with {neurofibromatosis} at age six.
e.zh: 她儿子六岁时被诊断出患有神经纤维瘤病。

e.en: {Neurofibromatosis} can cause tumors to grow on nerve tissue.
e.zh: 神经纤维瘤病可能导致神经组织上长出肿瘤。

e.en: The doctor suspected a {neurogenic} cause for the bladder problems.
e.zh: 医生怀疑膀胱问题是神经源性的。

e.en: Chronic pain can sometimes be {neurogenic} in origin.
e.zh: 慢性疼痛有时源于神经系统。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered a {neolithic} village near the river.
e.zh: 考古学家在河边发现了一个新石器时代的村落。

e.en: Farming began during the {neolithic} period thousands of years ago.
e.zh: 农业起源于数千年前的新石器时代。

e.en: The word "selfie" was once considered a silly {neologism}.
e.zh: "自拍"一词曾被视为一个滑稽的新造词。

e.en: Tech culture constantly generates new {neologism} like "doomscrolling".
e.zh: 科技文化不断产生像"末日刷屏"这样的新词。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a cream containing {neomycin} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生开了一种含新霉素的药膏来治疗感染。

e.en: Some patients are allergic to {neomycin} found in eye drops.
e.zh: 有些患者对眼药水中的新霉素过敏。

neon.t:
n. 氖气
adj. 霓虹（灯）的

e.en: The bar's bright {neon} sign flickered all night.
e.zh: 酒吧那块明亮的霓虹招牌闪烁了一整夜。

e.en: She wore a {neon} green jacket to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿了一件荧光绿夹克去看演唱会。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {neonatal} intensive care unit last month.
e.zh: 医院上月开设了一个新的新生儿重症监护病房。

e.en: She works as a {neonatal} nurse caring for premature babies.
e.zh: 她是一名新生儿护士,照顾早产婴儿。

e.en: The {neonate} weighed only two kilograms at birth.
e.zh: 这名新生儿出生时仅重两公斤。

e.en: Doctors monitor every {neonate} closely in the first hours.
e.zh: 医生在最初几小时密切监测每一名新生儿。

e.en: She specialized in {neonatology} after finishing her pediatric residency.
e.zh: 她完成儿科住院医师培训后专攻新生儿医学。

e.en: Advances in {neonatology} have saved countless premature infants.
e.zh: 新生儿医学的进步拯救了无数早产婴儿。

e.en: As a {neophyte} programmer, he found the syntax confusing.
e.zh: 作为编程新手,他觉得语法很难懂。

e.en: The chess club welcomes both masters and {neophyte} players.
e.zh: 该象棋俱乐部欢迎大师和新手棋手加入。

e.en: The workshop is designed for complete {neophytes} to photography.
e.zh: 这个工作坊专为摄影完全新手设计。

e.en: Even {neophytes} can build a website with this drag-and-drop tool.
e.zh: 即使是新手也能用这个拖拽工具搭建网站。

neoplasia.t: n. 新生物形成；肿瘤病变

e.en: The biopsy revealed signs of early {neoplasia} in the tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示组织中有早期肿瘤形成的迹象。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients closely for any signs of {neoplasia}.
e.zh: 医生密切监测患者是否出现肿瘤形成的迹象。

e.en: The scan revealed a small benign {neoplasm} in her lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示她肺部有一个小的良性肿瘤。

e.en: Most types of {neoplasm} can be removed through surgery.
e.zh: 大多数类型的肿瘤可以通过手术切除。

e.en: The pathologist examined the tissue for {neoplastic} cells.
e.zh: 病理学家检查组织中是否有肿瘤细胞。

e.en: Chemotherapy targets rapidly dividing {neoplastic} growths in the body.
e.zh: 化疗针对体内快速分裂的肿瘤性增生。

e.en: Renaissance art often reflected {neoplatonic} ideas about beauty and the soul.
e.zh: 文艺复兴艺术常反映新柏拉图主义关于美与灵魂的观念。

e.en: His essay explores {neoplatonic} influences on early Christian theology.
e.zh: 他的论文探讨新柏拉图主义对早期基督教神学的影响。

e.en: {Neoplatonism} shaped medieval philosophy for several centuries.
e.zh: 新柏拉图主义影响了中世纪哲学数个世纪。

e.en: Plotinus is considered the founder of {neoplatonism}.
e.zh: 普罗提诺被视为新柏拉图主义的奠基人。

e.en: Surfers wear {neoprene} wetsuits to stay warm in cold water.
e.zh: 冲浪者穿氯丁橡胶潜水服在冷水中保暖。

e.en: The laptop sleeve is made of durable {neoprene} material.
e.zh: 这款笔记本电脑套由耐用的氯丁橡胶制成。

e.en: The Amazon rainforest hosts countless {neotropical} bird species.
e.zh: 亚马逊雨林栖息着无数新热带鸟类物种。

e.en: Researchers study {neotropical} frogs threatened by climate change.
e.zh: 研究人员研究受气候变化威胁的新热带蛙类。

e.en: The cotton was rejected because of visible {nep} defects in the yarn.
e.zh: 这批棉花因纱线中明显的棉结缺陷被退货。

e.en: Quality control workers inspect fabric for any {nep} formation.
e.zh: 质检员检查织物是否有棉结形成。

e.en: She trekked through {Nepal} for two months last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天她在尼泊尔徒步了两个月。

e.en: Mount Everest sits on the border between {Nepal} and Tibet.
e.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰位于尼泊尔与西藏的边界上。

nepalese.t:
adj. 尼泊尔的
n. 尼泊尔人

e.en: The {Nepalese} government announced new visa rules for tourists.
e.zh: 尼泊尔政府宣布了针对游客的新签证规定。

e.en: We had dinner at a {Nepalese} restaurant downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心一家尼泊尔餐厅吃了晚餐。

nepali.t:
n. 尼泊尔语
adj. 尼泊尔的

e.en: She's been learning {Nepali} before her trip to Kathmandu.
e.zh: 她在去加德满都之前一直在学尼泊尔语。

e.en: Many {Nepali} workers send remittances home each month.
e.zh: 许多尼泊尔工人每月把汇款寄回家。

e.en: My {nephew} just started kindergarten this fall.
e.zh: 我侄子今年秋天刚开始上幼儿园。

e.en: She bought her {nephew} a new bicycle for his birthday.
e.zh: 她给侄子买了一辆新自行车作为生日礼物。

nephews.t: n. 侄子们（nephew 的复数）

e.en: He has three {nephews} who all live in different cities.
e.zh: 他有三个侄子,都住在不同的城市。

e.en: My {nephews} love coming over to play video games.
e.zh: 我的侄子们喜欢过来玩电子游戏。

e.en: The patient recovered quickly after the {nephrectomy} last week.
e.zh: 病人在上周的肾切除术后恢复得很快。

e.en: Surgeons performed a partial {nephrectomy} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了部分肾切除术以切除肿瘤。

e.en: Chronic {nephritis} can eventually lead to kidney failure.
e.zh: 慢性肾炎最终可能导致肾衰竭。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with acute {nephritis} after the tests.
e.zh: 检查后医生诊断她患有急性肾炎。

nephrologist.t: n. 肾病学家；肾科医生

e.en: Her family doctor referred her to a {nephrologist} for further tests.
e.zh: 她的家庭医生将她转介给肾科医生做进一步检查。

e.en: The {nephrologist} adjusted his dialysis schedule this month.
e.zh: 这位肾科医生本月调整了他的透析时间表。

e.en: Diabetic {nephropathy} is a leading cause of kidney failure worldwide.
e.zh: 糖尿病肾病是全球肾衰竭的主要原因。

e.en: Early treatment can slow the progression of {nephropathy}.
e.zh: 早期治疗可以减缓肾病的进展。

e.en: Some painkillers can be {nephrotoxic} when used long-term.
e.zh: 某些止痛药长期使用可能对肾脏有毒性。

e.en: Doctors avoid prescribing {nephrotoxic} drugs to patients with weak kidneys.
e.zh: 医生避免给肾功能弱的患者开具有肾毒性的药物。

nepotism.t: n. 任人唯亲；裙带关系

e.en: Critics accused the CEO of {nepotism} after he hired his son.
e.zh: 在他聘用儿子后,批评者指责这位首席执行官搞裙带关系。

e.en: The new policy aims to prevent {nepotism} in government hiring.
e.zh: 新政策旨在防止政府招聘中的裙带关系。

nepotistic.t: adj. 任人唯亲的；裙带关系的

e.en: Several employees quit, citing the company's {nepotistic} promotion practices.
e.zh: 几名员工辞职,理由是公司搞裙带式晋升。

e.en: The board criticized the {nepotistic} hiring decisions made last year.
e.zh: 董事会批评了去年的裙带式招聘决定。

neptune.t:
n. 海王星
n. 尼普顿（罗马海神）

e.en: {Neptune} is the windiest planet in our solar system.
e.zh: 海王星是太阳系中风最大的行星。

e.en: Voyager 2 sent back stunning images of {Neptune} in 1989.
e.zh: 旅行者2号在1989年传回了海王星的惊人图像。

nerc.t: n. 北美电力可靠性委员会（缩写）

e.en: The {NERC} sets reliability standards for North American power grids.
e.zh: 北美电力可靠性公司为北美电网制定可靠性标准。

e.en: Utilities must report grid incidents to {NERC} within strict deadlines.
e.zh: 公用事业公司必须在严格期限内向NERC报告电网事故。

e.en: He's a total film {nerd} who knows every Tarantino quote.
e.zh: 他是个十足的电影迷,每句塔伦蒂诺的台词都记得。

e.en: In high school they called her a {nerd} for loving math.
e.zh: 高中时他们因为她喜欢数学而叫她书呆子。

nerdy.t: adj. 书呆子气的；极客的

e.en: He wore {nerdy} glasses and a comic book T-shirt.
e.zh: 他戴着书呆子气的眼镜,穿着漫画T恤。

e.en: Their podcast covers {nerdy} topics like medieval history and astrophysics.
e.zh: 他们的播客讨论中世纪历史和天体物理等极客话题。

e.en: Roman emperor {Nero} is famous for fiddling while Rome burned.
e.zh: 罗马皇帝尼禄因罗马大火时仍弹琴而闻名。

e.en: Historians still debate whether {Nero} actually persecuted the early Christians.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论尼禄是否真的迫害了早期基督徒。

nerve.t:
n. 神经；胆量
v. 鼓起勇气

e.en: It took a lot of {nerve} to ask for that raise.
e.zh: 鼓起勇气要求加薪着实不容易。

e.en: The injury damaged a {nerve} in his right hand.
e.zh: 这次受伤损伤了他右手的一根神经。

e.en: The pilot made a {nerveless} landing despite the engine failure.
e.zh: 尽管引擎故障,这位飞行员沉着冷静地完成了着陆。

e.en: She gave a {nerveless} performance in front of thousands of people.
e.zh: 她在数千人面前做了一场镇定自若的表演。

nerves.t: n. 神经；紧张（nerve 的复数）

e.en: The loud chewing really gets on my {nerves}.
e.zh: 那大声的咀嚼声真让我心烦。

e.en: She tried to calm her {nerves} before the job interview.
e.zh: 她试图在面试前平复紧张情绪。

nervosa.t: adj. 神经性的（多用于 anorexia nervosa 神经性厌食）

e.en: The clinic specializes in treating anorexia {nervosa} in teenagers.
e.zh: 该诊所专门治疗青少年神经性厌食症。

e.en: Bulimia {nervosa} often goes undiagnosed for years.
e.zh: 神经性贪食症常常多年未被诊断出来。

e.en: She felt {nervous} before her first job interview.
e.zh: 第一次工作面试前她感到很紧张。

e.en: The puppy seemed {nervous} around large dogs at the park.
e.zh: 这只小狗在公园里见到大狗时似乎很紧张。

e.en: He {nervously} tapped his pen during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议期间他紧张地敲打着笔。

e.en: She {nervously} checked her phone every few minutes.
e.zh: 她每隔几分钟就紧张地查看一下手机。

e.en: His {nervousness} showed when he kept stumbling over his words.
e.zh: 他不停结结巴巴地说话,显出他的紧张。

e.en: A cup of tea helped ease her pre-show {nervousness}.
e.zh: 一杯茶帮她缓解了演出前的紧张。

e.en: The therapist helped clients identify the different {nervousnesses} they experienced.
e.zh: 治疗师帮助客户识别他们所经历的各种紧张感。

e.en: Public speaking and flying triggered separate {nervousnesses} in him.
e.zh: 公开演讲和坐飞机在他身上引发了不同的紧张感。

e.en: It was pretty {nervy} of him to ask for a refund.
e.zh: 他居然敢要求退款,真是大胆。

e.en: She felt {nervy} after drinking too much coffee this morning.
e.zh: 今早喝了太多咖啡后她感到心神不宁。

e.en: He drinks a cup of {Nescafe} every morning before work.
e.zh: 他每天上班前喝一杯雀巢咖啡。

e.en: The hotel room had a kettle and some {Nescafe} sachets.
e.zh: 酒店房间里有一个水壶和几包雀巢速溶咖啡。

ness.t: n. 海岬；尼斯（地名常用）

e.en: The word "happiness" ends with the suffix {ness}.
e.zh: "happiness"这个词以后缀ness结尾。

e.en: Loch {Ness} is famous for its legendary monster.
e.zh: 尼斯湖以其传说中的水怪而闻名。

e.en: Nouns like "kindness" and "sadness" end in {nesses} when pluralized.
e.zh: 像kindness和sadness这样的名词复数形式以nesses结尾。

e.en: The teacher listed several abstract {nesses} on the board.
e.zh: 老师在黑板上列出了几个以ness结尾的抽象名词。

nessie.t: n. 尼斯湖水怪的昵称

e.en: Tourists flock to Scotland hoping to spot {Nessie}.
e.zh: 游客们涌向苏格兰,希望能看到尼斯湖水怪。

e.en: {Nessie} remains one of the world's most famous cryptids.
e.zh: 尼斯湖水怪仍是世界上最著名的神秘生物之一。

nest.t:
n. 巢；窝
v. 筑巢；嵌套

e.en: A robin built its {nest} in our backyard tree.
e.zh: 一只知更鸟在我们后院的树上筑了巢。

e.en: The startup is a {nest} of young engineers.
e.zh: 这家初创公司是年轻工程师的聚集地。

e.en: The patient showed clear {neurologic} symptoms after the stroke.
e.zh: 患者中风后出现了明显的神经系统症状。

e.en: A {neurologic} exam is needed to rule out nerve damage.
e.zh: 需要做神经科检查以排除神经损伤。

neurological.t: adj. 神经病学的；神经系统的

e.en: She booked a {neurological} exam to investigate her headaches.
e.zh: 她预约了神经科检查以查明头痛原因。

e.en: Long COVID may trigger lasting {neurological} symptoms.
e.zh: 新冠后遗症可能引发持续的神经系统症状。

neurologist.t: n. 神经科医生；神经病学家

e.en: The {neurologist} ordered an MRI of the brain.
e.zh: 神经科医生开了脑部核磁共振检查。

e.en: Her grandmother sees a {neurologist} for Parkinson's disease.
e.zh: 她奶奶因帕金森病在看神经科医生。

e.en: He's a resident in the {neurology} department this year.
e.zh: 他今年在神经内科当住院医生。

e.en: Modern {neurology} relies heavily on brain imaging technology.
e.zh: 现代神经病学十分依赖脑部影像技术。

e.en: A painful {neuroma} formed in the ball of her foot.
e.zh: 她的前脚掌长了一个疼痛的神经瘤。

e.en: Runners often develop a {neuroma} between the toes.
e.zh: 跑步者常会在脚趾间长神经瘤。

e.en: Physical therapy improved her {neuromuscular} coordination after the injury.
e.zh: 理疗改善了她受伤后的神经肌肉协调能力。

e.en: ALS is a serious {neuromuscular} disease.
e.zh: 渐冻症是一种严重的神经肌肉疾病。

e.en: Each {neuron} can connect to thousands of others in the brain.
e.zh: 大脑中每个神经元可以与上千个其他神经元相连。

e.en: Sleep helps the brain clear waste between every {neuron}.
e.zh: 睡眠帮助大脑清理神经元之间的代谢废物。

e.en: Stress can disrupt {neuronal} activity in the hippocampus.
e.zh: 压力会扰乱海马体内的神经元活动。

e.en: The drug protects {neuronal} cells from oxidative damage.
e.zh: 该药物可保护神经元细胞免受氧化损伤。

neurone.t: n. 神经元（neuron 的英式拼写）

e.en: A motor {neurone} carries signals from the brain to the muscles.
e.zh: 运动神经元将信号从大脑传递到肌肉。

e.en: Each {neurone} fires when it receives enough input.
e.zh: 每个神经元在接收到足够输入时就会放电。

e.en: He takes medication for chronic {neuropathic} pain in his legs.
e.zh: 他长期服药治疗腿部的神经性疼痛。

e.en: {Neuropathic} pain often feels like burning or tingling.
e.zh: 神经性疼痛常常像灼烧或刺麻的感觉。

e.en: Diabetes can lead to nerve damage known as {neuropathy}.
e.zh: 糖尿病可导致被称为神经病变的神经损伤。

e.en: She felt numbness in her feet from peripheral {neuropathy}.
e.zh: 她因周围神经病变感到脚部麻木。

e.en: Researchers identified a {neuropeptide} linked to appetite control.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一种与食欲控制相关的神经肽。

e.en: Each {neuropeptide} acts as a chemical messenger in the brain.
e.zh: 每种神经肽都是大脑中的化学信使。

e.en: The study used {neurophysiological} measures to track brain activity.
e.zh: 该研究采用神经生理学指标来追踪大脑活动。

e.en: Sleep loss has clear {neurophysiological} effects on memory.
e.zh: 睡眠不足对记忆有明显的神经生理影响。

e.en: The {neurophysiologist} recorded electrical signals from the patient's nerves.
e.zh: 神经生理学家记录了患者神经的电信号。

e.en: A clinical {neurophysiologist} interprets EEG results in the hospital.
e.zh: 临床神经生理学家在医院解读脑电图结果。

e.en: She's writing her thesis on cardiac {neurophysiology}.
e.zh: 她正在撰写关于心脏神经生理学的论文。

e.en: Modern {neurophysiology} uses advanced imaging to study brain function.
e.zh: 现代神经生理学利用先进影像技术研究脑功能。

e.en: The drug carries a risk of serious {neuropsychiatric} side effects.
e.zh: 该药物有引发严重神经精神副作用的风险。

e.en: Lupus can cause a range of {neuropsychiatric} symptoms.
e.zh: 狼疮可引起多种神经精神症状。

e.en: He specializes in {neuropsychiatry} at the university hospital.
e.zh: 他在大学医院专攻神经精神病学。

e.en: {Neuropsychiatry} bridges neurology and psychiatry in patient care.
e.zh: 神经精神病学将神经病学与精神病学结合用于患者治疗。

e.en: She underwent a full {neuropsychological} assessment after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她接受了一次全面的神经心理评估。

e.en: {Neuropsychological} testing can detect early signs of dementia.
e.zh: 神经心理测试可发现痴呆的早期迹象。

e.en: The {neuropsychologist} evaluated his memory and attention span.
e.zh: 神经心理学家评估了他的记忆力和注意力。

e.en: A {neuropsychologist} helps patients recover cognitive function after injury.
e.zh: 神经心理学家帮助患者在受伤后恢复认知功能。

e.en: She's pursuing a doctorate in clinical {neuropsychology}.
e.zh: 她正在攻读临床神经心理学博士学位。

e.en: {Neuropsychology} studies how brain damage affects behavior.
e.zh: 神经心理学研究脑损伤如何影响行为。

e.en: He switched majors to {neuroscience} in his second year.
e.zh: 他大二时转到了神经科学专业。

e.en: Recent {neuroscience} research has changed how we view memory.
e.zh: 近期神经科学研究改变了我们对记忆的理解。

e.en: The {neuroscientist} explained how habits form in the brain.
e.zh: 这位神经科学家解释了习惯是如何在大脑中形成的。

e.en: She works as a {neuroscientist} at a leading research lab.
e.zh: 她在一家顶尖研究实验室担任神经科学家。

neuroses.t: n. 神经症（neurosis 的复数）

e.en: The novel explores the small {neuroses} of city dwellers.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了都市人那些细微的神经质。

e.en: Therapy helped him manage his everyday {neuroses}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助他控制了日常的神经官能症状。

neurosis.t: n. 神经官能症；神经症

e.en: His checking the door three times borders on {neurosis}.
e.zh: 他反复检查三遍门锁的行为近乎神经质。

e.en: Anxiety {neurosis} can severely affect daily functioning.
e.zh: 焦虑性神经症会严重影响日常生活。

e.en: The {neurosurgeon} successfully removed the brain tumor.
e.zh: 神经外科医生成功切除了脑部肿瘤。

e.en: Becoming a {neurosurgeon} requires over a decade of training.
e.zh: 成为神经外科医生需要十多年的训练。

e.en: He underwent {neurosurgery} to relieve pressure on his brain.
e.zh: 他接受了神经外科手术以缓解脑部压力。

e.en: Robotic tools have transformed modern {neurosurgery}.
e.zh: 机器人工具已经改变了现代神经外科手术。

e.en: The hospital just opened a new {neurosurgical} unit.
e.zh: 医院刚开设了一个新的神经外科病区。

e.en: Recovery from a {neurosurgical} procedure can take months.
e.zh: 神经外科手术后的康复可能需要数月。

neurotic.t:
adj. 神经质的；神经过敏的
n. 神经症患者

e.en: He's a bit {neurotic} about cleaning his keyboard every night.
e.zh: 他对每晚清洁键盘有点神经质。

e.en: Stop being so {neurotic} about what others think of you.
e.zh: 别再为别人怎么看你这么神经兮兮的了。

e.en: She {neurotically} checks her phone every few minutes.
e.zh: 她神经质地每隔几分钟就看一次手机。

e.en: He {neurotically} rearranges the books on his desk.
e.zh: 他神经质地反复整理桌上的书。

e.en: High {neuroticism} is linked to greater anxiety in stressful jobs.
e.zh: 高神经质与高压工作中的焦虑程度相关。

e.en: Personality tests often measure {neuroticism} as one key trait.
e.zh: 人格测试常将神经质作为一项核心特质来衡量。

e.en: Lead is a well-known {neurotoxic} metal harmful to children.
e.zh: 铅是一种众所周知对儿童有害的神经毒性金属。

e.en: Some pesticides have {neurotoxic} effects on bees.
e.zh: 某些农药对蜜蜂具有神经毒性作用。

e.en: Botox is essentially a {neurotoxin} used in tiny doses.
e.zh: 肉毒杆菌素本质上是一种小剂量使用的神经毒素。

e.en: The snake's venom contains a powerful {neurotoxin}.
e.zh: 这种蛇的毒液中含有一种强效神经毒素。

e.en: Dopamine is a {neurotransmitter} linked to reward and motivation.
e.zh: 多巴胺是一种与奖赏和动机相关的神经递质。

e.en: Antidepressants change how each {neurotransmitter} moves between cells.
e.zh: 抗抑郁药改变神经递质在细胞间传递的方式。

e.en: The doctor checked his {neurovascular} status after the cast was applied.
e.zh: 打完石膏后医生检查了他的神经血管状况。

e.en: The injury affected the {neurovascular} bundle in his arm.
e.zh: 这处损伤影响了他手臂中的神经血管束。

neuter.t:
adj. 中性的（语法）
v. 阉割（动物）

e.en: We took the kitten to the vet to {neuter} him.
e.zh: 我们带小猫去兽医那里做绝育手术。

e.en: In German, every noun is masculine, feminine, or {neuter}.
e.zh: 德语中每个名词都是阳性、阴性或中性的。

neutered.t: adj. 已阉割的；已绝育的

e.en: Most shelters require dogs to be {neutered} before adoption.
e.zh: 大多数收容所要求狗在被领养前先做绝育。

e.en: The committee {neutered} the proposal by removing key clauses.
e.zh: 委员会删除了关键条款，使提案失去效力。

neutering.t:
n. 绝育；阉割
v. 阉割（neuter 的现在分词）

e.en: {Neutering} pets helps reduce the stray animal population.
e.zh: 为宠物做绝育有助于减少流浪动物的数量。

e.en: Critics accused the amendment of {neutering} the new law.
e.zh: 批评者指责这项修正案削弱了新法律的效力。

neutral.t:
adj. 中立的；中性的
n. 空挡

e.en: Switzerland remained {neutral} during both world wars.
e.zh: 瑞士在两次世界大战中都保持中立。

e.en: She painted the living room a warm {neutral} color.
e.zh: 她把客厅刷成了温暖的中性色。

neutralisation.t: n. 中和；中立化（英式拼写）

e.en: The {neutralisation} of the acid produced water and salt.
e.zh: 酸的中和反应生成了水和盐。

e.en: The treaty called for the {neutralisation} of all border zones.
e.zh: 该条约要求所有边境地区中立化。

e.en: Several chemical {neutralisations} were performed during the lab session.
e.zh: 实验课上进行了多次化学中和反应。

e.en: The report listed all the {neutralisations} required to clean the spill.
e.zh: 报告列出了清理泄漏所需的所有中和处理。

neutralise.t: v. 中和；使无效（英式拼写）

e.en: Baking soda can {neutralise} odors in the fridge.
e.zh: 小苏打可以中和冰箱里的异味。

e.en: The army moved in to {neutralise} the threat quickly.
e.zh: 军队迅速行动以消除威胁。

neutralised.t: v. 中和（neutralise 的过去式）

e.en: The bomb squad safely {neutralised} the explosive device.
e.zh: 拆弹小组安全地排除了爆炸装置。

e.en: Antacid tablets {neutralised} the acid in her stomach.
e.zh: 抗酸药片中和了她胃里的酸。

e.en: This shampoo {neutralises} the chlorine left in your hair after swimming.
e.zh: 这款洗发水可中和游泳后留在头发上的氯。

e.en: A strong defense {neutralises} the opponent's attacking plays.
e.zh: 强有力的防守能化解对手的进攻配合。

neutralising.t: v. 中和（neutralise 的现在分词）

e.en: She added lime to the soil for {neutralising} excess acidity.
e.zh: 她在土壤中加入石灰以中和过多的酸性。

e.en: The goalkeeper played a key role in {neutralising} their forwards.
e.zh: 门将在化解对方前锋进攻中起到了关键作用。

e.en: The judge maintained strict {neutrality} throughout the trial.
e.zh: 法官在整个审判过程中保持严格中立。

e.en: Net {neutrality} ensures equal access to all websites.
e.zh: 网络中立性确保所有网站都能被平等访问。

e.en: The {neutralization} of the chemical spill took several hours.
e.zh: 化学品泄漏的中和处理花了好几个小时。

e.en: Vaccines work partly through the {neutralization} of harmful viruses.
e.zh: 疫苗部分通过中和有害病毒来发挥作用。

e.en: The lab manual described several acid-base {neutralizations} in detail.
e.zh: 实验手册详细介绍了几种酸碱中和反应。

e.en: Multiple {neutralizations} were needed to render the waste safe.
e.zh: 需要多次中和处理才能使废料变得安全。

e.en: Baking soda can {neutralize} the strong acid in your stomach.
e.zh: 小苏打可以中和胃里的强酸。

e.en: The team worked to {neutralize} the threat before dawn.
e.zh: 团队赶在黎明前消除了威胁。

neutralized.t: v. 中和（neutralize 的过去式）

e.en: Security {neutralized} the malware before it spread further.
e.zh: 安全人员在恶意软件扩散前将其清除了。

e.en: The lemon juice {neutralized} the fishy smell completely.
e.zh: 柠檬汁完全去除了那股鱼腥味。

e.en: Apply the {neutralizer} after rinsing the perm solution out.
e.zh: 冲掉烫发药水后再涂上中和剂。

e.en: This spray works as a {neutralizer} for pet odors.
e.zh: 这种喷雾可以中和宠物的异味。

e.en: This cream {neutralizes} redness on sensitive skin.
e.zh: 这款面霜能中和敏感肌肤的红血丝。

e.en: The antivirus quickly {neutralizes} most known threats.
e.zh: 杀毒软件能迅速消除大多数已知威胁。

neutralizing.t: v. 中和；抵消（neutralize 的现在分词）

e.en: The vaccine triggers {neutralizing} antibodies against the virus.
e.zh: 该疫苗能激发对抗病毒的中和抗体。

e.en: She added vinegar, {neutralizing} the soapy taste in the sauce.
e.zh: 她加了醋,中和了酱汁里的肥皂味。

e.en: The reporter described the protest {neutrally}, without taking sides.
e.zh: 记者中立地描述了抗议活动,没有偏袒任何一方。

e.en: Try to phrase the feedback {neutrally} so nobody feels attacked.
e.zh: 尽量中性地表达反馈,让人不觉得被针对。

e.en: A single {neutrino} can pass through the entire Earth unnoticed.
e.zh: 一个中微子可以毫无察觉地穿过整个地球。

e.en: Scientists detected a rare {neutrino} burst from a distant supernova.
e.zh: 科学家探测到来自遥远超新星的罕见中微子爆发。

e.en: She swears by {Neutrogena} sunscreen for daily use.
e.zh: 她非常推崇露得清防晒霜作为日常使用。

e.en: I picked up a {Neutrogena} face wash at the drugstore.
e.zh: 我在药妆店买了一瓶露得清的洗面奶。

e.en: A {neutron} has no electric charge, unlike a proton.
e.zh: 中子不像质子那样带电荷。

e.en: Astronomers observed two {neutron} stars colliding billions of light-years away.
e.zh: 天文学家观测到几十亿光年外两颗中子星的碰撞。

neutropenia.t: n. 中性粒细胞减少症

e.en: Chemotherapy patients often develop {neutropenia} and become vulnerable to infections.
e.zh: 化疗病人常出现中性粒细胞减少,容易感染。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild {neutropenia} after reviewing the blood test.
e.zh: 医生看了血液检查后诊断为轻度中性粒细胞减少症。

e.en: A {neutrophil} is the first immune cell to reach an infection.
e.zh: 中性粒细胞是最先到达感染部位的免疫细胞。

e.en: The lab measures your {neutrophil} count in a routine blood test.
e.zh: 化验室会在常规血检中测量你的中性粒细胞数量。

e.en: Las Vegas is the largest city in {Nevada}.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯是内华达州最大的城市。

e.en: We drove across {Nevada} desert under a blazing sun.
e.zh: 我们顶着烈日开车穿过了内华达沙漠。

e.en: I have {never} been to Japan, but I want to go.
e.zh: 我从来没去过日本,但我很想去。

e.en: {Never} share your password with strangers online.
e.zh: 千万不要在网上把密码告诉陌生人。

e.en: The raven croaked "{Nevermore}" in the famous Poe poem.
e.zh: 在爱伦·坡那首名诗里,乌鸦哑声说着"永不复焉"。

e.en: After the betrayal, she vowed to trust him {nevermore}.
e.zh: 那次背叛之后,她发誓再也不信他了。

e.en: The movie was long; {nevertheless}, I enjoyed every minute.
e.zh: 这部电影很长,但我每一分钟都看得很尽兴。

e.en: He was tired; {nevertheless}, he finished the marathon.
e.zh: 他很累,尽管如此还是跑完了马拉松。

e.en: Ben {Nevis} is the highest mountain in the British Isles.
e.zh: 本尼维斯山是不列颠群岛最高的山峰。

e.en: Saint Kitts and {Nevis} is a small Caribbean island nation.
e.zh: 圣基茨和尼维斯是加勒比海上的一个小岛国。

e.en: I just got a {new} phone and I love it.
e.zh: 我刚买了个新手机,非常喜欢。

e.en: There's a {new} café opening down the street next week.
e.zh: 下周街角会有一家新咖啡馆开业。

e.en: Our flight lands at {Newark} airport around midnight.
e.zh: 我们的航班大约午夜降落在纽瓦克机场。

e.en: {Newark} is the largest city in New Jersey.
e.zh: 纽瓦克是新泽西州最大的城市。

e.en: I'm a total {newbie} at coding, please be patient.
e.zh: 我是个编程小白,请多包涵。

e.en: The forum has a friendly section just for {newbie} questions.
e.zh: 论坛有个友好的板块专门解答新手的问题。

newborn.t:
n. 新生儿
adj. 新生的

e.en: Her {newborn} baby sleeps almost twenty hours a day.
e.zh: 她刚出生的宝宝一天差不多睡二十个小时。

e.en: The {newborn} foal stood up within minutes of birth.
e.zh: 小马驹出生几分钟后就能站起来了。

e.en: {Newbridge} is a busy commuter town in County Kildare, Ireland.
e.zh: 纽布里奇是爱尔兰基尔代尔郡一个繁忙的通勤小镇。

e.en: We stopped in {Newbridge} to buy some Irish silverware.
e.zh: 我们在纽布里奇停下来买了一些爱尔兰银器。

e.en: {Newburgh} sits along the Hudson River north of New York City.
e.zh: 纽堡位于纽约市以北的哈德逊河畔。

e.en: We took the ferry from Beacon across to {Newburgh}.
e.zh: 我们从灯塔镇坐渡轮过河到了纽堡。

e.en: {Newbury} is famous for its historic horse racing course.
e.zh: 纽伯里以其历史悠久的赛马场而闻名。

e.en: The train from London to {Newbury} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到纽伯里的火车大约需要一小时。

newcastle.t: n. 纽卡斯尔（英国城市）

e.en: {Newcastle} fans are known for their loyalty to the football club.
e.zh: 纽卡斯尔球迷以对球队的忠诚而闻名。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring pubs in {Newcastle}.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在纽卡斯尔逛酒吧。

e.en: As a {newcomer} to the team, she asked lots of questions.
e.zh: 作为团队的新人,她问了很多问题。

e.en: The neighborhood welcomed the {newcomer} with a small dinner party.
e.zh: 邻居们办了个小晚宴欢迎这位新来的住户。

newcomers.t: n. 新来者们（newcomer 复数）

e.en: The city offers free language classes for {newcomers}.
e.zh: 市政府为新移民提供免费的语言课程。

e.en: Several {newcomers} joined our hiking group this spring.
e.zh: 今年春天有几位新人加入了我们的徒步小组。

newel.t: n. 楼梯中柱；扶手立柱

e.en: She hung her coat on the carved wooden {newel} post.
e.zh: 她把外套挂在了雕花的木楼梯柱上。

e.en: The grand staircase ended in an ornate {newel}.
e.zh: 豪华楼梯的尽头是一根装饰华丽的栏杆柱。

newfangled.t: adj. 新奇的；新花样的（略带贬义）

e.en: Grandpa refuses to use these {newfangled} smart speakers.
e.zh: 爷爷拒绝使用这些新潮的智能音箱。

e.en: She prefers her old recipes to any {newfangled} cooking gadgets.
e.zh: 比起任何新奇的厨房小工具,她更爱用老食谱。

newfound.t: adj. 新发现的；新获得的

e.en: He enjoyed his {newfound} freedom after graduating from college.
e.zh: 大学毕业后,他很享受这份新获得的自由。

e.en: She used her {newfound} confidence to apply for the promotion.
e.zh: 她凭着新建立的自信申请了晋升。

newfoundland.t: n. 纽芬兰（加拿大）；纽芬兰犬

e.en: {Newfoundland} is famous for its rugged coastline and friendly locals.
e.zh: 纽芬兰以崎岖的海岸线和友好的居民而闻名。

e.en: Our {Newfoundland} dog loves swimming in icy lake water.
e.zh: 我们家的纽芬兰犬特别爱在冰冷的湖水里游泳。

newgate.t: n. 纽盖特（伦敦旧监狱）

e.en: {Newgate} Prison was once London's most notorious jail.
e.zh: 新门监狱曾是伦敦最声名狼藉的监狱。

e.en: Charles Dickens wrote vividly about life inside {Newgate}.
e.zh: 查尔斯·狄更斯生动地描写过新门监狱里的生活。

e.en: {Newham} hosted many events during the 2012 London Olympics.
e.zh: 纽汉区承办了2012年伦敦奥运会的许多赛事。

e.en: He grew up in a quiet street in east London's {Newham}.
e.zh: 他在伦敦东部纽汉区的一条安静街道上长大。

e.en: You can catch a ferry from {Newhaven} to Dieppe in France.
e.zh: 你可以从纽黑文坐渡轮到法国迪耶普。

e.en: {Newhaven} harbor was busy with fishing boats this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上纽黑文港满是繁忙的渔船。

e.en: {Newington} Green is a leafy square in north London.
e.zh: 纽因顿绿地是伦敦北部一处绿树成荫的广场。

e.en: She rented a flat near {Newington} library last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她在纽因顿图书馆附近租了一套公寓。

e.en: He drives a {newish} Toyota that still smells like the dealership.
e.zh: 他开着一辆挺新的丰田车,还带着4S店的味道。

e.en: The café is {newish} but already has a loyal crowd.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆开张不久,但已经有了一批忠实顾客。

e.en: {Newland} Avenue is full of student bars and cafés.
e.zh: 纽兰大街上满是学生酒吧和咖啡馆。

e.en: The pioneers crossed the river in search of {newland} to farm.
e.zh: 拓荒者们渡过河,寻找可以耕种的新土地。

e.en: The {newly} married couple moved into a small apartment downtown.
e.zh: 这对新婚夫妇搬进了市中心的一间小公寓。

e.en: She showed off her {newly} dyed hair at the party.
e.zh: 她在派对上展示了刚染好的头发。

e.en: The {newlywed} couple flew to Bali for their honeymoon.
e.zh: 这对新婚夫妇飞去巴厘岛度蜜月了。

e.en: As a {newlywed}, he was still learning to share the bathroom.
e.zh: 作为新婚丈夫,他还在学着和妻子共用浴室。

e.en: Paul {Newman} starred in many classic Hollywood films.
e.zh: 保罗·纽曼出演过许多好莱坞经典影片。

e.en: Cardinal {Newman} is remembered for his influential religious writings.
e.zh: 纽曼枢机主教因其影响深远的宗教著作而被人铭记。

newmarket.t: n. 纽马基特（英国赛马城）

e.en: {Newmarket} is widely considered the headquarters of British horse racing.
e.zh: 纽马基特被普遍视为英国赛马运动的中心。

e.en: Trainers walk their horses through {Newmarket} every morning.
e.zh: 训练师每天早上都会牵着马走过纽马基特的街道。

e.en: I love the {newness} of a fresh notebook on day one.
e.zh: 我喜欢开学第一天那本崭新笔记本带来的新鲜感。

e.en: The {newness} of the city eventually wore off after a year.
e.zh: 住了一年后,这座城市的新鲜感慎慢消失了。

e.en: {Newnham} College is one of Cambridge University's women's colleges.
e.zh: 纽纳姆学院是剑桥大学的一所女子学院。

e.en: She studied history at {Newnham} during the late 1990s.
e.zh: 九十年代末,她在纽纳姆学院学习历史。

e.en: {Newport} hosts a famous folk music festival every summer.
e.zh: 纽波特每年夏天都会举办一个著名的民谣音乐节。

e.en: We sailed into {Newport} harbor just before sunset.
e.zh: 我们刚好在日落前驶进了纽波特港。

nga.t:
n. 美国国家地理空间情报局缩写
(罕用)

e.en: The {NGA} produces classified maps for U.S. military operations.
e.zh: 国家地理空间情报局为美军行动制作机密地图。

e.en: The {NGA} hangs many works by Vermeer and Rembrandt.
e.zh: 国家美术馆悬挂着许多维米尔和伦勃朗的作品。

ngc.t: n. 天文学中星云星团新总表编号

e.en: Astronomers cataloged that nebula as {NGC} 7000 long ago.
e.zh: 天文学家很久以前就将那个星云编目为NGC 7000。

e.en: Many bright galaxies carry {NGC} numbers from a 19th-century catalog.
e.zh: 许多亮星系沿用着十九世纪星表中的NGC编号。

ngo.t: n. 非政府组织（NGO 缩写）

e.en: She works for an {NGO} that delivers clean water to villages.
e.zh: 她在一家向村庄输送清洁饮用水的非政府组织工作。

e.en: International {NGO} workers coordinated relief after the hurricane hit.
e.zh: 飓风过后，国际非政府组织的工作人员协调救援。

ngoma.t: n. 非洲传统鼓乐与舞蹈

e.en: Villagers gathered around the fire to play {ngoma} drums.
e.zh: 村民们围坐在火堆旁敲击恩戈马鼓。

e.en: The healer led an {ngoma} ceremony lasting through the night.
e.zh: 医者主持了一场通宵的恩戈马仪式。

e.en: {Nguyen} is the most common surname in Vietnam.
e.zh: 阮是越南最常见的姓氏。

e.en: My coworker {Nguyen} grew up in Hanoi before moving here.
e.zh: 我同事阮在搬到这里之前是在河内长大的。

nhs.t: n. 英国国民保健服务（缩写）

e.en: The {NHS} provides free healthcare to UK residents.
e.zh: 英国国民保健署为英国居民提供免费医疗服务。

e.en: Long waiting lists have plagued the {NHS} for several years.
e.zh: 长长的候诊名单已困扰英国国民保健署多年。

e.en: Whole grains are a good dietary source of {niacin}.
e.zh: 全谷物是膳食中烟酸的良好来源。

e.en: Doctors sometimes prescribe {niacin} to help lower cholesterol levels.
e.zh: 医生有时会开烟酸来帮助降低胆固醇。

niagara.t: n. 尼亚加拉（瀑布/地名）

e.en: We took a boat right under {Niagara} Falls last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们乘船一直开到了尼亚加拉瀑布脚下。

e.en: Honeymooners have flocked to {Niagara} for over a century.
e.zh: 一个多世纪以来，新婚夫妇纷纷前往尼亚加拉度蜜月。

e.en: The fountain pen's gold {nib} glides smoothly across paper.
e.zh: 那支钢笔的金笔尖在纸上滑动得十分顺畅。

e.en: Replace the {nib} if your ink starts skipping on downstrokes.
e.zh: 如果下笔时墨水断断续续，就该换笔尖了。

nibble.t:
v. 一小口一小口地咬
n. 小块；半字节

e.en: The rabbit started to {nibble} on the fresh lettuce leaves.
e.zh: 那只兔子开始啃食新鲜的生菜叶。

e.en: I only had time to {nibble} a small snack at lunch.
e.zh: 午餐时我只来得及吃了一点小零食。

nibbler.t: n. 小口啃食的人或动物

e.en: My cat is a picky {nibbler} who never finishes her food.
e.zh: 我家猫是个挑食的小馋嘴，从不把食物吃完。

e.en: He's a constant {nibbler} who snacks throughout the workday.
e.zh: 他是个嘴馋的人，整个工作日都在吃零食。

nibbling.t: v. 正在小口啃咬（nibble 的现在分词）

e.en: The mice were {nibbling} at the corner of the cardboard box.
e.zh: 老鼠正在啃咬纸箱的一角。

e.en: She sat on the couch {nibbling} chocolate while watching TV.
e.zh: 她坐在沙发上一边看电视一边小口吃巧克力。

e.en: My grandfather still keeps his old {niblick} in the garage.
e.zh: 我爷爷至今还把他那支旧高尔夫铁杆放在车库里。

e.en: He swung the {niblick} to lift the ball from the sand.
e.zh: 他挥动这支老式铁杆把球从沙坑里击出。

nic.t: n. 网络接口卡（NIC 缩写）

e.en: Many vapers track their daily {nic} intake using an app.
e.zh: 许多电子烟用户用应用程序记录每日尼古丁摄入量。

e.en: This pouch contains a low {nic} level for beginners.
e.zh: 这种烟袋含有较低的尼古丁含量，适合初学者。

e.en: The old drill still uses a bulky {nicad} battery pack.
e.zh: 那台旧电钻仍使用笨重的镍镉电池组。

e.en: Modern tools have largely replaced {nicad} cells with lithium ones.
e.zh: 现代工具大多已用锂电池取代了镍镉电池。

e.en: We spent two weeks surfing along the Pacific coast of {Nicaragua}.
e.zh: 我们在尼加拉瓜的太平洋沿岸冲浪了两周。

e.en: {Nicaragua} is famous for its volcanoes and freshwater lakes.
e.zh: 尼加拉瓜以火山和淡水湖闻名。

nicaraguan.t:
adj. 尼加拉瓜的
n. 尼加拉瓜人

e.en: She married a {Nicaraguan} engineer she met during graduate school.
e.zh: 她嫁给了一位读研时认识的尼加拉瓜工程师。

e.en: The cafe serves rich {Nicaraguan} coffee imported directly from farms.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供直接从农场进口的浓郁尼加拉瓜咖啡。

nice.t: adj. 好的，不错的，友善的

e.en: That's a really {nice} jacket — where did you get it?
e.zh: 这件夹克真不错，你在哪儿买的？

e.en: The neighbors have always been very {nice} to our family.
e.zh: 邻居们一直对我们家很友善。

e.en: The new sofa fits {nicely} in the corner of the room.
e.zh: 新沙发刚好放在房间的角落，很合适。

e.en: She asked {nicely} if we could lower the music.
e.zh: 她很客气地问我们能不能把音乐调小。

e.en: His genuine {niceness} makes him popular with all the kids.
e.zh: 他真诚的善良让他深受所有孩子喜爱。

e.en: Don't mistake her {niceness} for weakness in negotiations.
e.zh: 别把她在谈判中的友善当成软弱。

e.en: He skipped the social {nicety} of greeting everyone at the door.
e.zh: 他省略了在门口跟每个人打招呼的礼节。

e.en: Legal documents demand attention to every {nicety} of language.
e.zh: 法律文件要求关注语言上的每一处细微之处。

nich.t: n. 人名缩写（Nicholas 简称）

e.en: She found her perfect {nich} in indie game development.
e.zh: 她在独立游戏开发领域找到了完美的定位。

e.en: This shop fills a small {nich} for vintage camera collectors.
e.zh: 这家店满足了老式相机收藏者的小众需求。

niche.t:
n. 利基市场；壁龛
adj. 小众的

e.en: Her startup found a profitable {niche} in pet wearables.
e.zh: 她的创业公司在宠物可穿戴设备领域找到了赚钱的细分市场。

e.en: A small statue stood in the {niche} above the doorway.
e.zh: 一尊小雕像立在门口上方的壁龛里。

niches.t: n. 利基市场；壁龛（复数）

e.en: YouTube creators often grow faster by targeting specific {niches}.
e.zh: YouTube 创作者通常通过专攻细分领域而增长更快。

e.en: The cathedral walls had {niches} holding statues of saints.
e.zh: 大教堂的墙上设有壁龛，里面放着圣徒雕像。

e.en: Professor {Nichol} will be leading tomorrow's seminar on climate policy.
e.zh: 尼科尔教授将主持明天关于气候政策的研讨会。

e.en: My friend {Nichol} just opened a bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我朋友妮可刚在市中心开了一家面包店。

nick.t:
n. 小刻痕
v. 划伤；偷

e.en: There's a small {nick} on the edge of the kitchen knife.
e.zh: 厨刀边缘有一处小缺口。

e.en: He arrived just in the {nick} of time to catch the train.
e.zh: 他在最后一刻赶到，正好赶上火车。

nicked.t: v. 划出缺口；偷走（过去式）

e.en: I {nicked} my finger while chopping onions this morning.
e.zh: 今早切洋葱时我把手指划了个小口子。

e.en: Someone {nicked} my umbrella from the office lobby.
e.zh: 有人从办公室大堂顺走了我的雨伞。

e.en: He dropped a {nickel} into the parking meter and walked away.
e.zh: 他往停车计时器里投了一枚五分硬币就走开了。

e.en: The frame is plated with shiny {nickel} for durability.
e.zh: 这个框架镀有亮闪闪的镍以提高耐用性。

e.en: The horses {nicker} softly when they hear footsteps near the barn.
e.zh: 马儿听到谷仓附近的脚步声时会轻声嘶鸣。

e.en: My pony gave a happy {nicker} as I brought her breakfast.
e.zh: 我给小马驹送早餐时，她发出愉快的嘶鸣声。

nickname.t:
n. 昵称，绰号
v. 给……起绰号

e.en: His childhood {nickname} stuck with him all the way through college.
e.zh: 他童年时的绰号一直跟着他到大学。

e.en: The team gave their goalie the {nickname} "The Wall."
e.zh: 队员们给他们的守门员起了"铜墙"这个绰号。

nicknamed.t: v. 被起绰号为（过去式）

e.en: Friends {nicknamed} her "Sparkle" because of her bright personality.
e.zh: 朋友们因为她开朗的性格给她取了个绰号叫"闪闪"。

e.en: The fast new train was quickly {nicknamed} "the Bullet."
e.zh: 这列快速新列车很快就被昵称为"子弹号"。

e.en: Most players on the basketball team have funny {nicknames}.
e.zh: 篮球队里的大多数球员都有有趣的绰号。

e.en: Online gamers often go by creative {nicknames} instead of real names.
e.zh: 网络游戏玩家常用创意昵称代替真实姓名。

nicodemus.t: n. 圣经人物「尼哥底母」

e.en: The pastor referenced {Nicodemus} during last Sunday's evening sermon.
e.zh: 牧师在上周日晚间的布道中提到了尼哥底母。

e.en: In the gospel, {Nicodemus} visits Jesus quietly at night.
e.zh: 福音书中，尼哥底母在夜里悄悄拜访耶稣。

nicosia.t: n. 尼科西亚（塞浦路斯首都）

e.en: We landed in {Nicosia} after a short flight from Athens.
e.zh: 从雅典短途飞行后，我们降落在尼科西亚。

e.en: {Nicosia} remains the last divided capital city in Europe.
e.zh: 尼科西亚仍是欧洲最后一个被分割的首都。

e.en: She planted fragrant {nicotiana} along the garden path last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天她在花园小径旁种下了芬芳的花烟草。

e.en: The white {nicotiana} blooms release sweet scent after sunset.
e.zh: 白色的花烟草在日落后散发出甜美的香气。

nicotine.t: n. 尼古丁（烟草中的成瘾物质）

e.en: He's been chewing gum to fight {nicotine} cravings since quitting.
e.zh: 戒烟以来他一直靠嚼口香糖来对抗尼古丁的渴求。

e.en: This vape pod contains a high {nicotine} concentration.
e.zh: 这款电子烟弹含有较高浓度的尼古丁。

e.en: My {niece} just graduated from high school with top honors.
e.zh: 我的侄女刚以最优异的成绩高中毕业。

e.en: I'm taking my {niece} to the zoo this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我要带侄女去动物园。

e.en: Both of my {nieces} love coming over to bake cookies.
e.zh: 我两个侄女都喜欢过来一起烤饼干。

e.en: She bought matching dresses for her three little {nieces}.
e.zh: 她给三个小侄女买了款式相同的连衣裙。

e.en: My philosophy class spent two weeks reading {Nietzsche} this semester.
e.zh: 我的哲学课这学期花了两周时间研读尼采。

e.en: {Nietzsche} famously challenged traditional views of morality and religion.
e.zh: 尼采以挑战传统道德观和宗教观而闻名。

nietzschean.t:
adj. 尼采的；尼采哲学的
n. 尼采信徒

e.en: His writing has a distinctly {Nietzschean} tone of defiance and individualism.
e.zh: 他的文字带有鲜明的尼采式反叛和个人主义色彩。

e.en: The novel explores {Nietzschean} themes of power and self-overcoming.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了尼采式的权力与自我超越主题。

nifty.t: adj. 俏皮的；精巧好用的

e.en: That's a {nifty} little gadget for organizing your desk cables.
e.zh: 那是个整理桌面电线的精巧小玩意儿。

e.en: She showed me a {nifty} keyboard shortcut to save time.
e.zh: 她给我演示了一个能节省时间的实用键盘快捷键。

e.en: The country of {Niger} is named after its longest river.
e.zh: 尼日尔这个国家是以其最长的河流命名的。

e.en: Travelers to {Niger} often visit the dunes of the Sahara.
e.zh: 前往尼日尔的旅行者常去参观撒哈拉沙漠的沙丘。

nigeria.t: n. 尼日利亚（非洲国家）

e.en: {Nigeria} has Africa's largest population and a booming tech scene.
e.zh: 尼日利亚是非洲人口最多的国家，科技产业发展迅猛。

e.en: Many Nollywood films are produced in Lagos, {Nigeria}.
e.zh: 许多瑙莱坞电影都是在尼日利亚拉各斯制作的。

nigerian.t:
adj. 尼日利亚的
n. 尼日利亚人

e.en: My favorite {Nigerian} dish is jollof rice with grilled chicken.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的尼日利亚菜是炒米饭配烤鸡。

e.en: The {Nigerian} writer won a major international book prize.
e.zh: 这位尼日利亚作家荣获了一项重要国际图书奖。

e.en: The old {niggard} refused to spend even a penny on heating.
e.zh: 那个守财奴连一分钱取暖费都舍不得花。

e.en: Don't be such a {niggard} when leaving tips for good service.
e.zh: 服务好的时候给小费别那么吝啬。

e.en: The company offered a {niggardly} raise after a record-profit year.
e.zh: 公司在创纪录盈利的一年后只给了少得可怜的加薪。

e.en: He was {niggardly} with praise but quick to criticize.
e.zh: 他对赞美十分吝啬，却急于批评他人。

nigger.t: n. 黑鬼（蔑称，严重冒犯）

e.en: The novel discusses why the word {nigger} carries such painful history.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了"黑鬼"一词为何承载着如此痛苦的历史。

e.en: Schools have debated whether to teach books containing the word {nigger}.
e.zh: 学校一直在争论是否应教授含有该侮辱性词汇的书籍。

niggle.t:
v. 挑剔；烦扰
n. 小疑虑

e.en: A small {niggle} of doubt kept her from signing the contract.
e.zh: 一丝挥之不去的疑虑让她迟迟没有签合同。

e.en: Don't {niggle} over every tiny detail of the report.
e.zh: 别在报告的每个琐碎细节上斤斤计较。

niggling.t: adj. 烦人的；琐碎恼人的

e.en: He has a {niggling} injury that's affecting his running form.
e.zh: 他有一处恼人的小伤，影响了他的跑步姿势。

e.en: There's a {niggling} feeling that I forgot something important.
e.zh: 我有种挥之不去的感觉，好像忘了什么重要的事。

nigh.t:
adv. 临近；几乎
adj. 接近的

e.en: Many people felt the end of the world was {nigh}.
e.zh: 许多人觉得世界末日近在眼前。

e.en: It's {nigh} impossible to find parking downtown on Saturdays.
e.zh: 周六在市中心找停车位几乎是不可能的。

e.en: We stayed up all {night} watching old movies and eating popcorn.
e.zh: 我们整晚没睡，一边看老电影一边吃爆米花。

e.en: The city looks magical at {night} with all the lights on.
e.zh: 夜晚灯火齐明的城市看起来如梦如幻。

e.en: He poured himself a small {nightcap} before heading to bed.
e.zh: 他给自己倒了一小杯睡前酒，然后上床睡觉。

e.en: Grandma still wears a knitted {nightcap} during winter nights.
e.zh: 奶奶冬夜里还戴着一顶针织睡帽。

e.en: The kids ran downstairs in their {nightclothes} to open presents.
e.zh: 孩子们穿着睡衣冲下楼去拆礼物。

e.en: She quickly changed out of her {nightclothes} before answering the door.
e.zh: 她迅速换下睡衣才去开门。

e.en: The new {nightclub} downtown stays packed until three in the morning.
e.zh: 市中心那家新夜店一直热闹到凌晨三点。

e.en: Security at the {nightclub} checks every guest's ID at the door.
e.zh: 夜店保安在门口会检查每位客人的身份证件。

e.en: Berlin is famous for its underground {nightclubs} and techno scene.
e.zh: 柏林以其地下夜店和电子音乐场景而闻名。

e.en: Most {nightclubs} require a strict dress code on weekends.
e.zh: 大多数夜店在周末有严格的着装要求。

e.en: She bought a soft cotton {nightdress} for the hot summer nights.
e.zh: 她买了一件柔软的棉质睡裙应付炎热的夏夜。

e.en: The little girl's {nightdress} was covered in tiny printed stars.
e.zh: 小女孩的睡裙上印满了小星星图案。

e.en: We need to set up the tent before {nightfall} arrives.
e.zh: 我们得在夜幕降临之前把帐篷搭好。

e.en: The streets grew quiet as {nightfall} settled over the village.
e.zh: 夜幕笼罩村庄，街道渐渐安静下来。

e.en: She slipped into a long silk {nightgown} before going to bed.
e.zh: 她换上一件长款丝绸睡袍才去睡觉。

e.en: The hotel provides a soft white {nightgown} for every guest.
e.zh: 酒店为每位客人提供一件柔软的白色睡袍。

e.en: A {nighthawk} swooped low across the field hunting for insects.
e.zh: 一只夜鹰低低地掠过田野捕捉昆虫。

e.en: He's a real {nighthawk} who does his best coding after midnight.
e.zh: 他是个十足的夜猫子，午夜后写代码效率最高。

e.en: She slipped into a cotton {nightie} before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前换上了一件棉质睡裙。

e.en: The little girl's pink {nightie} had cartoon stars on it.
e.zh: 小女孩的粉色睡裙上印着卡通星星。

e.en: A {nightingale} sang outside the bedroom window.
e.zh: 一只夜莺在卧室窗外鸣唱。

e.en: Poets often compare a beautiful voice to a {nightingale}.
e.zh: 诗人常把美妙的嗓音比作夜莺。

e.en: The {nightjar} is hard to spot due to its camouflage.
e.zh: 夜鹰因伪装色而很难被发现。

e.en: We heard a {nightjar} calling from the woods at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时我们听到林中传来夜鹰的叫声。

e.en: Tokyo is famous for its vibrant {nightlife}.
e.zh: 东京以其热闹的夜生活而闻名。

e.en: After the pandemic, the city's {nightlife} slowly recovered.
e.zh: 疫情过后,这座城市的夜生活慢慢恢复了。

e.en: Different cities have very different {nightlives}.
e.zh: 不同城市的夜生活差异很大。

e.en: The book compares the {nightlives} of Berlin and Bangkok.
e.zh: 这本书比较了柏林和曼谷的夜生活。

nightly.t:
adv. 每夜；夜间
adj. 每晚的

e.en: He watches the {nightly} news before going to sleep.
e.zh: 他睡前会看每晚的新闻节目。

e.en: The hotel charges two hundred dollars {nightly}.
e.zh: 这家酒店每晚收费两百美元。

e.en: Driving in rush hour traffic is a complete {nightmare}.
e.zh: 高峰时段开车简直是一场噩梦。

e.en: She woke up sweating from a terrifying {nightmare}.
e.zh: 她从可怕的噩梦中惊醒,出了一身汗。

e.en: The horror movie gave the kids {nightmares} for weeks.
e.zh: 这部恐怖片让孩子们做了好几周的噩梦。

e.en: Tax season is the stuff of {nightmares} for small businesses.
e.zh: 报税季是小企业的噩梦时节。

e.en: The traffic jam turned the commute into a {nightmarish} ordeal.
e.zh: 堵车让通勤变成了噩梦般的折磨。

e.en: The novel describes a {nightmarish} dystopian future.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个噩梦般的反乌托邦未来。

nights.t:
n. night 的复数
adv. 每到夜里

e.en: Summer {nights} in Spain are warm and lively.
e.zh: 西班牙的夏夜既温暖又热闹。

e.en: He works {nights} at the hospital as a nurse.
e.zh: 他在医院上夜班做护士。

e.en: Deadly {nightshade} contains highly toxic alkaloids.
e.zh: 颠茄含有剧毒的生物碱。

e.en: Tomatoes belong to the {nightshade} family of plants.
e.zh: 番茄属于茄科植物。

e.en: Nurses on the {nightshift} rely on caffeine to stay alert.
e.zh: 上夜班的护士靠咖啡因保持清醒。

e.en: He earns extra pay for working the {nightshift}.
e.zh: 他因为上夜班而多拿一些工资。

e.en: Grandpa wore an old-fashioned flannel {nightshirt}.
e.zh: 爷爷穿着一件老式的法兰绒睡衣。

e.en: He pulled on a long {nightshirt} and climbed into bed.
e.zh: 他套上长睡衣便钻进了被窝。

e.en: That bar is the trendiest {nightspot} in the city.
e.zh: 那家酒吧是城里最潮的夜店。

e.en: The jazz club is a popular {nightspot} for tourists.
e.zh: 这家爵士俱乐部是游客们爱去的夜店。

e.en: She keeps a glass of water on the {nightstand}.
e.zh: 她在床头柜上放了一杯水。

e.en: My phone charges on the {nightstand} every night.
e.zh: 我的手机每晚都在床头柜上充电。

newquay.t: n. 纽基（英国康沃尔郡海滨小镇）

e.en: {Newquay} has some of the best surfing beaches in England.
e.zh: 纽基拥有英格兰最好的几个冲浪海滩。

e.en: We rented a campervan and drove down to {Newquay}.
e.zh: 我们租了一辆露营车,开到了纽基。

newry.t: n. 纽里（北爱尔兰城市）

e.en: {Newry} sits right on the border between Northern Ireland and Ireland.
e.zh: 纽里就坐落在北爱尔兰和爱尔兰的边界线上。

e.en: Shoppers from across the border flock to {Newry} for bargains.
e.zh: 边境另一侧的购物者纷纷涌到纽里淘便宜货。

e.en: I check the {news} on my phone every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上都会用手机看新闻。

e.en: She got some great {news} about her job interview today.
e.zh: 她今天收到了关于面试的好消息。

newsagent.t: n. 报刊经销商；报刊亭

e.en: I picked up a magazine from the {newsagent} on the corner.
e.zh: 我在街角的报刊亭买了本杂志。

e.en: The local {newsagent} also sells lottery tickets and snacks.
e.zh: 当地的报刊亭还卖彩票和零食。

newsboy.t: n. 卖报或送报的男孩

e.en: A {newsboy} stood on the corner shouting the morning headlines.
e.zh: 一个报童站在街角大声喊着早间头条。

e.en: He wore a tweed {newsboy} cap that looked vintage.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶看起来很复古的花呢报童帽。

newscast.t: n. 电视或广播的新闻节目

e.en: The evening {newscast} led with the storm warning for tonight.
e.zh: 晚间新闻以今晚的暴风雨预警作为头条。

e.en: I rarely watch the local {newscast} anymore since I read online.
e.zh: 我现在都看网上新闻,几乎不看本地电视新闻了。

e.en: The {newscaster} kept a calm tone while reporting the disaster.
e.zh: 主播在播报灾难时一直保持着平静的语调。

e.en: She dreamed of becoming a TV {newscaster} since high school.
e.zh: 她从高中起就梦想成为一名电视新闻主播。

e.en: The {newscasters} interviewed survivors live from the disaster zone.
e.zh: 新闻主播在灾区现场采访幸存者。

e.en: Two {newscasters} share the desk on the morning show.
e.zh: 两位新闻主播共同主持晨间节目。

e.en: Call the {newsdesk} if you spot breaking news downtown.
e.zh: 如果在市中心发现突发新闻，请联系新闻编辑部。

e.en: The {newsdesk} stayed open all night during the election.
e.zh: 选举期间新闻编辑部彻夜运转。

e.en: A {newsflash} interrupted the movie to report the earthquake.
e.zh: 一则新闻快讯中断了电影，报道了地震消息。

e.en: {Newsflash}: the concert has been postponed until Sunday.
e.zh: 快讯：演唱会已延期至周日举行。

newsgroup.t: n. 网络新闻组，讨论组

e.en: He posted his question to a Linux {newsgroup} in 1998.
e.zh: 他在1998年向一个Linux新闻组发帖提问。

e.en: Old Usenet {newsgroup} archives still hold valuable technical discussions.
e.zh: 旧的Usenet新闻组档案仍保留着宝贵的技术讨论。

newshound.t: n. 热衷追新闻的记者

e.en: That {newshound} chases every rumor coming out of City Hall.
e.zh: 那位新闻迷追踪着市政厅传出的每一条传闻。

e.en: My grandmother is a real {newshound}, reading three papers daily.
e.zh: 我祖母是个十足的新闻迷，每天读三份报纸。

newsletter.t: n. 定期发送的新闻通讯，简报

e.en: I subscribed to a weekly tech {newsletter} on Substack.
e.zh: 我在Substack订阅了一份每周科技通讯。

e.en: The school sends a {newsletter} to parents every Friday.
e.zh: 学校每周五给家长发一份通讯。

e.en: My inbox is flooded with {newsletters} I never read.
e.zh: 我的收件箱塞满了从来不看的订阅邮件。

e.en: Several startup {newsletters} cover funding rounds and product launches.
e.zh: 几份创业通讯专门报道融资和产品发布。

e.en: The young senator became a {newsmaker} after her viral speech.
e.zh: 那位年轻参议员凭借爆红演讲成为新闻人物。

e.en: Tech CEOs are reliable {newsmaker} subjects for business magazines.
e.zh: 科技公司CEO是商业杂志可靠的新闻人物报道对象。

e.en: The veteran {newsman} retired after forty years on television.
e.zh: 这位资深新闻主播在电视台工作四十年后退休。

e.en: A local {newsman} broke the story before national outlets.
e.zh: 一位本地记者抢在全国媒体之前披露了这则新闻。

e.en: My dad still reads a paper {newspaper} every morning.
e.zh: 我爸每天早上仍然读纸质报纸。

e.en: The {newspaper} won a Pulitzer for its investigative reporting.
e.zh: 该报凭借调查报道荣获普利策奖。

newspaperman.t: n. 报社记者，男性新闻从业者

e.en: He worked as a {newspaperman} in Chicago for thirty years.
e.zh: 他在芝加哥当了三十年的报人。

e.en: The old {newspaperman} kept a typewriter on his desk.
e.zh: 那位老报人办公桌上一直摆着打字机。

e.en: Most {newspapers} now earn more from digital subscriptions than print.
e.zh: 如今大多数报纸的数字订阅收入已超过纸版。

e.en: She wraps fragile dishes in old {newspapers} when moving.
e.zh: 她搬家时用旧报纸包易碎的盘子。

newspeak.t: n. 官方粉饰性语言（源自《1984》）

e.en: Critics called the official statement pure corporate {newspeak}.
e.zh: 批评者称这份官方声明是十足的企业新话。

e.en: Orwell coined {newspeak} to describe language that controls thought.
e.zh: 奥威尔创造了"新话"一词，用来形容操控思想的语言。

e.en: Several {newspeople} gathered outside the courthouse for comment.
e.zh: 几位记者聚集在法院外等待发言。

e.en: Local {newspeople} have lost jobs as papers shut down.
e.zh: 随着报社关闭，本地新闻从业者纷纷失业。

e.en: The cost of {newsprint} has soared in the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年新闻纸的价格大幅飙升。

e.en: His fingers were stained black from cheap {newsprint}.
e.zh: 他的手指被劣质新闻纸染得乌黑。

newsreader.t: n. 新闻播报员；新闻阅读器

e.en: The BBC {newsreader} announced the results at midnight.
e.zh: BBC新闻播报员在午夜宣读了结果。

e.en: She trained as a {newsreader} before becoming a documentary host.
e.zh: 她转做纪录片主持人之前曾接受过新闻播报员的培训。

newsreel.t: n. 影院放映的新闻短片

e.en: Old {newsreel} footage showed crowds celebrating the war's end.
e.zh: 旧的新闻片画面显示人群在庆祝战争结束。

e.en: They watched a black-and-white {newsreel} before the feature film.
e.zh: 他们在正片放映前看了一段黑白新闻片。

e.en: The {newsroom} buzzed with energy on election night.
e.zh: 选举之夜的新闻编辑室一片忙碌。

e.en: Layoffs have shrunk the {newsroom} to half its size.
e.zh: 裁员让新闻编辑室的规模缩减了一半。

e.en: The village prints a small {newssheet} every other week.
e.zh: 村里每两周印发一份小型新闻简报。

e.en: Volunteers distribute the church {newssheet} after Sunday service.
e.zh: 志愿者在主日礼拜后分发教会的新闻简报。

e.en: I grabbed a magazine from the {newsstand} at the station.
e.zh: 我在车站的报刊亭买了一本杂志。

e.en: The corner {newsstand} closed after fifty years of business.
e.zh: 街角的报刊亭在经营五十年后关门了。

e.en: Lord Byron inherited {Newstead} Abbey at the age of ten.
e.zh: 拜伦勋爵十岁时继承了纽斯特德庄园。

e.en: Tourists visit {Newstead} to see Byron's restored ancestral home.
e.zh: 游客前往纽斯特德参观拜伦修复后的祖宅。

e.en: The story made the cover of {Newsweek} that month.
e.zh: 那篇报道登上了当月《新闻周刊》的封面。

e.en: {Newsweek} shifted to digital-first publishing over a decade ago.
e.zh: 《新闻周刊》十多年前就转向了数字优先的出版模式。

newswire.t: n. 新闻通讯社发送的电讯

e.en: The story moved on the Reuters {newswire} within minutes.
e.zh: 这则消息几分钟内就上了路透社的新闻专线。

e.en: Editors monitor the {newswire} for breaking developments overnight.
e.zh: 编辑通宵盯着新闻专线，跟踪突发动态。

e.en: The award-winning {newswoman} reported from war zones for decades.
e.zh: 这位获奖的女记者数十年来从战区发回报道。

e.en: A young {newswoman} broke the corruption scandal wide open.
e.zh: 一位年轻女记者彻底揭开了贪腐丑闻的内幕。

e.en: Editors debated the {newsworthiness} of the celebrity's tweet.
e.zh: 编辑们就那位名人推文的新闻价值展开了争论。

e.en: Local impact often determines a story's {newsworthiness} for regional papers.
e.zh: 对地方报纸而言，本地影响往往决定一则新闻的报道价值。

e.en: The mayor's resignation is definitely {newsworthy} this week.
e.zh: 市长辞职本周绝对是值得报道的大新闻。

e.en: Not every social media post is actually {newsworthy}.
e.zh: 并不是每条社交媒体帖子都真的有新闻价值。

e.en: She sent a long, {newsy} email about her summer travels.
e.zh: 她发来一封长长的、内容丰富的邮件，讲述夏天的旅行。

e.en: His blog has a {newsy} feel with frequent updates.
e.zh: 他的博客更新频繁，颇有新闻速递的感觉。

newt.t: n. 蝾螈（小型两栖动物）

e.en: A small {newt} darted under a rock in the pond.
e.zh: 一只小蝾螈钻到了池塘里的石头下面。

e.en: Children spotted a spotted {newt} near the garden stream.
e.zh: 孩子们在花园小溪边发现了一只斑点蝾螈。

newton.t: n. 牛顿（力的单位；人名）

e.en: One {newton} equals the force needed to accelerate one kilogram.
e.zh: 一牛顿等于使一公斤物体产生加速度所需的力。

e.en: Isaac {Newton} formulated the laws of motion in the 1680s.
e.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿在17世纪80年代提出了运动定律。

newtonian.t: adj. 牛顿的，牛顿力学的

e.en: {Newtonian} physics works fine for everyday speeds and distances.
e.zh: 牛顿力学在日常的速度和距离下完全适用。

e.en: The simulator uses simple {Newtonian} mechanics for the orbit calculations.
e.zh: 该模拟器使用简单的牛顿力学进行轨道计算。

e.en: They moved to {Newtown} for the better school district.
e.zh: 他们为了更好的学区搬到了新城。

e.en: The {Newtown} farmers' market opens every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 新城农贸市场每周六上午开市。

next.t:
adj. 下一个的
adv. 接下来

e.en: Click the button to see the {next} page of results.
e.zh: 点击按钮查看下一页结果。

e.en: I'll catch the {next} train back to the city.
e.zh: 我会赶下一班火车回市里。

e.en: Our {next-door} neighbors invited us over for dinner.
e.zh: 我们的隔壁邻居邀请我们去吃晚饭。

e.en: The {next-door} café makes the best espresso on the block.
e.zh: 隔壁的咖啡馆做的浓缩咖啡是这条街上最棒的。

nexts.t: n. next 的复数形式（罕用）

e.en: The playlist queues up the {nexts} automatically after each song.
e.zh: 播放列表在每首歌结束后会自动排好下一曲。

e.en: In the schedule view, upcoming {nexts} appear in gray.
e.zh: 在日程视图中，即将到来的下一项以灰色显示。

e.en: Apple's macOS evolved from the original {NeXTSTEP} operating system.
e.zh: 苹果的macOS脱胎于最初的NeXTSTEP操作系统。

e.en: Developers loved {NeXTSTEP} for its elegant object-oriented frameworks.
e.zh: 开发者钟爱NeXTSTEP优雅的面向对象框架。

nexus.t: n. 联系，纽带；核心枢纽

e.en: Singapore is a major financial {nexus} in Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 新加坡是东南亚重要的金融枢纽。

e.en: The startup sits at the {nexus} of AI and healthcare.
e.zh: 这家初创公司处于人工智能与医疗健康的交汇点。

nez.t: n. Nez（专有名词，如 Nez Perce 族）

e.en: The {Nez} Perce tribe lived across the Pacific Northwest.
e.zh: 内兹珀斯部族曾居住在太平洋西北地区一带。

e.en: Chief Joseph led the {Nez} Perce on a long retreat.
e.zh: 约瑟夫酋长率领内兹珀斯人进行了一次漫长的撤退。

nfc.t: n. 近场通信（手机感应支付等）

e.en: Just tap your phone on the {NFC} reader to pay.
e.zh: 只需用手机轻触NFC读卡器即可付款。

e.en: Modern hotel keys often use {NFC} chips instead of magnetic stripes.
e.zh: 现代酒店门卡常用NFC芯片代替磁条。

nfl.t: n. 美国国家橄榄球联盟

e.en: The {NFL} season kicks off on the first Thursday of September.
e.zh: NFL赛季在九月第一个星期四正式开打。

e.en: He dreamed of playing in the {NFL} since middle school.
e.zh: 他从中学起就梦想能在NFL打球。

nfs.t: n. 网络文件系统（Network File System）

e.en: We mounted the shared directory over {NFS} for the cluster.
e.zh: 我们通过NFS将共享目录挂载到集群上。

e.en: {NFS} performance drops noticeably over high-latency network connections.
e.zh: 在高延迟的网络连接下，NFS的性能会明显下降。

nfu.t: n. 英国全国农民联盟缩写

e.en: The {NFU} represents thousands of farmers across the United Kingdom.
e.zh: 全国农民联合会代表着英国各地数以千计的农民。

e.en: Farmers attended the {NFU} conference to discuss subsidy reforms.
e.zh: 农民们参加全国农民联合会的会议，讨论补贴改革。

e.en: The officer carried a {nightstick} on his belt.
e.zh: 那名警官腰带上挂着一根警棍。

e.en: Police are trained to use a {nightstick} only as last resort.
e.zh: 警察受训只把警棍当作最后手段使用。

e.en: Owls are most active during {nighttime} hours.
e.zh: 猫头鹰在夜间最为活跃。

e.en: Use a {nighttime} moisturizer for deeper hydration.
e.zh: 使用夜间保湿霜可以更深层补水。

nightwatchman.t: n. 守夜人；夜间值班员

e.en: The {nightwatchman} patrolled the warehouse with a flashlight.
e.zh: 夜间看守员打着手电巡视仓库。

e.en: An elderly {nightwatchman} guarded the museum entrance.
e.zh: 一位年长的夜班守卫守在博物馆门口。

nightwear.t: n. 睡衣；夜间穿的衣物

e.en: The store has a sale on silk {nightwear} this week.
e.zh: 这家店本周丝绸睡衣特价销售。

e.en: Comfortable {nightwear} helps you sleep better.
e.zh: 舒适的睡衣有助于你睡得更好。

nigra.t: adj. 黑色的（拉丁语词根，罕用）

e.en: The substantia {nigra} is affected in Parkinson's disease.
e.zh: 帕金森病会影响大脑中的黑质。

e.en: Researchers studied dopamine neurons in the substantia {nigra}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了黑质中的多巴胺神经元。

nih.t: n. 美国国立卫生研究院（National Institutes of Health 缩写）

e.en: The {NIH} funds a wide range of medical research.
e.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院资助大量医学研究。

e.en: Her lab received a grant from the {NIH} last year.
e.zh: 她的实验室去年获得了美国国立卫生研究院的资助。

e.en: The novel explores themes of {nihilism} and despair.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了虚无主义和绝望的主题。

e.en: Online culture sometimes drifts toward ironic {nihilism}.
e.zh: 网络文化有时会滑向一种反讽式虚无主义。

e.en: He claims to be a {nihilist} but still pays his taxes.
e.zh: 他自称是虚无主义者,却照样交税。

e.en: The character is portrayed as a brooding young {nihilist}.
e.zh: 这个角色被塑造成一个忧郁的年轻虚无主义者。

e.en: His {nihilistic} jokes make everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那些虚无主义的玩笑让大家很不自在。

e.en: The film has a deeply {nihilistic} ending.
e.zh: 这部电影有一个极度虚无主义的结局。

nijinsky.t: n. 尼金斯基（俄国著名芭蕾舞者）

e.en: {Nijinsky} is remembered as one of the greatest dancers ever.
e.zh: 尼金斯基被誉为有史以来最伟大的舞者之一。

e.en: The biography details {Nijinsky}'s rise and tragic decline.
e.zh: 这本传记记述了尼金斯基的崛起与悲剧性衰落。

nik.t: n. 后缀，表示爱好者（如 peacenik）

e.en: The suffix "-{nik}" appears in words like beatnik and refusenik.
e.zh: "-nik"这个后缀出现在beatnik和refusenik等词中。

e.en: He's a real computer {nik}, always tinkering with code.
e.zh: 他是个十足的电脑迷,总在折腾代码。

nike.t: n. 耐克（运动品牌）；希腊胜利女神

e.en: She bought a new pair of {Nike} running shoes.
e.zh: 她买了一双新的耐克跑鞋。

e.en: {Nike} announced a sponsorship deal with the young athlete.
e.zh: 耐克宣布与这位年轻运动员签下赞助合约。

nikkei.t: n. 日经指数（日本股市指数）

e.en: The {Nikkei} index closed higher after positive earnings reports.
e.zh: 日经指数在利好财报公布后收高。

e.en: Tokyo's {Nikkei} fell sharply on inflation concerns.
e.zh: 东京日经指数因通胀担忧大幅下挫。

e.en: We took the train to {Nikko} to see the autumn leaves.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去日光看红叶。

e.en: {Nikko}'s ancient shrines are a UNESCO World Heritage site.
e.zh: 日光的古代神社是联合国教科文组织的世界遗产。

e.en: He shoots wildlife photos with a professional {Nikon} camera.
e.zh: 他用一台专业尼康相机拍野生动物照片。

e.en: {Nikon} just released a new mirrorless camera body.
e.zh: 尼康刚发布了一款新的无反相机机身。

e.en: The match ended two-{nil} in our favor.
e.zh: 比赛以二比零我方取胜结束。

e.en: Chances of rain tomorrow are virtually {nil}.
e.zh: 明天下雨的可能性几乎为零。

e.en: The {Nile} is the longest river in Africa.
e.zh: 尼罗河是非洲最长的河流。

e.en: Ancient Egyptian civilization flourished along the {Nile}.
e.zh: 古埃及文明沿着尼罗河繁荣发展。

nilgai.t: n. 蓝牛羚（印度大型羚羊）

e.en: The {nilgai} is the largest antelope native to India.
e.zh: 蓝牛羚是印度本土最大的羚羊。

e.en: A herd of {nilgai} grazed peacefully at the edge of the forest.
e.zh: 一群蓝牛羚在森林边缘安静地吃草。

nim.t: n. 取子游戏；Nim 编程语言

e.en: {Nim} is a classic mathematical game of strategy.
e.zh: 尼姆游戏是一种经典的数学策略游戏。

e.en: He wrote his backend service in the {Nim} programming language.
e.zh: 他用Nim编程语言写了后端服务。

e.en: The cat made a {nimble} leap onto the bookshelf.
e.zh: 那只猫敏捷地一跃跳上了书架。

e.en: Small startups are more {nimble} than large corporations.
e.zh: 小型初创公司比大企业更灵活敏捷。

e.en: The dancer's {nimbleness} amazed the audience.
e.zh: 舞者的灵巧让观众惊叹不已。

e.en: Mental {nimbleness} matters more than raw memory in this job.
e.zh: 在这份工作中,思维灵活比死记硬背更重要。

e.en: She {nimbly} dodged the puddles on the sidewalk.
e.zh: 她灵巧地避开了人行道上的水坑。

e.en: The startup {nimbly} adapted to changing market conditions.
e.zh: 这家初创公司灵活地适应了变化的市场环境。

e.en: A dark {nimbus} cloud signaled the approaching storm.
e.zh: 一团乌黑的雨云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

e.en: The saint was painted with a golden {nimbus} around his head.
e.zh: 画中的圣人头上绘有金色的光环。

nimby.t: n. 邻避（Not In My Back Yard 缩写）

e.en: Local {NIMBY} groups blocked the new housing development.
e.zh: 当地的邻避组织阻止了新住宅项目的开发。

e.en: He supports renewable energy but is a {NIMBY} about wind turbines.
e.zh: 他支持可再生能源,却反对在自家附近建风机。

nimrod.t: n. 宁录（圣经人物）；猎人；蠢货（俚语）

e.en: Don't be such a {nimrod} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么犯傻,先看看说明书。

e.en: The Bible describes {Nimrod} as a mighty hunter.
e.zh: 《圣经》中将宁录描述为一位强大的猎人。

e.en: Only a {nincompoop} would forget his own birthday.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会忘了自己的生日。

e.en: She called the rude driver a complete {nincompoop}.
e.zh: 她骂那个粗鲁的司机是个十足的笨蛋。

e.en: The meeting starts at {nine} sharp tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 会议明天早上九点整开始。

e.en: My daughter just turned {nine} last weekend.
e.zh: 我女儿上周末刚满九岁。

ninepence.t: n. 九便士（旧英国货币）

e.en: In old British currency, {ninepence} was a common amount.
e.zh: 在旧英国货币中,九便士是个常见的金额。

e.en: The vintage stamp originally cost just {ninepence}.
e.zh: 这张老邮票当年只卖九便士。

e.en: She turned {nineteen} just before starting university.
e.zh: 她在上大学前刚满十九岁。

e.en: The team scored {nineteen} points in the final quarter.
e.zh: 球队在最后一节得了十九分。

nineteenth.t: num. 第十九；十九分之一

e.en: This novel was written in the {nineteenth} century.
e.zh: 这部小说写于十九世纪。

e.en: Her birthday falls on the {nineteenth} of June.
e.zh: 她的生日是六月十九日。

ninetieth.t: num. 第九十；九十分之一

e.en: We threw a big party for grandma's {ninetieth} birthday.
e.zh: 我们为奶奶的九十大寿办了一场盛大的派对。

e.en: He finished {ninetieth} out of two hundred runners.
e.zh: 在两百名选手中他排在第九十名。

e.en: My grandfather is almost {ninety} but still gardens daily.
e.zh: 我祖父快九十岁了,但每天还在打理花园。

e.en: The flight takes about {ninety} minutes from Beijing to Shanghai.
e.zh: 从北京飞上海大约需要九十分钟。

nineveh.t: n. 尼尼微（古亚述首都）

e.en: Ancient {Nineveh} was once the capital of the Assyrian Empire.
e.zh: 古城尼尼微曾是亚述帝国的首都。

e.en: Archaeologists have uncovered remarkable ruins at {Nineveh}.
e.zh: 考古学家在尼尼微发掘出了令人惊叹的遗迹。

e.en: He moves through the kitchen like a silent {ninja}.
e.zh: 他在厨房里走动起来像个无声的忍者。

e.en: She's a coding {ninja} who fixes bugs in minutes.
e.zh: 她是个编程高手,几分钟就能修复漏洞。

e.en: Don't be a {ninny} — just ask for help when you need it.
e.zh: 别犯傻了,需要帮忙就开口。

e.en: He felt like a {ninny} after locking his keys in the car.
e.zh: 把钥匙锁在车里后,他觉得自己像个傻瓜。

e.en: My nephew got a {Nintendo} Switch for his birthday.
e.zh: 我侄子生日时收到了一台任天堂Switch。

e.en: {Nintendo} released another Mario game this fall.
e.zh: 任天堂今年秋天又推出了一款马里奥游戏。

e.en: She finished in {ninth} place at the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中获得了第九名。

e.en: My office is on the {ninth} floor of the building.
e.zh: 我的办公室在大楼的第九层。

e.en: {Niobium} is used to make superconducting magnets.
e.zh: 铌被用于制造超导磁体。

e.en: The alloy contains small amounts of {niobium} for strength.
e.zh: 该合金含有少量铌以增加强度。

nip.t:
v. 夹；捏；小口喝
n. 寒意；一小口

e.en: The puppy tried to {nip} my fingers playfully.
e.zh: 小狗调皮地想咬我的手指。

e.en: There's a {nip} in the air this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上空气里透着一丝寒意。

e.en: The little {nipper} ran around the playground laughing.
e.zh: 那个小家伙在操场上跑来跑去笑个不停。

e.en: He used a {nipper} to cut the wire cleanly.
e.zh: 他用钳子把电线剪得干净利落。

e.en: Bring the {nippers} to trim these stray cables.
e.zh: 把钳子拿过来,修剪这些散乱的电线。

e.en: The crab waved its tiny {nippers} at us.
e.zh: 那只螃蟹朝我们挥舞着小钳子。

nipping.t:
adj. 刺骨的；凛冽的
v. 夹、咬（nip 的现在分词）

e.en: A cold wind was {nipping} at our cheeks.
e.zh: 寒风刺得我们的脸颊生疼。

e.en: I'm just {nipping} out to grab some coffee.
e.zh: 我只是出去一下买杯咖啡。

e.en: Replace the bottle's {nipple} when it gets worn.
e.zh: 奶嘴磨损后要及时更换。

e.en: The baby refused to take the rubber {nipple}.
e.zh: 宝宝不肯吸橡胶奶嘴。

e.en: {Nippon} is the Japanese name for Japan itself.
e.zh: 日本人自己用Nippon这个名字称呼日本。

e.en: The cargo ship sailed under the {Nippon} flag.
e.zh: 那艘货船悬挂着日本国旗航行。

nippy.t: adj. 寒冷刺骨的；敏捷的

e.en: It's pretty {nippy} outside, so wear a jacket.
e.zh: 外面挺冷的,穿件外套吧。

e.en: This little hatchback is surprisingly {nippy} in traffic.
e.zh: 这辆小掀背车在车流中出奇地灵活。

e.en: For coffee lovers, this café is pure {nirvana}.
e.zh: 对咖啡爱好者来说,这家咖啡馆简直是天堂。

e.en: Buddhist monks meditate to attain {nirvana}.
e.zh: 佛教僧侣通过冥想来达到涅槃。

nis.t: abbr. 网络信息服务（Network Information Service）

e.en: The server uses {NIS} to manage user accounts centrally.
e.zh: 该服务器使用NIS来集中管理用户账户。

e.en: Most modern networks have replaced {NIS} with LDAP.
e.zh: 大多数现代网络已经用LDAP取代了NIS。

nisei.t: n. 日裔二世（海外出生的日本移民后代）

e.en: Many {Nisei} served honorably in the U.S. army.
e.zh: 许多日裔二代曾在美军中光荣服役。

e.en: His grandmother was a {Nisei} born in California.
e.zh: 他祖母是出生在加利福尼亚的日裔二代。

nisi.t: adj. 暂准的（法律用语，附条件生效）

e.en: The court issued a decree {nisi} for the divorce.
e.zh: 法院就这宗离婚案发出了暂准判决。

e.en: A decree {nisi} becomes absolute after six weeks.
e.zh: 暂准判决在六周后即成为绝对判决。

nissan.t: n. 日产（日本汽车品牌）

e.en: She just bought a used {Nissan} Leaf for commuting.
e.zh: 她刚买了一辆二手日产Leaf用来通勤。

e.en: {Nissan} announced a new electric SUV last week.
e.zh: 日产上周发布了一款新型电动SUV。

nissen.t: n. 尼森式拱形活动房屋

e.en: The soldiers slept in a corrugated {Nissen} hut.
e.zh: 士兵们睡在波纹铁皮搭的活动营房里。

e.en: Old {Nissen} huts still stand on the abandoned airfield.
e.zh: 废弃机场上还留着几间旧式活动营房。

e.en: The school nurse found a {nit} in her hair.
e.zh: 校医在她头发里发现了一颗虱卵。

e.en: Stop being such a {nit} about every detail.
e.zh: 别在每个细节上都那么吹毛求疵。

nite.t: n. 夜晚（night 的非正式写法）

e.en: Good {nite}, sleep tight, see you tomorrow.
e.zh: 晚安,睡个好觉,明天见。

e.en: The diner has a $5 burger {nite} on Tuesdays.
e.zh: 那家餐厅周二推出五美元汉堡之夜。

nitpick.t: v. 吹毛求疵；挑小毛病

e.en: Please don't {nitpick} every line of my draft.
e.zh: 请别对我草稿的每一行都吹毛求疵。

e.en: Reviewers tend to {nitpick} minor formatting issues.
e.zh: 评审者往往会对微小的格式问题斤斤计较。

e.en: High {nitrate} levels in the river harm fish populations.
e.zh: 河水中高浓度的硝酸盐会危害鱼群。

e.en: Farmers often apply {nitrate} fertilizer to boost crop yields.
e.zh: 农民常施用硝酸盐肥料来提高作物产量。

e.en: {Nitric} acid is widely used in fertilizer production.
e.zh: 硝酸广泛用于化肥的生产。

e.en: Our bodies produce {nitric} oxide to relax blood vessels.
e.zh: 人体会产生一氧化氮来舒张血管。

e.en: Gallium {nitride} chargers are smaller and more efficient.
e.zh: 氮化镓充电器更小巧也更高效。

e.en: The drill bit is coated with titanium {nitride}.
e.zh: 这个钻头表面镀了一层氮化钛。

e.en: {Nitrification} converts ammonia into nitrate in soil.
e.zh: 硝化作用会将土壤中的氨转化为硝酸盐。

e.en: Bacteria drive {nitrification} in healthy aquariums.
e.zh: 细菌在健康的水族箱中推动着硝化过程。

e.en: Cured bacon often contains sodium {nitrite} as a preservative.
e.zh: 腌制培根中常含有亚硝酸钠作为防腐剂。

e.en: Test the tank water weekly for {nitrite} levels.
e.zh: 每周检测一次鱼缸水的亚硝酸盐含量。

e.en: He ordered a {nitro} cold brew at the café.
e.zh: 他在咖啡馆点了一杯氮气冷萃咖啡。

e.en: Discord {Nitro} unlocks larger file uploads and custom emojis.
e.zh: Discord的Nitro会员可以上传更大的文件和使用自定义表情。

e.en: Plants need {nitrogen} to grow strong leaves.
e.zh: 植物需要氮元素才能长出健壮的叶子。

e.en: Liquid {nitrogen} is used to flash-freeze ice cream.
e.zh: 液氮被用来快速冷冻冰淇淋。

e.en: Beans add {nitrogenous} compounds back to the soil.
e.zh: 豆类能将含氮化合物重新补充到土壤中。

e.en: The kidneys filter {nitrogenous} waste from the blood.
e.zh: 肾脏负责从血液中过滤含氮废物。

nitroglycerin.t: n. 硝化甘油（炸药、心脏药）

e.en: Doctors prescribe {nitroglycerin} for sudden chest pain.
e.zh: 医生会开硝酸甘油来缓解突发的胸痛。

e.en: {Nitroglycerin} is the explosive compound found in dynamite.
e.zh: 硝酸甘油是炸药中所含的爆炸性化合物。

e.en: He carried a small bottle of {nitroglycerine} pills.
e.zh: 他随身带着一小瓶硝酸甘油片。

e.en: {Nitroglycerine} must be transported with extreme care.
e.zh: 硝酸甘油在运输时必须格外小心。

nitrosamine.t: n. 亚硝胺（致癌化合物）

e.en: Regulators recalled the drug due to {nitrosamine} contamination.
e.zh: 监管机构因亚硝胺污染召回了该药。

e.en: Grilled meats can contain trace amounts of {nitrosamine}.
e.zh: 烧烤肉类中可能含有微量的亚硝胺。

nitrous.t: adj. 亚硝的；一氧化二氮的

e.en: The dentist offered {nitrous} oxide to ease anxiety.
e.zh: 牙医提供笑气来缓解病人的紧张情绪。

e.en: Race cars sometimes use {nitrous} to boost acceleration.
e.zh: 赛车有时会使用一氧化二氮来提升加速性能。

nitty.t: adj. 核心的（常用 nitty-gritty 指本质细节）

e.en: Let's get down to the {nitty}-gritty of the contract.
e.zh: 让我们进入合同里最关键的细节部分。

e.en: The manager loves discussing the {nitty}-gritty details.
e.zh: 那位经理喜欢讨论各种琐碎的细节。

e.en: Don't be such a {nitwit}—read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么糊涂,先把说明书读一遍。

e.en: Some {nitwit} parked across two spaces again.
e.zh: 又有哪个笨蛋把车横跨两个车位停了。

e.en: She rubbed some {Nivea} cream onto her dry hands.
e.zh: 她在干燥的手上抹了点妮维雅润肤霜。

e.en: That blue tin of {Nivea} sits on every bathroom shelf.
e.zh: 那罐蓝色的妮维雅几乎每个浴室架上都有。

nix.t:
v. 否决；禁止
n. 拒绝；零

e.en: The boss decided to {nix} our weekend project.
e.zh: 老板决定否决我们的周末项目。

e.en: They had to {nix} the trip after flights got canceled.
e.zh: 航班取消后他们只好取消了那次旅行。

nixon.t: n. 尼克松（美国前总统）

e.en: {Nixon} resigned the presidency in August 1974.
e.zh: 尼克松于1974年8月辞去了总统职务。

e.en: Historians still debate {Nixon}'s foreign policy legacy.
e.zh: 史学界至今仍在争论尼克松外交政策的遗产。

nixonian.t: adj. 尼克松式的；尼克松时代的

e.en: Critics called the cover-up classically {Nixonian} in nature.
e.zh: 批评人士称这场掩盖行为典型地具有尼克松式的色彩。

e.en: The senator's tactics felt distinctly {Nixonian} to reporters.
e.zh: 在记者眼中,这位参议员的手段颇有尼克松遗风。

nkvd.t: abbr. 苏联内务人民委员部（克格勃前身）

e.en: The {NKVD} carried out mass arrests during Stalin's purges.
e.zh: 内务人民委员部在斯大林大清洗期间进行了大规模逮捕。

e.en: Declassified files revealed how the {NKVD} operated abroad.
e.zh: 解密档案揭示了内务人民委员部在境外的运作方式。

nld.t: abbr. 荷兰（ISO 三字母代码）

e.en: The team's jerseys had {NLD} printed on the back.
e.zh: 队服背后印着代表荷兰的字母NLD。

e.en: Children with {NLD} often struggle with social cues.
e.zh: 患有非语言学习障碍的儿童常常难以理解社交暗示。

nlp.t: abbr. 自然语言处理（Natural Language Processing）

e.en: Modern chatbots rely on advanced {NLP} models.
e.zh: 现代聊天机器人依赖先进的自然语言处理模型。

e.en: She studies {NLP} at a graduate research lab.
e.zh: 她在一个研究生实验室研究自然语言处理。

nmda.t: abbr. N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸（神经递质受体）

e.en: Ketamine blocks the brain's {NMDA} receptors.
e.zh: 氯胺酮会阻断大脑中的NMDA受体。

e.en: {NMDA} receptors play a key role in memory formation.
e.zh: NMDA受体在记忆形成中起着关键作用。

nme.t: abbr. 英国音乐杂志《新音乐快递》

e.en: {NME} reviewed the band's debut album last week.
e.zh: 《NME》杂志上周评论了这支乐队的首张专辑。

e.en: He used to read {NME} every Friday in college.
e.zh: 他大学时每周五都会看《NME》杂志。

nmr.t: abbr. 核磁共振（Nuclear Magnetic Resonance）

e.en: Chemists confirmed the structure using {NMR} spectroscopy.
e.zh: 化学家通过核磁共振谱学确认了该结构。

e.en: The lab just bought a new 600 MHz {NMR} machine.
e.zh: 实验室刚购置了一台600兆赫兹的核磁共振仪。

nob.t: n. 有钱人；大人物（俚语）

e.en: He acted like some posh {nob} from the countryside.
e.zh: 他装出一副乡下来的阔佬模样。

e.en: The party was full of London {nobs} sipping champagne.
e.zh: 派对上挤满了喝着香槟的伦敦贵族。

nobble.t: v. 收买、贿赂；暗中搞垮（英式俚语）

e.en: Someone tried to {nobble} the favorite before the race.
e.zh: 有人试图在比赛前对那匹热门赛马动手脚。

e.en: Reporters tried to {nobble} the minister at the airport.
e.zh: 记者试图在机场拦住那位部长。

nobby.t: adj. 时髦的；上等的（俚语）

e.en: He showed up in a {nobby} velvet jacket.
e.zh: 他穿着一件时髦的丝绒外套出现了。

e.en: She lives in a rather {nobby} part of town.
e.zh: 她住在城里相当高档的一个区。

e.en: She won the {Nobel} Prize in chemistry last year.
e.zh: 她去年获得了诺贝尔化学奖。

e.en: Three researchers shared the {Nobel} for their gene work.
e.zh: 三位研究人员因其基因研究共享了诺贝尔奖。

nobilities.t: n. 贵族阶层（nobility 的复数）

e.en: European {nobilities} once held vast tracts of land.
e.zh: 欧洲各国贵族阶层曾拥有广阔的土地。

e.en: The book compares medieval {nobilities} across different regions.
e.zh: 这本书比较了不同地区中世纪贵族阶层的特点。

nobility.t:
n. 贵族阶层
n. 高尚、崇高

e.en: Members of the {nobility} attended the royal wedding.
e.zh: 贵族成员们出席了那场皇室婚礼。

e.en: There's a quiet {nobility} in how she helps strangers.
e.zh: 她帮助陌生人的方式透着一种静默的高尚。

noble.t:
adj. 高尚的；贵族的
n. 贵族

e.en: Volunteering at the shelter is a {noble} thing to do.
e.zh: 在收容所做志愿者是一件高尚的事。

e.en: A {noble} once owned this entire valley.
e.zh: 曾经有一位贵族拥有整座山谷。

e.en: The {nobleman} owned vast estates across the countryside.
e.zh: 那位贵族在乡间拥有大片庄园。

e.en: A young {nobleman} arrived at court seeking the king's favor.
e.zh: 一位年轻贵族来到宫廷,寻求国王的青睐。

noblemen.t: n. 贵族们（nobleman 的复数）

e.en: Several {noblemen} gathered to sign the famous charter.
e.zh: 几位贵族聚在一起签署那份著名的宪章。

e.en: The {noblemen} rode out to hunt at dawn.
e.zh: 贵族们破晓时分骑马外出打猎。

noblesse.t: n. 贵族阶层；贵族身份

e.en: He helped the poor out of a sense of {noblesse} oblige.
e.zh: 他出于贵族义务感帮助穷人。

e.en: The old families still cling to ideas of {noblesse} and honor.
e.zh: 那些老家族仍坚守贵族身份与荣誉的观念。

e.en: The {noblewoman} hosted lavish dinners at her country house.
e.zh: 那位贵妇在乡间宅邸举办豪华晚宴。

e.en: A {noblewoman} from Florence funded the artist's early work.
e.zh: 一位佛罗伦萨贵妇资助了那位艺术家的早期作品。

e.en: He {nobly} refused to take credit for the team's success.
e.zh: 他高尚地拒绝把团队的成功归功于自己。

e.en: She {nobly} stepped aside so a junior colleague could lead.
e.zh: 她大度地让位,让一位年轻同事来主导。

nobody.t:
pron. 没有人
n. 无名小卒

e.en: {Nobody} answered the door when I knocked.
e.zh: 我敲门时没人应答。

e.en: He felt like a {nobody} until he started his own company.
e.zh: 创业之前他一直觉得自己是个无名小卒。

nock.t:
n. 箭尾凹口
v. 搭箭

e.en: She fitted the arrow's {nock} onto the bowstring carefully.
e.zh: 她小心地把箭尾扣槽对准弓弦。

e.en: Archers learn to {nock} an arrow without looking down.
e.zh: 弓箭手要练到不低头也能搭箭上弦。

e.en: Owls are {nocturnal} hunters with excellent night vision.
e.zh: 猫头鹰是夜行猎手,夜视能力极强。

e.en: As a programmer, he kept {nocturnal} hours by choice.
e.zh: 作为程序员,他主动选择了昼伏夜出的作息。

e.en: Chopin's {nocturne} filled the quiet recital hall.
e.zh: 肖邦的夜曲在静谧的音乐厅里回荡。

e.en: The pianist closed the concert with a gentle {nocturne}.
e.zh: 钢琴家以一首柔和的夜曲结束了音乐会。

nod.t:
v. 点头
n. 点头示意

e.en: She gave a quick {nod} to show she understood.
e.zh: 她迅速点了下头,表示明白了。

e.en: The film includes a clear {nod} to classic westerns.
e.zh: 这部电影明显在向经典西部片致敬。

e.en: Singapore is a {nodal} point in global shipping routes.
e.zh: 新加坡是全球航运网络中的关键节点。

e.en: The graph highlights several {nodal} cities in the network.
e.zh: 该图标出了网络中几个枢纽城市。

nodded.t: v. 点头（nod 的过去式）

e.en: He {nodded} politely as the guests walked in.
e.zh: 客人们走进来时他礼貌地点了点头。

e.en: She {nodded} off during the long afternoon meeting.
e.zh: 漫长的下午会议中她打起了瞌睡。

nodding.t: v. 点头中（nod 的现在分词）

e.en: The audience kept {nodding} along to the speaker's points.
e.zh: 观众频频点头,赞同演讲者的观点。

e.en: I have only a {nodding} acquaintance with their CEO.
e.zh: 我跟他们的首席执行官只是点头之交。

e.en: That's a real {noddy} mistake any beginner could spot.
e.zh: 这是个连新手都看得出来的低级错误。

e.en: The flock of {noddy} terns nested on the small island.
e.zh: 一群玄燕鸥在那座小岛上筑巢。

e.en: Each computer in the cluster acts as a separate {node}.
e.zh: 集群中每台计算机都作为一个独立节点。

e.en: The doctor noticed a swollen lymph {node} in his neck.
e.zh: 医生发现他颈部有一个肿大的淋巴结。

e.en: She {nods} every time her name is mentioned.
e.zh: 每次提到她的名字,她都会点头。

e.en: The new design {nods} to the brand's original logo.
e.zh: 新设计向品牌最初的标志致敬。

nodular.t: adj. 结节状的；有小瘤的

e.en: The scan revealed a small {nodular} growth in her lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示她肺部有一个小的结节状增生。

e.en: This rock has a distinctive {nodular} texture under magnification.
e.zh: 这块岩石在放大镜下呈现明显的结核状结构。

e.en: The dermatologist removed a small {nodule} from his back.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生从他背上切除了一个小结节。

e.en: Each plant root carries a tiny nitrogen-fixing {nodule}.
e.zh: 每条植物根须上都有一个固氮的小根瘤。

e.en: The choir sang a traditional French {noel} on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 合唱团在平安夜唱起一首传统的法式圣诞颂歌。

e.en: "The First {Noel}" played softly throughout the shop.
e.zh: 《第一首圣诞颂歌》在店里轻柔地回荡。

e.en: The book explores {noetic} experiences reported by meditators.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了冥想者报告的心智体验。

e.en: Philosophers distinguish sensory perception from {noetic} insight.
e.zh: 哲学家把感官知觉与心智洞见区分开来。

e.en: He poured himself a glass of egg {nog} at the party.
e.zh: 他在派对上给自己倒了一杯蛋酒。

e.en: Grandma's homemade {nog} is the highlight of every Christmas.
e.zh: 奶奶自制的蛋酒是每年圣诞节的亮点。

e.en: The {Nogai} horde once roamed the steppes north of the Caspian.
e.zh: 诺盖部曾在里海以北的草原上游牧。

e.en: Historians study {Nogai} customs through old Russian chronicles.
e.zh: 史学家通过古俄罗斯编年史研究诺盖人的习俗。

noggin.t:
n. 脑袋（俚语）
n. 小杯酒

e.en: Use your {noggin} and figure out the puzzle yourself.
e.zh: 动动你的小脑瓜,自己把这道谜题解出来。

e.en: He bumped his {noggin} on the low doorway.
e.zh: 他在低矮的门框上撞到了脑袋。

noir.t:
n. 黑色电影
adj. 黑色风格的

e.en: The director loves classic film {noir} from the 1940s.
e.zh: 那位导演钟爱四十年代的经典黑色电影。

e.en: Her new novel is a stylish {noir} set in Hong Kong.
e.zh: 她的新小说是一部以香港为背景的时髦黑色小说。

noise.t:
n. 噪音；杂讯
v. 散布

e.en: The construction {noise} woke everyone in the building.
e.zh: 施工的噪音吵醒了楼里所有人。

e.en: Investors should ignore short-term market {noise}.
e.zh: 投资者应忽略市场上的短期杂讯。

e.en: The new electric motor is almost completely {noiseless}.
e.zh: 这款新电机几乎完全无声。

e.en: She crossed the room with {noiseless} steps.
e.zh: 她迈着无声的步伐穿过房间。

e.en: The cat slipped {noiselessly} through the open window.
e.zh: 那只猫无声无息地从开着的窗户溜了进来。

e.en: He closed the door {noiselessly} so as not to wake the baby.
e.zh: 他悄无声息地关上门,以免吵醒宝宝。

noisemaker.t: n. 吵闹的人或物；助威器

e.en: Each guest got a {noisemaker} to use at midnight.
e.zh: 每位客人都拿到一个零点时分使用的发声玩具。

e.en: The {noisemaker} on his keychain scares away stray dogs.
e.zh: 他钥匙扣上的发声器能吓走流浪狗。

noises.t:
n. 噪音（复数）
v. 散布（三单）

e.en: Strange {noises} were coming from the attic at night.
e.zh: 晚上阁楼里传来奇怪的声响。

e.en: The company is making positive {noises} about a merger.
e.zh: 该公司正放出有关合并的积极风声。

e.en: The chef served lamb {noisette} with rosemary jus.
e.zh: 主厨端上一份配迷迭香肉汁的小羊里脊。

e.en: She ordered a chocolate {noisette} torte for dessert.
e.zh: 她点了一份榛子巧克力蛋糕当甜点。

e.en: The kids ran {noisily} through the empty hallway.
e.zh: 孩子们吵吵闹闹地跑过空荡荡的走廊。

e.en: He slurped his soup {noisily} at the dinner table.
e.zh: 他在餐桌上稀里呼噜地喝着汤。

noisome.t: adj. 恶臭的；令人厌恶的

e.en: A {noisome} smell drifted up from the old drain.
e.zh: 一股恶臭从旧下水道里飘了上来。

e.en: The alley behind the market was dark and {noisome}.
e.zh: 市场后面的小巷又黑又臭。

e.en: My downstairs neighbors are incredibly {noisy} at night.
e.zh: 我楼下的邻居晚上吵得不行。

e.en: The data is too {noisy} to draw clear conclusions.
e.zh: 这些数据噪音太大,得不出明确结论。

e.en: He works remotely as a digital {nomad} from Bali.
e.zh: 他作为数字游民在巴厘岛远程办公。

e.en: The {nomad} packed his tent and moved with the herd.
e.zh: 那位游牧者收起帐篷,跟着畜群迁徙。

e.en: Mongolian herders still lead a largely {nomadic} life.
e.zh: 蒙古牧民至今仍过着以游牧为主的生活。

e.en: After college she embraced a {nomadic} lifestyle abroad.
e.zh: 大学毕业后她在国外过起了四海为家的生活。

e.en: Desert {nomads} travel from oasis to oasis with their camels.
e.zh: 沙漠游牧民赶着骆驼在绿洲之间迁移。

e.en: Modern digital {nomads} often choose Lisbon as a base.
e.zh: 现代数字游民常把里斯本当作落脚地。

nome.t: n. 诺姆（地名）；古埃及行政区

e.en: Each ancient Egyptian {nome} had its own patron god.
e.zh: 古埃及每个州都有自己的守护神。

e.en: Researchers mapped how each {nome} contributed to the kingdom.
e.zh: 研究者绘制了每个州对王国所作贡献的分布图。

e.en: Biologists follow strict {nomenclature} when naming new species.
e.zh: 生物学家在命名新物种时遵循严格的命名法。

e.en: The chemistry textbook explains the {nomenclature} for organic compounds.
e.zh: 这本化学教材讲解有机化合物的命名规则。

e.en: The Soviet {nomenklatura} enjoyed perks unavailable to ordinary citizens.
e.zh: 苏联特权阶层享有普通公民得不到的待遇。

e.en: Critics accuse the party of behaving like a new {nomenklatura}.
e.zh: 批评者指责该党表现得像新的特权阶层。

nomic.t: n. Nomic（可改规则的逻辑游戏）

e.en: Friends invented a {nomic} game whose rules change as you play.
e.zh: 朋友们发明了一种在游戏中规则不断改变的游戏。

e.en: The seminar discussed {nomic} truths versus contingent facts.
e.zh: 研讨会讨论了规律性真理与偶然事实之间的区别。

nominal.t: adj. 名义上的；象征性的（金额）

e.en: The service is free apart from a {nominal} processing fee.
e.zh: 除一笔象征性的手续费外,这项服务是免费的。

e.en: All systems are running at {nominal} performance levels.
e.zh: 所有系统都在正常性能水平下运行。

e.en: Medieval debates over {nominalism} shaped Western philosophy.
e.zh: 中世纪关于唯名论的争辩塑造了西方哲学。

e.en: He defends {nominalism} by denying that universals truly exist.
e.zh: 他通过否认共相真实存在来为唯名论辩护。

e.en: She is {nominally} the manager, but her deputy runs everything.
e.zh: 她名义上是经理,但实际事务都是副手在打理。

e.en: The country is {nominally} a democracy under one-party rule.
e.zh: 该国名义上是民主国家,实则一党执政。

e.en: The committee will {nominate} three finalists next week.
e.zh: 委员会下周将提名三位最终候选人。

e.en: I'd like to {nominate} her for employee of the month.
e.zh: 我想提名她为本月最佳员工。

nominated.t: v. 提名（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She was {nominated} for an Oscar at just nineteen.
e.zh: 她十九岁就获得奥斯卡提名。

e.en: The team {nominated} him as captain by unanimous vote.
e.zh: 全队一致提名他为队长。

nominates.t: v. 提名（第三人称单数）

e.en: The president {nominates} judges, but the senate confirms them.
e.zh: 总统提名法官,但需要参议院批准。

e.en: Each department {nominates} one representative for the council.
e.zh: 每个部门提名一名代表加入委员会。

e.en: The party is {nominating} its candidate at next month's convention.
e.zh: 该党将在下月的代表大会上提名其候选人。

e.en: Thanks for {nominating} me — I'm honored to be considered.
e.zh: 谢谢提名,能被考虑是我的荣幸。

e.en: Her {nomination} for best director surprised the industry.
e.zh: 她获得最佳导演提名,让业界倍感意外。

e.en: The senator's {nomination} still needs full chamber approval.
e.zh: 这位参议员的提名仍需获得全院批准。

e.en: This year's Oscar {nominations} will be announced on Tuesday.
e.zh: 今年奥斯卡提名名单将于周二公布。

e.en: We are accepting {nominations} for the community service award.
e.zh: 我们正在接受社区服务奖的提名。

e.en: Each {nominator} must submit a short letter of support.
e.zh: 每位提名人都需提交一封简短的推荐信。

e.en: The {nominator} explained why the candidate deserved the prize.
e.zh: 提名人说明了为何这位候选人应获此奖。

e.en: The Oscar {nominee} thanked her family during the speech.
e.zh: 那位奥斯卡提名者在致辞中感谢了家人。

e.en: Each {nominee} must submit a financial disclosure form.
e.zh: 每位被提名人必须提交一份财务披露表。

e.en: This year's {nominees} were announced live on TV.
e.zh: 今年的提名名单在电视上现场公布。

e.en: All five {nominees} attended the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 五位被提名人都出席了颁奖典礼。

nomothetic.t: adj. 制定通则的；立法的

e.en: Psychology often takes a {nomothetic} approach to behavior.
e.zh: 心理学常采用普遍法则的方式研究行为。

e.en: Her research blends {nomothetic} laws with case studies.
e.zh: 她的研究将普遍规律与个案研究结合起来。

nomura.t: n. 野村（日本姓氏／证券公司）
