e.en: {Nomura} is one of Japan's largest investment banks.
e.zh: 野村是日本最大的投资银行之一。

e.en: He took a job at {Nomura} after graduation.
e.zh: 他毕业后进入野村证券工作。

e.en: She marked the box {non}-applicable on the form.
e.zh: 她在表格上把那栏勾为不适用。

e.en: The label clearly says {non}-toxic and child-safe.
e.zh: 标签明确写着无毒且对儿童安全。

e.en: As a {non-drinker}, he ordered sparkling water at the bar.
e.zh: 他不喝酒,在酒吧点了一杯气泡水。

e.en: The survey asked whether each guest was a {non-drinker}.
e.zh: 调查询问每位客人是否为不饮酒者。

non-profit.t:
adj. 非营利的
n. 非营利组织

e.en: She runs a {non-profit} that supports homeless youth.
e.zh: 她经营着一家帮助流浪青少年的非营利机构。

e.en: The museum operates as a registered {non-profit} organization.
e.zh: 该博物馆以注册非营利组织的形式运作。

e.en: Please book a {non-smoking} room on a high floor.
e.zh: 请帮我订一间高楼层的无烟客房。

e.en: The entire restaurant is now a {non-smoking} area.
e.zh: 整家餐厅现在都是无烟区。

e.en: My {nona} taught me how to make fresh pasta.
e.zh: 我的奶奶教我做新鲜意面。

e.en: Every Sunday we visit {Nona} for a big lunch.
e.zh: 我们每个周日都去奶奶家吃大餐。

e.en: The {nonagenarian} still walks two miles every morning.
e.zh: 那位九十多岁的老人每天早上还能走两英里。

e.en: A {nonagenarian} author published her tenth novel last year.
e.zh: 一位九十多岁的作家去年出版了她的第十部小说。

e.en: The two countries signed a {nonaggression} pact last week.
e.zh: 两国上周签署了一项互不侵犯条约。

e.en: Their treaty included clear {nonaggression} clauses for border regions.
e.zh: 他们的条约包含针对边境地区明确的不侵犯条款。

nonaggressive.t: adj. 非侵略性的；温和的

e.en: Doctors prefer a {nonaggressive} treatment for early-stage tumors.
e.zh: 医生对早期肿瘤倾向于采取非激进的治疗方案。

e.en: He has a calm, {nonaggressive} style in negotiations.
e.zh: 他在谈判中风格平和,不咄咄逼人。

e.en: The town's economy depends on {nonagricultural} jobs like tourism.
e.zh: 该镇的经济依赖旅游业等非农就业。

e.en: {Nonagricultural} land use has expanded around the city rapidly.
e.zh: 非农用地在城市周边迅速扩张。

e.en: The cafe serves creative {nonalcoholic} cocktails for designated drivers.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆为代驾司机供应创意无酒精鸡尾酒。

e.en: Please order me a {nonalcoholic} beer if they have one.
e.zh: 如果有的话请帮我点一瓶无酒精啤酒。

e.en: As a {nonathlete}, he was nervous about the company hike.
e.zh: 作为一个不爱运动的人,他对公司远足感到紧张。

e.en: The gym offers gentle classes designed for the {nonathlete} beginner.
e.zh: 这家健身房为非运动员的初学者开设了轻量课程。

nonbank.t: adj. 非银行的（金融机构）

e.en: Many startups now borrow from {nonbank} lenders online.
e.zh: 许多初创公司如今从非银行贷款机构线上借款。

e.en: The regulator is tightening rules for large {nonbank} institutions.
e.zh: 监管机构正在加强对大型非银行金融机构的规则。

e.en: She uses a {noncaloric} sweetener in her morning coffee.
e.zh: 她在早晨的咖啡里加无热量代糖。

e.en: The drink is marketed as a refreshing {noncaloric} alternative.
e.zh: 这款饮料作为清爽的无热量替代品销售。

noncanonical.t: adj. 非正典的；非规范的

e.en: Scholars debate whether the text is {noncanonical} or authentic.
e.zh: 学者们争论这份文本是否属于非正典。

e.en: He proposed a {noncanonical} solution that surprised the committee.
e.zh: 他提出了一个让委员会惊讶的非正统方案。

nonce.t: n. 当前；一次性随机数（加密）

e.en: The server rejects any request without a valid {nonce}.
e.zh: 服务器会拒绝任何缺少有效随机数的请求。

e.en: She coined the word for the {nonce} during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议上临时造了那个词。

e.en: He answered the tough question with surprising {nonchalance}.
e.zh: 他出人意料地以满不在乎的态度回答了那个难题。

e.en: Her {nonchalance} during the crisis calmed the whole team.
e.zh: 危机中她的从容让整个团队都安定下来。

nonchalant.t: adj. 冷静的；毫不在意的

e.en: He gave a {nonchalant} shrug when asked about the loss.
e.zh: 被问到那次失利时,他满不在乎地耸了耸肩。

e.en: She tried to look {nonchalant} as her crush walked by.
e.zh: 暗恋的人经过时,她努力装作毫不在意。

e.en: He {nonchalantly} mentioned that he had won the lottery.
e.zh: 他若无其事地提到自己中了彩票。

e.en: She {nonchalantly} dropped her keys into the bowl.
e.zh: 她漫不经心地把钥匙扔进了碗里。

e.en: The architect chose a {noncircular} window for the stairwell.
e.zh: 建筑师为楼梯间选择了一扇非圆形的窗户。

e.en: Make sure your reasoning is logical and {noncircular}.
e.zh: 请确保你的推理合乎逻辑且不是循环论证。

e.en: The {noncom} barked orders at the new recruits.
e.zh: 那位士官冲着新兵大声下达命令。

e.en: He served twenty years as a respected {noncom}.
e.zh: 他作为一名受人尊敬的士官服役了二十年。

e.en: International law protects every {noncombatant} during armed conflict.
e.zh: 国际法在武装冲突中保护每一位非战斗人员。

e.en: As a medic, he served as a {noncombatant} overseas.
e.zh: 作为军医,他在海外以非战斗人员身份服役。

e.en: This font is free for {noncommercial} personal projects.
e.zh: 这款字体可免费用于非商业的个人项目。

e.en: The radio station runs only {noncommercial} community programming.
e.zh: 这家电台只播放非商业的社区节目。

e.en: He was promoted to a {noncommissioned} officer last spring.
e.zh: 他去年春天晋升为士官。

e.en: {Noncommissioned} officers handle most of the daily training duties.
e.zh: 士官承担着大部分日常训练职责。

noncommittal.t: adj. 不表态的；模棱两可的

e.en: The CEO gave a {noncommittal} answer about future layoffs.
e.zh: CEO对未来的裁员问题给出了一个含糊的回答。

e.en: His {noncommittal} smile told us nothing about the deal.
e.zh: 他那含糊的微笑没有透露任何关于交易的信息。

e.en: She nodded {noncommittally} and changed the subject quickly.
e.zh: 她含糊地点点头,迅速换了个话题。

e.en: He shrugged {noncommittally} when asked about the rumors.
e.zh: 被问到那些传言时,他不置可否地耸了耸肩。

e.en: Repeated {noncompliance} with safety rules can result in fines.
e.zh: 反复不遵守安全规定可能会被罚款。

e.en: The audit revealed widespread {noncompliance} across several departments.
e.zh: 审计发现多个部门普遍存在违规情况。

noncompliant.t: adj. 不服从的；不合规的

e.en: The factory was shut down for being {noncompliant} with regulations.
e.zh: 那家工厂因不符合法规而被关停。

e.en: Browsers may block apps that are {noncompliant} with privacy standards.
e.zh: 浏览器可能会屏蔽不符合隐私标准的应用。

nonconformist.t:
n. 不从众者
adj. 不随大流的

e.en: She's always been a {nonconformist} who questions every trend.
e.zh: 她一直是个不随大流、质疑每股潮流的人。

e.en: The artist's {nonconformist} style annoyed traditional critics.
e.zh: 这位艺术家不落俗套的风格惹恼了传统派评论家。

e.en: Silicon Valley culture often celebrates creative {nonconformity}.
e.zh: 硅谷文化常常推崇富有创造力的不落俗套。

e.en: Her quiet {nonconformity} eventually changed the company's culture.
e.zh: 她那不张扬的特立独行最终改变了公司文化。

nonconsumptive.t: adj. 非消耗性的（使用方式）

e.en: Birdwatching is a popular {nonconsumptive} use of natural areas.
e.zh: 观鸟是自然区域中一种流行的非消耗性利用方式。

e.en: The park promotes {nonconsumptive} activities like hiking and photography.
e.zh: 公园鼓励徒步和摄影等非消耗性的活动。

noncontributory.t: adj. 无需缴费的（保险、养老金）

e.en: Employees enjoy a fully {noncontributory} pension at this firm.
e.zh: 这家公司为员工提供完全由公司承担的养老金。

e.en: The plan is {noncontributory}, so workers pay nothing themselves.
e.zh: 该计划由公司全额支付,员工无需缴纳。

noncriminal.t: adj. 非犯罪的；非刑事的

e.en: The dispute is a {noncriminal} matter handled in civil court.
e.zh: 该争议属非刑事案件,由民事法庭处理。

e.en: Police referred the {noncriminal} complaint to a mediator.
e.zh: 警方将这起非刑事投诉转交给了调解员。

noncritical.t: adj. 非关键的；不严重的

e.en: You can defer {noncritical} updates until the weekend.
e.zh: 非关键更新可以推迟到周末再装。

e.en: The bug affects only {noncritical} parts of the dashboard.
e.zh: 这个漏洞只影响仪表盘的非关键部分。

e.en: Could I get a latte with {nondairy} milk, please?
e.zh: 麻烦给我来一杯用植物奶做的拿铁好吗?

e.en: The cafe added several {nondairy} desserts to the menu.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆在菜单上加了几款不含奶制品的甜点。

nondenominational.t: adj. 不属于特定教派的

e.en: The hospital chapel is a {nondenominational} space for everyone.
e.zh: 医院的小礼拜堂是面向所有人的无宗派空间。

e.en: They held a {nondenominational} wedding in the garden.
e.zh: 他们在花园里举行了一场无宗派的婚礼。

nondescript.t: adj. 毫无特色的；普通的

e.en: The spies met in a {nondescript} cafe near the station.
e.zh: 特工们在车站附近一家毫不起眼的咖啡馆碰头。

e.en: He drove a {nondescript} gray sedan to avoid attention.
e.zh: 他开着一辆毫无特色的灰色轿车以免引人注意。

nonsexual.t: adj. 非性的；与性无关的

e.en: Their relationship is close but completely {nonsexual}.
e.zh: 他们的关系很亲密,但完全没有性的成分。

e.en: The hug was a warm, {nonsexual} gesture of comfort.
e.zh: 那个拥抱只是温暖的、不带性意味的安慰。

e.en: The difference between groups was small and {nonsignificant}.
e.zh: 两组之间的差异很小,不具统计显著性。

e.en: Researchers reported a {nonsignificant} drop in symptoms.
e.zh: 研究人员报告称症状下降不具显著性。

e.en: The bathroom mat has a {nonskid} backing for safety.
e.zh: 这块浴室垫的背面防滑,更加安全。

e.en: Wear shoes with {nonskid} soles when hiking on wet rocks.
e.zh: 在湿滑的岩石上徒步时,要穿防滑鞋底的鞋子。

e.en: As a lifelong {nonsmoker}, she got a discount on insurance.
e.zh: 作为一辈子的非吸烟者,她拿到了保险折扣。

e.en: Please request a hotel room suitable for a {nonsmoker}.
e.zh: 请预订一间适合非吸烟者的酒店房间。

e.en: Never use {nonsterile} gloves during a surgical procedure.
e.zh: 做手术时绝不能使用非无菌手套。

e.en: The wound was cleaned with {nonsterile} tap water in an emergency.
e.zh: 紧急情况下,伤口是用未经消毒的自来水清洗的。

e.en: Ibuprofen is a common {nonsteroidal} anti-inflammatory drug.
e.zh: 布洛芬是一种常见的非甾体抗炎药。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {nonsteroidal} pain reliever.
e.zh: 医生建议服用一种非甾体类止痛药。

e.en: Pancakes slide right out of a good {nonstick} pan.
e.zh: 用一口好的不粘锅,煎饼能轻松滑出来。

e.en: Avoid metal utensils on a {nonstick} surface.
e.zh: 不粘涂层表面上不要使用金属餐具。

nonstop.t:
adj. 不间断的
adv. 直达地

e.en: We took a {nonstop} flight from Tokyo to New York.
e.zh: 我们坐了一班从东京直飞纽约的航班。

e.en: The kids talked {nonstop} during the entire car ride.
e.zh: 孩子们在整个车程中讲个不停。

e.en: Doctors first try {nonsurgical} options like physical therapy.
e.zh: 医生会先尝试理疗等非手术治疗方案。

e.en: She chose a {nonsurgical} treatment for her back pain.
e.zh: 她为自己的背痛选择了非手术治疗。

e.en: The device uses a {nonthermal} laser that won't burn skin.
e.zh: 该设备使用一种不会灼伤皮肤的非热效应激光。

e.en: Researchers are studying {nonthermal} effects of microwaves.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究微波的非热效应。

e.en: This paint is {nontoxic} and safe for kids' rooms.
e.zh: 这款油漆无毒，适合用在儿童房。

e.en: We use {nontoxic} cleaning products at home.
e.zh: 我们家里使用无毒的清洁产品。

e.en: She took a {nontraditional} path into tech.
e.zh: 她以非传统的方式进入了科技行业。

e.en: The school welcomes {nontraditional} students of all ages.
e.zh: 这所学校欢迎各个年龄的非传统学生。

nontrivial.t: adj. 非平凡的；不简单的

e.en: Fixing this bug turned out to be {nontrivial}.
e.zh: 修复这个 bug 其实并不简单。

e.en: The migration involves a {nontrivial} amount of work.
e.zh: 这次迁移涉及相当可观的工作量。

nonuniform.t: adj. 不均匀的；不一致的

e.en: The paint dried in a {nonuniform} pattern on the wall.
e.zh: 油漆在墙上干得不均匀。

e.en: Data is distributed in a {nonuniform} way across servers.
e.zh: 数据在各服务器之间分布得不均匀。

e.en: Most communication is {nonverbal}, like body language and tone.
e.zh: 大多数沟通是非语言的，比如肢体语言和语气。

e.en: The toddler used {nonverbal} cues to ask for milk.
e.zh: 那个幼儿用非语言的方式示意要喝奶。

e.en: Dogs communicate {nonverbally} through tail movements and posture.
e.zh: 狗通过尾巴动作和姿势进行非语言交流。

e.en: She agreed {nonverbally} with a quick nod.
e.zh: 她点了点头，无声地表示同意。

nonviable.t: adj. 不可行的；无法存活的

e.en: The startup's business model proved {nonviable} after a year.
e.zh: 这家创业公司的商业模式一年后被证明行不通。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the pregnancy was {nonviable}.
e.zh: 医生确认这次怀孕无法继续。

e.en: Gandhi championed {nonviolence} as a tool for change.
e.zh: 甘地倡导以非暴力作为变革的手段。

e.en: The movement is rooted in {nonviolence} and civil dialogue.
e.zh: 这场运动植根于非暴力与公民对话。

e.en: They organized a {nonviolent} protest outside the building.
e.zh: 他们在大楼外组织了一场非暴力抗议。

e.en: The offender was charged with a {nonviolent} crime.
e.zh: 该违法者被指控犯有非暴力罪行。

e.en: The protesters {nonviolently} blocked the road for hours.
e.zh: 抗议者以非暴力方式封堵道路数小时。

e.en: She resolved the dispute {nonviolently} through dialogue.
e.zh: 她通过对话以非暴力方式化解了争端。

e.en: Screen readers offer a {nonvisual} way to browse the web.
e.zh: 屏幕阅读器提供了一种非视觉的上网方式。

e.en: The app supports {nonvisual} navigation for blind users.
e.zh: 这款应用支持盲人用户的非视觉导航。

e.en: Flash memory is {nonvolatile} and keeps data without power.
e.zh: 闪存是非易失性的，断电也能保存数据。

e.en: The chip uses {nonvolatile} storage for firmware.
e.zh: 该芯片使用非易失性存储来保存固件。

noo.t: (罕用) adv. 现在（苏格兰方言 now）

e.en: "{Noo}, don't go!" she whined playfully.
e.zh: "不要嘛，别走！"她撒娇地说。

e.en: He texted back "{noo} way" with a laughing emoji.
e.zh: 他回了"才不要呢"还配了个大笑表情。

noodle.t:
n. 面条
v. 随意尝试；琢磨

e.en: I had a hot bowl of {noodle} soup for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐吃了一碗热腾腾的面汤。

e.en: Let me {noodle} on that idea overnight.
e.zh: 让我今晚再琢磨琢磨这个想法。

e.en: She curled up in a cozy reading {nook} by the window.
e.zh: 她蜷在窗边舒适的阅读小角落里。

e.en: The café has a quiet {nook} perfect for studying.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有个安静的小角落，特别适合学习。

nookie.t: n. 俚语 性爱；亲热

e.en: They sneaked off for a bit of {nookie} after dinner.
e.zh: 他们晚饭后偷偷溜走亲热了一下。

e.en: The song is basically about {nookie} and weekend fun.
e.zh: 这首歌基本就是在唱亲热和周末玩乐。

e.en: Let's meet for lunch at {noon} tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们明天中午一起吃午饭吧。

e.en: The sun was directly overhead by {noon}.
e.zh: 到了正午时分，太阳已经直射头顶。

noonday.t:
n. 正午
adj. 正午的

e.en: The {noonday} sun beat down on the empty plaza.
e.zh: 正午的太阳火辣辣地照在空荡的广场上。

e.en: They rested under a tree to escape the {noonday} heat.
e.zh: 他们在树下休息，躲避正午的炎热。

noone.t: pron. 没有人（no one 的连写）

e.en: {Noone} answered when I knocked on the door.
e.zh: 我敲门时没人应答。

e.en: {Noone} expected the meeting to last so long.
e.zh: 没人料到这场会议会开这么久。

e.en: Saturday {noons} are the busiest time at the café.
e.zh: 周六的中午是这家咖啡馆最忙的时候。

e.en: Hot summer {noons} drive everyone indoors.
e.zh: 炎热的夏日正午让所有人都躲进室内。

e.en: The park is packed with office workers at {noontime}.
e.zh: 中午时分公园里挤满了上班族。

e.en: We grabbed a quick {noontime} bite near the office.
e.zh: 我们在办公室附近匆匆吃了顿午饭。

noose.t:
n. 绳套；绞索
v. 用套索套住

e.en: The cowboy tightened the {noose} around the post.
e.zh: 那个牛仔把绳套在柱子上勒紧。

e.en: Mounting debt felt like a {noose} around her neck.
e.zh: 不断累积的债务像一根绞索套在她脖子上。

e.en: The compiler inserted a {nop} to align the next instruction.
e.zh: 编译器插入了一个空操作来对齐下一条指令。

e.en: Replace the function body with a {nop} for now.
e.zh: 暂时把这个函数体替换成空操作就行。

e.en: Grilled {nopal} is a classic side at Mexican restaurants.
e.zh: 烤仙人掌是墨西哥餐馆的经典配菜。

e.en: She added sliced {nopal} to the morning eggs.
e.zh: 她把切片的仙人掌加到了早餐的鸡蛋里。

e.en: "{Nope}, I haven't seen your keys anywhere."
e.zh: "没有啊，我没在哪儿看到你的钥匙。"

e.en: I asked if he was coming and he said {nope}.
e.zh: 我问他来不来，他说不来。

e.en: She doesn't drink coffee {nor} tea in the morning.
e.zh: 她早上既不喝咖啡也不喝茶。

e.en: The food wasn't great, {nor} was the service.
e.zh: 东西不好吃，服务也不怎么样。

nor'easter.t: n. 东北风暴（美东沿海）

e.en: A powerful {nor'easter} dumped two feet of snow on Boston.
e.zh: 一场强劲的东北风暴给波士顿带来了两英尺的积雪。

e.en: Coastal towns boarded up before the {nor'easter} hit.
e.zh: 沿海小镇在东北风暴来袭前都钉好了门窗。

e.en: {Noradrenaline} surges when the body senses danger.
e.zh: 当身体感知到危险时，去甲肾上腺素会激增。

e.en: The drug increases {noradrenaline} levels in the brain.
e.zh: 这种药物会提高大脑中去甲肾上腺素的水平。

e.en: She grew up in {Norbury}, a quiet suburb of London.
e.zh: 她在诺伯里长大，那是伦敦一个安静的郊区。

e.en: The train to {Norbury} leaves from platform three.
e.zh: 开往诺伯里的火车从三号站台发车。

e.en: He bought a vintage {Nord} synthesizer for his studio.
e.zh: 他给自己的工作室买了一台老款 Nord 合成器。

e.en: The pianist played a {Nord} keyboard on stage.
e.zh: 那位钢琴家在舞台上演奏的是 Nord 键盘。

e.en: The {Norden} bombsight was a key WWII technology.
e.zh: 诺顿瞄准器是二战中的一项关键技术。

e.en: He visited the {Norden} museum during his trip.
e.zh: 他旅行时参观了诺顿博物馆。

nordic.t:
adj. 北欧的
n. 北欧人

e.en: {Nordic} design favors clean lines and natural light.
e.zh: 北欧设计偏爱简洁线条和自然光。

e.en: She booked a {Nordic} cruise through the fjords.
e.zh: 她订了一趟穿越峡湾的北欧邮轮之旅。

e.en: {Norepinephrine} helps regulate alertness and focus.
e.zh: 去甲肾上腺素有助于调节警觉和专注力。

e.en: Some antidepressants boost {norepinephrine} in the brain.
e.zh: 某些抗抑郁药会提高大脑中去甲肾上腺素的水平。

norfolk.t: n. 地名 Norfolk（英国/美国）

e.en: They spent the weekend sailing along the {Norfolk} coast.
e.zh: 他们在诺福克海岸边航行度过了周末。

e.en: {Norfolk} is famous for its big skies and quiet beaches.
e.zh: 诺福克以辽阔的天空和宁静的海滩闻名。

e.en: Wrap the rice in a sheet of {nori} to make sushi.
e.zh: 用一张海苔把米饭卷起来做寿司。

e.en: She sprinkled crispy {nori} flakes over the noodles.
e.zh: 她把酥脆的海苔片撒在面上。

nondiabetic.t: adj. 非糖尿病的；不患糖尿病的

e.en: The study compared diabetic and {nondiabetic} patients over five years.
e.zh: 该研究对糖尿病患者和非糖尿病患者进行了五年的对比。

e.en: This dessert is sweet enough for {nondiabetic} guests too.
e.zh: 这款甜点对非糖尿病客人来说也足够甜。

nondiscretionary.t: adj. 非自主的；强制性的

e.en: Rent and groceries are {nondiscretionary} expenses for most families.
e.zh: 房租和食品对大多数家庭来说属于非自主性支出。

e.en: The fund follows a strict {nondiscretionary} investment strategy.
e.zh: 该基金遵循严格的非自主决策投资策略。

none.t:
pron. 没有一个；无一
adv. 毫不

e.en: I checked the fridge but {none} of the milk was left.
e.zh: 我看了冰箱,牛奶一点都没剩。

e.en: {None} of the candidates impressed the hiring panel today.
e.zh: 今天没有一位候选人让招聘小组眼前一亮。

nonentity.t: n. 无足轻重的人；不存在的东西

e.en: He felt like a {nonentity} at the glamorous Hollywood party.
e.zh: 在那场光鲜的好莱坞派对上,他觉得自己就像个无名小卒。

e.en: Until the scandal, the senator was a political {nonentity}.
e.zh: 在丑闻爆发前,这位参议员只是个政坛无名之辈。

nonequivalent.t: adj. 不等价的；不等同的

e.en: The two job titles sound similar but are {nonequivalent} in pay.
e.zh: 这两个职位听起来相似,但薪资并不对等。

e.en: Researchers compared outcomes between {nonequivalent} treatment groups carefully.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细对比了非等同处理组之间的结果。

nonesuch.t: n. 无与伦比的人或物

e.en: As a chess teacher, she is a {nonesuch} in this town.
e.zh: 作为国际象棋老师,她在这座小城里堪称无人能及。

e.en: His grandmother's apple pie was truly a {nonesuch}.
e.zh: 他奶奶做的苹果派真是世间罕有。

e.en: It rained all day; we enjoyed the trip {nonetheless}.
e.zh: 那天下了一整天的雨,但我们仍然玩得很开心。

e.en: The plan is risky; {nonetheless}, the board approved it.
e.zh: 该计划风险不小,但董事会还是批准了。

e.en: Scientists debate the existence or {nonexistence} of parallel universes.
e.zh: 科学家们争论平行宇宙是存在还是不存在。

e.en: The lawyer pointed to the {nonexistence} of any signed contract.
e.zh: 律师指出根本不存在任何签署过的合同。

e.en: Cell service is basically {nonexistent} deep in the canyon.
e.zh: 在峡谷深处,手机信号基本是不存在的。

e.en: His patience for late replies is {nonexistent} these days.
e.zh: 他最近对迟回的消息毫无耐心可言。

nonferrous.t: adj. 有色金属的；非铁的

e.en: Copper and aluminum are common {nonferrous} metals in electronics.
e.zh: 铜和铝是电子产品中常见的有色金属。

e.en: The plant specializes in recycling {nonferrous} scrap materials.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门回收有色金属废料。

nonfiction.t: n. 非虚构作品；纪实文学

e.en: She mostly reads {nonfiction} about science and history.
e.zh: 她主要阅读关于科学和历史的非虚构作品。

e.en: His memoir won an award for best {nonfiction} this year.
e.zh: 他的回忆录获得了今年最佳非虚构类作品奖。

e.en: The gallery features {nonfigurative} paintings full of bold colors.
e.zh: 画廊展出色彩大胆的非具象绘画作品。

e.en: Her style shifted from realism to {nonfigurative} abstraction.
e.zh: 她的风格从写实转向了非具象抽象。

e.en: The kitchen curtains are made of {nonflammable} fabric.
e.zh: 厨房的窗帘是用不易燃面料制成的。

e.en: Always store cleaning supplies in {nonflammable} containers.
e.zh: 清洁用品要始终存放在不易燃的容器里。

nonfunctional.t: adj. 无功能的；不起作用的

e.en: The old printer is completely {nonfunctional} now.
e.zh: 那台旧打印机现在完全不能用了。

e.en: Several buttons on the remote are {nonfunctional}.
e.zh: 遥控器上有几个按键已经失灵了。

e.en: Many {nongovernmental} groups provide aid in disaster zones.
e.zh: 许多非政府组织在灾区提供援助。

e.en: She works for a small {nongovernmental} organization in Kenya.
e.zh: 她在肯尼亚一家小型非政府组织工作。

e.en: Researchers study {nonhuman} primates to understand human behavior.
e.zh: 研究人员通过研究非人类灵长动物来理解人类行为。

e.en: The film features several {nonhuman} characters voiced by famous actors.
e.zh: 电影中有几个由知名演员配音的非人类角色。

noninvasive.t: adj. 非侵入性的（医疗）；无创的

e.en: Doctors prefer {noninvasive} tests whenever possible.
e.zh: 医生在可能的情况下更倾向于使用无创检查。

e.en: Ultrasound is a safe and {noninvasive} imaging method.
e.zh: 超声波是一种安全的非侵入式成像方法。

nonjudgmental.t: adj. 不加评判的；不带偏见的

e.en: A good therapist creates a {nonjudgmental} space for clients.
e.zh: 好的治疗师会为来访者营造一个不带评判的空间。

e.en: Try to listen in a {nonjudgmental} way when friends share problems.
e.zh: 朋友倾诉烦恼时,试着不带评判地倾听。

e.en: The novel uses a {nonlinear} narrative that jumps between decades.
e.zh: 这部小说采用非线性叙事,在几十年间跳跃。

e.en: Career paths today are often {nonlinear} and unpredictable.
e.zh: 如今的职业道路往往是非线性、难以预测的。

nonlinearity.t: n. 非线性；非线性特性

e.en: The model accounts for {nonlinearity} in user behavior.
e.zh: 该模型考虑了用户行为中的非线性。

e.en: Engineers must handle the {nonlinearity} of the system carefully.
e.zh: 工程师必须小心处理这个系统的非线性。

e.en: Babies communicate using {nonlinguistic} cues like crying and pointing.
e.zh: 婴儿通过哭闹、指点等非语言线索来交流。

e.en: Music conveys emotion through {nonlinguistic} means.
e.zh: 音乐通过非语言的方式传达情感。

e.en: Surgeons use {nonmagnetic} tools near MRI machines.
e.zh: 外科医生在核磁共振仪附近使用无磁性的器械。

e.en: Aluminum is a common {nonmagnetic} metal.
e.zh: 铝是一种常见的无磁性金属。

nonmaterial.t: adj. 非物质的；精神层面的

e.en: Friendship is a {nonmaterial} reward that money cannot buy.
e.zh: 友谊是金钱买不到的非物质回报。

e.en: Culture includes {nonmaterial} elements like beliefs and values.
e.zh: 文化包含信仰和价值观等非物质要素。

nonmedical.t: adj. 非医疗的；非医用的

e.en: The clinic offers some {nonmedical} services like counseling.
e.zh: 这家诊所还提供咨询等一些非医疗服务。

e.en: Avoid using prescription drugs for {nonmedical} reasons.
e.zh: 不要因非医疗原因使用处方药。

e.en: The gym charges {nonmember} guests a daily fee.
e.zh: 健身房向非会员客人收取日费。

e.en: A {nonmember} cannot vote at the annual meeting.
e.zh: 非会员不能在年会上投票。

e.en: Rubber and plastic are common {nonmetallic} materials.
e.zh: 橡胶和塑料是常见的非金属材料。

e.en: The detector ignores {nonmetallic} objects in your bag.
e.zh: 该探测器会忽略包里的非金属物品。

nonobjective.t: adj. 抽象的（艺术）；非客观的

e.en: His {nonobjective} paintings rely on shape and color alone.
e.zh: 他的非具象绘画完全依靠形状与色彩。

e.en: The class explored {nonobjective} art from the early 1900s.
e.zh: 这门课探讨了二十世纪初的非具象艺术。

e.en: The {nonoccurrence} of the predicted storm surprised forecasters.
e.zh: 预报中的风暴未发生,令气象员感到意外。

e.en: Insurance may cover the {nonoccurrence} of a planned event.
e.zh: 保险可能覆盖既定活动未能举办的情况。

nonpareil.t:
adj. 无与伦比的
n. 无双之物

e.en: Her chocolate cake is a {nonpareil} among local desserts.
e.zh: 她的巧克力蛋糕在当地甜点中无与伦比。

e.en: The violinist is widely considered a {nonpareil} of her generation.
e.zh: 这位小提琴家被公认为她那一代中无人能及的高手。

e.en: The committee aims to provide {nonpartisan} analysis of the bill.
e.zh: 该委员会旨在对该法案提供无党派的分析。

e.en: She runs a {nonpartisan} voter education website.
e.zh: 她经营着一个无党派的选民教育网站。

nonpartisanship.t: n. 无党派立场；中立性

e.en: The judge is known for her strict {nonpartisanship}.
e.zh: 这位法官以严格的无党派立场而闻名。

e.en: True {nonpartisanship} is rare in today's political climate.
e.zh: 在当今政治环境下,真正的无党派立场十分罕见。

e.en: Your service may be cut off due to {nonpayment} of bills.
e.zh: 因未付账单,您的服务可能被切断。

e.en: The landlord filed a complaint over {nonpayment} of rent.
e.zh: 房东因租金未付而提起了投诉。

nonperformance.t: n. 不履行；未执行（合约）

e.en: The contract penalizes {nonperformance} of agreed duties.
e.zh: 合同对未履行约定义务的行为规定了罚则。

e.en: Repeated {nonperformance} led to the supplier being dropped.
e.zh: 屡次未能履约导致这家供应商被淘汰。

nonplus.t: v. 使困惑；使不知所措

e.en: The strange question seemed to {nonplus} the speaker.
e.zh: 这个奇怪的问题似乎让演讲者一时语塞。

e.en: Her sudden silence began to {nonplus} the entire room.
e.zh: 她突然的沉默让整个房间的人都不知所措。

nonplussed.t: adj. 困惑的；不知所措的

e.en: He looked completely {nonplussed} by the unexpected news.
e.zh: 他被这意外的消息弄得完全不知所措。

e.en: The teacher was {nonplussed} when no one answered.
e.zh: 没人回答时,老师一时茫然不知如何是好。

e.en: Glass and metal are {nonporous} surfaces that wipe clean easily.
e.zh: 玻璃和金属是无孔表面,容易擦拭干净。

e.en: Use a {nonporous} cutting board to avoid bacteria buildup.
e.zh: 使用不渗水的菜板可以避免细菌滋生。

nonprofessional.t:
adj. 非专业的
n. 业余人士

e.en: The league is open to {nonprofessional} players over eighteen.
e.zh: 该联赛对十八岁以上的非职业选手开放。

e.en: She gave a surprisingly polished {nonprofessional} performance.
e.zh: 她作为非专业人士,表现得意外地出色。

e.en: He left the bank to run a small {nonprofit}.
e.zh: 他离开银行去经营一家小型非营利组织。

e.en: The {nonprofit} provides free meals to the elderly.
e.zh: 这家非营利机构为老人提供免费餐食。

e.en: The treaty supports nuclear {nonproliferation} worldwide.
e.zh: 该条约支持全球范围的核不扩散。

e.en: Diplomats met to discuss weapons {nonproliferation} efforts.
e.zh: 外交官齐聚一堂讨论武器不扩散事务。

e.en: The lab now uses a {nonradioactive} tracer for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室现在用非放射性示踪剂做这个实验。

e.en: Most everyday materials are perfectly {nonradioactive}.
e.zh: 日常生活中的大多数材料都完全无放射性。

nonreactive.t: adj. 非反应性的；惰性的

e.en: Cook tomato sauce in a {nonreactive} pan to preserve flavor.
e.zh: 用不起化学反应的锅煮番茄酱,以保留风味。

e.en: Glass containers are {nonreactive} and safe for acidic foods.
e.zh: 玻璃容器不起反应,适合盛放酸性食物。

nonrecognition.t: n. 不承认（国家、政权等）

e.en: The country's {nonrecognition} of the new regime caused tension.
e.zh: 该国不承认新政权一事引发了紧张局势。

e.en: Her {nonrecognition} of the visitor was clearly deliberate.
e.zh: 她对那位来客视而不见显然是有意为之。

nonrefundable.t: adj. 不可退款的；不退还的

e.en: This ticket is {nonrefundable}, so plan your trip carefully.
e.zh: 这张票不可退款,请仔细安排行程。

e.en: You'll need to pay a {nonrefundable} deposit to book the venue.
e.zh: 预订场地需要支付一笔不可退还的定金。

e.en: At low speeds, {nonrelativistic} mechanics works perfectly well.
e.zh: 在低速下,非相对论力学完全适用。

e.en: The textbook starts with {nonrelativistic} quantum theory.
e.zh: 这本教科书从非相对论量子理论讲起。

e.en: Oil and coal are {nonrenewable} energy sources.
e.zh: 石油和煤炭都是不可再生的能源。

e.en: We must reduce our reliance on {nonrenewable} resources.
e.zh: 我们必须减少对不可再生资源的依赖。

nonrepresentational.t: adj. 非写实的；抽象派的

e.en: He prefers {nonrepresentational} art over realistic portraits.
e.zh: 比起写实肖像,他更喜欢非具象艺术。

e.en: The mural is purely {nonrepresentational}, full of swirling shapes.
e.zh: 这幅壁画完全是非具象的,充满旋转的形状。

nonreproductive.t: adj. 非生殖的；不繁殖的

e.en: Worker bees perform {nonreproductive} roles in the colony.
e.zh: 工蜂在蜂群中承担非繁殖性的工作。

e.en: The drug has only {nonreproductive} side effects.
e.zh: 该药物只有与生殖无关的副作用。

nonresidential.t: adj. 非住宅的；非居住性的

e.en: This zone is reserved for {nonresidential} buildings only.
e.zh: 这一区域仅供非住宅类建筑使用。

e.en: The college runs a {nonresidential} summer program for teens.
e.zh: 该学院为青少年举办了一个走读式的暑期项目。

e.en: Stop talking {nonsense} and focus on the real issue.
e.zh: 别再胡说八道了,把注意力放在真正的问题上。

e.en: The toddler made up a song full of cheerful {nonsense}.
e.zh: 那个小孩编了一首充满欢快胡话的歌。

e.en: His explanation was completely {nonsensical} and hard to follow.
e.zh: 他的解释完全荒谬,让人摸不着头脑。

e.en: The meeting ended with a {nonsensical} proposal nobody supported.
e.zh: 会议以一项无人赞成的荒谬提案结束。

e.en: Working from home has become the {norm} since 2020.
e.zh: 自2020年以来，居家办公已经成为常态。

e.en: Cheating on tests goes against every social {norm}.
e.zh: 考试作弊违背了所有的社会规范。

e.en: {Norma} called to say she'd be late for dinner.
e.zh: 诺玛打电话说她晚饭会迟到。

e.en: The opera {Norma} premiered in Milan in 1831.
e.zh: 歌剧《诺尔玛》于 1831 年在米兰首演。

normal.t:
adj. 正常的；标准的
n. 常态

e.en: It's totally {normal} to feel nervous before a flight.
e.zh: 坐飞机前感到紧张完全是正常的。

e.en: After the storm, life slowly returned to {normal}.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，生活慢慢恢复了正常。

e.en: After months of chaos, we craved a sense of {normalcy}.
e.zh: 经历几个月的混乱后，我们渴望一些常态感。

e.en: The reopening of schools restored some {normalcy}.
e.zh: 学校复课让生活恢复了一些常态。

normalisation.t: n. 标准化；正常化（英式拼写）

e.en: The {normalisation} of remote work has reshaped offices.
e.zh: 远程办公的常态化已经重塑了办公场所。

e.en: Diplomatic {normalisation} ended decades of tension.
e.zh: 外交关系正常化结束了数十年的紧张局势。

normalise.t: v. 使标准化；使正常化（英式拼写）

e.en: We need to {normalise} talking openly about mental health.
e.zh: 我们应该让公开谈论心理健康成为常态。

e.en: The script will {normalise} all email addresses to lowercase.
e.zh: 脚本会把所有邮箱地址统一转成小写。

e.en: Slowly, a sense of {normality} returned to the city.
e.zh: 这座城市渐渐恢复了正常的生活气息。

e.en: He longed for the {normality} of his old daily routine.
e.zh: 他怀念过去那种平常的日常生活。

normalization.t: n. 标准化；归一化；正常化

e.en: Database {normalization} reduces redundancy across tables.
e.zh: 数据库规范化能减少表之间的数据冗余。

e.en: The {normalization} of overtime has hurt employee health.
e.zh: 加班的常态化已经损害了员工的健康。

normalize.t: v. 标准化；归一化；使正常

e.en: Let's {normalize} taking real lunch breaks at work.
e.zh: 我们应该让在工作中好好吃午休变成常态。

e.en: The function will {normalize} the input to a 0-1 range.
e.zh: 该函数会把输入归一化到 0 到 1 的范围。

normalized.t: adj. 已标准化的；已归一化的

e.en: The data was {normalized} before training the model.
e.zh: 在训练模型之前数据已经做过归一化处理。

e.en: Society has gradually {normalized} flexible work hours.
e.zh: 社会已经逐渐把弹性工作时间视为常态。

e.en: I {normally} get to the office around nine.
e.zh: 我通常九点左右到办公室。

e.en: After the reboot, the printer worked {normally} again.
e.zh: 重启之后打印机又恢复正常工作了。

e.en: The shader uses surface {normals} to calculate lighting.
e.zh: 这个着色器用表面法线来计算光照。

e.en: This week's temperatures are above seasonal {normals}.
e.zh: 本周气温高于季节性平均值。

e.en: The castle dates back to the {Norman} conquest.
e.zh: 这座城堡可以追溯到诺曼征服时期。

e.en: {Norman} architecture features thick walls and round arches.
e.zh: 诺曼建筑以厚墙和圆拱为特色。

e.en: They visited the beaches of {Normandy} on a history tour.
e.zh: 他们在历史之旅中参观了诺曼底的海滩。

e.en: {Normandy} is famous for its cheese, cider, and apples.
e.zh: 诺曼底以奶酪、苹果酒和苹果闻名。

e.en: She moved to {Normanton} for a teaching job last year.
e.zh: 她去年搬到诺曼顿任教。

e.en: {Normanton} is a small market town in West Yorkshire.
e.zh: 诺曼顿是西约克郡的一个小集镇。

e.en: The textbook takes a {normative} approach to ethics.
e.zh: 这本教材以规范性的视角探讨伦理学。

e.en: Critics argue the policy is too {normative} for a diverse society.
e.zh: 批评者认为该政策对多元社会而言过于规范化。

e.en: Philosophers debate the source of moral {normativity}.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论道德规范性的来源。

e.en: Her thesis explores {normativity} in everyday language.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨日常语言中的规范性。

e.en: The test is {normed} on a national sample of students.
e.zh: 该测试以全国学生样本为常模进行标准化。

e.en: We work in a {normed} vector space throughout this chapter.
e.zh: 本章我们始终在赋范向量空间中讨论。

e.en: Teams pass through forming, storming, {norming}, and performing.
e.zh: 团队会经历形成、震荡、规范和成熟四个阶段。

e.en: The committee spent weeks {norming} the new exam.
e.zh: 委员会花了数周时间对新考试进行常模化处理。

e.en: Social {norms} vary widely from country to country.
e.zh: 社会规范因国家而有很大差异。

e.en: The startup challenged industry {norms} with its pricing.
e.zh: 这家初创公司用其定价方式挑战了行业惯例。

e.en: A {norovirus} outbreak shut down the cruise ship's buffet.
e.zh: 一场诺如病毒疫情让邮轮的自助餐厅关闭了。

e.en: Wash your hands often to avoid catching {norovirus}.
e.zh: 勤洗手以避免感染诺如病毒。

norse.t:
adj. 古斯堪的纳维亚的
n. 古北欧语

e.en: The museum displays artifacts from ancient {Norse} settlements.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了古代北欧人聚居地的文物。

e.en: Thor and Odin are central figures in {Norse} mythology.
e.zh: 托尔和奥丁是北欧神话中的核心人物。

norseman.t: n. 古代斯堪的纳维亚人

e.en: A {Norseman} sailed across the Atlantic long before Columbus.
e.zh: 早在哥伦布之前,一位北欧人就已横渡大西洋。

e.en: The film depicts a {Norseman} returning to his village.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一位北欧人回到家乡村庄的故事。

e.en: The label on the package was written in {Norsk}.
e.zh: 包裹上的标签是用挪威语写的。

e.en: He's learning {Norsk} before moving to Oslo next year.
e.zh: 他在搬去奥斯陆之前正在学习挪威语。

e.en: They drove through Baja California {Norte} on their road trip.
e.zh: 他们公路旅行时穿越了下加利福尼亚北部。

e.en: The restaurant serves classic dishes from {Norte} Mexico.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应墨西哥北部的经典菜肴。

north.t:
n. 北方
adj. 北方的

e.en: The wind is blowing from the {north} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的风是从北方吹来的。

e.en: Drive {north} for ten miles and you'll see the lake.
e.zh: 向北开十英里,你就会看到那座湖。

northallerton.t: n. 北阿勒顿（英国地名）

e.en: The train to {Northallerton} departs from platform three.
e.zh: 开往诺萨勒顿的列车在三号站台发车。

e.en: {Northallerton} is the county town of North Yorkshire.
e.zh: 诺萨勒顿是北约克郡的郡治所在地。

northampton.t: n. 北安普顿（英国城市）

e.en: She grew up in a small village near {Northampton}.
e.zh: 她在北安普顿附近的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: {Northampton} was historically famous for shoemaking.
e.zh: 北安普顿历史上以制鞋业闻名。

northamptonshire.t: n. 北安普敦郡（英国郡名）

e.en: Many stately homes are scattered across {Northamptonshire}.
e.zh: 北安普顿郡境内散布着许多宏伟的庄园。

e.en: The new factory will create jobs throughout {Northamptonshire}.
e.zh: 新工厂将在整个北安普顿郡创造就业机会。

northants.t: n. 北安普敦郡（Northamptonshire 的缩写）

e.en: {Northants} cricket club had a strong season this year.
e.zh: 北安普顿郡板球俱乐部今年表现强劲。

e.en: The address shows the property is in {Northants}.
e.zh: 地址显示这处房产位于北安普顿郡。

northbound.t: adj. 向北行驶的；北行的

e.en: All {northbound} trains are delayed due to signal failures.
e.zh: 由于信号故障,所有北行列车都晚点了。

e.en: Traffic on the {northbound} lanes was at a standstill.
e.zh: 北行车道上的车流陷入了停滞。

northcliffe.t: n. 诺斯克利夫（人名/地名）

e.en: Lord {Northcliffe} revolutionized British popular journalism.
e.zh: 诺斯克利夫勋爵彻底改变了英国大众新闻业。

e.en: The biography focuses on {Northcliffe}'s media empire.
e.zh: 这本传记聚焦于诺斯克利夫的媒体帝国。

northcote.t: n. 诺斯科特（姓氏/地名）

e.en: We rented a small flat in {Northcote} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在诺斯科特租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The cafés along {Northcote} High Street are always busy.
e.zh: 诺斯科特大街沿线的咖啡馆总是很热闹。

northeast.t:
n. 东北方
adj. 东北的

e.en: A storm is moving toward the {northeast} coast tonight.
e.zh: 今晚有一场风暴正在向东北海岸移动。

e.en: Their cabin sits in the {northeast} corner of the property.
e.zh: 他们的小木屋位于这片地产的东北角。

northeasterly.t: adj. 来自东北的；向东北的

e.en: A strong {northeasterly} wind is forecast for tomorrow.
e.zh: 预报明天将刮强劲的东北风。

e.en: The yacht held a steady {northeasterly} course all morning.
e.zh: 游艇整个上午都保持着稳定的东北方向航线。

e.en: She studied biology at a {northeastern} university last year.
e.zh: 她去年在一所东北部的大学攻读生物学。

e.en: The {northeastern} states received heavy snowfall overnight.
e.zh: 东北部各州一夜之间下了大雪。

northeasts.t: n. 东北方向（复数，罕用）

e.en: The map highlighted the {northeasts} of several countries.
e.zh: 地图上标出了几个国家的东北部地区。

e.en: Trade routes once linked the {northeasts} of these regions.
e.zh: 贸易路线曾连接这些地区的东北部。

northeastward.t:
adv. 向东北方向
adj. 朝东北的

e.en: The hurricane is tracking {northeastward} at fifteen miles per hour.
e.zh: 飓风正以每小时十五英里的速度向东北方向移动。

e.en: They hiked {northeastward} until they reached the ridge.
e.zh: 他们朝东北方向徒步,直到抵达山脊。

northerly.t: adj. 向北的；来自北方的

e.en: A cold {northerly} wind chilled the campers overnight.
e.zh: 寒冷的北风让露营者冻了一夜。

e.en: The ship maintained a {northerly} course toward Iceland.
e.zh: 这艘船保持着向北驶往冰岛的航线。

e.en: {Northern} Europe enjoys long summer days near the solstice.
e.zh: 北欧在夏至前后白昼非常漫长。

e.en: She has a strong {northern} accent that's hard to place.
e.zh: 她有很重的北方口音,让人难以辨认来自哪里。

e.en: As a {northerner}, he never quite got used to humid summers.
e.zh: 作为一个北方人,他始终不太适应潮湿的夏天。

e.en: The locals quickly recognized him as a {northerner}.
e.zh: 当地人很快就听出他是个北方人。

e.en: This village is the {northernmost} settlement on the island.
e.zh: 这个村庄是岛上最北端的居民点。

e.en: Svalbard is among the {northernmost} inhabited places on Earth.
e.zh: 斯瓦尔巴是地球上最北端的有人居住地之一。

e.en: The company's headquarters relocated to {Northfield} last year.
e.zh: 公司总部去年搬到了诺斯菲尔德。

e.en: {Northfield} High School is hosting the science fair this weekend.
e.zh: 诺斯菲尔德高中本周末将举办科学博览会。

e.en: The {northland} is famous for its fjords and reindeer.
e.zh: 北部地区以峡湾和驯鹿而闻名。

e.en: Hardy farmers have worked the {northland} for generations.
e.zh: 坚韧的农民世代耕作着这片北方土地。

e.en: Magnetic and geographic {norths} are not the same point.
e.zh: 地磁北极和地理北极并不是同一个点。

e.en: The compass distinguished between true and magnetic {norths}.
e.zh: 罗盘区分出真北和磁北两个方向。

e.en: The bakery on the {northside} of town is the best.
e.zh: 镇北边的那家面包店是最好的。

e.en: He grew up on the {northside}, near the old stadium.
e.zh: 他在北区长大,就在老体育场附近。

northumberland.t: n. 诺森伯兰郡（英格兰东北部）

e.en: {Northumberland} is famous for its rugged coastal castles.
e.zh: 诺森伯兰郡以其崎岖的海岸城堡而闻名。

e.en: We hiked along Hadrian's Wall through northern {Northumberland}.
e.zh: 我们沿着哈德良长城徒步穿越了诺森伯兰北部。

northumbria.t: n. 诺森布里亚（英国古王国）

e.en: Ancient {Northumbria} was once a powerful Anglo-Saxon kingdom.
e.zh: 古代诺森布里亚曾是一个强盛的盎格鲁-撒克逊王国。

e.en: She studied medieval manuscripts produced in {Northumbria}.
e.zh: 她研究诺森布里亚地区产出的中世纪手稿。

northumbrian.t:
adj. 诺森布里亚的
n. 诺森布里亚人

e.en: His grandfather spoke with a thick {Northumbrian} accent.
e.zh: 他祖父说话带着浓重的诺森布里亚口音。

e.en: The festival celebrates traditional {Northumbrian} pipe music.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝传统的诺森布里亚风笛音乐。

northward.t:
adv. 向北
adj. 朝北的

e.en: The geese flew {northward} as the weather warmed.
e.zh: 天气转暖时,大雁向北飞去。

e.en: From here the trail bends sharply {northward}.
e.zh: 从这里开始,小径急剧向北转弯。

e.en: The expedition pushed {northwards} through deep snow.
e.zh: 探险队顶着深雪向北推进。

e.en: Migration patterns shift {northwards} as temperatures rise.
e.zh: 随着气温上升,迁徙路线在向北偏移。

northwest.t:
n. 西北
adj. 西北的

e.en: The Pacific {Northwest} is famous for its dense rainforests.
e.zh: 太平洋西北地区以茂密的雨林而闻名。

e.en: Drive {northwest} along the coast for about an hour.
e.zh: 沿着海岸向西北方向开大约一小时。

northwesterly.t: adj. 来自西北的；朝西北的

e.en: A chilly {northwesterly} breeze blew across the harbor.
e.zh: 一阵冷飕飕的西北风吹过港口。

e.en: The plane changed to a {northwesterly} heading after takeoff.
e.zh: 飞机起飞后改为向西北方向飞行。

e.en: Wildfires continue to threaten the {northwestern} part of the state.
e.zh: 野火持续威胁着该州的西北部地区。

e.en: He teaches history at a {northwestern} liberal arts college.
e.zh: 他在一所西北部的文理学院教历史。

e.en: The atlas compares the {northwests} of two continents side by side.
e.zh: 这本地图册并排比较了两个大陆的西北部。

e.en: Climates differ sharply between the {northwests} of these regions.
e.zh: 这些地区的西北部气候差异显著。

northwestward.t:
adv. 朝西北方向
adj. 向西北的

e.en: The fleet sailed {northwestward} toward unfamiliar waters.
e.zh: 舰队朝西北方向驶向陌生的海域。

e.en: Storm clouds drifted {northwestward} across the prairie.
e.zh: 暴风云朝西北方向飘过大草原。

northwich.t: n. 诺斯威奇（英国地名）

e.en: {Northwich} grew prosperous from its salt mining industry.
e.zh: 诺斯威奇因其盐矿业而繁荣起来。

e.en: The canal runs right through the center of {Northwich}.
e.zh: 运河正好穿过诺斯威奇的市中心。

e.en: Their new house is in a quiet part of {Northwood}.
e.zh: 他们的新房子在诺斯伍德一处安静的地段。

e.en: {Northwood} station is on the Metropolitan line.
e.zh: 诺斯伍德地铁站位于大都会线上。

e.en: My laptop runs {Norton} antivirus to block malware.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑装了诺顿杀毒软件来阻止恶意程序。

e.en: Mary {Norton} wrote the children's classic about the Borrowers.
e.zh: 玛丽·诺顿写了那部关于地板下小人的儿童经典作品。

e.en: We took a fjord cruise along the western coast of {Norway}.
e.zh: 我们沿着挪威西海岸乘船游览了峡湾。

e.en: {Norway} consistently ranks high on global happiness indexes.
e.zh: 挪威在全球幸福指数排行中始终名列前茅。

norwegian.t:
adj. 挪威的
n. 挪威人；挪威语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Norwegian} after living in Oslo for years.
e.zh: 在奥斯陆住了多年后,她能讲一口流利的挪威语。

e.en: The {Norwegian} salmon at this restaurant is incredibly fresh.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的挪威三文鱼非常新鲜。

e.en: {Norwich} cathedral is one of England's finest medieval buildings.
e.zh: 诺里奇大教堂是英格兰最精美的中世纪建筑之一。

e.en: He took the train from London to {Norwich} for the weekend.
e.zh: 他周末从伦敦坐火车去了诺里奇。

e.en: The old cinema in {Norwood} has finally been renovated.
e.zh: 诺伍德那家老电影院终于翻修好了。

e.en: She catches the bus at {Norwood} Junction every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上在诺伍德枢纽站坐公交车。

nos.t: n. 号码（number 的复数缩写）

e.en: The proposal received twelve {nos} and only three yeses.
e.zh: 该提案收到了十二张反对票,只有三张赞成票。

e.en: After several {nos} from investors, she finally found backing.
e.zh: 在被投资人多次拒绝后,她终于获得了资金支持。

nose.t:
n. 鼻子
v. 嗅；小心地前进

e.en: She wrinkled her {nose} at the strong smell of cheese.
e.zh: 她闻到浓烈的奶酪味,皱了皱鼻子。

e.en: The plane's {nose} dipped sharply during the turbulence.
e.zh: 飞机在颠簸时机头突然下沉。

e.en: The horse munched oats from a {nosebag} hung on its bridle.
e.zh: 那匹马从挂在缰绳上的饲料袋里嚼着燕麦。

e.en: Farmers still use a canvas {nosebag} for working horses.
e.zh: 农夫们仍用帆布饲料袋来喂干活的马。

e.en: Dry winter air gave him a sudden {nosebleed} at work.
e.zh: 干燥的冬季空气让他在工作时突然流鼻血。

e.en: We sat in the {nosebleed} seats far from the stage.
e.zh: 我们坐在离舞台很远的最高层座位上。

nosedive.t:
n. 俯冲；暴跌
v. 急剧下降

e.en: The stock took a {nosedive} after the earnings report.
e.zh: 财报发布后股价一头栽了下去。

e.en: Sales {nosedive} every January once the holidays end.
e.zh: 每年一月假期一过销售就直线下滑。

e.en: She carried a small {nosegay} of violets to the wedding.
e.zh: 她带着一小束紫罗兰去参加婚礼。

e.en: Victorian ladies often wore a fragrant {nosegay} at parties.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的女士常在聚会上佩戴芬芳的小花束。

nosepiece.t: n. (眼镜) 鼻梁架；物镜转换器

e.en: Adjust the {nosepiece} so your glasses sit comfortably.
e.zh: 调整鼻梁架,让眼镜戴得舒适。

e.en: The microscope's {nosepiece} rotates to switch lenses.
e.zh: 显微镜的物镜转换器可以旋转切换镜头。

noses.t:
n. 鼻子（复数）
v. 嗅探（第三人称单数）

e.en: The puppies pressed their cold {noses} against the window.
e.zh: 小狗们把冰凉的鼻子贴在窗户上。

e.en: Reporters poked their {noses} into every corner of the scandal.
e.zh: 记者们把鼻子伸进丑闻的每个角落打探。

nosey.t: adj. 爱管闲事的；好打听的

e.en: Our {nosey} neighbor always asks about our weekend plans.
e.zh: 我们那位爱打听的邻居总是问我们周末的安排。

e.en: Don't be {nosey} about other people's salaries.
e.zh: 别多管闲事去打听别人的工资。

nosh.t:
v. 吃零食
n. 小吃

e.en: Let's grab a quick {nosh} before the movie starts.
e.zh: 我们在电影开始前先随便吃点东西吧。

e.en: He likes to {nosh} on chips while watching TV.
e.zh: 他喜欢一边看电视一边嚼薯片。

e.en: Hospitals work hard to prevent {nosocomial} infections.
e.zh: 医院在努力预防医院内感染。

e.en: The patient developed a {nosocomial} pneumonia after surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术后患上了医院内获得性肺炎。

e.en: Old photos filled her with sweet {nostalgia} for college days.
e.zh: 旧照片让她对大学时光涌起甜蜜的怀旧之情。

e.en: The game's pixel art plays on 90s {nostalgia}.
e.zh: 这款游戏的像素画风打的是九十年代怀旧牌。

e.en: Different generations carry their own peculiar {nostalgias}.
e.zh: 不同世代怀有各自独特的怀旧情怀。

e.en: His essays explore the small {nostalgias} of suburban life.
e.zh: 他的散文探讨郊区生活中那些细微的怀旧情绪。

e.en: This song always makes me feel {nostalgic} about high school.
e.zh: 这首歌总让我对高中时代感到怀念。

e.en: The cafe has a {nostalgic} 1950s diner vibe.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有一种怀旧的五十年代餐厅氛围。

e.en: He spoke {nostalgically} about summers at his grandmother's farm.
e.zh: 他怀念地谈起在奶奶农场度过的夏天。

e.en: Fans look back {nostalgically} on the team's golden era.
e.zh: 球迷们怀念地回顾球队的黄金时代。

nostradamus.t: n. 诺查丹玛斯（预言家）

e.en: People still debate whether {Nostradamus} predicted modern events.
e.zh: 人们仍在争论诺查丹玛斯是否预言了现代事件。

e.en: You don't need to be a {Nostradamus} to see this failing.
e.zh: 不用当诺查丹玛斯也能看出这事儿要黄。

e.en: A drop of water trickled into his left {nostril}.
e.zh: 一滴水流进了他的左鼻孔。

e.en: The doctor gently examined each {nostril} with a small light.
e.zh: 医生用一支小灯轻轻检查每个鼻孔。

e.en: The smell of fresh bread filled her {nostrils}.
e.zh: 新鲜面包的香味充满了她的鼻孔。

e.en: The horse flared its {nostrils} at the strange noise.
e.zh: 那匹马听到怪声张大了鼻孔。

e.en: Cutting taxes is his favorite political {nostrum}.
e.zh: 减税是他最爱的政治万灵药。

e.en: That diet pill is just another useless {nostrum}.
e.zh: 那种减肥药不过是又一种没用的偏方。

nosy.t: adj. 爱管闲事的；好打听的

e.en: Stop being so {nosy} about my text messages.
e.zh: 别那么爱管闲事偷看我的短信。

e.en: A {nosy} reporter dug up the old court records.
e.zh: 一名爱打探的记者挖出了旧法庭记录。

e.en: I'm {not} sure I can make it to the meeting.
e.zh: 我不太确定能不能赶上会议。

e.en: That's {not} how the app is supposed to work.
e.zh: 这款应用本来不该是这样运作的。

e.en: Wikipedia editors debated the topic's {notability} for hours.
e.zh: 维基百科编辑就该话题的关注度争论了几个小时。

e.en: The award confirmed her {notability} in the design world.
e.zh: 这个奖项确立了她在设计界的知名地位。

notable.t:
adj. 值得注意的；著名的
n. 名人

e.en: The conference featured several {notable} speakers from the industry.
e.zh: 这次会议邀请了几位业内知名讲者。

e.en: There's a {notable} difference between the two designs.
e.zh: 两种设计之间有显著的差别。

e.en: Service has improved {notably} since the new manager arrived.
e.zh: 自从新经理到任以来,服务明显改善了。

e.en: Several countries, {notably} Japan, have aging populations.
e.zh: 一些国家,尤其是日本,正面临人口老龄化。

e.en: The contract requires a {notarial} seal to be valid.
e.zh: 该合同需要公证印章才能生效。

e.en: She works at a {notarial} office downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心的一家公证处工作。

notarized.t:
adj. 经公证的
v. 公证（过去式）

e.en: The bank asked for a {notarized} copy of my passport.
e.zh: 银行要求提供经过公证的护照复印件。

e.en: He {notarized} the document at the courthouse this morning.
e.zh: 他今早在法院公证了那份文件。

e.en: You'll need a {notary} to witness the property transfer.
e.zh: 过户时你需要一位公证人见证。

e.en: The {notary} stamped each page of the agreement.
e.zh: 公证员在协议的每一页都盖了章。

e.en: Composers {notate} their music using standard symbols.
e.zh: 作曲家用标准符号来记录他们的音乐。

e.en: Please {notate} any errors you find in the manuscript.
e.zh: 请把你在稿件中发现的错误标注出来。

e.en: She {notated} the rhythm carefully on the staff paper.
e.zh: 她在五线谱纸上仔细标记了节奏。

e.en: The teacher {notated} corrections in red ink.
e.zh: 老师用红墨水标注了修改意见。

e.en: Musical {notation} took centuries to develop into its modern form.
e.zh: 乐谱记谱法经过几个世纪才发展成现代形式。

e.en: Mathematicians use shorthand {notation} to save space.
e.zh: 数学家用速记符号来节省篇幅。

e.en: The new standard introduces several {notational} changes.
e.zh: 新标准引入了几处记号上的改动。

e.en: Different fields have their own {notational} conventions.
e.zh: 不同领域有各自的符号惯例。

notch.t:
n. 刻痕；等级
v. 刻凹痕

e.en: Cut a small {notch} in the wood to mark the spot.
e.zh: 在木头上刻个小凹口来标记位置。

e.en: This phone is a {notch} above its competitors in quality.
e.zh: 这款手机在质量上比竞品高一个档次。

notched.t:
adj. 有凹口的
v. 刻痕（过去式）

e.en: The team {notched} another win against their rivals last night.
e.zh: 球队昨晚又拿下一场对宿敌的胜利。

e.en: He wore a jacket with a {notched} lapel to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿了件平驳领的西装去面试。

note.t:
n. 笔记；便条
v. 注意；记下

e.en: I left a {note} on the fridge about dinner.
e.zh: 我在冰箱上留了张关于晚餐的便条。

e.en: Please {note} that the office closes early on Fridays.
e.zh: 请注意办公室周五会提早关门。

notebook.t: n. 笔记本；笔记本电脑

e.en: She jotted the idea down in her leather {notebook}.
e.zh: 她把那个想法记在了她的皮面笔记本上。

e.en: Open a Jupyter {notebook} to run the analysis.
e.zh: 打开一个 Jupyter 笔记本来运行这段分析。

e.en: Stacks of old {notebooks} filled the bottom drawer.
e.zh: 最下层抽屉里塞满了旧笔记本。

e.en: Data scientists share their {notebooks} on GitHub.
e.zh: 数据科学家们在 GitHub 上分享他们的 notebook。

noted.t:
adj. 著名的
v. 注意到（note 的过去式）

e.en: She is a {noted} expert on climate policy.
e.zh: 她是一位知名的气候政策专家。

e.en: The judge {noted} that the evidence was inconclusive.
e.zh: 法官指出证据不够充分。

notepad.t: n. 记事本（纸质或软件）

e.en: He scribbled the address on a yellow {notepad}.
e.zh: 他把地址潦草地写在一本黄色记事本上。

e.en: Open {Notepad} and paste the error message there.
e.zh: 打开记事本,把错误信息粘贴进去。

e.en: She wrote the thank-you note on cream-colored {notepaper}.
e.zh: 她用米白色信纸写了那张感谢便条。

e.en: The hotel provides personalized {notepaper} in every room.
e.zh: 这家酒店每个房间都配有定制信纸。

notes.t:
n. 笔记；便条
v. 注意到

e.en: Take detailed {notes} during the lecture for the exam.
e.zh: 听课时做好详细笔记,以备考试用。

e.en: This wine has subtle {notes} of vanilla and oak.
e.zh: 这款酒带有淡淡的香草和橡木气息。

noteworthy.t: adj. 值得注意的；显著的

e.en: Nothing {noteworthy} happened during yesterday's board meeting.
e.zh: 昨天的董事会会议上没发生什么值得一提的事。

e.en: The film features several {noteworthy} performances by newcomers.
e.zh: 这部电影里有几位新人值得关注的表演。

e.en: There's {nothing} in the fridge except some leftover pizza.
e.zh: 冰箱里除了几块剩披萨什么都没有。

e.en: He said {nothing} when asked about the missing files.
e.zh: 被问到丢失的文件时他什么也没说。

e.en: The astronaut floated in the cold {nothingness} of space.
e.zh: 宇航员漂浮在太空那冰冷的虚无之中。

e.en: The novel explores themes of meaning and {nothingness}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了意义与虚无的主题。

notice.t:
n. 通知；公告
v. 注意到

e.en: Did you {notice} the new logo on their website?
e.zh: 你注意到他们网站上的新标志了吗?

e.en: The landlord posted a {notice} about the elevator repair.
e.zh: 房东贴出了关于电梯维修的通知。

noticeable.t: adj. 明显的；显而易见的

e.en: There's a {noticeable} improvement in the app's performance.
e.zh: 这款应用的性能有了明显的提升。

e.en: She had a {noticeable} accent that hinted at her hometown.
e.zh: 她有一种明显的口音,暗示了她的家乡。

e.en: The room grew {noticeably} colder after the heater broke.
e.zh: 暖气坏掉后房间明显变冷了。

e.en: He seemed {noticeably} tired during the second half of the meeting.
e.zh: 会议下半场他看起来明显疲倦了。

e.en: Job postings are pinned to the kitchen {noticeboard}.
e.zh: 招聘启事贴在厨房的公告板上。

e.en: Check the {noticeboard} for this week's class schedule.
e.zh: 看看公告板上本周的课程安排。

e.en: School {noticeboards} were covered in flyers for the talent show.
e.zh: 学校的公告板上贴满了才艺表演的海报。

e.en: Office {noticeboards} are slowly being replaced by digital screens.
e.zh: 办公室的公告板正逐渐被电子屏幕取代。

noticed.t: v. 注意到（notice 的过去式）

e.en: I {noticed} a typo on the homepage this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我注意到主页上有个错别字。

e.en: Nobody {noticed} her quietly leaving the party.
e.zh: 没人注意到她悄悄离开了派对。

notices.t:
n. 通知（复数）
v. 注意到

e.en: Several eviction {notices} were taped to the building's door.
e.zh: 楼门上贴着几张驱逐通知。

e.en: The film received glowing {notices} from major critics.
e.zh: 这部电影获得了主要影评人的赞誉。

noticing.t: v. 注意到（notice 的现在分词）

e.en: I keep {noticing} the same bug in the login flow.
e.zh: 我一直注意到登录流程里有同一个 bug。

e.en: She slipped out without anyone {noticing} her absence.
e.zh: 她悄悄溜出去,没人察觉她不在。

notifiable.t: adj. 须申报的（疾病等须报告当局）

e.en: Measles is a {notifiable} disease in most countries.
e.zh: 麻疹在大多数国家是法定报告传染病。

e.en: Doctors must report any {notifiable} infection to health authorities.
e.zh: 医生必须向卫生部门报告任何法定传染病。

notification.t: n. 通知；（手机）推送消息

e.en: My phone buzzed with a {notification} from the bank.
e.zh: 我的手机响了一下，是银行发来的通知。

e.en: Please send a {notification} once the order ships.
e.zh: 订单发货后请发一条通知给我。

notified.t: v. 通知（notify 的过去式）

e.en: The school {notified} parents about the snow day.
e.zh: 学校通知家长今天因下雪停课。

e.en: I should have {notified} you sooner about the change.
e.zh: 我应该早点把变动告诉你的。

notifies.t: v. 通知（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {notifies} you when a friend posts.
e.zh: 朋友发帖时，这个应用会通知你。

e.en: The system {notifies} the manager of any errors.
e.zh: 系统会把任何错误通知给经理。

e.en: Please {notify} me if the price drops.
e.zh: 如果价格下降，请通知我。

e.en: You must {notify} HR before taking leave.
e.zh: 请假之前你必须通知人事部。

e.en: Thanks for {notifying} me about the meeting time.
e.zh: 谢谢你告诉我会议的时间。

e.en: The hospital is {notifying} families of the delay.
e.zh: 医院正在通知家属手术延迟的事。

noting.t: v. 注意到；指出（note 的现在分词）

e.en: She read the report, {noting} several factual errors.
e.zh: 她读那份报告，注意到几处事实错误。

e.en: He replied politely, {noting} that he disagreed.
e.zh: 他礼貌地回复，并指出自己并不同意。

e.en: I have no {notion} of where she went.
e.zh: 我完全不知道她去了哪里。

e.en: The {notion} that money buys happiness is debatable.
e.zh: 金钱能买到幸福这种观念值得商榷。

e.en: The budget includes a {notional} figure for travel.
e.zh: 预算里包含了一个估算出来的差旅费数字。

e.en: Their agreement was {notional} rather than legally binding.
e.zh: 他们的协议只是名义上的，并没有法律效力。

e.en: He is {notionally} in charge, but rarely decides.
e.zh: 他名义上负责，但很少做决定。

e.en: The two teams are {notionally} equal in skill.
e.zh: 两支队伍在水平上名义上是相当的。

e.en: Old {notions} about gender roles are slowly fading.
e.zh: 关于性别角色的旧观念正在慢慢消失。

e.en: She had romantic {notions} of life in Paris.
e.zh: 她对巴黎的生活抱有浪漫的幻想。

e.en: The town's two {notorieties} were both gangsters.
e.zh: 这座小镇上两个臭名昭著的人物都是黑帮分子。

e.en: History remembers their {notorieties} more than their talents.
e.zh: 历史记住的更多是他们的恶名，而非才华。

e.en: The scandal brought him instant {notoriety} online.
e.zh: 那场丑闻让他在网上瞬间臭名远扬。

e.en: She gained {notoriety} for her sharp public criticisms.
e.zh: 她因尖锐的公开批评而声名狼藉。

notorious.t: adj. 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的

e.en: That intersection is {notorious} for traffic accidents.
e.zh: 那个路口因交通事故频发而臭名远扬。

e.en: He's {notorious} for showing up late to meetings.
e.zh: 他开会迟到是出了名的。

notoriously.t: adv. 众所周知地（常用于贬义）

e.en: This city is {notoriously} expensive for renters.
e.zh: 这座城市的租房费用是出了名的贵。

e.en: Cats are {notoriously} hard to photograph well.
e.zh: 猫是出了名的难拍出好照片。

notre.t: (罕用) 法语词，常见于 Notre Dame（圣母院）

e.en: We visited {Notre} Dame Cathedral last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天参观了巴黎圣母院。

e.en: The bell of {Notre} Dame rang across the river.
e.zh: 圣母院的钟声响彻河面。

e.en: Professor {Nott} teaches medieval history at the college.
e.zh: 诺特教授在这所学院教中世纪历史。

e.en: Mr. {Nott} owns the bakery on Main Street.
e.zh: 诺特先生开的是大街上那家面包店。

notting.t: (罕用) 地名，如 Notting Hill（诺丁山）

e.en: We rented a flat in {Notting} Hill for August.
e.zh: 我们在诺丁山租了一套公寓，住到八月。

e.en: The {Notting} Hill Carnival draws huge crowds yearly.
e.zh: 诺丁山狂欢节每年都吸引大量人群。

e.en: She studied engineering at the University of {Nottingham}.
e.zh: 她在诺丁汉大学读工程专业。

e.en: {Nottingham} is famous for the Robin Hood legend.
e.zh: 诺丁汉因罗宾汉的传说而闻名。

nottinghamshire.t: n. 诺丁汉郡（英格兰郡名）

e.en: They drove through {Nottinghamshire} on the way north.
e.zh: 他们北上途中开车穿过了诺丁汉郡。

e.en: Sherwood Forest lies in the heart of {Nottinghamshire}.
e.zh: 舍伍德森林就在诺丁汉郡的中心地带。

e.en: He grew up in a small village in {Notts}.
e.zh: 他在诺丁汉郡的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: {Notts} County is one of England's oldest football clubs.
e.zh: 诺茨郡队是英格兰最古老的足球俱乐部之一。

notwithstanding.t:
prep. 尽管；虽然
adv. 仍然

e.en: {Notwithstanding} the rain, the concert went ahead.
e.zh: 尽管下着雨，音乐会还是照常举行。

e.en: Her injury {notwithstanding}, she finished the marathon.
e.zh: 尽管受了伤，她还是跑完了马拉松。

e.en: This chocolate bar has a soft {nougat} center.
e.zh: 这块巧克力里面是软软的牛轧糖夹心。

e.en: She bought almond {nougat} from a shop in Provence.
e.zh: 她在普罗旺斯一家店里买了杏仁牛轧糖。

e.en: All his efforts came to {nought} in the end.
e.zh: 他所有的努力最终都化为乌有。

e.en: The temperature dropped to {nought} degrees overnight.
e.zh: 夜里气温降到了零度。

e.en: The kids played {noughts} and crosses on a napkin.
e.zh: 孩子们在餐巾纸上玩起了井字棋。

e.en: Add a few more {noughts} to that price tag.
e.zh: 在那个标价后面再加几个零吧。

e.en: "Happiness" is an abstract {noun} in English.
e.zh: "happiness"在英语中是一个抽象名词。

e.en: Every sentence usually contains a {noun} and a verb.
e.zh: 每个句子通常都包含一个名词和一个动词。

e.en: German {nouns} are always written with a capital letter.
e.zh: 德语名词的首字母总是要大写的。

e.en: The teacher asked us to underline all the {nouns}.
e.zh: 老师让我们把所有名词都画上线。

e.en: Vegetables and fruit {nourish} the body naturally.
e.zh: 蔬菜和水果能自然地滋养身体。

e.en: Good books {nourish} the imagination of young readers.
e.zh: 好书能滋养年轻读者的想象力。

nourished.t: v. 滋养（过去式）；adj. 营养充足的

e.en: The plants looked healthy and well {nourished}.
e.zh: 那些植物看起来健康，营养充足。

e.en: Her grandmother's letters {nourished} her through college.
e.zh: 奶奶的信陪伴并滋养着她度过了大学时光。

nourishes.t: v. 滋养（第三人称单数）

e.en: This soup {nourishes} you on a cold winter day.
e.zh: 在寒冷的冬日里，这碗汤能滋补你的身体。

e.en: Reading {nourishes} the mind in ways TV cannot.
e.zh: 阅读对心灵的滋养是电视无法做到的。

e.en: She made a warm, {nourishing} bowl of chicken soup.
e.zh: 她煮了一碗温暖又滋补的鸡汤。

e.en: Long walks in nature can be deeply {nourishing}.
e.zh: 在大自然中长途散步能深深滋养身心。

e.en: Babies get all their {nourishment} from milk at first.
e.zh: 婴儿起初的全部营养都来自奶水。

e.en: She found {nourishment} in poetry during difficult times.
e.zh: 在艰难的日子里，她从诗歌中获得了精神滋养。

e.en: The pantry held basic {nourishments} for the long winter.
e.zh: 储藏室里备好了过冬的基本食物。

e.en: Soldiers carried light {nourishments} on the long march.
e.zh: 士兵们在长途行军中带着轻便的口粮。

e.en: He has the {nous} to negotiate a great deal.
e.zh: 他有谈成一笔好生意的精明头脑。

e.en: You need political {nous} to survive in this office.
e.zh: 在这个办公室生存，你需要点政治头脑。

e.en: The hotel lobby is decorated in art {nouveau} style.
e.zh: 酒店大堂以新艺术风格装饰。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a {nouveau} riche showoff.
e.zh: 评论家把他看作爱炫耀的暴发户。

e.en: The chef trained in classic {nouvelle} cuisine techniques.
e.zh: 这位厨师接受过经典新派烹饪的技法训练。

e.en: The film borrowed heavily from the French {nouvelle} vague.
e.zh: 这部电影深受法国新浪潮的影响。

e.en: Our wedding anniversary falls on {Nov} 12th.
e.zh: 我们的结婚纪念日是11月12日。

e.en: The report is due by the end of {Nov}.
e.zh: 这份报告必须在11月底前交。

e.en: Astronomers spotted a bright {nova} in the constellation.
e.zh: 天文学家在那个星座中发现了一颗明亮的新星。

e.en: She drives an old Chevy {Nova} from the seventies.
e.zh: 她开着一辆七十年代的老款雪佛兰Nova。

novel.t:
n. 小说
adj. 新奇的

e.en: I'm reading a fantastic mystery {novel} this week.
e.zh: 我这周在读一本超棒的悬疑小说。

e.en: The team came up with a {novel} solution.
e.zh: 团队想出了一个新颖的解决方案。

e.en: She wrote a charming {novelette} about a small village.
e.zh: 她写了一部关于小村庄的迷人中短篇小说。

e.en: The magazine publishes one {novelette} in each issue.
e.zh: 这本杂志每期都会刊登一篇中短篇小说。

e.en: The {novelist} spent years researching nineteenth-century London.
e.zh: 这位小说家花了多年研究十九世纪的伦敦。

e.en: She's a bestselling {novelist} with seven books out.
e.zh: 她是一位畅销小说家，已经出版了七本书。

e.en: His memoir has a strong {novelistic} feel to it.
e.zh: 他的回忆录带有浓郁的小说式风格。

e.en: The journalist used {novelistic} techniques to tell the story.
e.zh: 那位记者用小说手法来讲述这个故事。

e.en: Many famous {novelists} began their careers as journalists.
e.zh: 许多著名小说家最初都是当记者起步的。

e.en: Contemporary {novelists} often write about climate change.
e.zh: 当代小说家经常以气候变化为主题进行创作。

e.en: The {novelization} of the film sold surprisingly well.
e.zh: 那部电影的小说改编版销量出奇地好。

e.en: He's writing the official {novelization} of the video game.
e.zh: 他正在为那款电子游戏写官方小说改编版。

e.en: Our office once ran on a {Novell} network.
e.zh: 我们办公室以前用的是Novell网络。

e.en: {Novell} was a major software company in the nineties.
e.zh: Novell是九十年代的一家大型软件公司。

e.en: His latest {novella} can be read in one evening.
e.zh: 他最新的中篇小说一个晚上就能读完。

e.en: The {novella} won a major literary prize last year.
e.zh: 那部中篇小说去年获得了一项重要的文学奖。

e.en: Ivor {Novello} wrote many beloved British musicals.
e.zh: 伊弗·诺韦洛创作了许多深受喜爱的英国音乐剧。

e.en: The {Novello} Awards celebrate songwriting talent each year.
e.zh: 诺韦洛奖每年都在表彰优秀的词曲创作人才。

e.en: She owns hundreds of {novels} in three languages.
e.zh: 她拥有数百本三种语言的小说。

e.en: His detective {novels} top the charts every summer.
e.zh: 他的侦探小说每年夏天都登上销量榜首。

e.en: The shop sells cheap party {novelties} and balloons.
e.zh: 那家店出售便宜的派对小玩意儿和气球。

e.en: Voice assistants were exciting {novelties} a decade ago.
e.zh: 十年前语音助手还是让人兴奋的新鲜事物。

e.en: The {novelty} of the new app wore off quickly.
e.zh: 这款新应用的新鲜感很快就消失了。

e.en: He bought a {novelty} mug shaped like a cat.
e.zh: 他买了一只猫咪造型的趣味马克杯。

e.en: The leaves usually fall by mid-{November} here.
e.zh: 这里的树叶通常到十一月中旬就落光了。

e.en: Thanksgiving is celebrated in late {November} every year.
e.zh: 感恩节每年都在十一月下旬庆祝。

e.en: The last three {Novembers} have been unusually warm here.
e.zh: 过去三个十一月这里异常温暖。

e.en: She remembers cold {Novembers} from her childhood in Boston.
e.zh: 她记得波士顿童年时寒冷的十一月。

e.en: Her grandmother prayed a {novena} for the sick child.
e.zh: 她奶奶为生病的孩子做了九日祷告。

e.en: The parish announced a {novena} starting next Monday evening.
e.zh: 教区宣布下周一晚开始举行九日敬礼。

novgorod.t: n. 诺夫哥罗德（俄城市）

e.en: {Novgorod} was a major trading hub in medieval Russia.
e.zh: 诺夫哥罗德是中世纪俄罗斯的重要贸易中心。

e.en: We visited the ancient kremlin in {Novgorod} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了诺夫哥罗德的古老克里姆林宫。

e.en: As a {novice} programmer, she struggled with recursion at first.
e.zh: 作为编程新手,她起初对递归很头疼。

e.en: The class welcomes both experts and complete {novice} climbers.
e.zh: 该课程欢迎专家和完全的攀岩新手。

e.en: She spent her {novitiate} year studying scripture and silence.
e.zh: 她用见习修女年学习圣经并保持静默。

e.en: The monastery's {novitiate} program lasts for two full years.
e.zh: 修道院的初学期课程为期整整两年。

e.en: The team started {novo} after the original prototype failed.
e.zh: 原型失败后团队从头重新开始。

e.en: {Novo} Nordisk announced strong sales of its diabetes drug.
e.zh: 诺和诺德宣布其糖尿病药物销售强劲。

e.en: The dentist injected {novocaine} before drilling the cavity.
e.zh: 牙医在钻蛀牙前注射了奴佛卡因。

e.en: My jaw felt numb for hours after the {novocaine} wore off.
e.zh: 奴佛卡因失效后我下巴还麻木了好几个小时。

novosibirsk.t: n. 新西伯利亚（俄城市）

e.en: {Novosibirsk} is the largest city in Siberia by population.
e.zh: 新西伯利亚是西伯利亚人口最多的城市。

e.en: Winters in {Novosibirsk} regularly drop below minus thirty.
e.zh: 新西伯利亚的冬天经常降到零下三十度以下。

e.en: We booked a {Novotel} near the airport for our layover.
e.zh: 我们在机场附近订了诺富特酒店过夜。

e.en: The {Novotel} chain offers consistent quality across European cities.
e.zh: 诺富特连锁酒店在欧洲各城市提供一致的品质。

now.t:
adv. 现在；此刻
conj. 既然

e.en: Can you call me back {now}? It's really urgent.
e.zh: 你现在能回我电话吗?真的很急。

e.en: {Now} that the kids are grown, we travel more often.
e.zh: 如今孩子们长大了,我们经常出门旅行。

e.en: {Nowadays} most people read the news on their phones.
e.zh: 如今大多数人都在手机上看新闻。

e.en: Kids {nowadays} learn to code before they finish primary school.
e.zh: 现在的孩子小学没毕业就会编程了。

nowhere.t:
adv. 哪儿也不
n. 无名之地

e.en: My keys were {nowhere} to be found this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我的钥匙怎么都找不到。

e.en: The cabin sits in the middle of {nowhere}, miles from town.
e.zh: 那间小屋坐落在荒郊野外,离城里好几英里。

e.en: There's {nowt} left in the fridge for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 冰箱里啥也没剩下做晚饭了。

e.en: He said {nowt} when I asked about the missing money.
e.zh: 我问起丢失的钱时他什么都没说。

e.en: Diesel engines produce significant {NOx} emissions during cold starts.
e.zh: 柴油发动机冷启动时会产生大量氮氧化物排放。

e.en: New regulations aim to cut urban {NOx} levels by half.
e.zh: 新规旨在将城市氮氧化物水平减半。

e.en: The factory leaked {noxious} fumes into the surrounding neighborhood.
e.zh: 工厂将有毒烟雾泄漏到周边社区。

e.en: Bleach mixed with ammonia creates a {noxious} chemical reaction.
e.zh: 漂白剂与氨混合会产生有害的化学反应。

e.en: Clean the printer {nozzle} if your prints look streaky.
e.zh: 如果打印效果有条纹,请清洁打印机喷嘴。

e.en: The firefighter aimed the hose {nozzle} at the burning roof.
e.zh: 消防员把水管喷嘴对准燃烧的屋顶。

e.en: The shopkeeper {NPC} sells rare potions in this dungeon.
e.zh: 这个地牢里的店主NPC会卖稀有药水。

e.en: He stood frozen like an {NPC} during the entire meeting.
e.zh: 整场会议他像个NPC一样一动不动地站着。

e.en: The {NPT} aims to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons.
e.zh: 《不扩散核武器条约》旨在防止核武器扩散。

e.en: North Korea withdrew from the {NPT} back in 2003.
e.zh: 朝鲜早在2003年就退出了《不扩散核武器条约》。

e.en: Calculate the project's {NPV} before approving the capital expense.
e.zh: 在批准资本支出前请计算项目的净现值。

e.en: A negative {NPV} suggests the investment will lose money.
e.zh: 负的净现值意味着该投资会亏损。

nra.t: n. 美国全国步枪协会

e.en: The {NRA} lobbies heavily against new gun control measures.
e.zh: 全美步枪协会大力游说反对新的枪支管制措施。

e.en: His father has been an {NRA} member for forty years.
e.zh: 他父亲已经做了四十年的全美步枪协会会员。

nrc.t: n. 美国核管理委员会

e.en: The {NRC} approved the new reactor design last week.
e.zh: 核管理委员会上周批准了新的反应堆设计。

e.en: Plant operators must report any incident to the {NRC} immediately.
e.zh: 电厂运营方必须立即向核管理委员会报告任何事故。

e.en: Snowden leaked classified documents revealing {NSA} surveillance programs.
e.zh: 斯诺登泄露机密文件揭露了国安局的监控项目。

e.en: The {NSA} headquarters is located in Fort Meade, Maryland.
e.zh: 国安局总部位于马里兰州的米德堡。

e.en: Ibuprofen is a common {NSAID} used for pain relief.
e.zh: 布洛芬是常用于止痛的非甾体抗炎药。

e.en: Long-term {NSAID} use can damage your stomach lining.
e.zh: 长期服用非甾体抗炎药会损伤胃黏膜。

nsc.t: n. 美国国家安全委员会

e.en: The president convened the {NSC} to discuss the crisis.
e.zh: 总统召集国家安全委员会讨论这场危机。

e.en: {NSC} advisors briefed the cabinet on emerging cyber threats.
e.zh: 国安委顾问向内阁通报了新的网络威胁。

nsf.t: n. 美国国家科学基金会

e.en: Her research is funded by an {NSF} graduate fellowship.
e.zh: 她的研究由美国国家科学基金会的研究生奖学金资助。

e.en: The bank charged him an {NSF} fee for the bounced check.
e.zh: 银行因支票退票向他收取了存款不足手续费。

nspcc.t: n. 英国防止虐待儿童协会

e.en: The {NSPCC} runs a confidential helpline for at-risk children.
e.zh: 全国防止虐待儿童协会设有面向高危儿童的保密热线。

e.en: She volunteers with the {NSPCC} every Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每周六下午都在防止虐待儿童协会做志愿者。

nsw.t: n. 新南威尔士州（澳大利亚州名缩写）

e.en: Sydney is the capital of {NSW} in eastern Australia.
e.zh: 悉尼是澳大利亚东部新南威尔士州的首府。

e.en: Bushfires in {NSW} forced thousands of residents to evacuate.
e.zh: 新南威尔士州的森林大火迫使数千居民撤离。

e.en: I've explained the rules for the {nth} time today.
e.zh: 我今天已经第无数次解释这些规则了。

e.en: The formula gives you the {nth} term of the sequence.
e.zh: 该公式给出数列的第n项。

nuance.t: n. 细微差别；微妙之处

e.en: Translation often loses the cultural {nuance} of the original.
e.zh: 翻译往往会丢失原文的文化微妙之处。

e.en: His argument missed an important {nuance} in the data.
e.zh: 他的论点忽略了数据中一个重要的细微差别。

nuanced.t: adj. 有细微差别的；微妙的

e.en: The film offers a {nuanced} portrait of immigrant family life.
e.zh: 这部电影细腻地刻画了移民家庭的生活。

e.en: We need a more {nuanced} approach to content moderation.
e.zh: 我们对内容审核需要更细致的处理方式。

nub.t:
n. 要点；核心
n. 小块；疙瘩

e.en: The {nub} of the problem is poor team communication.
e.zh: 问题的核心在于团队沟通不畅。

e.en: She chewed the pencil down to a tiny {nub}.
e.zh: 她把铅笔啃到只剩一小段。

e.en: Only a {nubbin} of the eraser remained on the pencil.
e.zh: 铅笔上的橡皮只剩一小块了。

e.en: The plant sprouted a green {nubbin} where the leaf fell.
e.zh: 叶子掉落处植物长出了一个小绿芽。

nubby.t: adj. 有小疙瘩的；粗纺的

e.en: She wore a {nubby} wool sweater to the cabin.
e.zh: 她穿着一件粗纺羊毛衫去了小屋。

e.en: The sofa is upholstered in a {nubby} beige fabric.
e.zh: 沙发包着一种带颗粒感的米色面料。

nubian.t:
adj. 努比亚的
n. 努比亚人

e.en: Ancient {Nubian} kingdoms once rivaled Egypt in wealth and power.
e.zh: 古代努比亚王国曾在财富和实力上与埃及比肩。

e.en: The museum displayed pottery from a {Nubian} burial site.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一处努比亚墓葬出土的陶器。

nubile.t: adj. (女子)适婚年龄的；妙龄的

e.en: The novel romanticizes its {nubile} young heroine in troubling ways.
e.zh: 这部小说以令人不安的方式美化了年轻貌美的女主角。

e.en: Critics objected to the camera lingering on {nubile} dancers.
e.zh: 评论家反对镜头长时间停留在妙龄舞者身上。

e.en: Marine biologists study {Nucella} snails to track ocean pollution.
e.zh: 海洋生物学家通过研究荔枝螺来追踪海洋污染。

e.en: The {Nucella} drilled a neat hole through the mussel shell.
e.zh: 那只荔枝螺在贻贝壳上钻了一个整齐的洞。

e.en: France generates most of its electricity from {nuclear} power.
e.zh: 法国大部分电力来自核能。

e.en: My boss went {nuclear} when he saw the missed deadline.
e.zh: 老板看到错过截止日期后大发雷霆。

e.en: The region's {nuclearization} has alarmed neighboring countries for decades.
e.zh: 该地区的核武化几十年来令邻国感到警觉。

e.en: Diplomats are working hard to prevent further {nuclearization} of Asia.
e.zh: 外交官正努力阻止亚洲进一步核武化。

nucleate.t:
v. 成核；形成核心
adj. 有核的

e.en: Tiny dust particles help water vapor {nucleate} into raindrops.
e.zh: 微小尘粒帮助水蒸气凝结成雨滴。

e.en: A few committed members can {nucleate} an entire grassroots movement.
e.zh: 少数核心成员就能催生出整个草根运动。

e.en: Ice crystals {nucleated} on the cold windowpane overnight.
e.zh: 夜里冰晶在冰冷的窗玻璃上凝结成形。

e.en: Bird red blood cells are {nucleated}, unlike those in mammals.
e.zh: 与哺乳动物不同,鸟类的红细胞是有核的。

e.en: Cloud seeding promotes the {nucleation} of ice in supercooled droplets.
e.zh: 人工降雨促进了过冷水滴中冰晶的成核。

e.en: The {nucleation} of bubbles in champagne happens at tiny imperfections.
e.zh: 香槟中气泡的成核发生在微小的瑕疵处。

e.en: Atomic {nuclei} contain protons and neutrons bound tightly together.
e.zh: 原子核内含有紧密结合的质子和中子。

e.en: Scientists observed multiple {nuclei} forming inside the abnormal cells.
e.zh: 科学家观察到异常细胞内形成了多个细胞核。

e.en: DNA and RNA are the two main types of {nucleic} acids.
e.zh: DNA和RNA是两种主要的核酸。

e.en: The vaccine delivers {nucleic} acid instructions directly to your cells.
e.zh: 该疫苗将核酸指令直接送入你的细胞。

e.en: Each {nucleon} contributes roughly one atomic mass unit to the atom.
e.zh: 每个核子为原子贡献约一个原子质量单位。

e.en: Physicists study how a {nucleon} behaves under extreme pressure.
e.zh: 物理学家研究核子在极端压力下的行为。

e.en: A {nucleoside} consists of a base attached to a sugar.
e.zh: 一个核苷由碱基连接糖分子构成。

e.en: Many antiviral drugs work as {nucleoside} analogues during replication.
e.zh: 许多抗病毒药物在复制过程中充当核苷类似物。

e.en: Heavy elements form through stellar {nucleosynthesis} inside dying stars.
e.zh: 重元素是通过垂死恒星内部的恒星核合成形成的。

e.en: Big Bang {nucleosynthesis} produced the first hydrogen and helium atoms.
e.zh: 大爆炸核合成产生了最早的氢原子和氦原子。

e.en: DNA is built from four different {nucleotide} building blocks.
e.zh: DNA由四种不同的核苷酸单元构建而成。

e.en: A single {nucleotide} change can cause serious genetic disease.
e.zh: 单个核苷酸的改变就可能导致严重的遗传病。

nucleus.t:
n. 核；核心
n. 原子核；细胞核

e.en: The cell {nucleus} stores nearly all of the genetic material.
e.zh: 细胞核储存着几乎全部的遗传物质。

e.en: These three engineers form the {nucleus} of our research team.
e.zh: 这三位工程师是我们研究团队的核心。

e.en: Each {nuclide} has a specific number of protons and neutrons.
e.zh: 每种核素都有特定的质子数和中子数。

e.en: Radioactive {nuclide} decay is used to date ancient rocks.
e.zh: 放射性核素衰变被用于测定古老岩石的年代。

nude.t:
adj. 裸体的
n. 裸体画；裸色

e.en: The gallery features classical {nude} sculptures from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 美术馆展出文艺复兴时期的古典裸体雕塑。

e.en: She painted her nails a soft {nude} pink for the wedding.
e.zh: 为了婚礼她把指甲涂成柔和的裸粉色。

nudge.t:
v. 轻推；推动
n. 轻推；提醒

e.en: She gave him a gentle {nudge} to wake him up.
e.zh: 她轻轻推了他一下,把他叫醒。

e.en: The app sends a daily {nudge} to drink more water.
e.zh: 这款应用每天提醒你多喝水。

e.en: They spent the weekend at a {nudist} beach in France.
e.zh: 他们在法国的天体海滩度过了周末。

e.en: He joined a {nudist} colony after retiring last year.
e.zh: 他退休后加入了一个天体主义者社区。

e.en: The film was rated R for {nudity} and strong language.
e.zh: 这部电影因裸露和粗口被评为 R 级。

e.en: Public {nudity} is illegal in most parts of the country.
e.zh: 在该国大部分地区,公开裸体是违法的。

nuffield.t: n. 纳菲尔德（英国地名/人名）

e.en: She studies medicine at the {Nuffield} Department in Oxford.
e.zh: 她在牛津的纳菲尔德学院学习医学。

e.en: The {Nuffield} Foundation funds education research across Britain.
e.zh: 纳菲尔德基金会资助英国各地的教育研究。

e.en: The court declared the old contract entirely {nugatory}.
e.zh: 法院宣布那份旧合同完全无效。

e.en: His objections were dismissed as {nugatory} and irrelevant.
e.zh: 他的反对意见被视为无足轻重而遭驳回。

nugget.t: n. 小块（尤指金块）；精华

e.en: The kids ordered chicken {nuggets} and fries for lunch.
e.zh: 孩子们午餐点了鸡块和薯条。

e.en: That podcast contains a real {nugget} of wisdom.
e.zh: 那期播客里有一句真正有价值的箴言。

nuisance.t: n. 讨厌的人或事；麻烦

e.en: Mosquitoes are a real {nuisance} on summer evenings.
e.zh: 夏天傍晚的蚊子真让人烦。

e.en: Sorry to be a {nuisance}, but could you help me?
e.zh: 抱歉打扰你了,你能帮我一下吗?

nuisances.t: n. 讨厌的事（nuisance 复数）

e.en: Robocalls are among the biggest {nuisances} of modern life.
e.zh: 骚扰电话是现代生活中最烦人的事之一。

e.en: The new law targets noise {nuisances} in residential areas.
e.zh: 新法律针对住宅区的噪音扰民问题。

e.en: The festival is called {Nuit} Blanche, meaning sleepless night.
e.zh: 这个艺术节叫白夜,意思是不眠之夜。

e.en: Bonne {nuit} is the French way to say goodnight.
e.zh: Bonne nuit 是法语里的晚安。

nuj.t: n. 英国记者工会（National Union of Journalists）

e.en: She joined the {NUJ} after becoming a freelance journalist.
e.zh: 她成为自由记者后加入了全国记者联盟。

e.en: The {NUJ} represents thousands of media workers across Britain.
e.zh: 全国记者联盟代表着英国数千名媒体从业者。

nuke.t:
n. 核武器
v. 用核弹攻击；微波加热

e.en: Just {nuke} the leftovers in the microwave for dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭就把剩菜放微波炉里热一下吧。

e.en: No country should ever use a {nuke} in war.
e.zh: 任何国家都不应在战争中使用核武器。

null.t:
adj. 空的；无效的
n. 零；空值

e.en: The function returns {null} when no user is found.
e.zh: 找不到用户时,该函数会返回 null。

e.en: Always check for {null} before accessing object properties.
e.zh: 访问对象属性前一定要先判空。

e.en: The treaty's {nullification} sparked protests across the country.
e.zh: 该条约的废除在全国引发了抗议。

e.en: They demanded the {nullification} of the rigged election results.
e.zh: 他们要求宣布舞弊的选举结果无效。

e.en: A single typo can {nullify} the entire legal contract.
e.zh: 一个错字就可能让整份合同失效。

e.en: The judge moved to {nullify} the unfair verdict.
e.zh: 法官采取行动撤销了那项不公的判决。

e.en: The court granted a decree of {nullity} for the marriage.
e.zh: 法院判决这桩婚姻无效。

e.en: He argued the document was a legal {nullity} from the start.
e.zh: 他主张这份文件从一开始就在法律上无效。

e.en: Set {num} equal to the length of the array.
e.zh: 把 num 设为数组的长度。

e.en: The variable {num} stores how many users logged in.
e.zh: 变量 num 用于记录有多少用户登录了。

numb.t:
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
v. 使麻木

e.en: My fingers went {numb} after hours in the snow.
e.zh: 在雪地里待了几个小时后,我的手指都麻了。

e.en: She felt {numb} after hearing the terrible news.
e.zh: 听到那个噩耗后,她整个人都麻木了。

e.en: The dentist {numbed} my gum before pulling the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医在拔牙前先把我的牙龈麻醉了。

e.en: Years of bad news had {numbed} him to tragedy.
e.zh: 多年的坏消息让他对悲剧已经麻木了。

number.t:
n. 数字；号码
v. 编号；计数

e.en: Please enter your phone {number} to receive the code.
e.zh: 请输入你的手机号码以接收验证码。

e.en: A growing {number} of students prefer studying online.
e.zh: 越来越多的学生更喜欢在线学习。

e.en: Each seat is {numbered} so you can find yours easily.
e.zh: 每个座位都有编号,方便你找到自己的位置。

e.en: His days as champion are clearly {numbered} now.
e.zh: 他作为冠军的日子显然不多了。

e.en: The page {numbering} restarts at the beginning of each chapter.
e.zh: 每章开头页码都会重新编号。

e.en: A crowd {numbering} ten thousand gathered in the square.
e.zh: 约一万人聚集在了广场上。

e.en: {Numberless} stars filled the dark desert sky above us.
e.zh: 无数星星布满了我们头顶幽暗的沙漠夜空。

e.en: She has faced {numberless} setbacks but never gave up.
e.zh: 她历经无数挫折,却从未放弃。

numbers.t: n. 数字（number 复数）；数据

e.en: The sales {numbers} this quarter exceeded everyone's expectations.
e.zh: 本季度的销售数据超出了所有人的预期。

e.en: Kids learn their {numbers} before starting elementary school.
e.zh: 孩子们在上小学前就学会数数了。

numbing.t:
adj. 令人麻木的
v. 使麻木（numb 的现在分词）

e.en: The dentist applied a {numbing} gel before the injection.
e.zh: 牙医在打针前涂了一层麻醉凝胶。

e.en: Working twelve-hour shifts has a {numbing} effect on creativity.
e.zh: 每天工作十二小时会让创造力变得麻木。

e.en: She stared {numbly} at the wreckage of her car.
e.zh: 她麻木地盯着那辆撞毁的车。

e.en: He nodded {numbly} as the doctor delivered the diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生宣告诊断结果时,他木然地点了点头。

e.en: A strange {numbness} spread down his left arm suddenly.
e.zh: 一种奇怪的麻木感突然蔓延到他的左臂。

e.en: After the loss, she felt only emotional {numbness}.
e.zh: 失去亲人后,她只感到情感上的麻木。

numbs.t: v. 使麻木（numb 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This cream {numbs} the skin before a tattoo session.
e.zh: 这种药膏可以在纹身前麻醉皮肤。

e.en: Constant scrolling slowly {numbs} your attention span.
e.zh: 不停地刷手机会慢慢麻痹你的专注力。

e.en: Don't be a {numbskull} and lock your keys inside.
e.zh: 别犯傻把钥匙锁在车里啊。

e.en: Some {numbskull} parked across two spaces again.
e.zh: 又有哪个糊涂蛋把车横跨两个车位停了。

numeracy.t: n. 计算能力；识数能力

e.en: Schools should focus on literacy and {numeracy} from an early age.
e.zh: 学校应从小就重视读写和数学能力的培养。

e.en: Basic {numeracy} skills are essential in nearly every job.
e.zh: 基本的计算能力几乎在每份工作中都不可或缺。

numeral.t:
n. 数字；数码
adj. 数字的

e.en: The clock face uses Roman {numerals} instead of digits.
e.zh: 这个表盘用的是罗马数字而不是阿拉伯数字。

e.en: Write the {numeral} seven on the top of your paper.
e.zh: 在纸的顶部写上数字 7。

numerate.t:
adj. 有计算能力的
v. 数；计算

e.en: Employers want staff who are both literate and {numerate}.
e.zh: 雇主希望员工既识字又能算数。

e.en: You need to be {numerate} to work in finance.
e.zh: 在金融行业工作需要有较强的数学能力。

e.en: The book explains the {numeration} system used by Mayans.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了玛雅人使用的计数系统。

e.en: Different cultures developed their own methods of {numeration}.
e.zh: 不同的文化发展出了各自的计数方法。

e.en: In the fraction three-fifths, three is the {numerator}.
e.zh: 在五分之三这个分数中,3 是分子。

e.en: To add fractions, first compare the {numerator} and denominator.
e.zh: 要加分数,先比较分子和分母。

e.en: This field only accepts {numeric} input, not letters.
e.zh: 此字段只接受数字输入,不能输入字母。

e.en: Sort the list in ascending {numeric} order before submitting.
e.zh: 提交前请按数字升序排列这个列表。

numerical.t: adj. 数值的；用数字表示的

e.en: Please arrange the files in {numerical} order by ID.
e.zh: 请按 ID 的数字顺序整理这些文件。

e.en: The report includes a detailed {numerical} analysis of sales.
e.zh: 报告中包含了对销售情况的详细数字分析。

e.en: Sort the entries {numerically} rather than alphabetically.
e.zh: 请按数字顺序而非字母顺序排序这些条目。

e.en: Their team is {numerically} stronger but less experienced.
e.zh: 他们队人数上更占优势,但经验不足。

numerology.t: n. 数字命理学；数秘术

e.en: She uses {numerology} to choose lucky dates for weddings.
e.zh: 她用数字命理学来挑选婚礼的吉日。

e.en: Many find {numerology} fascinating but scientifically unproven.
e.zh: 很多人觉得数字命理学很有趣,但缺乏科学依据。

e.en: He has visited Japan on {numerous} business trips.
e.zh: 他已多次出差去过日本。

e.en: There are {numerous} reasons to switch to renewable energy.
e.zh: 改用可再生能源的理由有很多。

e.en: The cathedral had a quiet, {numinous} atmosphere at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,这座大教堂笼罩着一种静谧而神圣的氛围。

e.en: She described the forest as a {numinous} place.
e.zh: 她形容那片森林是个充满神性的地方。

e.en: The museum displays a rare {numismatic} collection from ancient Rome.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一批稀有的古罗马钱币藏品。

e.en: He attends {numismatic} fairs to trade rare coins.
e.zh: 他参加钱币收藏展会来交换珍稀硬币。

numismatist.t: n. 钱币收藏家；钱币学家

e.en: As a {numismatist}, he owns coins from over fifty countries.
e.zh: 作为一名钱币收藏家,他拥有来自五十多个国家的硬币。

e.en: The {numismatist} authenticated the rare silver dollar instantly.
e.zh: 那位钱币学家立刻鉴定了这枚稀有的银元。

e.en: A {nun} in a black habit greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 一位身穿黑袍的修女在门口迎接我们。

e.en: She left her career to become a Catholic {nun}.
e.zh: 她放弃了事业,成为一名天主教修女。

e.en: The choir sang the {Nunc} Dimittis at the evening service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在晚祷时唱了《西面颂》。

e.en: Latin phrases like {nunc} pro tunc still appear in legal texts.
e.zh: 像 nunc pro tunc 这样的拉丁短语至今仍出现在法律文件中。

e.en: The {nunciature} in Paris hosted a quiet diplomatic dinner.
e.zh: 驻巴黎的教廷大使馆举办了一场低调的外交晚宴。

e.en: Documents were delivered directly to the apostolic {nunciature}.
e.zh: 文件被直接送到了教廷大使馆。

e.en: The papal {nuncio} met with the foreign minister yesterday.
e.zh: 教廷大使昨天会见了外交部长。

e.en: A new {nuncio} was appointed to represent the Vatican.
e.zh: 梵蒂冈任命了一位新的教廷大使。

e.en: She grew up in {Nuneaton}, a town in Warwickshire, England.
e.zh: 她在英格兰沃里克郡的纽尼顿镇长大。

e.en: The train from London to {Nuneaton} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到纽尼顿的火车大约需要一个小时。

e.en: The old {nunnery} on the hill is now a museum.
e.zh: 山上那座古老的修女院如今已改建为博物馆。

e.en: She entered a {nunnery} after losing her fiancé.
e.zh: 未婚夫去世后,她进了修女院。

nupe.t: n. 努佩族（尼日利亚民族）

e.en: The {Nupe} people live mainly in central Nigeria.
e.zh: 努佩人主要居住在尼日利亚中部。

e.en: He studied {Nupe} traditions for his anthropology thesis.
e.zh: 他为人类学论文研究了努佩族的传统文化。

e.en: They exchanged {nuptial} vows on a quiet beach.
e.zh: 他们在一片安静的海滩上交换了结婚誓言。

e.en: The {nuptial} ceremony lasted nearly three hours.
e.zh: 婚礼仪式持续了将近三个小时。

e.en: The royal {nuptials} were televised across the world.
e.zh: 这场王室婚礼向全世界进行了电视直播。

e.en: Friends flew in from abroad to attend the {nuptials}.
e.zh: 朋友们从国外飞来参加这场婚礼。

nur.t: (罕用) n. 努尔（人名/地名）

e.en: The Arabic word {nur} means light or radiance.
e.zh: 阿拉伯语单词 nur 意为光明或光辉。

e.en: Many girls in the region are named {Nur}.
e.zh: 该地区许多女孩取名为 Nur。

e.en: The {Nuremberg} trials shaped modern international law.
e.zh: 纽伦堡审判塑造了现代国际法。

e.en: We visited a charming Christmas market in {Nuremberg}.
e.zh: 我们参观了纽伦堡一个迷人的圣诞市场。

nurse.t:
n. 护士
v. 护理；照料

e.en: The {nurse} checked my blood pressure before the exam.
e.zh: 护士在检查前给我量了血压。

e.en: She had to {nurse} her sick father back to health.
e.zh: 她不得不照料生病的父亲恢复健康。

nursed.t: v. 护理；照料（nurse 的过去式）

e.en: He {nursed} a cup of coffee for an hour.
e.zh: 他端着一杯咖啡慢慢喝了一个小时。

e.en: She {nursed} the injured bird until it could fly.
e.zh: 她照料那只受伤的小鸟直到它能飞。

nursemaid.t: n. 保姆；带孩子的女佣

e.en: The wealthy family hired a {nursemaid} for the twins.
e.zh: 那个富裕家庭为双胞胎雇了一名保姆。

e.en: I'm not your {nursemaid} — clean up your own mess.
e.zh: 我不是你的保姆,自己的烂摊子自己收拾。

nurseries.t: n. 托儿所；苗圃（nursery 复数）

e.en: Local {nurseries} sell tomato seedlings every spring.
e.zh: 当地的苗圃每年春天都出售番茄幼苗。

e.en: Many {nurseries} closed during the pandemic lockdowns.
e.zh: 许多托儿所在疫情封锁期间关闭了。

nursery.t:
n. 托儿所；育儿室
n. 苗圃

e.en: We painted the {nursery} pale yellow before the baby arrived.
e.zh: 宝宝出生前我们把婴儿房刷成了浅黄色。

e.en: I bought three rose bushes at the garden {nursery}.
e.zh: 我在园艺苗圃买了三株玫瑰。

e.en: The {nurseryman} recommended drought-resistant shrubs for our yard.
e.zh: 那位苗圃工人为我们的院子推荐了耐旱灌木。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {nurseryman} for forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父做了四十年的苗圃园艺师。

nurses.t:
n. 护士（复数）
v. 护理

e.en: The hospital is hiring more {nurses} this quarter.
e.zh: 医院本季度正在招聘更多护士。

e.en: She {nurses} her newborn every two hours.
e.zh: 她每两小时给新生儿喂一次奶。

nursing.t:
n. 护理；看护工作
adj. 哺乳的

e.en: She's studying {nursing} at the local community college.
e.zh: 她在当地的社区学院学习护理专业。

e.en: My grandmother lives in a {nursing} home now.
e.zh: 我祖母现在住在养老院。

e.en: The journal collected several {nursings} of orphaned wildlife.
e.zh: 该期刊收录了几例孤儿野生动物的喂养案例。

e.en: Her early {nursings} of the lambs saved the flock.
e.zh: 她早期对羔羊的哺育拯救了整个羊群。

e.en: Children need consistent {nurturance} to develop emotional security.
e.zh: 孩子需要持续的关爱才能发展出情感安全感。

e.en: The therapy emphasizes self-{nurturance} and compassion.
e.zh: 该疗法强调自我关怀和慈悲。

e.en: She has a warm, {nurturant} style as a teacher.
e.zh: 作为老师,她有一种温暖、关怀的风格。

e.en: Studies show {nurturant} parenting reduces childhood anxiety.
e.zh: 研究表明关爱型教养能减少儿童焦虑。

nurture.t:
v. 培养；养育
n. 养育；教养

e.en: Good mentors {nurture} talent rather than control it.
e.zh: 好的导师培养人才,而不是控制人才。

e.en: The debate over nature versus {nurture} continues today.
e.zh: 关于先天与后天的争论至今仍在继续。

e.en: She's a natural {nurturer} who looks after everyone.
e.zh: 她天生就是个照顾别人的人。

e.en: Every team needs a {nurturer} to support new members.
e.zh: 每个团队都需要一个能扶持新人的人。

nurturing.t:
v. 培养；养育
adj. 关爱的

e.en: The school provides a {nurturing} environment for young learners.
e.zh: 这所学校为年幼的学习者提供了培育性的环境。

e.en: He spent years {nurturing} his small business into a brand.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间把自己的小生意培育成品牌。

nut.t:
n. 坚果；螺母
n. 疯子（俚语）

e.en: I'm allergic to every kind of {nut} except almonds.
e.zh: 除了杏仁,我对所有坚果都过敏。

e.en: You need a wrench to tighten that {nut}.
e.zh: 你需要扳手来拧紧那个螺母。

e.en: Don't listen to him — he's a complete {nutcase}.
e.zh: 别听他的,他完全是个疯子。

e.en: Only a {nutcase} would swim in this freezing lake.
e.zh: 只有疯子才会在这冰冷的湖里游泳。

e.en: Pass me the {nutcracker} so I can open these walnuts.
e.zh: 把胡桃夹子递给我,让我把这些核桃打开。

e.en: We watched The {Nutcracker} ballet on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 我们在圣诞夜观看了《胡桃夹子》芭蕾舞剧。

e.en: A small {nuthatch} climbed headfirst down the tree trunk.
e.zh: 一只小䴓头朝下沿着树干往下爬。

e.en: The {nuthatch} is a frequent visitor to our backyard feeder.
e.zh: 䴓鸟是我们后院喂食器的常客。

e.en: This office becomes a {nuthouse} every Monday morning.
e.zh: 这间办公室每周一早上都乱成一团。

e.en: With four toddlers, the place is a complete {nuthouse}.
e.zh: 家里有四个小孩,简直就是个疯人院。

e.en: Sprinkle a little {nutmeg} on top of the latte.
e.zh: 在拿铁上撒一点肉豆蔻粉。

e.en: The striker scored after a clever {nutmeg} on the defender.
e.zh: 前锋巧妙穿裆过掉防守球员后破门得分。

nutraceutical.t: n. 营养保健品（具药用价值的食品）

e.en: The {nutraceutical} industry has grown rapidly in recent years.
e.zh: 营养保健品行业近年来发展迅速。

e.en: Turmeric is marketed as a popular {nutraceutical} supplement.
e.zh: 姜黄被作为一种流行的营养保健品来销售。

nutria.t: n. 海狸鼠；海狸鼠毛皮

e.en: Invasive {nutria} are damaging wetlands across the southern states.
e.zh: 入侵的海狸鼠正在破坏南部各州的湿地。

e.en: A large {nutria} swam slowly across the muddy bayou.
e.zh: 一只大海狸鼠慢慢游过浑浊的河湾。

nutrient.t:
n. 营养素，养分
adj. 有营养的

e.en: Spinach is rich in iron and other essential {nutrient} compounds.
e.zh: 菠菜富含铁和其他必需的营养成分。

e.en: This {nutrient}-dense smoothie keeps me full all morning.
e.zh: 这杯营养丰富的奶昔让我整个上午都不饿。

e.en: Leafy greens provide a wide range of essential {nutrients}.
e.zh: 绿叶蔬菜提供多种必需的营养素。

e.en: Plants absorb {nutrients} from the soil through their roots.
e.zh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收养分。

e.en: The thin broth offered little {nutriment} to the patients.
e.zh: 这清汤几乎不能给病人提供什么营养。

e.en: Reading provides {nutriment} for a curious mind.
e.zh: 阅读为好奇的心灵提供养分。

e.en: Good {nutrition} is the foundation of long-term health.
e.zh: 良好的营养是长期健康的基础。

e.en: Check the {nutrition} label before buying packaged snacks.
