e.zh: 买包装零食前先看一下营养标签。

nutritional.t: adj. 营养的，有关营养的

e.en: The app tracks the {nutritional} value of every meal.
e.zh: 这款应用会追踪每餐的营养价值。

e.en: Many breakfast cereals lack real {nutritional} content.
e.zh: 许多早餐麦片其实没什么营养价值。

e.en: This frozen meal is surprisingly {nutritionally} balanced.
e.zh: 这份速冻餐在营养上出乎意料地均衡。

e.en: White bread is {nutritionally} inferior to whole grain.
e.zh: 白面包在营养上不如全麦面包。

e.en: My {nutritionist} suggested cutting back on processed foods.
e.zh: 我的营养师建议我少吃加工食品。

e.en: She works as a {nutritionist} at a children's hospital.
e.zh: 她在一家儿童医院担任营养师。

e.en: Oatmeal with berries makes a {nutritious} breakfast.
e.zh: 燕麦粥加浆果是一顿营养丰富的早餐。

e.en: Kids need {nutritious} meals to support their growth.
e.zh: 孩子需要营养丰富的餐食来支持他们的成长。

e.en: You can eat {nutritiously} on a tight budget.
e.zh: 即使预算紧张也能吃得有营养。

e.en: The chef cooks {nutritiously} without sacrificing flavor.
e.zh: 这位厨师做菜既有营养又不失美味。

nutritive.t: adj. 有营养的；有关营养的

e.en: Whole grains have higher {nutritive} value than refined ones.
e.zh: 全谷物的营养价值比精制谷物更高。

e.en: The soil lacks the {nutritive} elements plants need.
e.zh: 这片土壤缺乏植物所需的营养元素。

nuts.t:
n. 坚果（复数）
adj. 疯狂的，着迷的

e.en: I snack on mixed {nuts} during long meetings.
e.zh: 开长会时我会吃点混合坚果当零食。

e.en: You'd be {nuts} to quit such a great job.
e.zh: 放弃这么好的工作你就是疯了。

nutshell.t: n. 坚果壳；（in a ~）简言之

e.en: In a {nutshell}, the project is over budget.
e.zh: 简而言之,这个项目超预算了。

e.en: He cracked the {nutshell} open with his teeth.
e.zh: 他用牙齿把坚果壳咬开了。

e.en: Sweep up the {nutshells} scattered around the bird feeder.
e.zh: 把散落在鸟食器周围的果壳扫干净。

e.en: Empty walnut {nutshells} can be used as garden mulch.
e.zh: 空核桃壳可以用作花园的覆盖物。

nutter.t: n. 疯子，怪人（英式俚语）

e.en: Some {nutter} was shouting on the train this morning.
e.zh: 今早有个疯子在火车上大喊大叫。

e.en: Only a {nutter} would camp outside in this storm.
e.zh: 只有疯子才会在这种暴风雨里露营。

nuttier.t: adj. nutty 的比较级；更古怪的

e.en: This pesto tastes {nuttier} when you toast the pine nuts.
e.zh: 把松子烤一下,这青酱的坚果味会更浓。

e.en: His theories get {nuttier} every time we talk.
e.zh: 我们每次聊天,他的理论都变得更离谱。

e.en: Roasting brings out the {nuttiness} of the brown butter.
e.zh: 加热能引出焦化黄油的坚果香味。

e.en: There's a charming {nuttiness} to her sense of humor.
e.zh: 她的幽默感里有种讨人喜欢的古怪劲儿。

e.en: We went {nutting} in the woods every October as kids.
e.zh: 小时候我们每年十月都去林子里采坚果。

e.en: Squirrels were busy {nutting} before the first snowfall.
e.zh: 松鼠们在初雪前忙着采集坚果。

nutty.t:
adj. 疯癫的，古怪的
adj. 有坚果味的

e.en: The brown butter gives the cookies a {nutty} flavor.
e.zh: 焦化黄油让饼干带着坚果的香味。

e.en: That's a {nutty} idea, but it just might work.
e.zh: 这是个疯狂的主意,但说不定真能行。

e.en: The puppy loves to {nuzzle} into my neck.
e.zh: 小狗喜欢把头蹭到我脖子里。

e.en: Horses {nuzzle} each other as a sign of affection.
e.zh: 马儿用鼻子互相轻蹭以表达亲昵。

nvocc.t: abbr. 无船承运人（货运术语）

e.en: The {NVOCC} arranged ocean freight without owning any ships.
e.zh: 这家无船承运人安排海运,但本身不拥有船舶。

e.en: Many small exporters rely on an {NVOCC} for shipping.
e.zh: 许多小出口商依赖无船承运人来安排运输。

nvq.t: abbr. 英国国家职业资格证书

e.en: She earned an {NVQ} in childcare last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天获得了一个儿童保育的国家职业资格证书。

e.en: Many UK employers value an {NVQ} over a degree.
e.zh: 许多英国雇主更看重国家职业资格证而非学位。

nyasaland.t: n. 尼亚萨兰（今马拉维旧称）

e.en: {Nyasaland} became independent Malawi in 1964.
e.zh: 尼亚萨兰于1964年独立成为马拉维。

e.en: My grandfather served as a teacher in colonial {Nyasaland}.
e.zh: 我祖父曾在殖民时期的尼亚萨兰当老师。

e.en: This jacket is made of lightweight, water-resistant {nylon}.
e.zh: 这件夹克由轻便防水的尼龙制成。

e.en: She tore her {nylon} stockings on a chair.
e.zh: 她的尼龙丝袜被椅子刮破了。

nymph.t:
n. 仙女，宁芙
n. 若虫（昆虫幼体）

e.en: In Greek myth, a forest {nymph} guarded the spring.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,一位森林女神守护着泉水。

e.en: The dragonfly {nymph} lives underwater for years.
e.zh: 蜻蜓的若虫在水下生活多年。

e.en: The pond was covered with white {Nymphaea} blossoms.
e.zh: 池塘上覆盖着白色的睡莲花。

e.en: Monet painted countless studies of {Nymphaea} in his garden.
e.zh: 莫奈在他的花园里画了无数张睡莲的习作。

e.en: Nabokov's novel introduced the controversial term {nymphet}.
e.zh: 纳博科夫的小说引入了那个有争议的词 nymphet。

e.en: Critics objected to the film's portrayal of a {nymphet}.
e.zh: 评论家反对这部电影对早熟少女形象的刻画。

e.en: The novel's protagonist is unfairly labeled a {nymphomaniac} by gossipers.
e.zh: 小说的主角被八卦者不公平地贴上花痴的标签。

e.en: Old psychiatry texts used {nymphomaniac} as a clinical diagnosis for women.
e.zh: 早期精神病学教科书把女性色情狂当作临床诊断。

e.en: The company plans to list on the {NYSE} next quarter.
e.zh: 该公司计划下个季度在纽约证券交易所上市。

e.en: Trading on the {NYSE} closed sharply lower on Friday.
e.zh: 纽约证券交易所周五收盘大幅下跌。

e.en: The {Nyssa} tree turns brilliant red in early autumn.
e.zh: 紫树在初秋时会变成鲜艳的红色。

e.en: Botanists classify {Nyssa} species among the tupelo family.
e.zh: 植物学家把紫树属归入蓝果树科。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her involuntary eye movements as {nystagmus}.
e.zh: 医生把她不自主的眼球运动诊断为眼球震颤。

e.en: Children born with {nystagmus} may need vision therapy early on.
e.zh: 先天性眼球震颤的儿童可能需要尽早接受视力治疗。

narrowest.t:
n. 狭窄部分, 隘路
a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的
vi. 变窄
vt. 使变狭窄

nastier.t: a. 污秽的, 下流的, 险恶的

nastiest.t: a. 污秽的, 下流的, 险恶的

nattier.t: a. 整洁的, 帅的, 清楚的, 敏捷的

naughtiest.t: a. 顽皮的, 没规矩的, 不适当的, 下流的

naughtier.t: a. 顽皮的, 没规矩的, 不适当的, 下流的

neatest.t: a. 整洁的, 巧妙的, 匀称的, 简洁的\nn. 牛

nebulae.t: n. 星云, 角膜云翳\n[医] 薄翳; 角膜翳, 角膜云翳; 喷雾剂

neediest.t: a. 贫穷的, 贫困的, 生活艰苦的

newsmen.t: n. 报童, 送报人, 新闻记者

nicest.t: a. 美好的, 和蔼的, 正派的, 做得好的, 精密的, 细微的, 挑剔的, 谨慎的

niftiest.t: a. 俏皮的, 时髦的\nn. 俏皮话, 漂亮话

noisier.t: a. 嘈杂的, 喧闹的\n[机] 噪声的, 嘈杂的

noisiest.t: a. 嘈杂的, 喧闹的\n[机] 噪声的, 嘈杂的

nullified.t: vt. 使无效, 废弃, 取消\n[化] 使等于零; 作废

e.en: The miner leaned on his {nabbie} after the shift.
e.zh: 轮班结束后，矿工倚着他的煤矿铁锹。

e.en: An old {nabbie} hung beside the coal shed.
e.zh: 一把旧煤矿铁锹挂在煤棚旁边。

e.en: The old {nabe} showed cartoons every Saturday.
e.zh: 那家老邻里电影院每周六放动画片。

e.en: She still visits her childhood {nabe} on holidays.
e.zh: 她假期仍会回到童年住过的街坊。

e.en: The professor wrote a {nabla} before the vector field.
e.zh: 教授在向量场前写了一个倒三角算子。

e.en: A {nabla} symbol appears often in vector calculus.
e.zh: 倒三角符号常出现在向量微积分中。

e.en: Farmers planted {nablab} along the dry hillside.
e.zh: 农民在干燥的山坡上种了扁豆。

e.en: The stew included tender {nablab} and spices.
e.zh: 这锅炖菜里有软嫩的印度豆和香料。

e.en: The satire mocked the city's new {nabobery}.
e.zh: 这篇讽刺作品嘲笑城里的新富豪作风。

e.en: He despised the {nabobery} around colonial trade.
e.zh: 他鄙视殖民贸易周围的权贵阶层。

e.en: The novel presents her as a proud {nabobess}.
e.zh: 小说把她写成一位骄傲的女富豪。

e.en: A retired {nabobess} funded the village school.
e.zh: 一位退休女大亨资助了村里的学校。

e.en: Critics saw {nabobism} in his lavish parties.
e.zh: 批评者从他的奢华宴会中看出暴富作风。

e.en: The essay attacks {nabobism} in colonial politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击殖民政治中的权贵作风。

e.en: His sudden {nabobship} changed his manners.
e.zh: 他突然拥有的富豪地位改变了他的举止。

e.en: The play treats {nabobship} as a comic burden.
e.zh: 这部戏把大亨身份写成一种滑稽负担。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {nabumetone} for joint pain.
e.zh: 医生开了萘丁美酮来缓解关节痛。

e.en: Take {nabumetone} with food to reduce stomach upset.
e.zh: 服用萘丁美酮时配食物，可减少胃部不适。

e.en: She chose a {nacarat} ribbon for the dress.
e.zh: 她为这条裙子选了一条橙红色丝带。

e.en: The sunset turned the clouds {nacarat} and gold.
e.zh: 夕阳把云染成橙红和金色。

e.en: Her graduation gave the family great {nachas}.
e.zh: 她毕业让全家感到极大的欣慰和骄傲。

e.en: He spoke with {nachas} about his grandson's kindness.
e.zh: 他说起孙子的善良时满是欣慰。

e.en: Their son's award brought them real {nachus}.
e.zh: 儿子获奖给他们带来了真正的欣慰。

e.en: She got {nachus} from seeing her students succeed.
e.zh: 看到学生成功，她感到由衷的欣慰。

e.en: The chemist tested a {nacid} solution first.
e.zh: 化学师先检测了一种不酸的溶液。

e.en: The fruit tasted oddly {nacid} for a lemon.
e.zh: 作为柠檬，这种水果尝起来异常不酸。

e.en: He learned the {nacks} of repairing old clocks.
e.zh: 他学会了修理旧钟表的小诀窍。

e.en: These kitchen {nacks} save time on busy nights.
e.zh: 这些厨房小技巧能在忙碌的晚上节省时间。

e.en: The shell's {nacre} shone with pale colors.
e.zh: 贝壳的珍珠母闪着淡淡的色彩。

e.en: Buttons made from {nacre} were once common.
e.zh: 用珍珠母制成的纽扣曾经很常见。

e.en: A square is a two-dimensional {n-cube}.
e.zh: 正方形是二维的 n 维立方体。

e.en: The algorithm visits each corner of the {n-cube}.
e.zh: 该算法会访问这个 n 维立方体的每个顶点。

e.en: The workstation supported an {n-display} setup for simulation work.
e.zh: 这台工作站支持用于仿真工作的多路显示配置。

e.en: An {n-display} system can divide one image across many screens.
e.zh: 多路显示系统可以把一幅图像分到多块屏幕上。

n-gram.t: n元语法；连续n个词的序列

e.en: The search engine counts each {n-gram} in the document.
e.zh: 搜索引擎会统计文档中的每个 n 元语法序列。

e.en: A three-word {n-gram} is often called a trigram.
e.zh: 由三个词组成的 n 元语法通常称为三元语法。

n-signal.t: n信号；数学或工程中的第n个信号

e.en: The receiver stores each {n-signal} for later analysis.
e.zh: 接收器会保存每个 n 信号以便之后分析。

e.en: In the diagram, the {n-signal} enters the filter first.
e.zh: 在图中，n 信号先进入滤波器。

e.en: The formula gives the {n-th} term of the sequence.
e.zh: 这个公式给出了数列的第 n 项。

e.en: For the {n-th} time, she reminded him to check the lock.
e.zh: 她第不知道多少次提醒他检查门锁。

n-tuple.t: n元组；含n个元素的有序组

e.en: The database stores each record as an {n-tuple}.
e.zh: 数据库把每条记录存为一个 n 元组。

e.en: In mathematics, an {n-tuple} preserves the order of its entries.
e.zh: 在数学中，n 元组会保留各元素的顺序。

n-type.t: n型的；电子为主要载流子的

e.en: The diode uses an {n-type} semiconductor layer.
e.zh: 这个二极管使用一层 n 型半导体。

e.en: Adding donor atoms makes the silicon {n-type}.
e.zh: 加入施主原子会使硅变成 n 型材料。

nacred.t: 珍珠母似的；带虹彩的薄层状

e.en: The shell had a {nacred} shine in the sun.
e.zh: 贝壳在阳光下泛着珍珠母般的光泽。

e.en: A {nacred} layer lined the inside of the old oyster.
e.zh: 那只老牡蛎的内侧覆着一层带虹彩的薄层。

nacrite.t: 珍珠陶土；一种高岭石矿物

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {nacrite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为珍珠陶土。

e.en: Thin plates of {nacrite} formed in the clay deposit.
e.zh: 黏土矿床中形成了薄片状的珍珠陶土。

nacrous.t: 珍珠质的；有珍珠光泽的

e.en: The button had a {nacrous} surface.
e.zh: 这枚纽扣表面有珍珠般的光泽。

e.en: She admired the {nacrous} lining of the shell.
e.zh: 她欣赏着贝壳内侧那层珍珠质内层。

e.en: The craftsman polished the {nacrum} until it gleamed.
e.zh: 工匠把珍珠质层打磨到闪闪发亮。

e.en: A thin film of {nacrum} covered the inside of the shell.
e.zh: 贝壳内侧覆盖着一层薄薄的珍珠质。

nadis.t: 瑜伽中的气脉；能量通道

e.en: Some yoga texts describe the {nadis} as channels of energy.
e.zh: 一些瑜伽典籍把气脉描述为能量通道。

e.en: The teacher said breathing practice could clear the {nadis}.
e.zh: 老师说呼吸练习可以疏通这些气脉。

naegite.t: 钠铁硅酸盐矿物；钠闪石类矿物

e.en: The dark crystal was later classified as {naegite}.
e.zh: 这块深色晶体后来被归类为钠铁硅酸盐矿物。

e.en: Rare grains of {naegite} appeared in the rock section.
e.zh: 岩石切片中出现了少量罕见的钠铁硅酸盐颗粒。

naematolomoid.t: 似纳马托洛玛菌的；蘑菇类术语

e.en: The mycologist noted a {naematolomoid} form in the specimen.
e.zh: 真菌学家注意到这个标本呈现出类似纳马托洛玛菌的形态。

e.en: Several {naematolomoid} mushrooms grew on the fallen log.
e.zh: 几株类似纳马托洛玛菌的蘑菇长在倒木上。

e.en: A small {naeve} marked her left shoulder.
e.zh: 她左肩上有一小块胎记。

e.en: The doctor checked whether the {naeve} had changed color.
e.zh: 医生检查那颗痣是否变了颜色。

e.en: The dermatologist examined several dark {naevi} on his back.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生检查了他背上的几颗深色痣。

e.en: Most {naevi} are harmless, but some should be monitored.
e.zh: 多数痣是无害的，但有些需要持续观察。

e.en: The rash included a {naevoid} patch near the eye.
e.zh: 皮疹中有一块靠近眼睛、像痣一样的斑。

e.en: A {naevoid} lesion was photographed for the medical record.
e.zh: 一处胎记样病灶被拍照存入病历。

e.en: The surgeon removed a suspicious {naevus}.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了一个可疑的痣。

e.en: A pale {naevus} was visible on the baby's arm.
e.zh: 婴儿手臂上能看到一块浅色胎记。

e.en: The infection was treated with {nafcillin}.
e.zh: 这种感染用萘夫西林进行了治疗。

e.en: Her doctor changed the prescription to {nafcillin} after the test.
e.zh: 化验后，她的医生把处方改成了萘夫西林。

naftha.t: 石脑油；挥发性石油溶剂

e.en: The old manual warned that {naftha} was highly flammable.
e.zh: 旧手册警告说石脑油极易燃。

e.en: Workers used {naftha} to clean grease from the metal parts.
e.zh: 工人用石脑油清洗金属零件上的油脂。

e.en: The temple carving showed a coiled {naga}.
e.zh: 寺庙雕刻中有一条盘绕的那伽蛇神。

e.en: In the story, a {naga} guarded the hidden treasure.
e.zh: 在这个故事里，一位那伽守护着隐藏的宝藏。

e.en: The herd suffered badly from {nagana}.
e.zh: 这群牲畜严重感染了纳加纳病。

e.en: Tsetse flies can spread {nagana} among cattle.
e.zh: 采采蝇会在牛群中传播纳加纳病。

e.en: The curator identified the yellow crust as {nagatelite}.
e.zh: 馆员把那层黄色结壳鉴定为钠镁铀矿。

e.en: Few collectors have ever seen {nagatelite} in person.
e.zh: 很少有收藏者亲眼见过钠镁铀矿。

e.en: His {nagativistic} tone made every proposal sound hopeless.
e.zh: 他那种否定论的语气让每个提案听起来都毫无希望。

e.en: The essay takes a strangely {nagativistic} view of progress.
e.zh: 这篇文章对进步持有一种奇怪的消极看法。

e.en: The old road was cut through hard {nagelfluh}.
e.zh: 那条旧路开凿在坚硬的钉头砾岩中。

e.en: Geologists mapped bands of {nagelfluh} above the valley.
e.zh: 地质学家绘出了山谷上方的砾岩带。

e.en: The slag sample contained tiny crystals of {nagelschmidtite}.
e.zh: 炉渣样品中含有细小的纳格尔施密特石晶体。

e.en: Researchers reported {nagelschmidtite} in the kiln deposit.
e.zh: 研究人员在窑炉沉积物中报告发现了纳格尔施密特石。

e.en: Please don't {nagg} me about the dishes again.
e.zh: 请别再为洗碗的事不停唠叨我了。

e.en: He began to {nagg} at every small mistake.
e.zh: 他开始对每个小错误都挑剔个不停。

e.en: Her {naggish} remarks spoiled the relaxed dinner.
e.zh: 她那些爱挑剔的话破坏了轻松的晚餐气氛。

e.en: He sounded less helpful than {naggish}.
e.zh: 他听起来不像是在帮忙，倒更像是在唠叨。

e.en: A tall {nagi} shaded the temple gate.
e.zh: 一棵高大的竹柏遮住了寺门。

e.en: The garden guide pointed out the ancient {nagi}.
e.zh: 园林导览员指给我们看那棵古老的竹柏。

e.en: The cow settled down to {nagor} after feeding.
e.zh: 那头牛吃完后安静下来开始嚼回草。

e.en: Farmers watched the goats {nagor} in the shade.
e.zh: 农民看着山羊在阴凉处反刍。

e.en: The puzzle page was full of tricky {nagrams}.
e.zh: 谜题页上满是棘手的字母重组词。

e.en: She solved the {nagrams} before breakfast.
e.zh: 她早饭前就解出了那些字母重组题。

e.en: The {nagsman} led the tired horse into the yard.
e.zh: 马夫把疲惫的马牵进院子。

e.en: An old {nagsman} knew every horse at the fair.
e.zh: 一位老赶马人认识集市上的每一匹马。

nagual.t: 纳瓦尔守护灵；变形巫师

e.en: The story says his {nagual} appeared as a jaguar.
e.zh: 故事说他的纳瓦尔守护灵化作一只美洲豹出现。

e.en: Villagers feared the {nagual} who walked at night.
e.zh: 村民害怕那个夜里出没的变形巫师。

e.en: The biologist found a small {naia} in the streambed.
e.zh: 生物学家在溪床里发现了一只小水蚌。

e.en: Ancient {naia} shells were buried in the mud.
e.zh: 古老的水蚌贝壳埋在泥中。

e.en: A {naiad} rises from the pool in the painting.
e.zh: 画中一位水泽仙女从池中升起。

e.en: The dragonfly {naiad} clung to a submerged stem.
e.zh: 蜻蜓的水生若虫附在一根没入水中的茎上。

e.en: The deed described a {naibourne} strip of pasture.
e.zh: 契约描述了一条邻近边界的牧地。

e.en: They argued over the {naibourne} ditch between farms.
e.zh: 他们为两座农场之间那条邻界水沟争执。

e.en: He spoke {naice}, unaware of the politics involved.
e.zh: 他说得很天真，没有意识到其中牵涉的政治问题。

e.en: The plan was {naice} optimistic about human nature.
e.zh: 这个计划对人性抱有幼稚的乐观。

e.en: His {naif} questions embarrassed the experts.
e.zh: 他那些天真的问题让专家们感到尴尬。

e.en: The gallery showed paintings by a French {naif}.
e.zh: 画廊展出了一位法国素朴派艺术家的作品。

e.en: The {naik} ordered the squad to hold position.
e.zh: 那名印度军士命令小队守住阵地。

e.en: A village {naik} settled disputes after harvest.
e.zh: 一位地方首领在收成后调解村里的纠纷。

nail-biter.t: 紧张刺激的事；咬指甲的人

e.en: The final game was a real {nail-biter}.
e.zh: 最后一场比赛真是紧张到让人屏息。

e.en: As a child, she was a nervous {nail-biter}.
e.zh: 她小时候紧张时总爱咬指甲。

e.en: It was a {nail-biting} finish to the election.
e.zh: 这场选举的结局令人紧张不已。

e.en: His {nail-biting} got worse during exams.
e.zh: 考试期间，他咬指甲的习惯变得更严重了。

e.en: I packed {nail-clippers} in my travel bag.
e.zh: 我把指甲刀放进了旅行包。

e.en: She used the {nail-clippers} after her shower.
e.zh: 她洗完澡后用了指甲钳。

e.en: The chair had {nail-headed} trim along the arms.
e.zh: 那把椅子的扶手边有钉头装饰。

e.en: A {nail-headed} rivet held the old strap together.
e.zh: 一个钉头状铆钉把旧皮带固定在一起。

e.en: She chose red {nail-polish} for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对选了红色指甲油。

e.en: The {nail-polish} chipped after one day.
e.zh: 那层指甲油一天后就剥落了。

e.en: The board is {nailable} if you use short screws first.
e.zh: 如果先用短螺丝固定，这块板就能钉住。

e.en: The witness made the suspect {nailable} in court.
e.zh: 证人的证词让嫌疑人在法庭上难以脱罪。

e.en: He scrubbed his hands with a {nailbrush}.
e.zh: 他用指甲刷仔细刷洗双手。

e.en: Keep a {nailbrush} beside the sink.
e.zh: 在水槽旁放一把洗甲刷。

e.en: Several old {naileries} once stood near the river.
e.zh: 河边过去曾有几家老制钉厂。

e.en: The town's {naileries} employed whole families.
e.zh: 镇上的制钉作坊曾雇用许多整户人家。

e.en: The abandoned {nailery} became a small museum.
e.zh: 废弃的制钉厂后来成了一座小博物馆。

e.en: His grandfather worked in a {nailery}.
e.zh: 他的祖父曾在制钉作坊里工作。

e.en: She smoothed the edge with a {nailfile}.
e.zh: 她用指甲锉把边缘磨平。

e.en: A metal {nailfile} was in her bag.
e.zh: 她包里有一把金属修甲锉。

e.en: A tiny {nailhole} marked the wall.
e.zh: 墙上有一个小小的钉孔。

e.en: He filled each {nailhole} before painting.
e.zh: 粉刷前他把每个钉孔都补好了。

e.en: The {nailhouse} stood alone in the construction site.
e.zh: 那栋钉子户房屋孤零零地立在工地里。

e.en: Reporters photographed the famous {nailhouse}.
e.zh: 记者拍下了那座有名的拒迁房。

e.en: The carpenter built a {nailless} wooden frame.
e.zh: 木匠做了一个不用钉子的木框。

e.en: Her {nailless} fingers made the injury obvious.
e.zh: 她没有指甲的手指让伤势一眼可见。

e.en: The tool had a {naillike} metal tip.
e.zh: 这个工具有一个像钉子的金属尖端。

e.en: A {naillike} shell covered each toe.
e.zh: 每个脚趾上都覆盖着似指甲的硬壳。

e.en: The {nailsick} horse could barely walk.
e.zh: 那匹蹄部有病的马几乎走不动。

e.en: Farmers separated the {nailsick} cattle from the herd.
e.zh: 农民把患蹄病的牛从牛群中隔离出来。

e.en: The old plank felt {naily} underfoot.
e.zh: 那块旧木板踩上去满是钉子。

e.en: The sculpture had a sharp, {naily} texture.
e.zh: 这座雕塑有一种尖锐、像钉子的质感。

e.en: The baby wore a gown of white {nainsook}.
e.zh: 婴儿穿着一件白色细软棉布长袍。

e.en: She bought {nainsook} for summer underwear.
e.zh: 她买了南苏克布来做夏季内衣。

e.en: The book describes the {naissance} of modern science.
e.zh: 这本书描述了现代科学的诞生。

e.en: We watched the {naissance} of a new political movement.
e.zh: 我们见证了一个新政治运动的形成初期。

e.en: The {naissant} industry attracted bold investors.
e.zh: 这个初生的行业吸引了大胆的投资者。

e.en: Her {naissant} confidence was easy to see.
e.zh: 她正在形成的自信很容易看出来。

e.en: The storm seemed to {nake} the hillside overnight.
e.zh: 暴风雨仿佛一夜之间把山坡剥得光秃秃。

e.en: The old poem says winter will {nake} the trees.
e.zh: 那首古诗说冬天会让树木裸露。

e.en: The artist tried to {nakedize} the human form.
e.zh: 艺术家试图把人体表现得更为裸露。

e.en: The harsh light seemed to {nakedize} every flaw.
e.zh: 刺眼的光线似乎把每个缺陷都暴露出来。

e.en: The artist {nakedized} the mythic figure in a modern sketch.
e.zh: 那位艺术家在一幅现代素描中把神话人物画成裸体。

e.en: The edited poster {nakedized} the original costume design.
e.zh: 修改后的海报把原来的服装设计处理成裸体效果。

e.en: A {naker} sounded before the procession entered the hall.
e.zh: 队伍进入大厅前，一面中世纪小鼓响了起来。

e.en: The museum displayed a small {naker} beside the trumpets.
e.zh: 博物馆把一只小定音鼓陈列在号角旁边。

e.en: The lab identified the stone as a {nakhlite} from Mars.
e.zh: 实验室确认这块石头是一块来自火星的辉石质陨石。

e.en: A rare {nakhlite} can reveal clues about volcanic activity on Mars.
e.zh: 一块罕见的辉石质火星陨石能揭示火星火山活动的线索。

e.en: The city sprayed {naled} to control mosquitoes after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，市政府喷洒二溴磷来控制蚊虫。

e.en: Farm workers were warned not to enter fields treated with {naled}.
e.zh: 农场工人被警告不要进入用二溴磷处理过的田地。

e.en: Doctors once used {nalorphine} to counter severe opioid effects.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用纳洛芬来抵消严重的阿片类药物作用。

e.en: The textbook describes {nalorphine} as an early opioid antagonist.
e.zh: 这本教材把纳洛芬描述为一种早期的阿片拮抗药。

e.en: Every file in the archive must be {namable} and easy to find.
e.zh: 档案里的每个文件都必须能命名并且容易找到。

e.en: The fear was real but not easily {namable}.
e.zh: 那种恐惧是真实的，却不容易说出名字。

e.en: She greeted the teacher with a respectful {namaskar}.
e.zh: 她以恭敬的合十礼向老师问候。

e.en: The ceremony opened with a quiet {namaskar} to the guests.
e.zh: 仪式以向来宾安静行合十礼开始。

namaste.t: 合十礼问候；印度问候语

e.en: The yoga teacher ended the class by saying {namaste}.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师以说“合十礼问候”结束了课程。

e.en: He bowed slightly in {namaste} before entering the temple.
e.zh: 进寺庙前，他略微鞠躬行了合十礼。

e.en: The angler released the large {namaycush} back into the cold lake.
e.zh: 钓鱼者把那条大湖红点鲑放回了寒冷的湖中。

e.en: A {namaycush} often lives in deep northern waters.
e.zh: 湖红点鲑常生活在北方的深水湖域。

e.en: Many shops closed briefly during Friday {namaz}.
e.zh: 星期五礼拜期间，许多商店短暂关门。

e.en: He performed {namaz} before leaving for work.
e.zh: 他上班前做了伊斯兰礼拜。

e.en: The editor rejected the {namby-pamby} ending as too sentimental.
e.zh: 编辑认为那个软弱矫情的结尾太伤感，便拒绝了。

e.en: Stop being {namby-pamby} and make a clear decision.
e.zh: 别再优柔软弱了，做个明确决定。

e.en: The receptionist placed a {name-board} outside the meeting room.
e.zh: 接待员在会议室外放了一块姓名牌。

e.en: A painted {name-board} hung above the old shop door.
e.zh: 一块彩绘招牌板挂在老店门上方。

e.en: She bought {name-brand} shoes during the sale.
e.zh: 她在打折时买了一双名牌鞋。

e.en: The store keeps {name-brand} cereal on the top shelf.
e.zh: 这家店把知名品牌麦片放在最上层货架。

e.en: The teacher asked the {name-caller} to apologize after class.
e.zh: 老师要求那个骂人的学生课后道歉。

e.en: Online, a loud {name-caller} can ruin a serious discussion.
e.zh: 在网上，一个爱骂人的人会毁掉严肃讨论。

e.en: The debate quickly turned into childish {name-calling}.
e.zh: 那场辩论很快变成了幼稚的互相辱骂。

e.en: The school has strict rules against {name-calling}.
e.zh: 学校有严格规定禁止恶意叫外号。

e.en: Security did a quick {name-check} at the door.
e.zh: 保安在门口快速核对了姓名。

e.en: The singer gave a {name-check} to her first producer.
e.zh: 那位歌手特别提到了她的第一位制作人。

name-child.t: 同名孩子；以某人命名的孩子

e.en: Their youngest son is the {name-child} of his grandfather.
e.zh: 他们的小儿子是以祖父命名的孩子。

e.en: The author called the heroine her literary {name-child}.
e.zh: 那位作者把女主角称作自己在文学上的同名孩子。

e.en: In Greece, her {name-day} is celebrated more than her birthday.
e.zh: 在希腊，她的圣名纪念日比生日更受重视。

e.en: He received flowers on his {name-day}.
e.zh: 他在自己的命名日收到了鲜花。

e.en: He likes to {name-drop} famous actors at parties.
e.zh: 他喜欢在聚会上提起名演员来炫耀关系。

e.en: Do not {name-drop} unless the connection is truly relevant.
e.zh: 除非关系确实相关，否则不要借提名人来显摆。

e.en: Everyone knew him as a shameless {name-dropper}.
e.zh: 大家都知道他是个厚着脸皮攀名人关系的人。

e.en: A skilled {name-dropper} can make casual meetings sound important.
e.zh: 高明的爱提名人者能把普通会面说得很重要。

e.en: The old tale called the tiny creature a {nane}.
e.zh: 这个古老故事把那个小生物称作侏儒。

e.en: He used {nane} as an archaic word for a dwarf.
e.zh: 他把 nane 当作表示矮人的古词来用。

e.en: Police found empty {nangs} in the car park.
e.zh: 警方在停车场发现了空的一氧化二氮小钢瓶。

e.en: Some shops stopped selling {nangs} to teenagers.
e.zh: 一些商店停止向青少年出售这种笑气小钢瓶。

nani.t: 什么；表示惊讶的日语词

e.en: The anime character shouted {nani} in surprise.
e.zh: 那个动漫角色惊讶地喊了一声“什么”。

e.en: Online fans often use {nani} as a joking reaction.
e.zh: 网上粉丝常用“nani”来开玩笑地表示震惊。

e.en: The doctor discussed {nanism} in the medical lecture.
e.zh: 医生在医学讲座中讨论了侏儒症。

e.en: Botanists sometimes use {nanism} to describe stunted growth.
e.zh: 植物学家有时用 nanism 描述发育受限的矮小生长。

e.en: He wore a jacket made of {nankeen}.
e.zh: 他穿着一件用本色棉布做的夹克。

e.en: The curtains had a soft {nankeen} shade.
e.zh: 窗帘带着柔和的浅黄褐色。

e.en: My {nanna} makes soup every Sunday.
e.zh: 我奶奶每个星期天都会煲汤。

e.en: The children stayed with their {nanna} overnight.
e.zh: 孩子们晚上住在外婆家。

e.en: The family hired a {nannie} for the twins.
e.zh: 这家人为双胞胎请了一位保姆。

e.en: In old novels, a {nannie} often raised the children.
e.zh: 在旧小说里，奶妈常常负责把孩子带大。

e.en: The sediment sample contained a rare {nannofossil}.
e.zh: 这份沉积物样本中含有一种罕见的超微化石。

e.en: Geologists dated the rock by studying its {nannofossils}.
e.zh: 地质学家通过研究岩石中的超微化石来测定年代。

e.en: The microscope revealed abundant {nannoplankton} in the water.
e.zh: 显微镜显示水中有大量超微浮游生物。

e.en: Climate studies often examine ancient {nannoplankton}.
e.zh: 气候研究常常考察古代的超微浮游生物。

e.en: Wind erosion created delicate {nannorelief} on the surface.
e.zh: 风蚀在表面形成了细致的微地貌起伏。

e.en: The survey mapped {nannorelief} across the dry lake bed.
e.zh: 这次测量绘制了干湖床上的细小地形起伏。

e.en: The {nanny-goat} stood beside her kid.
e.zh: 那只母山羊站在小羊旁边。

e.en: They bought a {nanny-goat} for milk.
e.zh: 他们买了一只母山羊来产奶。

e.en: Birds fed on the dark {nannyberry} fruit.
e.zh: 鸟儿啄食那些深色的荚蒾果。

e.en: We planted {nannyberry} along the wet edge of the field.
e.zh: 我们在田边潮湿处种了荚蒾灌木。

e.en: The lab uses {nano-technology} to improve batteries.
e.zh: 实验室利用纳米技术来改进电池。

e.en: Investors are watching {nano-technology} in medicine closely.
e.zh: 投资者正密切关注医学领域的纳米技术。

e.en: The sensor draws only one {nanoamp} of current.
e.zh: 这个传感器只消耗一纳安的电流。

e.en: Engineers measured leakage in {nanoamps}.
e.zh: 工程师用纳安为单位测量漏电流。

e.en: A {nanoampere} is a very small electric current.
e.zh: 一纳安培是非常小的电流单位。

e.en: The meter can detect changes below a {nanoampere}.
e.zh: 这台仪表能检测低于一纳安培的变化。

e.en: The article described a {nanoatom} model for the cluster.
e.zh: 文章用纳米尺度原子模型描述这个团簇。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the {nanoatom} behaved like a metal.
e.zh: 研究人员讨论这个纳米原子结构是否表现得像金属。

e.en: The coating is a strong {nanocomposite}.
e.zh: 这种涂层是一种强度很高的纳米复合材料。

e.en: A polymer {nanocomposite} can resist heat better.
e.zh: 聚合物纳米复合材料能更好地耐热。

e.en: The team produced a {nanocrystalline} metal film.
e.zh: 团队制备了一层纳米晶体金属薄膜。

e.en: {Nanocrystalline} materials often have unusual strength.
e.zh: 纳米晶体材料常常具有不同寻常的强度。

e.en: The sample measured three {nanocuries} of activity.
e.zh: 这个样本测得三纳居里的放射性活度。

e.en: Safety limits were stated in {nanocuries} per liter.
e.zh: 安全限值以每升多少纳居里来表示。

e.en: The circuit needs a ten-{nanofarad} capacitor.
e.zh: 这个电路需要一个十纳法拉的电容器。

e.en: Capacitance was listed in {nanofarads} on the diagram.
e.zh: 图纸上的电容值以纳法拉标注。

e.en: The mask uses a layer of {nanofiber}.
e.zh: 这个口罩使用了一层纳米纤维。

e.en: Scientists spun {nanofibers} for wound dressings.
e.zh: 科学家纺制纳米纤维用于伤口敷料。

nanofossil.t: 纳米级微化石；超微化石

e.en: The sediment sample contained a tiny {nanofossil} from ancient algae.
e.zh: 这份沉积物样本中含有一枚来自古代藻类的纳米级微化石。

e.en: Researchers used the {nanofossil} record to date the chalk layer.
e.zh: 研究人员利用超微化石记录来测定这层白垩的年代。

nanohenry.t: 纳亨利；十亿分之一亨利

e.en: The coil has an inductance of one {nanohenry}.
e.zh: 这个线圈的电感为一纳亨利。

e.en: At high frequencies, even a few {nanohenries} can affect the circuit.
e.zh: 在高频下，即使几纳亨利也会影响电路。

e.en: The lab described the particles as {nanoid} crystals.
e.zh: 实验室把这些颗粒描述为纳米状晶体。

e.en: A {nanoid} structure formed on the metal surface.
e.zh: 金属表面形成了一种极小的纳米状结构。

e.en: The calf was born with {nanomelia}, a rare limb disorder.
e.zh: 这头小牛出生时患有肢体异常短小症，这是一种罕见的肢体疾病。

e.en: Genetic testing helped confirm {nanomelia} in the affected flock.
e.zh: 基因检测帮助确认了这群受影响羊只中的肢体异常短小症。

e.en: A human hair is thousands of {nanometres} wide.
e.zh: 一根人的头发宽度有数千纳米。

e.en: The chip uses features smaller than ten {nanometres}.
e.zh: 这款芯片采用小于十纳米的结构。

e.en: The paper proposed a {nanon} as a tiny unit of matter.
e.zh: 论文提出纳农可作为一种极微小的物质单位。

e.en: Physicists debated whether the {nanon} model was useful.
e.zh: 物理学家讨论这种纳农模型是否有用。

e.en: The net was too coarse to catch most {nanoplankton}.
e.zh: 这张网太粗，捕不到大多数微型浮游生物。

e.en: Marine scientists measured {nanoplankton} growth after the storm.
e.zh: 海洋科学家测量了风暴过后微型浮游生物的增长情况。

e.en: The coating works because of its {nanoscale} texture.
e.zh: 这种涂层之所以有效，是因为它具有纳米尺度的纹理。

e.en: Scientists observed {nanoscale} changes inside the cell.
e.zh: 科学家观察到了细胞内部极微小的变化。

e.en: The new {nanoscope} revealed structures inside living cells.
e.zh: 新的纳米显微镜显示了活细胞内部的结构。

e.en: They built a {nanoscope} to study single protein molecules.
e.zh: 他们制造了一台纳米显微镜来研究单个蛋白质分子。

nanotesla.t: 纳特斯拉；微弱磁感应单位

e.en: The sensor detected changes of just one {nanotesla}.
e.zh: 传感器探测到了仅一纳特斯拉的变化。

e.en: Earth's magnetic field varies by several {nanoteslas} during storms.
e.zh: 地球磁场在磁暴期间会变化数纳特斯拉。

e.en: The amplifier can measure a single {nanovolt}.
e.zh: 这台放大器能够测量一纳伏的电压。

e.en: Thermal noise may hide signals of a few {nanovolts}.
e.zh: 热噪声可能掩盖只有几纳伏的信号。

e.en: The technician connected a {nanovoltmeter} to the sample.
e.zh: 技术员把纳伏表连接到样品上。

e.en: A calibrated {nanovoltmeter} is essential for this experiment.
e.zh: 经过校准的纳伏表对这个实验至关重要。

nanozooid.t: 微小个员；小型群体动物个体

e.en: Each {nanozooid} in the colony had a specialized role.
e.zh: 群体中的每个微小个员都有专门的作用。

e.en: The biologist sketched the {nanozooid} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下描绘了这个微小个员。

e.en: The chemist isolated {nantenine} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出了南天竹碱。

e.en: Studies suggest {nantenine} may affect certain brain receptors.
e.zh: 研究表明南天竹碱可能会影响某些脑部受体。

e.en: The green crust contained {nantokite} and other copper minerals.
e.zh: 这层绿色外壳含有氯铜矿和其他铜矿物。

e.en: Conservators identified {nantokite} on the ancient bronze coin.
e.zh: 文物修复人员在古代铜币上鉴定出了氯铜矿。

e.en: The temple's {naoi} were rebuilt after the excavation.
e.zh: 发掘之后，这座神庙的内殿得到了重建。

e.en: Ancient visitors left offerings inside the {naos}.
e.zh: 古代访客会把供品留在神庙内殿里。

e.en: The gloves were made from soft {nappa} leather.
e.zh: 这副手套是用柔软的纳帕皮制成的。

e.en: She chose a black {nappa} jacket.
e.zh: 她选了一件黑色纳帕皮夹克。

e.en: The geologist mapped a large {nappe} in the mountains.
e.zh: 地质学家在山中绘制出一大片推覆体。

e.en: A white {nappe} covered the banquet table.
e.zh: 一块白色桌布盖在宴会桌上。

e.en: The {nappied} baby slept through the noise.
e.zh: 那个穿着尿布的婴儿在嘈杂声中睡着了。

e.en: A {nappied} toddler wandered across the room.
e.zh: 一个穿着尿布的幼儿在房间里走来走去。

e.en: This blanket feels {nappier} after washing.
e.zh: 这条毯子洗过后摸起来绒毛更多了。

e.en: His hair looked {nappier} in the humidity.
e.zh: 潮湿天气里他的头发显得更卷曲。

e.en: The fabric's {nappiness} made it feel warm.
e.zh: 这种织物的绒毛感让它摸起来很暖。

e.en: She embraced the natural {nappiness} of her hair.
e.zh: 她欣然接受自己头发天然的卷曲质感。

e.en: A {naprapath} treated his chronic back pain.
e.zh: 一名脊柱按摩治疗师为他治疗慢性背痛。

e.en: She visited a licensed {naprapath} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后她去看了一位有执照的脊柱按摩治疗师。

e.en: He tried {naprapathy} for his stiff neck.
e.zh: 他尝试用脊柱按摩疗法治疗僵硬的脖子。

e.en: {Naprapathy} focuses on muscles and connective tissue.
e.zh: 脊柱按摩疗法关注肌肉和结缔组织。

e.en: The eye drops contained {napthazoline} for redness.
e.zh: 这种眼药水含有用于缓解红眼的萘甲唑啉。

e.en: Ask a pharmacist before using {napthazoline} regularly.
e.zh: 经常使用萘甲唑啉前应先咨询药剂师。

e.en: The chemist identified a {napthoxy} group in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家在该化合物中识别出一个萘氧基。

e.en: A {napthoxy} derivative was tested in the lab.
e.zh: 一种萘氧基衍生物在实验室中接受了测试。

e.en: Researchers isolated {narbomycin} from a bacterial culture.
e.zh: 研究人员从细菌培养物中分离出了那波霉素。

e.en: The paper discussed {narbomycin} as an antibiotic compound.
e.zh: 论文把那波霉素作为一种抗生素化合物来讨论。

e.en: The old pharmacology text mentioned {narceine}.
e.zh: 那本旧药理学教材提到了那可因。

e.en: Scientists analyzed {narceine} in the opium sample.
e.zh: 科学家分析了鸦片样本中的那可因。

e.en: The extract contained a trace of {narcissine}.
e.zh: 这种提取物中含有微量水仙碱。

e.en: Her pose had a strangely {narcissine} quality.
e.zh: 她的姿态有一种奇异的水仙般气质。

e.en: He spoke {narcissistically} about his own brilliance.
e.zh: 他自恋地谈论着自己的聪明才智。

e.en: The article {narcissistically} centered every issue on the author.
e.zh: 这篇文章自我陶醉地把每个问题都归到作者身上。

e.en: The critic called the hero a {narcist}.
e.zh: 评论家称这位主人公是个自恋者。

e.en: A {narcist} may crave constant admiration.
e.zh: 自恋者可能渴望持续不断的赞美。

e.en: The hotel stored clean {naperies} in a locked cupboard.
e.zh: 酒店把干净的餐桌布草用品存放在上锁的柜子里。

e.en: Old inventories often listed silverware and {naperies} together.
e.zh: 旧清单常把银器和餐桌布草用品列在一起。

e.en: The restaurant replaced its {napery} before dinner service.
e.zh: 餐厅在晚餐营业前更换了餐桌布草。

e.en: Fine {napery} was once a sign of a well-kept household.
e.zh: 精致的餐桌布草曾是家庭打理得体的标志。

e.en: The eye drops contain {naphazoline} to reduce redness.
e.zh: 这种眼药水含有萘甲唑啉，用来减轻眼睛发红。

e.en: Patients should not overuse sprays with {naphazoline}.
e.zh: 患者不应过度使用含萘甲唑啉的喷剂。

e.en: The lab synthesized {naphthacene} for an organic semiconductor study.
e.zh: 实验室合成了并四苯，用于有机半导体研究。

e.en: Pure {naphthacene} is sensitive to light and oxygen.
e.zh: 纯并四苯对光和氧都比较敏感。

e.en: The chemist described the compound as a {naphthal} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物描述为萘基衍生物。

e.en: A faint {naphthal} odor came from the old sample bottle.
e.zh: 旧样品瓶里散出一股淡淡的萘味。

e.en: The clinic used {naphthalan} in a traditional skin treatment.
e.zh: 诊所把纳夫塔兰石油膏用于一种传统皮肤治疗。

e.en: Tourists bought {naphthalan} ointment near the spa town.
e.zh: 游客在温泉小镇附近购买纳夫塔兰软膏。

e.en: The reaction used {naphthalane} as a solvent.
e.zh: 这个反应用十氢萘作溶剂。

e.en: Old chemistry texts sometimes call decalin {naphthalane}.
e.zh: 旧化学书有时把十氢萘称作 naphthalane。

e.en: The sample showed a {naphthalenic} smell after heating.
e.zh: 样品加热后显出一种萘类气味。

e.en: Researchers measured the {naphthalenic} compounds in the fuel.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了燃料中的萘类化合物。

e.en: Sodium {naphthalenide} is often used as a strong reducing agent.
e.zh: 萘阴离子钠常被用作强还原剂。

e.en: The green color indicated formation of {naphthalenide}.
e.zh: 绿色表明生成了萘阴离子盐。

e.en: The dye was made from {naphthalic} anhydride.
e.zh: 这种染料由萘二甲酸酐制成。

e.en: Engineers tested a polymer based on {naphthalic} acid.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种基于萘二甲酸的聚合物。

e.en: The molecule contains a {naphthalimido} group that fluoresces strongly.
e.zh: 该分子含有会强烈发荧光的萘酰亚胺基。

e.en: They designed a {naphthalimido} probe for metal ions.
e.zh: 他们设计了一种用于金属离子的萘酰亚胺基探针。

e.en: The trunk smelled of {naphthalin} and old wool.
e.zh: 箱子里有萘和旧羊毛的气味。

e.en: Some older labels spell naphthalene as {naphthalin}.
e.zh: 一些旧标签把 naphthalene 拼作 naphthalin。

e.en: The process can {naphthalize} the material under high heat.
e.zh: 该工艺可在高温下使材料萘化。

e.en: Technicians tried to {naphthalize} the gas mixture before testing.
e.zh: 技术人员在测试前尝试向气体混合物中加入萘。

e.en: The team prepared a new {naphthamide} for screening.
e.zh: 团队制备了一种新的萘甲酰胺用于筛选。

e.en: This {naphthamide} derivative binds well to the target protein.
e.zh: 这种萘甲酰胺衍生物能很好地结合目标蛋白。

e.en: The manual listed {naphthane} among possible hydrocarbon solvents.
e.zh: 手册把萘烷列为可能使用的烃类溶剂之一。

e.en: Impure {naphthane} gave inconsistent boiling-point readings.
e.zh: 不纯的萘烷导致沸点读数不一致。

e.en: The chemist isolated {naphthanilide} from the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 化学家从反应混合物中分离出萘甲酰苯胺。

e.en: A substituted {naphthanilide} showed better stability in solution.
e.zh: 一种取代萘甲酰苯胺在溶液中表现出更好的稳定性。

e.en: The refinery used a {naphthaometer} to check the liquid's density.
e.zh: 炼油厂用石脑油比重计检查液体密度。

e.en: An antique {naphthaometer} hung in the laboratory display case.
e.zh: 一只古旧的石脑油比重计挂在实验室陈列柜里。

e.en: The toxicology paper discussed {naphthathiourea} exposure in rats.
e.zh: 毒理学论文讨论了大鼠接触萘基硫脲的情况。

e.en: Researchers handled {naphthathiourea} only inside the fume hood.
e.zh: 研究人员只在通风橱内操作萘基硫脲。

e.en: The artist studied {naphthazarine} as a historical pigment.
e.zh: 这位艺术家研究萘茜这种历史颜料。

e.en: Chemists used {naphthazarine} to make related quinone dyes.
e.zh: 化学家用萘茜制备相关的醌类染料。

e.en: The spectrum confirmed the presence of {naphthazulenone}.
e.zh: 光谱确认了萘并薁酮的存在。

e.en: They proposed {naphthazulenone} as an intermediate in the synthesis.
e.zh: 他们提出萘并薁酮是合成中的一种中间体。

e.en: Cobalt {naphthenate} speeds up drying in some paints.
e.zh: 环烷酸钴能加快某些油漆的干燥。

e.en: The spill contained metal {naphthenate} residues from the plant.
e.zh: 泄漏物中含有工厂产生的金属环烷酸盐残留。

e.en: The crude oil contains a high proportion of {naphthene}.
e.zh: 这种原油含有较高比例的环烷烃。

e.en: A {naphthene} ring can affect the fuel's combustion behavior.
e.zh: 环烷烃环会影响燃料的燃烧特性。

e.en: The refinery tested the {naphthenic} base oil for stability.
e.zh: 炼油厂检测了这种环烷基基础油的稳定性。

e.en: {Naphthenic} acids can corrode equipment in crude oil processing.
e.zh: 环烷酸会在原油加工中腐蚀设备。

e.en: The sample contained aromatics, paraffins, and {naphthenics}.
e.zh: 样品中含有芳烃、石蜡烃和环烷烃类化合物。

e.en: Engineers measured the {naphthenics} before blending the fuel.
e.zh: 工程师在调配燃料前测定了环烷烃含量。

e.en: The molecule includes a {naphthenyl} side group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个环烷基侧基。

e.en: Chemists compared several {naphthenyl} derivatives in the study.
e.zh: 化学家在研究中比较了几种环烷基衍生物。

e.en: The dye intermediate formed a stable {naphthionate} salt.
e.zh: 这种染料中间体形成了稳定的萘磺酸盐。

e.en: Researchers purified the {naphthionate} before the next reaction.
e.zh: 研究人员在下一步反应前纯化了萘磺酸盐。

e.en: The drug was prepared as a {naphthoate} ester.
e.zh: 这种药物被制成萘甲酸酯形式。

e.en: A white {naphthoate} precipitate appeared in the flask.
e.zh: 烧瓶中出现了白色的萘甲酸盐沉淀。

e.en: The lab used {naphthoflavone} to study enzyme induction.
e.zh: 实验室用萘黄酮研究酶诱导作用。

e.en: Beta-{naphthoflavone} affected the cells within hours.
e.zh: β-萘黄酮在数小时内影响了这些细胞。

e.en: The solution turned red after {naphthol} was added.
e.zh: 加入萘酚后，溶液变成了红色。

e.en: Some azo dyes are made from {naphthol} compounds.
e.zh: 一些偶氮染料由萘酚类化合物制成。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {naphthoquinaldine} in a sealed tube.
e.zh: 化学家在密封管中合成了萘并喹哪啶。

e.en: Old papers describe {naphthoquinaldine} as a fluorescent compound.
e.zh: 早期论文把萘并喹哪啶描述为一种荧光化合物。

e.en: The spectrum matched a substituted {naphthoquinoline}.
e.zh: 光谱与一种取代萘并喹啉相吻合。

e.en: Several {naphthoquinoline} derivatives showed biological activity.
e.zh: 几种萘并喹啉衍生物显示出生物活性。

e.en: The team prepared a new {naphthoquinoxaline} ligand.
e.zh: 团队制备了一种新的萘并喹噁啉配体。

e.en: {Naphthoquinoxaline} dyes can absorb visible light strongly.
e.zh: 萘并喹噁啉染料能强烈吸收可见光。

e.en: The pharmacist identified {naphthosalol} in the old formula.
e.zh: 药剂师在旧配方中鉴定出了萘酚水杨酸酯。

e.en: {Naphthosalol} was once discussed as an antiseptic compound.
e.zh: 萘酚水杨酸酯曾被作为防腐化合物讨论。

e.en: Heating the acid produced {naphthosultone}.
e.zh: 加热这种酸生成了萘磺内酯。

e.en: The {naphthosultone} ring opened under basic conditions.
e.zh: 萘磺内酯环在碱性条件下开环。

e.en: The paper reports a {naphthoxadithiole} synthesis route.
e.zh: 论文报道了一条萘并氧二硫杂环的合成路线。

e.en: A {naphthoxadithiole} core changed the material's conductivity.
e.zh: 萘并氧二硫杂环核心改变了材料的导电性。

e.en: The resin contains a {naphthoxazine} structure.
e.zh: 这种树脂含有萘并噁嗪结构。

e.en: Researchers tested {naphthoxazine} monomers for heat resistance.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了萘并噁嗪单体的耐热性。

e.en: The compound has a {naphthoyl} group attached to nitrogen.
e.zh: 该化合物有一个萘甲酰基连接在氮原子上。

e.en: They introduced the {naphthoyl} substituent in the final step.
e.zh: 他们在最后一步引入了萘甲酰基取代基。

e.en: The analyst used {naphthoyltrifluoroacetone} as a chelating reagent.
e.zh: 分析员使用萘甲酰三氟丙酮作为螯合试剂。

e.en: {Naphthoyltrifluoroacetone} helped separate the metal ions.
e.zh: 萘甲酰三氟丙酮有助于分离这些金属离子。

e.en: The molecule contains a {naphthyl} ring system.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个萘基环系。

e.en: A {naphthyl} substituent increased the compound's fluorescence.
e.zh: 萘基取代基增强了该化合物的荧光。

e.en: Workers avoided exposure to {naphthylamine} dust.
e.zh: 工人避免接触萘胺粉尘。

e.en: {Naphthylamine} was used in making certain dyes.
e.zh: 萘胺曾用于制造某些染料。

e.en: The polymer includes a rigid {naphthylene} unit.
e.zh: 这种聚合物含有刚性的萘撑基单元。

e.en: A {naphthylene} bridge connects the two nitrogen atoms.
e.zh: 一个萘撑桥连接着两个氮原子。

e.en: The toxicology report mentioned {naphthylthiourea}.
e.zh: 毒理报告提到了萘基硫脲。

e.en: Scientists handled {naphthylthiourea} only inside a fume hood.
e.zh: 科学家只在通风橱内处理萘基硫脲。

e.en: The drug candidate contains a {naphthyridine} scaffold.
e.zh: 这个候选药物含有萘啶骨架。

e.en: Several {naphthyridine} analogues bound tightly to the enzyme.
e.zh: 几种萘啶类似物与该酶结合得很紧。

e.en: The label used the older spelling {naphtol}.
e.zh: 标签上使用了较旧的拼法naphtol，指萘酚。

e.en: A textile recipe called for {naphtol} dye components.
e.zh: 一份纺织配方需要萘酚染料组分。

e.en: The archive spells the reagent as {naphtylamine}.
e.zh: 档案中把这种试剂拼作naphtylamine，即萘胺。

e.en: Early dye manuals listed {naphtylamine} among hazardous materials.
e.zh: 早期染料手册把萘胺列为危险材料。

e.en: By midnight the generator was {napoo}.
e.zh: 到午夜时，发电机已经坏透了。

e.en: His plan was {napoo} after the tickets sold out.
e.zh: 票卖光后，他的计划就彻底泡汤了。

e.en: Brush the {napp} gently to restore the fabric.
e.zh: 轻轻刷理绒面，让布料恢复原样。

e.en: The tailor checked the {napp} before cutting the cloth.
e.zh: 裁缝在裁布前检查了布面的绒毛方向。

narco-catharsis.t: 麻醉宣泄疗法；药物诱导宣泄

e.en: The psychiatrist described {narco-catharsis} as an obsolete technique.
e.zh: 精神科医生把麻醉宣泄疗法称为一种过时技术。

e.en: During {narco-catharsis}, buried memories were expected to surface.
e.zh: 在麻醉宣泄疗法中，人们期待被压抑的记忆浮现出来。

narcoanalysis.t: 麻醉分析；药物辅助心理分析

e.en: The hospital once used {narcoanalysis} for difficult trauma cases.
e.zh: 这家医院曾用麻醉分析处理棘手的创伤病例。

e.en: Modern courts rarely accept statements made under {narcoanalysis}.
e.zh: 现代法院很少采信在麻醉分析中作出的陈述。

narcocatharsis.t: 麻醉宣泄疗法；药物诱导宣泄

e.en: Some early therapists believed {narcocatharsis} could release hidden grief.
e.zh: 一些早期治疗师认为麻醉宣泄疗法能释放隐藏的悲痛。

e.en: The textbook treats {narcocatharsis} as a historical psychiatric practice.
e.zh: 这本教材把麻醉宣泄疗法视为精神医学史上的做法。

narcodiagnosis.t: 麻醉诊断；药物辅助诊断

e.en: The doctor mentioned {narcodiagnosis} only as a historical method.
e.zh: 医生只是把麻醉诊断当作历史方法提了一下。

e.en: In {narcodiagnosis}, medication was used to observe hidden symptoms.
e.zh: 在麻醉诊断中，药物被用来观察隐藏症状。

e.en: The cartel laundered millions in {narcodollars} through shell companies.
e.zh: 贩毒集团通过空壳公司洗白了数百万毒资。

e.en: Politicians feared that {narcodollars} were distorting the election.
e.zh: 政界人士担心毒品美元正在扭曲选举。

narcokleptocracy.t: 毒品盗贼统治；毒资腐败政权

e.en: Journalists called the regime a {narcokleptocracy} run by traffickers.
e.zh: 记者称这个政权是由毒贩操控的毒资腐败政权。

e.en: A {narcokleptocracy} steals public money while protecting drug networks.
e.zh: 毒品盗贼统治一边侵吞公款，一边庇护贩毒网络。

e.en: The nurse treated the {narcolept} with unusual patience.
e.zh: 护士以格外的耐心照顾那名嗜睡症患者。

e.en: As a {narcolept}, he avoided driving long distances alone.
e.zh: 作为嗜睡症患者，他避免独自长途驾驶。

narcolysis.t: 麻醉解除；催眠状态消解

e.en: The report used {narcolysis} to describe recovery from drug-induced stupor.
e.zh: 报告用麻醉解除来描述从药物性昏沉中恢复。

e.en: Researchers studied {narcolysis} after the experimental sedative wore off.
e.zh: 实验性镇静剂药效消退后，研究人员观察麻醉解除过程。

e.en: An overdose can push a patient into {narcoma}.
e.zh: 用药过量可能使患者陷入麻醉性昏迷。

e.en: The old case notes described prolonged {narcoma} after surgery.
e.zh: 旧病历描述了术后持续的药物昏睡。

narcomania.t: 药物成瘾狂；麻醉品狂热

e.en: Victorian doctors sometimes wrote of {narcomania} in moral terms.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生有时用道德化语言谈论药物成瘾狂。

e.en: The article traced {narcomania} to untreated pain and despair.
e.zh: 文章把药物成瘾狂追溯到未被治疗的疼痛与绝望。

narcomaniac.t: 药物成瘾者；麻醉品狂热者

e.en: The novel portrays the {narcomaniac} with surprising sympathy.
e.zh: 这部小说以出人意料的同情描写那名药物成瘾者。

e.en: Police reports labeled him a {narcomaniac}, though doctors disagreed.
e.zh: 警方报告称他为麻醉品狂热者，但医生并不同意。

e.en: The patient remained {narcomatous} for several hours after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后，患者仍处于麻醉性昏迷状态数小时。

e.en: A {narcomatous} haze dulled his reactions and speech.
e.zh: 一种昏睡般的迷蒙削弱了他的反应和说话能力。

e.en: The pharmacy kept {narcophine} in a locked cabinet.
e.zh: 药房把那可啡存放在上锁的柜子里。

e.en: Older manuals listed {narcophine} among morphine derivatives.
e.zh: 旧手册把那可啡列为吗啡衍生物之一。

e.en: The anesthetic can {narcose} small animals within minutes.
e.zh: 这种麻醉剂能在几分钟内使小动物昏睡。

e.en: Propaganda may {narcose} a public that is tired of crisis.
e.zh: 宣传可能麻痹一个厌倦危机的公众。

narcosynthesis.t: 麻醉综合疗法；药物辅助心理整合

e.en: The clinic experimented with {narcosynthesis} after the war.
e.zh: 战后，这家诊所试验过麻醉综合疗法。

e.en: In {narcosynthesis}, sedatives were paired with guided discussion.
e.zh: 在麻醉综合疗法中，镇静剂会配合引导式谈话使用。

e.en: The minister linked the bombing to {narcoterrorism}.
e.zh: 部长把这起爆炸事件与毒品恐怖主义联系起来。

e.en: Communities trapped by {narcoterrorism} often distrust the police.
e.zh: 受毒品恐怖主义困扰的社区往往不信任警方。

narcotherapy.t: 麻醉疗法；药物诱导心理治疗

e.en: The book devotes one chapter to {narcotherapy} in psychiatry.
e.zh: 这本书用一章讨论精神医学中的麻醉疗法。

e.en: Doctors abandoned {narcotherapy} as safer treatments emerged.
e.zh: 随着更安全疗法出现，医生们放弃了麻醉疗法。

e.en: The medicine acted {narcotically} and slowed her breathing.
e.zh: 这种药像麻醉剂一样起效，使她呼吸变慢。

e.en: The repetitive music worked {narcotically} on the exhausted crowd.
e.zh: 重复的音乐让疲惫的人群像被麻醉般迟钝。

narcotile.t: 有麻醉作用的；麻醉性的

e.en: The chemist tested a mildly {narcotile} compound.
e.zh: 化学家测试了一种有轻微麻醉作用的化合物。

e.en: Critics described the film's slow rhythm as almost {narcotile}.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影缓慢的节奏几乎有催眠麻醉感。

e.en: The laboratory isolated {narcotine} from the opium sample.
e.zh: 实验室从鸦片样本中分离出那可汀。

e.en: Old pharmacology texts discuss {narcotine} under opium alkaloids.
e.zh: 旧药理学教材在鸦片生物碱部分讨论那可汀。

e.en: The gas can {narcotise} a patient before surgery.
e.zh: 这种气体能在手术前使患者麻醉。

e.en: Endless entertainment may {narcotise} political anger.
e.zh: 无休止的娱乐可能麻痹政治愤怒。

e.en: The {narcotised} patient heard voices but felt no pain.
e.zh: 被麻醉的患者听见人声，却感觉不到疼痛。

e.en: A {narcotised} society may ignore obvious corruption.
e.zh: 一个麻木的社会可能无视明显的腐败。

e.en: The surgeon adjusted the {narcotising} dose carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细调整麻醉剂量。

e.en: The speech had a {narcotising} effect on the audience.
e.zh: 这场演讲对听众产生了使人麻木的效果。

e.en: The symptoms suggested acute {narcotism} after the overdose.
e.zh: 这些症状表明用药过量后出现了急性麻醉状态。

e.en: Reformers wrote about {narcotism} as a social danger.
e.zh: 改革者把麻醉品成瘾描述为一种社会危险。

e.en: The old report described him as a {narcotist}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把他称为麻醉剂成瘾者。

e.en: A {narcotist} may hide the habit for years.
e.zh: 麻醉剂使用者可能多年都隐瞒这种习惯。

e.en: The surgeon monitored the patient's {narcotization} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细监测病人的麻醉状态。

e.en: Repeated exposure can cause a kind of {narcotization}.
e.zh: 反复接触可能造成某种麻醉状态。

e.en: The drug can {narcotize} the patient within minutes.
e.zh: 这种药能在几分钟内使病人麻醉。

e.en: Endless noise seemed to {narcotize} the crowd.
e.zh: 无休止的噪声似乎让人群变得昏沉麻木。

e.en: The animal was {narcotized} before the procedure.
e.zh: 手术前那只动物已被麻醉。

e.en: After hours of television, he felt {narcotized}.
e.zh: 看了几个小时电视后，他觉得昏沉麻木。

e.en: This dose {narcotizes} the patient quickly.
e.zh: 这个剂量能很快使病人麻醉。

e.en: Routine propaganda {narcotizes} public anger.
e.zh: 例行宣传会麻木公众的愤怒。

e.en: The gas had a {narcotizing} effect on the crew.
e.zh: 这种气体对船员产生了麻醉作用。

e.en: The film's slow rhythm felt strangely {narcotizing}.
e.zh: 这部电影缓慢的节奏让人奇怪地昏沉。

narcotoline.t: 那可托林；罂粟碱类物质

e.en: The chemist isolated {narcotoline} from the sample.
e.zh: 化学家从样品中分离出了那可托林。

e.en: Old pharmacology texts mention {narcotoline} only briefly.
e.zh: 旧药理学教材只是简略提到那可托林。

e.en: Early anesthetists experimented with {narcylene}.
e.zh: 早期麻醉师曾试验使用麻醉用乙炔制剂。

e.en: The manual lists {narcylene} among obsolete anesthetic gases.
e.zh: 手册把narcylene列为已淘汰的麻醉气体之一。

e.en: The ancient perfume contained costly {nard}.
e.zh: 这种古代香水含有昂贵的甘松香。

e.en: She anointed the cloth with {nard}.
e.zh: 她用香膏涂抹那块布。

e.en: A {nardine} scent lingered in the room.
e.zh: 房间里残留着一股甘松香气。

e.en: The poet praised the oil's {nardine} sweetness.
e.zh: 诗人称赞这种油有甘松般的甜香。

e.en: Explorers once ate {nardoo} in the desert.
e.zh: 探险者曾在沙漠中食用澳洲苹蕨。

e.en: The seeds of {nardoo} must be prepared carefully.
e.zh: 澳洲苹蕨的孢子粉必须仔细处理后才能吃。

e.en: The balm was scented with {nardu}.
e.zh: 这种香膏带有甘松香味。

e.en: Ancient traders carried {nardu} across the mountains.
e.zh: 古代商人把甘松运过群山。

e.en: The doctor inspected the patient's {nares}.
e.zh: 医生检查了病人的鼻孔。

e.en: Air enters through the anterior {nares}.
e.zh: 空气从前鼻孔进入。

e.en: He smoked a {narghile} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他抽了一袋水烟。

e.en: The cafe offered tea and a brass {narghile}.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆供应茶和黄铜水烟筒。

e.en: A glass {narghileh} stood beside the low table.
e.zh: 一只玻璃水烟筒放在矮桌旁。

e.en: They shared a {narghileh} in the courtyard.
e.zh: 他们在院子里共抽一只水烟袋。

e.en: The old men passed the {nargile} around.
e.zh: 老人们轮流传着水烟袋抽。

e.en: Smoke curled from the tall {nargile}.
e.zh: 烟雾从高高的水烟筒里袅袅升起。

e.en: She ordered mint tea and a {nargileh}.
e.zh: 她点了薄荷茶和一只水烟筒。

e.en: The copper {nargileh} gleamed in the shop window.
e.zh: 铜制水烟筒在商店橱窗里闪闪发亮。

e.en: Each {nari} was checked for swelling.
e.zh: 每个鼻孔都被检查是否肿胀。

e.en: The left {nari} was partly blocked.
e.zh: 左侧鼻孔有些堵塞。

e.en: The scan showed a small {narial} obstruction.
e.zh: 扫描显示鼻孔处有一处小堵塞。

e.en: Birds vary in their {narial} structure.
e.zh: 鸟类的鼻孔结构各不相同。

e.en: Grapefruit contains the flavonoid {naringenin}.
e.zh: 葡萄柚含有黄酮类物质柚皮素。

e.en: Researchers measured {naringenin} in the extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了提取物中的柚皮素含量。

e.en: The bitterness comes partly from {naringin}.
e.zh: 这种苦味部分来自柚皮苷。

e.en: Enzymes can break down {naringin} in juice.
e.zh: 酶可以分解果汁中的柚皮苷。

e.en: Producers use {naringinase} to reduce bitterness.
e.zh: 生产商使用柚皮苷酶来降低苦味。

e.en: The lab tested {naringinase} activity at different temperatures.
e.zh: 实验室测试了不同温度下柚皮苷酶的活性。

e.en: The right {naris} was inflamed.
e.zh: 右侧鼻孔发炎了。

e.en: A probe entered the {naris} gently.
e.zh: 探针轻轻进入鼻腔开口。

narky.t: 爱发牢骚的；暴躁刻薄的

e.en: She got {narky} when the meeting ran late.
e.zh: 会议拖得太晚时，她变得有些暴躁刻薄。

e.en: His {narky} comments annoyed everyone at lunch.
e.zh: 他午饭时那些爱挖苦人的话惹恼了大家。

e.en: The cabinet was made from polished {narra}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用抛光的紫檀木做成的。

e.en: A tall {narra} shaded the old courtyard.
e.zh: 一棵高大的纳拉树遮住了老院子。

narratage.t: 叙述式剪辑；旁白蒙太奇

e.en: The film uses {narratage} to cover ten years quickly.
e.zh: 这部电影用叙述式剪辑快速带过了十年。

e.en: Her documentary opens with a quiet {narratage}.
e.zh: 她的纪录片以一段安静的旁白蒙太奇开场。

e.en: She studied {narratology} at graduate school.
e.zh: 她在研究生阶段学习叙事学。

e.en: Modern {narratology} examines how stories create meaning.
e.zh: 现代叙事学研究故事如何生成意义。

e.en: The camera has a {narrow-angle} lens for distant subjects.
e.zh: 这台相机配有适合拍远处物体的窄角镜头。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {narrow-angle} glaucoma.
e.zh: 她被诊断为闭角型青光眼。

e.en: They rented a {narrow-boat} for a canal holiday.
e.zh: 他们租了一艘英国运河窄船去度假。

e.en: The old {narrow-boat} moved slowly through the lock.
e.zh: 那艘旧窄船缓慢通过了船闸。

e.en: A {narrow-gauge} train climbs into the mountains.
e.zh: 一列窄轨火车驶向山里。

e.en: The mine once used {narrow-gauge} tracks.
e.zh: 这座矿山过去使用窄轨轨道。

narrow-minded.t: 心胸狭窄的；思想狭隘的

e.en: His {narrow-minded} attitude made discussion difficult.
e.zh: 他思想狭隘的态度让讨论很难进行。

e.en: Do not be {narrow-minded} about unfamiliar food.
e.zh: 不要对不熟悉的食物抱着狭隘成见。

narrow-mindedly.t: 心胸狭窄地；思想狭隘地

e.en: They {narrow-mindedly} rejected every new proposal.
e.zh: 他们狭隘地拒绝了每一个新提案。

e.en: He judged the artist {narrow-mindedly} by old standards.
e.zh: 他用旧标准狭隘地评判那位艺术家。

e.en: Her {narrow-mindedness} kept her from learning abroad.
e.zh: 她的思想狭隘让她不愿去国外学习。

e.en: The policy reflects cultural {narrow-mindedness}.
e.zh: 这项政策反映出文化上的狭隘。

narrowback.t: 爱尔兰移民后裔；瘦背者

e.en: He was called a {narrowback} in the old neighborhood.
e.zh: 在老街区里，他被人叫作爱尔兰移民后裔。

e.en: The tailor said the {narrowback} needed a smaller jacket.
e.zh: 裁缝说这个背窄的人需要一件更小的夹克。

e.en: The station will {narrowcast} programs for local teachers.
e.zh: 这家电台将为当地教师定向播送节目。

e.en: A {narrowcast} campaign can reach a specific audience.
e.zh: 定向传播活动可以触达特定受众。

e.en: The path is {narrowish} but easy to follow.
e.zh: 这条小路有点窄，但很好走。

e.en: He chose a {narrowish} tie for the interview.
e.zh: 他面试时选了一条略窄的领带。

narrowminded.t: 心胸狭窄的；思想狭隘的

e.en: That is a {narrowminded} way to view the problem.
e.zh: 那是看待这个问题的一种狭隘方式。

e.en: The town seemed {narrowminded} to young artists.
e.zh: 在年轻艺术家看来，这座小镇显得思想保守狭隘。

e.en: She packed a {nartjie} in her lunchbox.
e.zh: 她在午餐盒里放了一个南非小柑橘。

e.en: The market smelled of fresh {nartjies}.
e.zh: 市场里弥漫着新鲜小柑橘的香味。

e.en: A {narwal} surfaced beside the research boat.
e.zh: 一头独角鲸在研究船旁浮出水面。

e.en: The child drew a {narwal} with a long tusk.
e.zh: 那个孩子画了一头长着长牙的独角鲸。

e.en: The old book calls the animal a {narwhale}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种动物称作独角鲸。

e.en: A {narwhale} was shown on the museum poster.
e.zh: 博物馆海报上展示了一头独角鲸。

e.en: The singer held the {nasale} longer than expected.
e.zh: 歌手把那个鼻音拖得比预期更久。

e.en: In French class, we practiced a difficult {nasale}.
e.zh: 在法语课上，我们练习了一个很难的鼻音化元音。

e.en: The article traces the rise of {Nasserism} in Arab politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了纳赛尔主义在阿拉伯政治中的兴起。

e.en: His speech borrowed heavily from {Nasserism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲大量借用了纳赛尔主义的思想。

e.en: The poem was copied in elegant {nastalik} script.
e.zh: 这首诗用优雅的纳斯塔利克书体抄写。

e.en: She studies {nastalik} as part of Persian calligraphy.
e.zh: 她把纳斯塔利克书体作为波斯书法的一部分来研究。

e.en: The biologist described a {nastic} response in the leaves.
e.zh: 这位生物学家描述了叶片中的感性运动反应。

e.en: Some flowers show {nastic} movements when light changes.
e.zh: 有些花在光线变化时会表现出感性运动。

e.en: The insect has a {nasute} head with a long projection.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的头部呈鼻状突出，有一段长突起。

e.en: The old drawing showed a {nasute} figure in profile.
e.zh: 那幅旧画从侧面画出一个大鼻子的人物。

natalist.t: 鼓励生育者；鼓励生育的

e.en: The party promoted a strongly {natalist} policy.
e.zh: 该党推行了强烈鼓励生育的政策。

e.en: She criticized the minister as a strict {natalist}.
e.zh: 她批评那位部长是严格的鼓励生育论者。

e.en: The report compares {natality} rates across regions.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了各地区的出生率。

e.en: Public health officials track {natality} data every year.
e.zh: 公共卫生官员每年都会追踪出生情况数据。

e.en: The pond was covered with {natant} leaves.
e.zh: 池塘表面覆盖着漂浮的叶子。

e.en: A {natant} insect crossed the quiet water.
e.zh: 一只会游动的昆虫划过平静的水面。

e.en: The seeds drifted {natantly} along the stream.
e.zh: 种子顺着溪流漂浮着移动。

e.en: The larvae moved {natantly} near the surface.
e.zh: 幼虫在水面附近游动着前进。

e.en: The old club hired a skilled {natationist} to teach children.
e.zh: 那家老俱乐部聘请了一位熟练的游泳专家教孩子们。

e.en: As a competitive {natationist}, he trained before dawn.
e.zh: 作为一名竞技游泳者，他天亮前就开始训练。

e.en: A strong {natator} can cross the bay safely.
e.zh: 强壮的游泳者可以安全横渡海湾。

e.en: The coach praised the young {natator}'s smooth stroke.
e.zh: 教练称赞这位年轻游泳者的划水动作流畅。

e.en: Several public {natatoria} opened during the summer.
e.zh: 夏季有几家公共游泳馆开放了。

e.en: The university renovated its old {natatoria}.

e.zh: 鼻肌无力会影响细微的面部动作。

e.zh: 有些说话者会把鼻辅音前的元音鼻音化。

e.zh: 法语元音的鼻音化程度可能不同。

e.zh: 这种方言会把许多词尾元音鼻音化。

e.zh: 说话者发鼻音化音时，软腭会下降。

e.zh: 她练习正确地把这个元音鼻音化。

e.zh: 那位歌手避免把每个高音都唱得带鼻音。

e.zh: 脆爽的日本梨冷藏后吃起来更甜。

e.zh: 我们午饭点了印尼炒饭。

e.zh: 菜单上有配烤鸡的辣味米饭。

e.zh: 测量从鼻根点开始。

e.zh: 这份手稿是用纳斯赫体抄写的。

e.zh: 学生先学习纳斯赫体，再学华丽的书法体。

naskhi.t: 纳斯赫体的；阿拉伯楷书体

e.zh: 这一页采用清晰的纳斯赫体风格。

e.zh: 她的纳斯赫体字迹很容易辨认。

e.zh: 医生诊断为急性鼻咽炎。

e.zh: 临床医生用鼻镜检查气道。

e.zh: 她想要最好的座位，那当然了。

e.zh: 孩子们晚餐选了冰淇淋，自然不足为奇。

e.zh: 道路很危险，然而他们还是继续前进。

e.zh: 他知道代价，尽管如此仍接受了这项职责。

e.zh: 证据很薄弱，然而这个说法仍然站得住脚。

e.zh: 她害怕失败，尽管如此还是重新开始。

e.zh: 法国常被作为典型的民族国家来讨论。

e.zh: 全球市场可能削弱民族国家的权威。

e.zh: 现代民族国家会谨慎守卫自己的边界。

e.zh: 气候变化需要许多主权国家之间的合作。

e.zh: 几天之内，罢工变成了全国范围的抗议。

e.zh: 他们发起了遍及全国的失踪儿童搜寻行动。

e.zh: 这项法律偏向本国出生的公民，而不是移民。

e.zh: 她是土生土长的纽约人，父母则是移民。

native-like.t: 接近母语者的；像本族人的

e.en: The app aims to produce {native-like} translations.
e.zh: 这款应用旨在生成像本族人表达一样自然的译文。

e.zh: 请一位母语者检查一下措辞。

e.zh: 在西班牙十年后，她听起来像母语者一样。

e.zh: 我们为这次旅行请了一位以当地语言为母语的导游。

e.zh: 学校想招聘更多以英语为母语的教师。

e.zh: 这项北约主导的任务在数年后结束。

e.zh: 官员们讨论了这支北约主导部队的未来。

e.zh: 这种药在数小时内引起明显的钠尿。

e.zh: 医生在肾脏研究中测量了尿钠排泄增加的情况。

e.zh: 这种激素有很强的促钠排泄作用。

e.zh: 研究人员测试了一种新的利钠药物。

e.zh: 古代防腐师使用天然碱来干燥遗体。

e.zh: 湖泊沉积物中含有多层泡碱。

e.en: Older chemistry books sometimes called sodium {natrum}.

e.en: The symbol Na comes from the Latin word {natrum}.

e.zh: 水手们在港口入口附近留意雾号器的声音。

e.en: The pilot checked each {navaid} before the night flight.
e.zh: 飞行员在夜航前检查了每个导航辅助设备。

e.en: A damaged {navaid} can confuse aircraft approaching the runway.
e.zh: 受损的导航辅助设备可能误导接近跑道的飞机。

e.en: The geologist identified the dark sample as {navajoite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那块深色样本鉴定为纳瓦霍石。

e.en: Tiny crystals of {navajoite} lined the fracture.
e.zh: 裂缝里排列着细小的纳瓦霍石晶体。

e.en: The senator's speeches reflected strong {navalism}.
e.zh: 那位参议员的演讲体现出强烈的海军主义。

e.en: Industrial expansion encouraged {navalism} in several empires.
e.zh: 工业扩张助长了几个帝国的重海权思想。

e.en: A leading {navalist} argued for more battleships.
e.zh: 一位重要的海军主义者主张建造更多战列舰。

e.en: The newspaper hired a {navalist} to comment on fleet policy.
e.zh: 报社聘请一名海军主义者评论舰队政策。

e.en: The Spartan {navarch} commanded the fleet at sea.
e.zh: 那位斯巴达海军统帅在海上指挥舰队。

e.en: Ancient writers praised the {navarch} for his discipline.
e.zh: 古代作者称赞这位海军统帅治军严明。

e.en: His {navarchy} ended after the disastrous campaign.
e.zh: 那场灾难性的战役后，他的海军统帅职权结束了。

e.en: The historian compared Spartan {navarchy} with Athenian command.
e.zh: 历史学家把斯巴达的海军统帅制度与雅典指挥体系作比较。

e.en: The chef served {navarin} with spring vegetables.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配春季蔬菜的蔬菜炖羊肉。

e.en: A warm bowl of {navarin} suited the rainy evening.
e.zh: 雨夜里一碗热腾腾的蔬菜炖羊肉很合适。

e.en: The meeting became endless {navel-gazing} about the team's image.
e.zh: 会议变成了没完没了地纠结团队形象的自我沉溺。

e.en: Critics dismissed the memoir as literary {navel-gazing}.
e.zh: 批评家把这本回忆录斥为文学式的自我沉溺。

e.en: We found {navelwort} growing on the damp stone wall.
e.zh: 我们发现潮湿的石墙上长着脐草。

e.en: The guide said {navelwort} was once used in folk medicine.
e.zh: 向导说脐草过去曾用于民间草药。

e.en: Her ring held a small {navette} diamond.
e.zh: 她的戒指上镶着一颗小橄榄形钻石。

e.en: The necklace used {navette} beads between the pearls.
e.zh: 项链在珍珠之间用了梭形珠饰。

e.en: The farmer planted {navew} for winter fodder.
e.zh: 农民种下芜菁作为冬季饲料。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes mention {navew} with other roots.
e.zh: 老食谱有时会把芜菁和其他根菜一起提到。

e.en: The cargo could not sail without a {navicert}.
e.zh: 没有战时航运许可证，这批货物不能启航。

e.en: Officials inspected the {navicert} before releasing the ship.
e.zh: 官员在放行船只前检查了战时航运许可证。

e.en: The scan showed a small fracture in the {navicular} bone.
e.zh: 扫描显示舟骨有一处小骨折。

e.en: Some plants have {navicular} seed pods.
e.zh: 有些植物长着舟状的荚果。

e.en: Engineers assessed the river's {navigability} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，工程师评估了这条河的可航行性。

e.en: Good menus improve a website's {navigability} for new users.
e.zh: 清晰的菜单能提升新用户浏览网站的便利性。

e.en: The channel remained {navigably} deep through the dry season.
e.zh: 旱季里这条航道仍深到可以通航。

e.en: The app presents complex data {navigably} on a small screen.
e.zh: 这款应用能在小屏幕上把复杂数据呈现得便于查看。

navimeter.t: 航速测量仪；导航测量器

e.en: The old boat still had a working {navimeter} on the console.
e.zh: 那艘旧船的控制台上仍有一台能用的航速测量仪。

e.en: Pilots checked the {navimeter} before entering the narrow channel.
e.zh: 飞行员在进入狭窄航道前检查了导航测量器。

e.en: She wore a {navy-blue} coat to the interview.
e.zh: 她穿了一件藏青色外套去面试。

e.en: The logo looks cleaner on a {navy-blue} background.
e.zh: 这个标志放在深蓝色背景上显得更干净。

e.en: A blue {nazar} hung above the doorway.
e.zh: 门口上方挂着一个蓝色的避邪眼护符。

e.en: She wore a bracelet with a small {nazar} charm.
e.zh: 她戴着一条带小避邪眼吊饰的手链。

nazaritic.t: 拿细耳人的；禁欲誓愿的

e.en: The scholar discussed {nazaritic} vows in ancient Jewish law.
e.zh: 那位学者讨论了古代犹太律法中的拿细耳人誓愿。

e.en: His long hair was described as a {nazaritic} sign.
e.zh: 他的长发被描述为拿细耳人式的标志。

e.en: The lighthouse stood on a windy {naze}.
e.zh: 灯塔矗立在一处风很大的海角上。

e.en: Fishermen watched the tide from the {naze}.
e.zh: 渔民们从岬角上观察潮水。

e.en: The regime {nazified} schools and youth organizations.
e.zh: 该政权把学校和青年组织纳粹化了。

e.en: The archive shows how the university became {nazified}.
e.zh: 档案显示这所大学是如何被纳粹化的。

nazifies.t: 使纳粹化；灌输纳粹思想

e.en: The documentary shows how propaganda {nazifies} ordinary institutions.
e.zh: 这部纪录片展示了宣传如何使普通机构纳粹化。

e.en: He argues that the novel {nazifies} its villains too simplistically.
e.zh: 他认为这部小说把反派纳粹化得过于简单。

nazifying.t: 正在纳粹化；灌输纳粹思想的

e.en: The party was accused of {nazifying} public life.
e.zh: 该党被指控正在把公共生活纳粹化。

e.en: Critics saw the policy as a {nazifying} influence on schools.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项政策对学校有纳粹化影响。

ndebele.t: 恩德贝莱人；恩德贝莱语

e.en: She is learning {Ndebele} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她正在跟祖母学习恩德贝莱语。

e.en: The museum displayed bright {Ndebele} wall paintings.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了色彩鲜艳的恩德贝莱壁画。

e.en: The villagers called him a {ne'er-do-weel} after years of trouble.
e.zh: 多年惹事后，村民们叫他游手好闲的无赖。

e.en: In the old comedy, the {ne'er-do-weel} finally finds honest work.
e.zh: 在那部老喜剧里，那个无所事事的人终于找到了正经工作。

e.en: Her brother was dismissed as a charming {ne'er-do-well}.
e.zh: 她哥哥被人看作一个讨人喜欢却游手好闲的人。

e.en: The novel turns a village {ne'er-do-well} into an unlikely hero.
e.zh: 这部小说把一个村里的无赖写成了意外的英雄。

e.en: The rope frayed at the {neadend} after years of use.
e.zh: 那根绳子用了多年后在末端磨散了。

e.en: He tied a marker near the {neadend} of the measuring line.
e.zh: 他在测量绳的尽头附近系了一个标记。

e.en: The poem lingers over his {neanic} hopes and restless pride.
e.zh: 这首诗反复描写他年轻时的希望和不安的骄傲。

e.en: Her {neanic} energy made the old debate feel new again.
e.zh: 她青春般的活力让这场老辩论重新显得新鲜。

e.en: The museum label described the skull as {neanthropic}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这具头骨描述为近代人类的。

e.en: His lecture compared paleanthropic and {neanthropic} tools.
e.zh: 他的讲座比较了古人类和新人类的工具。

e.en: We stopped at a {near-by} cafe after the meeting.
e.zh: 会后我们在附近的一家咖啡馆停了下来。

e.en: A doctor was {near-by} when the accident happened.
e.zh: 事故发生时，一名医生就在近处。

e.en: The report favors {near-market} pricing for public services.
e.zh: 报告支持公共服务采用接近市场的定价。

e.en: They tested the idea in a {near-market} environment.
e.zh: 他们在接近真实市场的环境中测试了这个想法。

near-miss.t: 险些发生的事故；侥幸脱险

e.en: The runway incident was a serious {near-miss}.
e.zh: 这起跑道事件是一次严重的险些相撞事故。

e.en: Missing the deadline by one minute felt like a {near-miss}.
e.zh: 只差一分钟错过截止时间，感觉像是侥幸擦边。

e.en: There was {near-panic} when the alarm began to ring.
e.zh: 警报响起时，现场几乎陷入恐慌。

e.en: Her voice rose to {near-panic} as the child disappeared.
e.zh: 孩子不见时，她的声音几乎变成惊慌的喊叫。

e.en: She gave a {near-perfect} performance in the final.
e.zh: 她在决赛中献上了近乎完美的表演。

e.en: The recipe needs {near-perfect} timing to work.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要近乎完美的时间掌控才行。

e.en: My {near-sighted} brother cannot read signs across the street.
e.zh: 我近视的哥哥看不清街对面的标志。

e.en: The board made a {near-sighted} decision to cut training.
e.zh: 董事会削减培训，是一个目光短浅的决定。

e.en: The jet produced a {near-sonic} roar over the desert.
e.zh: 那架喷气机在沙漠上空发出接近音速的轰鸣。

e.en: Engineers studied airflow at {near-sonic} speeds.
e.zh: 工程师研究了接近音速时的气流。

e.en: The company faces {near-term} pressure from rising costs.
e.zh: 公司近期面临成本上升带来的压力。

e.en: Our {near-term} goal is to improve customer support.
e.zh: 我们的短期目标是改进客户支持。

e.en: The algorithm uses a {nearest-neighbor} rule to classify images.
e.zh: 该算法使用最近邻规则来分类图像。

e.en: Each village was matched with its {nearest-neighbor} settlement.
e.zh: 每个村庄都与距离最近的聚落进行匹配。

e.en: The survey measured pollution in {nearshore} waters.
e.zh: 这项调查测量了近岸水域的污染情况。

e.en: The firm moved support work to a {nearshore} team.
e.zh: 公司把支持工作转给了邻近地区的外包团队。

e.en: The old landlord was {neary} with repairs and generous with complaints.
e.zh: 那位老房东修东西很小气，抱怨却很多。

e.en: She called him {neary} for refusing to share the firewood.
e.zh: 她说他连柴火都不肯分，真是小气。

e.en: A {neat-handed} clerk tied every parcel perfectly.
e.zh: 一位手巧的店员把每个包裹都捆得很整齐。

e.en: His {neat-handed} repair made the cracked chair usable again.
e.zh: 他利落的修补让那把裂开的椅子又能用了。

e.en: The {neatherd} drove the cattle home before sunset.
e.zh: 牧牛人在日落前把牛群赶回家。

e.en: In the old tale, a poor {neatherd} finds a silver cup.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，一个贫穷的牧牛人发现了银杯。

e.en: The storm tore the roof from the old {neathouse}.
e.zh: 暴风雨掀掉了旧牛舍的屋顶。

e.en: They stored hay beside the {neathouse} for winter.
e.zh: 他们把干草存放在牛棚旁边过冬。

e.en: Everyone treated him like a harmless {nebbich}.
e.zh: 大家都把他当成一个无害的可怜虫。

e.en: The novel turns a shy {nebbich} into an unlikely hero.
e.zh: 这部小说把一个害羞的软弱小人物写成了意想不到的英雄。

nebbiolo.t: 内比奥罗葡萄酒；葡萄品种

e.en: The restaurant served a young {nebbiolo} with the lamb.
e.zh: 餐厅用一款年轻的内比奥罗葡萄酒来配羊肉。

e.en: Growers say {nebbiolo} needs patience and cool hillsides.
e.zh: 种植者说内比奥罗葡萄需要耐心和凉爽的山坡。

nebbishy.t: 怯懦窝囊的；可怜兮兮的

e.en: He played a {nebbishy} assistant who apologized for everything.
e.zh: 他饰演一个窝囊的助手，什么事都要道歉。

e.en: Her {nebbishy} smile vanished when she heard the insult.
e.zh: 听到那句侮辱后，她那可怜兮兮的笑容消失了。

e.en: The microscope image showed a clear {nebenkern} in the cell.
e.zh: 显微镜图像显示细胞中有清晰的副核结构。

e.en: During sperm development, mitochondria form a {nebenkern}.
e.zh: 在精子发育过程中，线粒体会形成副核样结构。

e.en: The moth had {nebulated} markings on its wings.
e.zh: 那只蛾子的翅膀上有云状斑纹。

e.en: A {nebulated} pattern softened the old glass.
e.zh: 云雾般的纹理让那块旧玻璃显得柔和。

e.en: The nurse cleaned the {nebuliser} after each treatment.
e.zh: 护士每次治疗后都会清洁雾化器。

e.en: He carried a small {nebuliser} for asthma attacks.
e.zh: 他随身带着一个小雾化器，以防哮喘发作。

e.en: Scientists once proposed {nebulium} to explain strange spectral lines.
e.zh: 科学家曾提出假想元素nebulium来解释奇特的光谱线。

e.en: The idea of {nebulium} disappeared after better physics emerged.
e.zh: 更完善的物理学出现后，nebulium这个概念便消失了。

e.en: The medicine works after {nebulization} into a fine mist.
e.zh: 药物雾化成细雾后才会发挥作用。

e.en: Improper {nebulization} can waste much of the dose.
e.zh: 雾化不当可能浪费大部分剂量。

e.en: The device can {nebulize} liquid medicine in seconds.
e.zh: 这台设备能在几秒内把液体药物雾化。

e.en: Technicians {nebulize} the disinfectant before it enters the chamber.
e.zh: 技术人员先把消毒剂喷成雾状，再送入舱内。

e.en: She inhaled the {nebulized} medication through a mask.
e.zh: 她通过面罩吸入雾化后的药物。

e.en: The {nebulized} droplets spread evenly through the chamber.
e.zh: 雾化后的微滴均匀散布在舱内。

e.en: The child used a {nebulizer} during the asthma attack.
e.zh: 孩子哮喘发作时使用了雾化器。

e.en: A laboratory {nebulizer} turns samples into a fine spray.
e.zh: 实验室雾化器会把样品变成细密喷雾。

e.en: The machine was {nebulizing} saline for the patient.
e.zh: 机器正在为病人雾化生理盐水。

e.en: The {nebulizing} nozzle must be kept clean.
e.zh: 雾化喷嘴必须保持清洁。

e.en: A {nebulose} haze covered the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，云雾般的薄霭笼罩着山谷。

e.en: His {nebulose} explanation satisfied no one.
e.zh: 他那番含混朦胧的解释谁也没说服。

e.en: The philosopher called himself a {necessarian} rather than a fatalist.
e.zh: 那位哲学家称自己是必然论者，而不是宿命论者。

e.en: A strict {necessarian} denies genuine free choice.
e.zh: 严格的必然论者否认真正自由选择的存在。

e.en: Her essay defends {necessarianism} against charges of pessimism.
e.zh: 她的文章为必然论辩护，反驳其悲观主义之名。

e.en: In theology, {necessarianism} raises difficult questions about guilt.
e.zh: 在神学中，必然论会引出关于罪责的难题。

e.en: He offered a {necessitarian} view of human action.
e.zh: 他提出了一种关于人类行为的必然论观点。

e.en: The {necessitarian} argued that every choice has prior causes.
e.zh: 那位必然论者认为每个选择都有先在原因。

e.en: The lecture traced {necessitarianism} from ancient philosophy to science.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了必然论从古代哲学到科学的发展。

e.en: Critics say {necessitarianism} leaves little room for moral blame.
e.zh: 批评者说，必然论几乎不给道德责备留下空间。

e.en: The book treats {necessitarism} as a rival to free will.
e.zh: 这本书把必然论视为自由意志的对立观点。

e.en: Few modern readers use the term {necessitarism}.
e.zh: 现代读者很少使用necessitarism这个词。

e.en: The storm caused the {necessitation} of an early departure.
e.zh: 暴风雨使提前出发成为必要。

e.en: Philosophers debated the {necessitation} of actions by prior causes.
e.zh: 哲学家争论先在原因是否必然决定行为。

e.en: The charity aided {necessitied} families during the winter.
e.zh: 慈善机构在冬天援助贫困家庭。

e.en: He wrote about the {necessitied} workers in the city.
e.zh: 他写到了城里处境窘迫的工人。

e.en: The poem speaks of human {necessitude} and suffering.
e.zh: 这首诗谈到人的困厄与苦难。

e.en: Older theologians used {necessitude} to mean unavoidable necessity.
e.zh: 早期神学家用necessitude表示不可避免的必然性。

e.en: She wore a silver {nechlace} to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一条银项链去参加聚会。

e.en: The shop repaired the broken {nechlace} clasp.
e.zh: 店里修好了那条项链坏掉的扣子。

needleful.t: 一针所能装的线量或药液量

e.en: She threaded a {needleful} of red silk before sewing the hem.
e.zh: 她先穿好一针红丝线，然后缝衣边。

e.en: The nurse measured a {needleful} of medicine for the tiny injection.
e.zh: 护士量出一针剂量的药水，用于小小的注射。

e.en: Several {needlefuls} of blue thread finished the delicate embroidery.
e.zh: 几针蓝线完成了这幅精细的刺绣。

e.en: The old doctor spoke of {needlefuls} rather than milliliters.
e.zh: 那位老医生不用毫升，而说几针的剂量。

e.en: The cactus had {needlelike} spines along every ridge.
e.zh: 仙人掌每道棱上都有针状的尖刺。

e.en: A {needlelike} pain shot through his wrist.
e.zh: 一阵针扎似的疼痛猛地穿过他的手腕。

needleman.t: 做针线活的男子；针具工匠

e.en: The village {needleman} repaired uniforms for the soldiers.
e.zh: 村里的男针线匠为士兵们修补制服。

e.en: A skilled {needleman} could make fine surgical needles by hand.
e.zh: 熟练的针具工匠能手工制作精细的外科针。

e.en: He used {needlenose} pliers to bend the tiny wire.
e.zh: 他用尖嘴钳弯折那根细小的金属丝。

e.en: The old cartoon gave the villain a {needlenose} face.
e.zh: 那部老漫画把反派画成尖长鼻子的脸。

needlestone.t: 磁石；可使针磁化的石头

e.en: Sailors once used a {needlestone} to magnetize compass needles.
e.zh: 水手们过去用磁石给罗盘针磁化。

e.en: The museum displayed a dark {needlestone} beside an early compass.
e.zh: 博物馆在早期罗盘旁展出了一块黑色磁石。

e.en: They packed food, rope, and other {needments} for the journey.
e.zh: 他们为旅程打包了食物、绳索和其他必需品。

e.en: The charity supplied the refugees with daily {needments}.
e.zh: 慈善机构向难民提供日常所需物资。

e.en: You {needn't} wait if you are tired.
e.zh: 如果你累了，就不必等。

e.en: She said we {needn't} bring anything to dinner.
e.zh: 她说我们去吃晚饭不用带任何东西。

e.en: The stew included a chopped {neep} and two potatoes.
e.zh: 炖菜里放了一个切碎的芜菁和两个土豆。

e.en: At Burns Night, they served haggis with {neep} and tatties.
e.zh: 在彭斯之夜，他们配着芜菁和土豆泥上哈吉斯。

neet.t: 不工作不读书不受训的人

e.en: The report counted him as a {NEET} after he left college.
e.zh: 他退学后，报告把他列为不工作不读书不受训的人。

e.en: Local programs try to help {NEET} teenagers find training.
e.zh: 当地项目努力帮助不读书不就业的青少年找到培训机会。

e.en: He gave a loud {neeze} in the dusty attic.
e.zh: 他在满是灰尘的阁楼里大声打了个喷嚏。

e.en: The old poem uses {neeze} where modern English says sneeze.
e.zh: 那首古诗用neeze这个词，现代英语则说sneeze。

e.en: A silver {nef} stood in the center of the banquet table.
e.zh: 宴会桌中央摆着一件银制船形器皿。

e.en: The curator explained that a {nef} could hold salt or spices.
e.zh: 馆长解释说，船形餐具可以盛盐或香料。

nefandous.t: 极其邪恶的；罪大恶极的

e.en: The chronicler condemned the king's {nefandous} cruelty.
e.zh: 编年史作者谴责国王罪大恶极的残暴。

e.en: In mock-heroic style, she called the missing cake a {nefandous} crime.
e.zh: 她用戏仿史诗的口吻，把蛋糕失踪称作一桩滔天罪行。

negabinary.t: 负二进制的；以负二为基数的

e.en: A {negabinary} system uses minus two as its base.
e.zh: 负二进制系统以负二作为基数。

e.en: The puzzle asked students to convert decimals into {negabinary}.
e.zh: 这道题要求学生把十进制数转换成负二进制。

negational.t: 否定的；表示否定作用的

e.en: The sentence has a {negational} phrase at the beginning.
e.zh: 这个句子开头有一个表示否定的短语。

e.en: His argument relied on a {negational} reading of the rule.
e.zh: 他的论证依赖于对这条规则的否定性解读。

negationist.t: 否认主义者；持否定论者

e.en: The historian criticized the {negationist} account of the massacre.
e.zh: 历史学家批评了对那场屠杀的否认主义叙述。

e.en: A {negationist} may reject evidence that contradicts his ideology.
e.zh: 否认主义者可能会拒绝与其意识形态相矛盾的证据。

e.en: The team's {negativist} dismissed every proposal as impossible.
e.zh: 团队里的消极主义者把每个提议都说成不可能。

e.en: Some philosophers labeled him a {negativist} because he denied moral progress.
e.zh: 一些哲学家称他为否定论者，因为他否认道德进步。

e.en: The patient showed {negativistic} behavior during the examination.
e.zh: 病人在检查中表现出抗拒性的行为。

e.en: Her {negativistic} comments drained energy from the meeting.
e.zh: 她那些消极否定的评论让会议气氛变得低落。

neck-and-neck.t: 并驾齐驱；不相上下；势均力敌，难分高下

e.en: The two runners were {neck-and-neck} near the finish line.
e.zh: 两名跑者在终点线附近并驾齐驱。

e.en: Polls show the candidates are still {neck-and-neck}.
e.zh: 民调显示两位候选人仍然势均力敌。

neck-rein.t: 用颈控缰；颈缰法，骑马时以缰触颈转向

e.en: The rider taught the horse to {neck-rein} smoothly.
e.zh: 骑手教那匹马熟练地用颈控缰转向。

e.en: Western horses often respond well to a {neck-rein}.
e.zh: 西部骑乘用马通常能很好地响应颈缰指令。

neckbreaking.t: 极危险的；速度快得惊人的；令人筋疲力尽的

e.en: They drove down the hill at a {neckbreaking} speed.
e.zh: 他们以惊人的危险速度冲下山坡。

e.en: The team kept a {neckbreaking} pace all week.
e.zh: 团队整整一周都保持着令人筋疲力尽的节奏。

neckcloth.t: 颈巾；围在脖子上的布巾或旧式领巾

e.en: He tucked a white {neckcloth} under his coat.
e.zh: 他把一条白色颈巾塞在外套下面。

e.en: The old portrait shows him wearing a stiff {neckcloth}.
e.zh: 那幅旧肖像里，他戴着一条硬挺的旧式领巾。

e.en: The statue looked almost {neckless} from that angle.
e.zh: 从那个角度看，雕像几乎像是没有脖子。

e.en: A thick scarf made him appear {neckless} in the photo.
e.zh: 一条厚围巾让他在照片里显得脖子很短。

necklet.t: 项链；颈饰；颈部环状花纹

e.en: She wore a silver {necklet} with a tiny charm.
e.zh: 她戴着一条带小吊坠的银项链。

e.en: The bird has a dark {necklet} around its throat.
e.zh: 这种鸟喉部周围有一圈深色颈纹。

necklike.t: 像颈部的；细长连接状的

e.en: A narrow {necklike} passage joined the two chambers.
e.zh: 一条像颈部般狭窄的通道连接着两个房间。

e.en: The vase has a tall, {necklike} upper section.
e.zh: 这个花瓶上部有一段高高的细颈状结构。

neckrein.t: 颈缰；用缰绳触马颈转向

e.en: Use the {neckrein} gently when you turn left.
e.zh: 向左转时要轻轻使用颈缰。

e.en: The mare learned to {neckrein} after several lessons.
e.zh: 那匹母马经过几节课后学会了用颈缰转向。

neckverse.t: 免颈诗；旧时证明识字以免绞刑的经文

e.en: The clerk asked the prisoner to read the {neckverse}.
e.zh: 书记员要求囚犯朗读那段免颈诗。

e.en: In old law, a successful {neckverse} could save a convict.
e.zh: 在旧法律中，成功读出免颈诗可能救下一名罪犯。

necremia.t: 尸毒血症；坏死物质入血引起的中毒

e.en: The surgeon feared {necremia} after the untreated infection spread.
e.zh: 感染未获治疗并扩散后，外科医生担心出现尸毒血症。

e.en: Old medical texts used {necremia} for poisoning from dead tissue.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用necremia指由坏死组织引起的中毒。

necrobacillosis.t: 坏死杆菌病；由坏死杆菌引起的感染

e.en: The calf was treated for {necrobacillosis} by the veterinarian.
e.zh: 兽医为那头小牛治疗坏死杆菌病。

e.en: Severe {necrobacillosis} can damage tissue around the mouth.
e.zh: 严重的坏死杆菌病会损伤口腔周围组织。

necrobiosis.t: 渐进性组织死亡；坏死生物过程

e.en: The biopsy showed signs of {necrobiosis} in the skin.
e.zh: 活检显示皮肤中有渐进性组织死亡的迹象。

e.en: Researchers studied {necrobiosis} in damaged plant cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究受损植物细胞中的坏死生物过程。

necrocoleopterophilous.t: 喜腐尸甲虫的；依赖食腐甲虫的

e.en: The fungus appears to be {necrocoleopterophilous} in its habitat.
e.zh: 这种真菌在其栖息地似乎依赖食腐甲虫。

e.en: A {necrocoleopterophilous} organism may spread on carrion beetles.
e.zh: 喜腐尸甲虫的生物可能借食腐甲虫传播。

necrocryptoxanthol.t: 死隐黄醇；一种与隐黄质相关的色素化合物

e.en: The chemist identified {necrocryptoxanthol} in the old sample.
e.zh: 化学家在旧样品中鉴定出死隐黄醇。

e.en: Few papers mention {necrocryptoxanthol} outside pigment research.
e.zh: 除色素研究外，很少有论文提到死隐黄醇。

necrogenic.t: 致坏死的；由死亡组织产生的

e.en: The doctor described the toxin as {necrogenic}.
e.zh: 医生把这种毒素描述为致坏死的。

e.en: Some bacteria release {necrogenic} substances during infection.
e.zh: 有些细菌在感染过程中会释放致坏死物质。

necrographer.t: 讣告作者；记录死者生平的人

e.en: The newspaper hired a careful {necrographer} for prominent deaths.
e.zh: 报社聘请了一位细致的讣告作者来撰写名人讣告。

e.en: A good {necrographer} balances facts with humane detail.
e.zh: 优秀的讣告作者会在事实与人情细节之间取得平衡。

e.en: The anthropologist wrote about {necrolatry} in ancient rituals.
e.zh: 人类学家写到了古代仪式中的亡灵崇拜。

e.en: Critics saw the monument as a form of political {necrolatry}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这座纪念碑是一种政治性的死者崇拜。

e.en: The journal published a {necrological} notice for the professor.
e.zh: 期刊为那位教授刊登了一则讣告。

e.en: His archive includes many {necrological} notes from local papers.
e.zh: 他的档案中有许多地方报纸的死亡记录笔记。

e.en: The library preserves nineteenth-century {necrologies} on microfilm.
e.zh: 图书馆用缩微胶片保存十九世纪的讣告集。

e.en: Her research compares {necrologies} from several monasteries.
e.zh: 她的研究比较了几座修道院的死亡名录。

necrologist.t: 讣告撰写者；死亡记录编纂者

e.en: The {necrologist} confirmed the dates before publication.
e.zh: 讣告撰写者在刊发前核实了日期。

e.en: A medieval {necrologist} recorded donors beside the dead.
e.zh: 一位中世纪死亡记录编纂者把捐赠者也记在死者旁边。

necrology.t: 讣告；死亡名录；死亡统计

e.en: The magazine printed a short {necrology} of the poet.
e.zh: 杂志刊登了一篇关于那位诗人的简短讣告。

e.en: The monastery's {necrology} lists deaths across many centuries.
e.zh: 修道院的死亡名录记录了多个世纪的逝者。

necromania.t: 迷恋死亡；对死物的病态迷恋

e.en: The novel treats the villain's {necromania} with dark humor.
e.zh: 这部小说用黑色幽默描写反派对死亡的迷恋。

e.en: Doctors once used {necromania} for an obsession with the dead.
e.zh: 医生曾用necromania指对死者的病态迷恋。

e.en: The wizard opened a {necromantic} book at midnight.
e.zh: 巫师在午夜翻开一本死灵法术之书。

e.en: Critics called the ritual {necromantic} rather than religious.
e.zh: 批评者称这场仪式是招魂术，而不是宗教活动。

necromantically.t: 以死灵法术方式；像招魂般地

e.en: The sorcerer spoke {necromantically} over the grave.
e.zh: 术士在坟墓上方以招魂般的方式念咒。

e.en: The poem revives the past almost {necromantically}.
e.zh: 这首诗几乎像招魂一样唤回过去。

e.en: Some beetles use {necromimesis} to avoid predators.
e.zh: 一些甲虫会用拟尸行为来躲避捕食者。

e.en: The researcher described the animal's stillness as {necromimesis}.
e.zh: 研究者把这种动物的一动不动描述为装死拟态。

e.en: The horror novel mentions a cursed {Necronomicon}.
e.zh: 这本恐怖小说提到一本受诅咒的死灵之书。

e.en: Fans treated the {Necronomicon} as a famous fictional grimoire.
e.zh: 粉丝把《死灵之书》视为著名的虚构魔典。

e.en: A vulture is a large {necrophage} in many ecosystems.
e.zh: 在许多生态系统中，秃鹫是一种大型食腐动物。

e.en: The team recorded each {necrophage} that visited the carcass.
e.zh: 团队记录了每一种来到尸体旁的食腐生物。

e.en: The paper examines {necrophagia} among insects after forest fires.
e.zh: 这篇论文研究森林火灾后昆虫的食腐行为。

e.en: In pathology notes, {necrophagia} may describe feeding on dead tissue.
e.zh: 在病理记录中，食尸习性可指取食坏死组织。

e.en: The trap attracted several {necrophagous} flies.
e.zh: 这个陷阱吸引了几种食腐苍蝇。

e.en: Forensic scientists study {necrophagous} insects at death scenes.
e.zh: 法医科学家会研究死亡现场的食尸昆虫。

e.en: The course discussed {necrophagy} in marine food webs.
e.zh: 这门课讨论了海洋食物网中的食腐行为。

e.en: Some larvae depend on {necrophagy} for rapid growth.
e.zh: 有些幼虫依靠食尸行为来快速生长。

e.en: The suspect was described as a {necrophiliac} in the report.
e.zh: 报告中称这名嫌疑人是恋尸者。

e.en: The film uses a {necrophiliac} character to shock the audience.
e.zh: 这部电影用一个恋尸癖角色来震撼观众。

e.en: The article discussed treatment options for {necrophiliacs}.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了恋尸癖患者的治疗选择。

e.en: Victorian tabloids sensationalized stories about {necrophiliacs}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的小报耸动地报道恋尸者的故事。

e.en: The psychiatrist identified signs of {necrophily}.
e.zh: 精神科医生发现了恋尸癖的迹象。

e.en: In literature, {necrophily} can symbolize a fixation on death.
e.zh: 在文学中，恋尸倾向可以象征对死亡的执迷。

e.en: Her {necrophobia} made funerals extremely difficult.
e.zh: 她的死亡恐惧让葬礼变得极其难熬。

e.en: The therapist treated his {necrophobia} with gradual exposure.
e.zh: 治疗师用逐步暴露法治疗他的尸体恐惧症。

e.en: A {necrophore} can bury a small dead mouse.
e.zh: 一只埋葬甲虫能把一只死小鼠埋起来。

e.en: The museum displayed a {necrophore} beside other carrion beetles.
e.zh: 博物馆把一只负尸甲虫和其他食腐甲虫一起展出。

e.en: Archaeologists mapped the ancient {necropole} outside the city walls.
e.zh: 考古学家绘制了城墙外那片古代墓园的地图。

e.en: The ruined {necropole} contained hundreds of stone tombs.
e.zh: 这片废弃的大墓地里有数百座石墓。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {necroscopy} to determine the cause of death.
e.zh: 医生要求进行尸体剖检，以确定死因。

e.en: In older medical texts, {necroscopy} often means an autopsy.
e.zh: 在较旧的医学文本中，necroscopy通常指验尸。

e.en: Without blood flow, the tissue may {necrose} quickly.
e.zh: 没有血流供应，组织可能很快发生坏死。

e.en: The infection caused the wound edges to {necrose}.
e.zh: 感染导致伤口边缘坏死。

e.en: The surgeon removed the {necrosed} tissue carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地切除了已坏死的组织。

e.en: Leaves with {necrosed} patches fell from the plant.
e.zh: 带有坏死斑块的叶子从植物上掉落。

e.en: The scan showed several small {necroses} in the liver.
e.zh: 扫描显示肝脏中有几处小的坏死病灶。

e.en: Pathologists compared the {necroses} caused by different toxins.
e.zh: 病理学家比较了不同毒素造成的坏死灶。

e.en: The patient had a {necrosing} infection in his leg.
e.zh: 这名患者腿部有一种致坏死的感染。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {necrosing} tissue around the burn.
e.zh: 医生监测烧伤周围正在坏死的组织。

e.en: Poor circulation can make skin {necrotise}.
e.zh: 血液循环不良会使皮肤坏死。

e.en: Some venoms {necrotise} tissue around the bite.
e.zh: 有些毒液会使咬伤周围的组织坏死。

e.en: The toxin can {necrotize} muscle cells.
e.zh: 这种毒素会使肌肉细胞坏死。

e.en: If untreated, the ulcer may {necrotize} further.
e.zh: 如果不治疗，溃疡可能进一步坏死。

e.en: The biopsy revealed {necrotized} cells near the tumor.
e.zh: 活检显示肿瘤附近有已坏死的细胞。

e.en: They cleaned the {necrotized} area before applying a dressing.
e.zh: 他们在敷药前清理了坏死区域。

necrotroph.t: 死养生物；坏死营养型生物

e.en: The fungus is a {necrotroph} that kills plant cells first.
e.zh: 这种真菌是一种死养生物，会先杀死植物细胞。

e.en: Researchers compared each {necrotroph} with living-tissue parasites.
e.zh: 研究人员把每种坏死营养型生物与活体组织寄生物比较。

e.en: The poem praises a {nectarean} sweetness in her voice.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美她声音中花蜜般的甜美。

e.en: They served a {nectarean} wine after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他们端上了一款甘美如蜜的酒。

e.en: The dessert had a {nectareous} flavor of ripe peaches.
e.zh: 这道甜点有成熟桃子般香甜的味道。

e.en: Bees gathered around the {nectareous} blossoms.
e.zh: 蜜蜂聚集在含蜜香甜的花朵周围。

e.en: The botanist examined the flower's {nectarial} glands.
e.zh: 植物学家检查了这朵花的蜜腺。

e.en: Its {nectarial} tissue attracts ants that protect the plant.
e.zh: 它的产蜜组织会吸引保护植物的蚂蚁。

e.en: Hummingbirds hovered near the {nectaried} flowers.
e.zh: 蜂鸟在含花蜜的花朵旁盘旋。

e.en: The old song spoke of {nectaried} lips and summer evenings.
e.zh: 那首老歌唱到甜美如蜜的双唇和夏夜。

e.en: The flower's {nectaries} attract many bees.
e.zh: 这朵花的蜜腺吸引了许多蜜蜂。

e.en: Botanists examined the tiny {nectaries} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家用放大镜检查那些细小的蜜腺。

e.en: Bees prefer {nectariferous} flowers in spring.
e.zh: 蜜蜂在春天更喜欢产蜜的花。

e.en: The plant has {nectariferous} glands near the petals.
e.zh: 这种植物在花瓣附近有含蜜的腺体。

e.en: The cook tried to {nectarize} the drink with honey.
e.zh: 厨师试着用蜂蜜把饮料调得像花蜜一样甜。

e.en: Some recipes {nectarize} fruit before it is baked.
e.zh: 有些食谱会在烘烤前给水果加蜜。

e.en: The dessert was {nectarized} with wildflower honey.
e.zh: 这道甜点加了野花蜂蜜调味。

e.en: She served {nectarized} peaches after dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐后端上了加蜜的桃子。

e.en: They are {nectarizing} the syrup for the pastry.
e.zh: 他们正在给糕点用的糖浆加蜜。

e.en: The chef described {nectarizing} fruit as an old technique.
e.zh: 厨师说给水果蜜化是一种老做法。

e.en: The poem praised a {nectarous} summer breeze.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美了甘美如蜜的夏日微风。

e.en: A {nectarous} scent rose from the blossoms.
e.zh: 花朵散发出一股像花蜜般甜美的香气。

e.en: Each flower has a small {nectary} at its base.
e.zh: 每朵花的底部都有一个小蜜腺。

e.en: The insect reached the {nectary} with its long tongue.
e.zh: 那只昆虫用长舌伸到了蜜腺处。

e.en: The siphonophore moves by pulsing its {nectocalyx}.
e.zh: 这只管水母通过收缩泳钟来移动。

e.en: A damaged {nectocalyx} made the creature swim unevenly.
e.zh: 受损的泳钟让这种生物游动得不太平稳。

e.en: Fish and squid are part of the {necton}.
e.zh: 鱼和鱿鱼属于自游生物群。

e.en: The survey compared plankton with {necton} in coastal waters.
e.zh: 这项调查比较了近海水域的浮游生物和自游生物。

e.en: The old farmer led a {neddie} down the lane.
e.zh: 老农夫牵着一头驴沿小路走。

e.en: Don't be a {neddie} about the obvious answer.
e.zh: 这么明显的答案，别犯傻了。

e.en: The bird tapped its {neeb} against the glass.
e.zh: 那只鸟用喙轻轻啄着玻璃。

e.en: He wiped his {neeb} with a handkerchief.
e.zh: 他用手帕擦了擦鼻子。

e.en: The college follows a {need-blind} admissions policy.
e.zh: 这所大学实行录取时不看经济状况的政策。

e.en: A {need-blind} review ignores an applicant's ability to pay.
e.zh: 不看经济需求的审核会忽略申请人的支付能力。

need-to-know.t: 按需知情的；必要才告知

e.en: The files were shared on a {need-to-know} basis.
e.zh: 这些文件只按必要知情原则共享。

e.en: She gave him only the {need-to-know} details.
e.zh: 她只告诉了他必须知道的细节。

e.en: Villagers once lit a {needfire} during cattle disease.
e.zh: 过去牲畜染病时，村民会点燃祈禳火。

e.en: The ritual {needfire} was kindled without ordinary flame.
e.zh: 仪式中的新火不是用普通火焰点燃的。

e.en: He clung {needily} to every kind word.
e.zh: 他很依赖地抓住每一句善意的话不放。

e.en: The children looked {needily} at the empty table.
e.zh: 孩子们可怜巴巴地看着空空的桌子。
