e.en: Be patient with a {newie} on his first shift.
e.zh: 对第一次上班的新手要有耐心。

e.en: They moved into a {newly-built} apartment near the station.
e.zh: 他们搬进了车站附近一套新建的公寓。

e.en: The {newly-built} bridge opened to traffic yesterday.
e.zh: 那座刚建成的大桥昨天通车了。

e.en: The {newly-crowned} king greeted the crowd from the balcony.
e.zh: 新加冕的国王在阳台上向人群致意。

e.en: The {newly-crowned} champion smiled through the interview.
e.zh: 新获冠军的选手在采访中一直微笑。

e.en: The {newly-married} couple spent a week by the sea.
e.zh: 这对新婚夫妇在海边度过了一周。

e.en: She was {newly-married} and still adjusting to city life.
e.zh: 她刚结婚，还在适应城市生活。

e.en: The {newly-wed} waved from the decorated car.
e.zh: 那位新婚者从装饰好的车里挥手。

e.en: They booked a quiet room for the {newly-wed} pair.
e.zh: 他们为这对新婚夫妇订了一间安静的房间。

e.en: The room smelled of {newmade} bread and fresh paint.
e.zh: 房间里有新做面包和新刷油漆的味道。

e.en: He proudly showed us his {newmade} fishing net.
e.zh: 他自豪地给我们看他新做成的渔网。

e.en: The air smelled sweet over the {newmown} hay.
e.zh: 新割的干草上方空气闻起来清甜。

e.en: She walked barefoot across the {newmown} lawn.
e.zh: 她赤脚走过刚修剪过的草坪。

e.en: A {news-flash} interrupted the radio program.
e.zh: 一条新闻快讯打断了广播节目。

e.en: Here is a {news-flash} from the city center.
e.zh: 现在播报一条来自市中心的突发消息。

e.en: The {news-reader} spoke calmly during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，那位新闻播报员说话很沉稳。

e.en: My grandfather was a careful {news-reader} every morning.
e.zh: 我祖父每天早上都认真读报。

e.en: A boy sold a cheap {news-sheet} outside the station.
e.zh: 一个男孩在车站外卖廉价的新闻单页。

e.en: The rebels printed a secret {news-sheet} at night.
e.zh: 叛军夜里印刷一份秘密简报。

e.en: I bought a magazine at the {news-stand}.
e.zh: 我在报摊买了一本杂志。

e.en: The {news-stand} closes early on Sundays.
e.zh: 那家报刊亭星期天关门很早。

e.en: The {news-vendor} shouted the morning headlines.
e.zh: 卖报人大声喊着当天早晨的头条。

e.en: She asked the {news-vendor} for an evening paper.
e.zh: 她向报刊摊主要了一份晚报。

e.en: Crime became his regular {newsbeat} at the paper.
e.zh: 犯罪新闻成了他在报社固定负责的线口。

e.en: The station used a quick {newsbeat} before each bulletin.
e.zh: 电台在每段新闻简报前使用了一段快速的新闻节奏。

e.en: Students checked the {newsboard} for campus announcements.
e.zh: 学生们查看新闻公告板上的校园通知。

e.en: Old papers were pinned to the village {newsboard}.
e.zh: 旧报纸被钉在村里的报纸板上。

e.en: A sudden {newsbreak} reported the minister's resignation.
e.zh: 一段突然的新闻插播播出了部长辞职的消息。

e.en: The comedy show paused for a brief {newsbreak}.
e.zh: 那档喜剧节目暂停了一会儿，插入简短新闻。

e.en: The editor reviewed the {newsclips} before the broadcast.
e.zh: 编辑在播出前审看了那些新闻剪辑。

e.en: She kept {newsclips} about her father's trial.
e.zh: 她保存了关于父亲审判的剪报。

e.en: The {newsdealer} opened his shop before dawn.
e.zh: 那位报刊经销商天亮前就开了店。

e.en: A local {newsdealer} supplied papers to every hotel.
e.zh: 当地一名报刊商给每家酒店供应报纸。

new-fallen.t: 刚落下的；新近掉落的雪等

e.en: The path was covered with {new-fallen} snow.
e.zh: 小路上覆盖着刚落下的雪。

e.en: She brushed the {new-fallen} leaves from the steps.
e.zh: 她把台阶上新落下的叶子扫掉。

new-fangled.t: 新奇却未必实用的；时髦的

e.en: He distrusts every {new-fangled} gadget in the kitchen.
e.zh: 他不信任厨房里每一种新奇的小玩意儿。

e.en: The manager dismissed the software as {new-fangled} nonsense.
e.zh: 经理把那款软件斥为花哨的新潮玩意。

e.en: She preferred a {new-fashioned} cut over the old uniform style.
e.zh: 她更喜欢新式剪裁，而不是旧式制服风格。

e.en: His {new-fashioned} ideas unsettled the conservative committee.
e.zh: 他的新派想法让保守的委员会感到不安。

new-for-old.t: 以新换旧的；保险按新品赔付的

e.en: The policy offers {new-for-old} replacement after a fire.
e.zh: 这份保单规定火灾后按新品进行更换赔付。

e.en: They bought a {new-for-old} cover for the damaged laptop.
e.zh: 他们为受损的笔记本买了以新换旧的保障。

e.en: She spoke with {new-found} confidence after the course.
e.zh: 上完课程后，她带着新获得的自信说话。

e.en: Scientists studied the {new-found} species in the cave.
e.zh: 科学家研究了洞穴中新发现的物种。

new-front.t: 新门面；新前线或新领域

e.en: The shop installed a {new-front} before reopening.
e.zh: 商店重新开业前安装了新门面。

e.en: Cybersecurity became a {new-front} in the conflict.
e.zh: 网络安全成了这场冲突中的新前线。

new-furnish.t: 重新布置家具；配新家具

e.en: They decided to {new-furnish} the guest room in spring.
e.zh: 他们决定春天给客房重新配家具。

e.en: The landlord will {new-furnish} the flat before renting it.
e.zh: 房东会在出租前给公寓换上新家具。

new-furnished.t: 新配家具的；重新布置过的

e.en: We stayed in a {new-furnished} apartment near the station.
e.zh: 我们住在车站附近一套新配家具的公寓里。

e.en: The {new-furnished} office smelled of paint and wood.
e.zh: 重新布置过的办公室里有油漆和木头的气味。

new-generation.t: 新一代的；面向新世代的

e.en: The company released a {new-generation} battery for electric cars.
e.zh: 公司发布了一款用于电动车的新一代电池。

e.en: These {new-generation} voters expect faster political change.
e.zh: 这些新一代选民期待更快的政治变化。

e.en: She collected {new-laid} eggs from the henhouse.
e.zh: 她从鸡舍里收集刚产下的鸡蛋。

e.en: The {new-laid} road surface was still soft.
e.zh: 刚铺好的路面还很软。

e.en: The baker placed {new-made} pies on the counter.
e.zh: 面包师把新做好的派放在柜台上。

e.en: The {new-made} captain thanked the whole crew.
e.zh: 这位新任船长感谢了全体船员。

new-model.t: 新型号的；按新样式改造

e.en: They compared the {new-model} phone with last year's version.
e.zh: 他们把新型号手机和去年的版本作了比较。

e.en: The school adopted a {new-model} timetable for senior students.
e.zh: 学校为高年级学生采用了新的课表模式。

e.en: The air smelled of {new-mown} grass after rain.
e.zh: 雨后空气里有刚割青草的味道。

e.en: Children ran across the {new-mown} field.
e.zh: 孩子们跑过刚割过草的田地。

e.en: The novel mocks the tastes of the {new-rich} elite.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽新富阶层的品味。

e.en: A {new-rich} investor bought the old mansion.
e.zh: 一位新近发家的投资者买下了那座老宅。

e.en: The garden was bright with {new-sprung} flowers.
e.zh: 花园里刚开的花让四周明亮起来。

e.en: They feared the {new-sprung} rumor would damage trust.
e.zh: 他们担心新近出现的谣言会破坏信任。

e.en: The restaurant serves {new-style} Sichuan dishes.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应新派川菜。

e.en: He wore a {new-style} jacket with a narrow collar.
e.zh: 他穿了一件窄领的新式夹克。

new-town.t: 新城；规划建设的新市镇

e.en: They moved to a {new-town} outside London.
e.zh: 他们搬到了伦敦郊外的一座新城。

e.en: The government planned a {new-town} with rail links.
e.zh: 政府规划了一座带铁路连接的新市镇。

e.en: Doctors tested a {new-type} vaccine in the trial.
e.zh: 医生在试验中测试了一种新型疫苗。

e.en: The story introduced a {new-type} hero to readers.
e.zh: 这个故事向读者呈现了一种新类型的英雄。

e.en: Potatoes were once a {new-world} crop in Europe.
e.zh: 土豆在欧洲曾被视为来自新大陆的作物。

e.en: Remote work created a {new-world} routine for many families.
e.zh: 远程工作给许多家庭带来了全新的生活常态。

e.en: We made {new-year} plans over dinner.
e.zh: 我们吃晚饭时制定了新年计划。

e.en: The city held a {new-year} parade downtown.
e.zh: 市中心举行了新年游行。

e.en: They bought a {newbuild} near the river.
e.zh: 他们在河边买了一套新建房。

e.en: The council approved the {newbuild} after long debate.
e.zh: 委员会经过长时间讨论后批准了这个新建项目。

e.en: The {newbuilding} stood beside the old library.
e.zh: 那座新建建筑坐落在老图书馆旁边。

e.en: Strict rules slowed {newbuilding} in the historic district.
e.zh: 严格规定拖慢了历史街区的新房建设。

e.en: The {newcome} apprentice learned the trade quickly.
e.zh: 那位新来的学徒很快学会了这门手艺。

e.en: Villagers watched the {newcome} with quiet curiosity.
e.zh: 村民们带着安静的好奇打量这个新来的人。

e.en: The guide quoted the price in {ngultrum}.
e.zh: 导游用努尔特鲁姆报了价格。

e.en: One {ngultrum} is divided into one hundred chetrum.
e.zh: 一努尔特鲁姆可分为一百切特鲁姆。

e.en: The old coin was worth fifty {ngwee}.
e.zh: 那枚旧硬币值五十恩韦。

e.en: Prices under one kwacha are counted in {ngwee}.
e.zh: 不足一克瓦查的价格按恩韦计算。

e.en: The mill used {ni-hard} liners to resist abrasion.
e.zh: 这台磨机使用镍铬铸铁衬板来抗磨损。

e.en: Engineers specified {ni-hard} for the crusher parts.
e.zh: 工程师为破碎机部件指定使用镍铬铸铁。

e.en: The pump casing was cast from {ni-resist}.
e.zh: 泵壳是用耐蚀镍铸铁铸成的。

e.en: Foundries use {ni-resist} where heat and corrosion matter.
e.zh: 在需要耐热耐腐蚀的场合，铸造厂会使用镍铸铁。

e.en: This serum contains {niacinamide} for uneven skin tone.
e.zh: 这款精华含有烟酰胺，用于改善肤色不均。

e.en: Doctors may recommend {niacinamide} for certain vitamin deficiencies.
e.zh: 医生可能会建议用烟酰胺来应对某些维生素缺乏。

niacytin.t: 结合型烟酸，谷物中烟酸形式

e.en: Corn contains {niacytin}, which is not easily absorbed.
e.zh: 玉米含有结合型烟酸，人体不易吸收。

e.en: Traditional processing can release niacin from {niacytin}.
e.zh: 传统加工方法可以从结合型烟酸中释放出烟酸。

e.en: {Nialamide} was once used as an antidepressant.
e.zh: 尼亚拉胺曾被用作抗抑郁药。

e.en: The paper discussed adverse reactions to {nialamide}.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了尼亚拉胺的不良反应。

e.en: In Theravada Buddhism, {nibbana} is the end of suffering.
e.zh: 在上座部佛教中，涅槃意味着苦的终结。

e.en: The monk described {nibbana} as freedom from craving.
e.zh: 那位僧人把涅槃描述为摆脱贪欲的自由境界。

e.en: Engineers sometimes express loudness ratios in {nibel}.
e.zh: 工程师有时用尼贝尔表示响度比。

e.en: A {nibel} is related to the more familiar decibel.
e.zh: 尼贝尔与更常见的分贝有关。

e.en: The valve was made from a heat-resistant {nicalloy}.
e.zh: 这个阀门由耐热镍合金制成。

e.en: A {nicalloy} coating can protect the surface from wear.
e.zh: 镍合金涂层可以保护表面免受磨损。

e.en: The museum displayed a sample of {niccolite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块红砷镍矿标本。

e.en: Miners identified {niccolite} by its copper-red color.
e.zh: 矿工通过铜红色辨认出红砷镍矿。

e.en: She bought a {nice-looking} jacket for the interview.
e.zh: 她为面试买了一件好看的夹克。

e.en: The apartment is {nice-looking}, but the rent is high.
e.zh: 这套公寓看起来不错，但租金很高。

e.en: He sounded like a {nice-nelly} when he objected to every joke.
e.zh: 他反对每个玩笑时，听起来像个过分拘谨的人。

e.en: The editor removed the slang to satisfy the {nice-nelly} readers.
e.zh: 编辑删掉了俚语，以迎合那些过分守礼的读者。

e.en: His {nicey} smile made the apology feel false.
e.zh: 他那种装出来的友善笑容让道歉显得很假。

e.en: The speech was too {nicey} to sound honest.
e.zh: 那篇讲话太过讨好，听起来不够真诚。

newsfront.t: 新闻报道前线；新闻界前沿

e.en: The reporter returned from the {newsfront} exhausted.
e.zh: 那名记者从新闻报道前线回来时筋疲力尽。

e.en: Digital platforms reshaped the political {newsfront}.
e.zh: 数字平台重塑了政治新闻界的前沿。

e.en: A {newsgirl} shouted headlines outside the station.
e.zh: 一个女报童在车站外大声喊着新闻标题。

e.en: The young {newsgirl} filed reports after midnight.
e.zh: 那位年轻女新闻从业者午夜后还在发稿。

newshawk.t: 敏锐记者；热衷新闻的人

e.en: The veteran {newshawk} spotted the scandal early.
e.zh: 那位老练的敏锐记者很早就发现了这桩丑闻。

e.en: Every office has a {newshawk} watching alerts.
e.zh: 每个办公室都有个热衷新闻的人盯着快讯。

e.en: The cafe left a local {newsheet} on each table.
e.zh: 咖啡馆在每张桌上放了一份本地新闻单页。

e.en: His first job was printing a weekly {newsheet}.
e.zh: 他的第一份工作是印刷一份每周小报纸。

e.en: The {newsie} waved papers at passing commuters.
e.zh: 那个报童向路过的通勤者挥舞着报纸。

e.en: In the film, a cheerful {newsie} sings downtown.
e.zh: 在电影里，一个开朗的卖报人在市中心唱歌。

newsier.t: 更像新闻的；新闻味更浓的

e.en: The editor wanted a {newsier} opening paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑想要一个新闻味更浓的开头段落。

e.en: Her second version sounded {newsier} and sharper.
e.zh: 她的第二版听起来更像新闻，也更有力度。

e.en: The producer questioned the story's {newsiness}.
e.zh: 制片人质疑这个故事的新闻性。

e.en: A plain headline increased the article's {newsiness}.
e.zh: 朴素的标题增强了这篇文章的新闻味。

newsless.t: 没有新闻的；缺少消息的

e.en: It was a strangely {newsless} Sunday morning.
e.zh: 那是一个奇怪地没有新闻的星期天早晨。

e.en: After the blackout, families endured {newsless} days.
e.zh: 停电之后，各家人熬过了缺少消息的日子。

newsmagazine.t: 新闻杂志；新闻专题节目

e.en: She subscribed to a weekly {newsmagazine}.
e.zh: 她订阅了一份周刊新闻杂志。

e.en: The {newsmagazine} aired a segment on housing.
e.zh: 那个新闻专题节目播出了一段关于住房的报道。

newsmonger.t: 传播新闻者；爱传消息的人

e.en: A tireless {newsmonger} spread updates through town.
e.zh: 一个不知疲倦的传播新闻者把最新消息传遍全城。

e.en: Do not trust every office {newsmonger}.
e.zh: 不要相信办公室里每个爱传消息的人。

e.en: His constant {newsmongering} annoyed the staff.
e.zh: 他不停散布消息，让同事们很厌烦。

e.en: The pamphlet mixed politics with {newsmongering}.
e.zh: 那本小册子把政治观点和传播新闻混在一起。

e.en: The {newspaperwoman} interviewed workers at dawn.
e.zh: 那位女报社记者清晨采访了工人。

e.en: As a {newspaperwoman}, she covered city politics.
e.zh: 作为一名女报人，她报道城市政治。

e.en: A {newsperson} asked the minister a direct question.
e.zh: 一名新闻记者向部长提了一个直接的问题。

e.en: Every {newsperson} needs reliable sources.
e.zh: 每个新闻工作者都需要可靠的消息来源。

e.en: The {newsvendor} opened his stall before sunrise.
e.zh: 那个报贩在日出前就开了摊。

e.en: She bought the evening paper from a {newsvendor}.
e.zh: 她从一个卖报人那里买了晚报。

e.en: The {newswriter} rewrote the lead twice.
e.zh: 那位新闻撰稿人把导语改写了两次。

e.en: A skilled {newswriter} makes facts readable.
e.zh: 熟练的新闻作者能让事实读起来清楚易懂。

e.en: The course teaches basic {newswriting} skills.
e.zh: 这门课程教授基本的新闻写作技巧。

e.en: Good {newswriting} avoids vague claims.
e.zh: 好的新闻稿写法会避免含糊的说法。

e.en: The old legal text called him a {nex}.
e.zh: 那部古老的法律文本称他为杀人者。

e.en: Scholars debated whether {nex} meant violent death.
e.zh: 学者们争论nex是否指暴死。

e.en: We chose the {next-best} route after the bridge closed.
e.zh: 桥关闭后，我们选择了次优路线。

e.en: The algorithm recommends the {next-best} action.
e.zh: 该算法会推荐仅次于最佳的行动。

nexum.t: 古罗马债务契约；债役关系

e.en: The historian explained {nexum} in Roman law.
e.zh: 历史学家解释了罗马法中的古罗马债务契约。

e.en: Under {nexum}, debt could bind a person harshly.
e.zh: 在债役关系下，债务可能严厉束缚一个人。

e.en: The musician played a mournful {ney} solo.
e.zh: 那位音乐家演奏了一段哀婉的尼伊笛独奏。

e.en: A wooden {ney} lay beside the drum.
e.zh: 一支木制中东长笛放在鼓旁边。

e.en: The archer won by a single {nickpoint}.
e.zh: 那名弓箭手只以一分取胜。

e.en: A tiny {nickpoint} marked the edge of the old scale.
e.zh: 旧刻度的边缘有一个小刻痕。

e.en: The chemist studied a {nicotian} extract from dried leaves.
e.zh: 化学家研究了干叶中的烟草提取物。

e.en: The report described the {nicotian} odor in the sample.
e.zh: 报告描述了样品里的烟草气味。

e.en: Old medical texts often spelled nicotine as {nicotin}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献常把尼古丁写作nicotin。

e.en: The assay detected traces of {nicotin} in the solution.
e.zh: 检测在溶液中发现了微量烟碱。

e.en: The serum contains {nicotinamide} to support the skin barrier.
e.zh: 这款精华含有烟酰胺，有助于维护皮肤屏障。

e.en: Doctors may prescribe {nicotinamide} for certain deficiency symptoms.
e.zh: 医生可能会为某些缺乏症状开烟酰胺。

e.en: The drug acts on {nicotinic} receptors in the nervous system.
e.zh: 这种药作用于神经系统中的尼古丁受体。

e.en: The label listed {nicotinic} acid as an active ingredient.
e.zh: 标签把烟酸列为有效成分。

e.en: Chronic {nicotinism} can affect sleep and appetite.
e.zh: 长期尼古丁中毒会影响睡眠和食欲。

e.en: The physician noted signs of {nicotinism} in the heavy smoker.
e.zh: 医生在这名重度吸烟者身上发现了烟瘾相关症状。

nicotinize.t: 使含尼古丁；用烟草处理

e.en: The experiment tried to {nicotinize} the solution gradually.
e.zh: 实验尝试逐步让溶液含有尼古丁。

e.en: Workers once used smoke to {nicotinize} stored plant samples.
e.zh: 工人过去曾用烟雾处理储存的植物样本。

e.en: The lab measured {nicotinoylglycine} in the urine sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了尿样中的烟酰甘氨酸。

e.en: Higher {nicotinoylglycine} levels may reflect changes in niacin metabolism.
e.zh: 较高的烟酰甘氨酸水平可能反映烟酸代谢变化。

e.en: Researchers identified {nicotyrin} among several tobacco alkaloids.
e.zh: 研究人员在几种烟草生物碱中鉴定出尼古替林。

e.en: The old paper discussed {nicotyrin} as a minor compound.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把尼古替林作为一种次要化合物讨论。

e.en: The database listed {nicoxin} as a little-studied compound.
e.zh: 数据库把尼可辛列为研究很少的化合物。

e.en: A faint peak suggested {nicoxin} might be present.
e.zh: 一个微弱峰值表明可能存在尼可辛。

e.en: The collector labeled the green specimen as {nicrite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块绿色标本标为尼克石。

e.en: Few modern manuals mention {nicrite} by that name.
e.zh: 现代手册很少用这个名称提到尼克石。

e.en: Some reptiles {nictate} to clear dust from the eye.
e.zh: 有些爬行动物会眨动瞬膜来清除眼里的灰尘。

e.en: The bird seemed to {nictate} before it took off.
e.zh: 那只鸟起飞前似乎眨动了一下瞬膜。

e.en: The turtle's {nictating} membrane slid across its eye.
e.zh: 乌龟的瞬膜滑过它的眼睛。

e.en: A {nictating} motion protected the bird from blowing sand.
e.zh: 一次瞬膜眨动保护了那只鸟免受飞沙刺激。

e.en: Rapid {nictation} kept the animal's eyes moist.
e.zh: 快速眨动让这只动物的眼睛保持湿润。

e.en: The vet checked for normal {nictation} after the injury.
e.zh: 兽医在受伤后检查瞬膜眨动是否正常。

e.en: The {nictitant} lid moved sideways across the hawk's eye.
e.zh: 那层会眨动的眼睑横向扫过鹰的眼睛。

e.en: Biologists recorded the {nictitant} response under bright light.
e.zh: 生物学家记录了强光下的瞬膜反应。

e.en: The lizard may {nictitate} when sand blows toward it.
e.zh: 沙子吹来时，蜥蜴可能会眨动瞬膜。

e.en: Bright light made the bird {nictitate} repeatedly.
e.zh: 强光让那只鸟反复眨动瞬膜。

e.en: The gecko {nictitated} after the dust settled.
e.zh: 尘土落定后，壁虎眨动了瞬膜。

e.en: It {nictitated} twice under the veterinarian's lamp.
e.zh: 它在兽医的灯下眨动了两次瞬膜。

e.en: The owl {nictitates} when the light suddenly changes.
e.zh: 光线突然变化时，猫头鹰会眨动瞬膜。

e.en: A shark {nictitates} to protect its eye during contact.
e.zh: 鲨鱼在接触时会眨动瞬膜来保护眼睛。

e.en: The old pamphlet called gambling a {nicious} habit.
e.zh: 那本旧小册子把赌博称为一种有害的习惯。

e.en: He warned against the {nicious} influence of flattery.
e.zh: 他警告人们提防奉承带来的邪恶影响。

nicish.t: 有点好看的；还算不错的

e.en: The room looked {nicish} after we cleaned it.
e.zh: 我们打扫后，房间看起来还算不错。

e.en: It was a {nicish} little cafe, though rather noisy.
e.zh: 那是一家有点不错的小咖啡馆，只是相当吵。

e.en: Every shelf was crowded with {nick-nacks} from her travels.
e.zh: 每个架子上都摆满了她旅行带回来的小装饰品。

e.en: He bought a cheap {nick-nack} at the market.
e.zh: 他在市场上买了一个便宜的小玩意儿。

e.en: Her {nick-name} at school was Bee.
e.zh: 她在学校的绰号是“小蜜蜂”。

e.en: The players {nick-named} the coach the General.
e.zh: 队员们给教练起了个绰号叫“将军”。

e.en: The airline tries to {nickel-and-dime} passengers with extra fees.
e.zh: 这家航空公司用各种额外收费来一点点盘剥乘客。

e.en: Stop the {nickel-and-dime} arguments and solve the main problem.
e.zh: 别再为小钱斤斤计较了，先解决主要问题。

e.en: The valve was made from {nickel-bronze} for corrosion resistance.
e.zh: 这个阀门用镍青铜制成，以增强耐腐蚀性。

e.en: Collectors admired the warm color of the {nickel-bronze} medal.
e.zh: 收藏者欣赏这枚镍青铜奖章温润的色泽。

e.en: They decided to {nickel-plate} the old brass handles.
e.zh: 他们决定给旧黄铜把手镀镍。

e.en: The thin {nickel-plate} began to peel near the edge.
e.zh: 边缘附近那层薄薄的镀镍层开始剥落。

e.en: The antenna core uses {nickelferrite} to improve performance.
e.zh: 这个天线磁芯使用镍铁氧体来提升性能。

e.en: Researchers measured how {nickelferrite} behaved in a magnetic field.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了镍铁氧体在磁场中的表现。

e.en: The chemist described a rare {nickelic} compound in the report.
e.zh: 化学家在报告中描述了一种罕见的高价镍化合物。

e.en: The {nickelic} oxide was unstable under ordinary conditions.
e.zh: 这种三价镍氧化物在普通条件下并不稳定。

e.en: The company surveyed {nickeliferous} rocks near the old mine.
e.zh: 公司勘测了旧矿附近的含镍岩石。

e.en: A {nickeliferous} ore can be valuable even at low grades.
e.zh: 含镍矿石即使品位较低也可能有价值。

e.en: The mineral sample was identified as {nickeline}.
e.zh: 这块矿物样品被鉴定为红砷镍矿。

e.en: Miners once mistook {nickeline} for a copper ore.
e.zh: 矿工曾经把红砷镍矿误认为铜矿。

e.en: The workshop can {nickelize} small steel parts.
e.zh: 这家作坊可以给小型钢件镀镍。

e.en: Engineers tried to {nickelize} the surface for durability.
e.zh: 工程师试图使表面镍化以提高耐用性。

e.en: The {nickelized} screws resisted rust for years.
e.zh: 这些镀镍螺丝多年都能防锈。

e.en: A {nickelized} surface gives the instrument a bright finish.
e.zh: 镍化表面让这件仪器呈现明亮的光泽。

e.en: The factory added a {nickelizing} line for metal fittings.
e.zh: 工厂增加了一条用于金属配件的镀镍处理线。

e.en: {Nickelizing} the parts improved their resistance to wear.
e.zh: 对这些零件进行镍化提高了它们的耐磨性。

nickelodeon.t: 五分钱影院；自动点唱机

e.en: They watched silent films in an old {nickelodeon}.
e.zh: 他们在一家老式五分钱影院里看无声电影。

e.en: The bar kept a vintage {nickelodeon} near the door.
e.zh: 酒吧把一台老式自动点唱机放在门边。

e.en: The experiment used a {nickelous} salt in solution.
e.zh: 实验使用了一种溶液中的二价镍盐。

e.en: A {nickelous} compound often has a green color.
e.zh: 亚镍化合物常常呈绿色。

e.en: The carpenter checked the {nickings} along the edge.
e.zh: 木匠检查了边缘上的那些刻痕。

e.en: Small {nickings} in the blade made the cut uneven.
e.zh: 刀刃上的小缺口让切口变得不平整。

e.en: He found an old {nickle} in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里找到一枚旧镍币。

e.en: The label used {nickle}, an old spelling of nickel.
e.zh: 标签上用了nickle，这是nickel的旧拼法。

e.en: She dusted every {nicknack} on the mantelpiece.
e.zh: 她把壁炉架上的每个小装饰品都掸了灰。

e.en: Tourists bought a bright {nicknack} from the stall.
e.zh: 游客们从摊位上买了一个鲜艳的小玩意儿。

nielli.t: 乌银镶嵌物的复数或相关形式

e.en: The museum case displayed several {nielli} from medieval Italy.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里陈列着几件来自中世纪意大利的乌银镶嵌品。

e.en: Collectors prized the tiny {nielli} for their dark inlaid patterns.
e.zh: 收藏者看重这些小乌银镶嵌品，是因为它们深色的嵌花纹样。

e.en: The {niellist} worked silver into a delicate black design.
e.zh: 那位乌银镶嵌工匠把银器做成精细的黑色图案。

e.en: A skilled {niellist} could turn a plain cup into a luxury object.
e.zh: 熟练的乌银匠能把普通杯子变成奢华器物。

e.en: The bracelet was decorated with {niello} and gold leaf.
e.zh: 这只手镯饰有乌银和金箔。

e.en: The artist learned {niello} from an old metalsmith.
e.zh: 这位艺术家从一位老金属匠那里学会了乌银镶嵌工艺。

e.en: She found a {nielloed} dagger in the antique shop.
e.zh: 她在古董店里发现了一把饰有乌银镶嵌的匕首。

e.en: The {nielloed} cross had survived for centuries.
e.zh: 那枚乌银镶嵌十字架保存了数百年。

e.en: Some early papers used {nielsbohrium} for element 105.
e.zh: 一些早期论文用nielsbohrium来称呼第105号元素。

e.en: The name {nielsbohrium} was later replaced by dubnium.
e.zh: nielsbohrium这个名称后来被“𨧀”取代。

e.en: The old poem says he raised his {nieve} in anger.
e.zh: 那首古诗说他愤怒地举起了拳头。

e.en: She held the coin tight in her {nieve}.
e.zh: 她把硬币紧紧攥在手里。

e.en: The engineer tested an old {nife} cell in the workshop.
e.zh: 工程师在车间测试了一只旧镍铁电池。

e.en: Meteorites often contain {nife} mixed with other minerals.
e.zh: 陨石常含有与其他矿物混在一起的镍铁合金。

e.en: Older geology texts called the core the {nifesphere}.
e.zh: 较早的地质学教材把地核称为镍铁圈层。

e.en: The {nifesphere} was thought to contain mostly nickel and iron.
e.zh: 人们曾认为镍铁圈主要由镍和铁组成。

e.en: A sour {niff} came from the drain.
e.zh: 下水道里传来一股酸臭味。

e.en: The bins began to {niff} in the summer heat.
e.zh: 垃圾桶在夏日高温下开始发臭。

e.en: He {niffed} the cork before tasting the wine.
e.zh: 他尝酒前先闻了闻软木塞。

e.en: The wet towels {niffed} after a day in the bag.
e.zh: 湿毛巾在包里放了一天后发出了臭味。

e.en: The dog was a good {niffer} of hidden food.
e.zh: 这条狗很会闻出藏起来的食物。

e.en: That old cheese is a real {niffer}.
e.zh: 那块老奶酪真是臭得厉害。

e.en: The room smelled {niffy} after the windows stayed shut.
e.zh: 窗户一直关着，房间里有点臭。

e.en: He threw away the {niffy} socks immediately.
e.zh: 他立刻把那双有味儿的袜子扔掉了。

e.en: The specimen was identified as {nifontovite} by a mineral expert.
e.zh: 矿物专家把这件标本鉴定为尼丰托夫石。

e.en: Crystals of {nifontovite} are rarely seen outside specialist collections.
e.zh: 尼丰托夫石晶体在专业收藏之外很少见到。

e.en: That was a {niftic} solution to a small problem.
e.zh: 那是解决小问题的一个漂亮办法。

e.en: He made a {niftic} turn through the narrow doorway.
e.zh: 他灵巧地一转身穿过了狭窄门口。

e.en: This app has a {niftier} search tool than the old one.
e.zh: 这个应用的搜索工具比旧版更巧妙。

e.en: She bought a {niftier} jacket for the party.
e.zh: 她为了参加聚会买了一件更时髦的夹克。

nig-nog.t: 侮辱黑人或傻瓜的旧俗语

e.en: The editor removed {nig-nog} because it was offensive.
e.zh: 编辑删掉了nig-nog这个词，因为它带有冒犯性。

e.en: In old slang, {nig-nog} could also mean a foolish person.
e.zh: 在旧俚语中，nig-nog也可指愚蠢的人。

e.en: The bird's {nictitating} membrane swept across its eye.
e.zh: 那只鸟的瞬膜掠过眼睛。

e.en: A {nictitating} motion protected the reptile's dry eye.
e.zh: 一种眨动般的动作保护了爬行动物干燥的眼睛。

e.en: His {nicy} answer made the whole room laugh.
e.zh: 他傻里傻气的回答让全屋人都笑了。

e.en: She dismissed the rumor as {nicy} village talk.
e.zh: 她把那个传言当成愚蠢的乡间闲话。

e.en: The old guard began to {nid-nod} by the fire.
e.zh: 老守卫在火炉旁开始打瞌睡。

e.en: His head made a slow {nid-nod} during the sermon.
e.zh: 听布道时，他的头慢慢一点一晃。

e.en: The squid releases a {nidamental} jelly around its eggs.
e.zh: 鱿鱼会在卵周围释放卵囊状胶质。

e.en: Biologists examined the bird's {nidamental} behavior in spring.
e.zh: 生物学家观察了这种鸟春季的筑巢行为。

e.en: Successful {nidation} occurs soon after the embryo reaches the uterus.
e.zh: 胚胎到达子宫后不久会发生成功着床。

e.en: The paper used {nidation} to describe early nest formation.
e.zh: 论文用nidation一词描述早期筑巢过程。

e.en: The knight called him a {niddering} coward.
e.zh: 骑士骂他是个卑怯的懦夫。

e.en: No {niddering} soul would cross that bridge at night.
e.zh: 没有哪个胆怯的人会在夜里过那座桥。

e.en: The sleepy child began to {niddle-noddle} in the chair.
e.zh: 困倦的孩子坐在椅子上开始摇头晃脑。

e.en: Do not {niddle-noddle} when a firm answer is needed.
e.zh: 需要明确答复时，不要犹豫不定。

e.en: A {nide} of pheasants rose from the grass.
e.zh: 一窝雉鸡从草丛里飞了起来。

e.en: A noisy {nide} of students crowded the doorway.
e.zh: 一群吵闹的学生挤在门口。

e.en: He was branded a {nidering} after fleeing the fight.
e.zh: 他逃离战斗后被骂成懦夫。

e.en: The tale mocks the {nidering} lord who betrayed his guests.
e.zh: 这个故事嘲笑那个背叛客人的卑怯领主。

e.en: She gave him a {nidge} to make him move over.
e.zh: 她轻轻推了他一下，让他挪开。

e.en: Stop trying to {nidge} me into changing my mind.
e.zh: 别再烦我，想逼我改主意了。

e.en: Only a {nidget} would leave the gate unlocked.
e.zh: 只有笨人才会让大门不上锁。

e.en: He felt like a complete {nidget} after the mistake.
e.zh: 犯错之后，他觉得自己简直是个傻瓜。

e.en: His {nidgeting} hands betrayed his nervousness.
e.zh: 他不停乱动的手暴露了紧张。

e.en: Stop {nidgeting} with the papers during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别再摆弄那些文件了。

e.en: The scans showed several {nidi} of infection.
e.zh: 扫描显示有几处感染病灶。

e.en: The researchers counted the {nidi} built under the rocks.
e.zh: 研究人员数了数岩石下筑成的巢。

e.en: Many {nidicolous} chicks depend on their parents for weeks.
e.zh: 许多留巢性雏鸟要依赖父母好几周。

e.en: The beetle is {nidicolous} and lives inside bird nests.
e.zh: 这种甲虫有巢居习性，生活在鸟巢里。

e.en: These swallows {nidificate} under the old bridge every spring.
e.zh: 这些燕子每年春天都在老桥下筑巢。

e.en: The species will not {nidificate} without sheltered branches.
e.zh: 没有遮蔽的树枝，这个物种就不会营巢。

e.en: The pair had {nidificated} in the same tree before.
e.zh: 这一对鸟以前曾在同一棵树上筑过巢。

e.en: A {nidificated} hollow was found near the stream.
e.zh: 溪边发现了一个已被筑巢利用过的树洞。

e.en: A {nidificating} robin carried moss to the hedge.
e.zh: 一只正在筑巢的知更鸟把苔藓叼到树篱里。

e.en: The law protects {nidificating} birds during breeding season.
e.zh: 法律在繁殖季保护正在营巢的鸟类。

e.en: Early {nidification} begins before the first eggs appear.
e.zh: 早期筑巢在第一批卵出现前就开始了。

e.en: The guide describes {nidification} in coastal birds.
e.zh: 这本指南描述了海岸鸟类的营巢过程。

e.en: Ducklings are {nidifugous} and leave the nest soon after hatching.
e.zh: 小鸭是离巢性的，孵化后很快离开巢。

e.en: The {nidifugous} young followed their mother across the field.
e.zh: 这些早成离巢的幼鸟跟着母鸟穿过田野。

e.en: The birds {nidify} in cliffs above the sea.
e.zh: 这些鸟在海边峭壁上筑巢。

e.en: They rarely {nidify} near busy roads.
e.zh: 它们很少在繁忙道路附近营巢。

e.en: The saga names the traitor a {niding}.
e.zh: 这部传奇把叛徒称作懦夫。

e.en: He feared being remembered as a {niding}.
e.zh: 他害怕后人记住他是个卑怯之人。

e.en: A greasy {nidor} drifted from the kitchen.
e.zh: 一股油腻的焦肉味从厨房飘来。

e.en: The old text describes the {nidor} of burnt offerings.
e.zh: 古书描述了祭品焚烧后的刺鼻气味。

e.en: A {nidorous} smoke filled the narrow room.
e.zh: 一股带焦肉臭的烟充满了狭窄房间。

e.en: The medicine had a {nidorous} smell he disliked.
e.zh: 那药有一种刺鼻气味，他很不喜欢。

e.en: The wound became a {nidus} for infection.
e.zh: 伤口成了感染的病灶。

e.en: The abandoned house was a {nidus} of local rumors.
e.zh: 那座废弃房子成了当地谣言的滋生地。

e.en: The old emergency kit contained {nikethamide} ampoules.
e.zh: 旧急救箱里有尼可刹米安瓿。

e.en: Doctors rarely use {nikethamide} in modern practice.
e.zh: 现代临床中医生很少使用尼可刹米。

e.en: A {nilgau} moved through the dry grass.
e.zh: 一只蓝牛羚穿过干草地。

e.en: The reserve protects the {nilgau} from hunters.
e.zh: 保护区让蓝牛羚免受猎人伤害。

e.en: He would {nill} the offer if pressed.
e.zh: 如果受到逼迫，他会拒绝这个提议。

e.en: She seemed to {nill} every compromise.
e.zh: 她似乎不愿接受任何妥协。

e.en: The paper studies a compact {nilmanifold}.
e.zh: 这篇论文研究一个紧的幂零流形。

e.en: A {nilmanifold} can arise from a nilpotent Lie group.
e.zh: 幂零流形可以来自幂零李群。

e.en: This matrix is {nilpotent} after three powers.
e.zh: 这个矩阵三次幂后变为零矩阵。

e.en: The algebra contains a {nilpotent} element.
e.zh: 这个代数中含有一个幂零元素。

e.en: The {nilradical} contains all nilpotent elements.
e.zh: 幂零根基包含所有幂零元素。

e.en: She computed the {nilradical} of the ring.
e.zh: 她计算了这个环的幂零根基。

e.en: The saint appeared {nimbed} in gold.
e.zh: 圣人显得有金色光环环绕。

e.en: The moon was {nimbed} by thin cloud.
e.zh: 月亮被薄云形成的光圈笼罩。

e.en: The icons showed saints with golden {nimbi}.
e.zh: 圣像上圣人都有金色光环。

e.en: Dark {nimbi} gathered over the hills.
e.zh: 阴沉的雨云聚集在群山上空。

e.en: The {nimble-fingered} tailor fixed the tear quickly.
e.zh: 手指灵巧的裁缝很快补好了裂口。

e.en: A {nimble-fingered} thief lifted the wallet.
e.zh: 一个手脚灵巧的小偷顺走了钱包。

e.en: The {nimble-footed} dancer crossed the stage.
e.zh: 脚步敏捷的舞者穿过舞台。

e.en: A {nimble-footed} defender blocked the attack.
e.zh: 一名脚步灵活的后卫挡住了进攻。

e.en: Her {nimble-witted} reply ended the argument.
e.zh: 她机智敏捷的回答结束了争论。

e.en: A {nimble-witted} lawyer spotted the contradiction.
e.zh: 一位头脑敏捷的律师发现了矛盾。

e.en: The {nimblehanded} mechanic replaced the tiny spring.
e.zh: 手巧的机械师换好了那枚小弹簧。

e.en: A {nimblehanded} magician shuffled the cards.
e.zh: 手法灵活的魔术师洗着牌。

e.en: She was the {nimblest} climber in the group.
e.zh: 她是队里最敏捷的攀登者。

e.en: Even the {nimblest} mind needs rest.
e.zh: 即使最机灵的头脑也需要休息。

e.en: The court valued him as a {nimblewit}.
e.zh: 宫廷看重他这个机敏的人。

e.en: Only a {nimblewit} could answer so quickly.
e.zh: 只有头脑机敏的人才能答得这么快。

e.en: She left a {night-light} on for the child.
e.zh: 她给孩子留了一盏小夜灯。

e.en: The hallway {night-light} glowed softly.
e.zh: 走廊里的夜灯发出柔和的光。

e.en: The {night-line} runs after midnight.
e.zh: 这条夜间线路在午夜后仍运行。

e.en: He called the emergency {night-line}.
e.zh: 他拨打了夜间紧急热线。

e.en: We took the {night-liner} to Berlin.
e.zh: 我们乘夜行客车去了柏林。

e.en: The {night-liner} was full of students.
e.zh: 那辆夜间班车坐满了学生。

e.en: They held a {night-long} vigil.
e.zh: 他们守了一整夜。

e.en: A {night-long} storm flooded the road.
e.zh: 持续一夜的暴雨淹没了道路。

e.en: Say {night-night} to Grandma.
e.zh: 跟奶奶说晚安吧。

e.en: The toddler went {night-night} early.
e.zh: 那个幼儿很早就睡觉觉了。

e.en: She works the {night-shift} at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院上夜班。

e.en: The {night-shift} cleaned the factory floor.
e.zh: 夜班工人清扫了工厂车间。

e.en: That {night-spot} is popular with tourists.
e.zh: 那家夜间娱乐场所很受游客欢迎。

e.en: Police visited the crowded {night-spot}.
e.zh: 警方去了那家拥挤的夜店。

e.en: The bus makes one {night-stop} here.
e.zh: 这趟公交夜间在这里停靠一次。

e.en: They planned a {night-stop} in Lyon.
e.zh: 他们计划在里昂过夜停留。

e.en: The city is quiet at {night-time}.
e.zh: 这座城市夜间很安静。

e.en: Use softer lights for {night-time} reading.
e.zh: 晚上阅读时用柔和一点的灯光。

e.en: The {night-watchman} checked every door.
e.zh: 夜间守卫检查了每一扇门。

e.en: A retired soldier became a {night-watchman}.
e.zh: 一名退伍士兵当了夜班看门人。

night-watchmen.t: 夜间守卫们；夜班看门人

e.en: The {night-watchmen} patrolled the warehouse.
e.zh: 夜间守卫们在仓库巡逻。

e.en: Two {night-watchmen} reported the fire.
e.zh: 两名夜班看门人报告了火情。

e.en: A {nightbird} called from the trees.
e.zh: 一只夜鸟在树丛中鸣叫。

e.en: My sister is a real {nightbird}.
e.zh: 我妹妹真是个夜猫子。

e.en: The fisherman used a {nightcrawler} as bait.
e.zh: 渔夫用一条夜行蚯蚓作鱼饵。

e.en: The reporter was a city {nightcrawler}.
e.zh: 那名记者是个城市夜间活动者。

e.en: The {nightglow} softened the horizon.
e.zh: 夜空辉光让地平线显得柔和。

e.en: We saw a faint {nightglow} above town.
e.zh: 我们看到城镇上方有淡淡夜光。

e.en: They spent a {nightless} summer in Iceland.
e.zh: 他们在冰岛度过了一个无夜的夏天。

e.en: The {nightless} sky confused the travelers.
e.zh: 白夜般的天空让旅人感到迷惑。

e.en: The music played {nightlong}.
e.zh: 音乐整夜都在播放。

e.en: Their {nightlong} debate ended at dawn.
e.zh: 他们持续一夜的辩论在黎明结束。

e.en: The {nightman} locked the building at ten.
e.zh: 夜班工人在十点锁上了大楼。

e.en: A {nightman} emptied the old privies.
e.zh: 旧时掏粪工清理了那些老式厕所。

nightmen.t: 夜班工人们；旧时掏粪工

e.en: The {nightmen} arrived after dark.
e.zh: 夜班工人们天黑后到了。

e.en: The town hired {nightmen} for sanitation.
e.zh: 镇上雇了掏粪工处理卫生事务。

e.en: A lone {nightrider} crossed the bridge.
e.zh: 一个孤独的夜骑者穿过了桥。

e.en: The story follows a masked {nightrider}.
e.zh: 这个故事讲述一名蒙面夜间巡行者。

e.en: The probe photographed the planet's {nightside}.
e.zh: 探测器拍下了这颗行星的夜半球。

e.en: The novel explores the city's {nightside}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了城市的黑暗面。

e.en: Owls have excellent {nightsight}.
e.zh: 猫头鹰有极佳的夜视能力。

e.en: The rifle carried a {nightsight}.
e.zh: 那支步枪装有夜视瞄具。

e.en: The old room had a wooden {nightstool}.
e.zh: 那间旧房里有一只木制夜壶凳。

e.en: She moved the {nightstool} beside the bed.
e.zh: 她把床边便盆凳移到床旁。

e.en: Fever gave him terrible {nightsweats}.
e.zh: 发烧让他夜里盗汗得很厉害。

e.en: Persistent {nightsweats} should be checked.
e.zh: 持续夜间盗汗应该去检查。

e.en: The bells rang at {nighttide}.
e.zh: 钟声在夜间响起。

e.en: Boats returned with the {nighttide}.
e.zh: 船只随着夜潮时分返回。

e.en: The taxi entered {nighttown} after midnight.
e.zh: 出租车午夜后驶入夜间城区。

e.en: The play moves through a dreamlike {nighttown}.
e.zh: 这出戏穿行在梦一般的声色场所。

nightviewer.t: 夜间观看者；夜视装置用户

e.en: The {nightviewer} watched the sky for meteors.
e.zh: 那名夜间观看者观察天空寻找流星。

e.en: A careful {nightviewer} can spot faint movement.
e.zh: 细心的夜视者能发现微弱的动静。

e.en: The old town felt safe for a {nightwalker}.
e.zh: 这座老城让夜行者觉得安全。

e.en: In folklore, a {nightwalker} may mean a ghost.
e.zh: 在民间传说中，夜行者可能指鬼魂。

e.en: He took the {nightwatch} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中他负责夜间值班。

e.en: The {nightwatch} reported a fire near the docks.
e.zh: 守夜人报告码头附近起了火。

e.en: Long {nightwork} can disturb normal sleep.
e.zh: 长期夜间工作会打乱正常睡眠。

e.en: The road repairs required noisy {nightwork}.
e.zh: 道路维修需要在夜里进行嘈杂施工。

e.en: She packed a cotton {nighty} for the trip.
e.zh: 她为旅行带了一件棉质睡衣。

e.en: The child whispered {nighty} and closed his eyes.
e.zh: 孩子小声说了句晚安就闭上眼睛。

e.en: Mom kissed him and said, {nighty-night}.
e.zh: 妈妈亲了亲他说，晚安。

e.en: The sleepy toddler mumbled {nighty-night} to everyone.
e.zh: 困倦的小孩含糊地向大家说晚安。

e.en: We ordered salmon {nigiri} at the sushi bar.
e.zh: 我们在寿司吧点了三文鱼握寿司。

e.en: Good {nigiri} needs warm rice and fresh fish.
e.zh: 好的握寿司需要温热米饭和新鲜鱼肉。

e.en: Old texts say the metal may {nigrate} with age.
e.zh: 古籍说这种金属会随年代变黑。

e.en: The chemical can {nigrate} the pale surface.
e.zh: 这种化学品会使浅色表面变黑。

e.en: The manuscript describes {nigredo} as spiritual darkness.
e.zh: 手稿把黑化阶段描述为精神上的黑暗。

e.en: In alchemy, {nigredo} begins the transformation.
e.zh: 在炼金术中，黑化阶段开启转化过程。

e.en: The painter admired the {nigrescence} of the glaze.
e.zh: 画家欣赏釉面逐渐发黑的效果。

e.en: Botanists noted {nigrescence} on the dying leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了枯叶上的发黑现象。

e.en: The shell had a {nigrescent} edge.
e.zh: 贝壳边缘带着渐黑的颜色。

e.en: A {nigrescent} stain spread across the paper.
e.zh: 一块发黑的污渍在纸上扩散开来。

e.en: The experiment measured {nigrification} under heat.
e.zh: 实验测量了加热条件下的黑化作用。

e.en: Artists sometimes use {nigrification} for dramatic shadows.
e.zh: 艺术家有时利用变黑效果营造强烈阴影。

e.en: The silver coin had {nigrified} in the damp soil.
e.zh: 银币在潮湿土壤中已经变黑。

e.en: Smoke {nigrified} the ceiling above the stove.
e.zh: 烟把炉子上方的天花板熏黑了。

e.en: Moist air slowly {nigrifies} the exposed metal.
e.zh: 潮湿空气会慢慢使裸露金属变黑。

e.en: The compound {nigrifies} when it reacts with light.
e.zh: 这种化合物遇光反应时会变黑。

e.en: The treatment will {nigrify} the pale leather.
e.zh: 这种处理会让浅色皮革变黑。

e.en: Some minerals {nigrify} after long exposure.
e.zh: 有些矿物长期暴露后会变黑。

e.en: The {nigrifying} solution stained his gloves.
e.zh: 这种会使物体变黑的溶液弄脏了他的手套。

e.en: She photographed the {nigrifying} clouds at dusk.
e.zh: 她拍下了黄昏时逐渐变黑的云。

e.en: The poem uses {nigritude} to suggest despair.
e.zh: 这首诗用黑暗状态来暗示绝望。

e.en: Medieval writers linked {nigritude} with decay.
e.zh: 中世纪作家把黑色与腐朽联系起来。

e.en: The lab used {nigrosine} to stain the sample.
e.zh: 实验室用苯胺黑染料给样本染色。

e.en: Old ink formulas sometimes contained {nigrosine}.
e.zh: 旧式墨水配方有时含有苯胺黑。

e.en: Parkinson's disease damages the {nigrostriatal} pathway.
e.zh: 帕金森病会损伤黑质纹状体通路。

e.en: The study measured {nigrostriatal} dopamine activity.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了黑质纹状体的多巴胺活动。

e.en: The crusher liners were made from {nihard}.
e.zh: 破碎机衬板由高镍耐磨铸铁制成。

e.en: Engineers chose {nihard} for its abrasion resistance.
e.zh: 工程师因其耐磨性选择了高镍铸铁。

e.en: The philosopher reduced the claim to {nihil}.
e.zh: 哲学家把这个主张归结为虚无。

e.en: In law, {nihil} sometimes means nothing is owed.
e.zh: 在法律中，nihil 有时表示没有欠款。

e.en: The novel dwells on {nihility} and loss.
e.zh: 这部小说沉浸在虚无和失落之中。

e.en: He feared the {nihility} behind empty praise.
e.zh: 他害怕空洞赞美背后的虚无。

e.en: Yoruba belongs to the {Niger-Congo} language family.
e.zh: 约鲁巴语属于尼日尔-刚果语系。

e.en: The lecture compared several {Niger-Congo} languages.
e.zh: 那场讲座比较了几种尼日尔-刚果语系语言。

e.en: He used {nigga} casually among close friends.
e.zh: 他在亲密朋友之间随口用了这个称呼。

e.en: Many people consider {nigga} offensive outside specific contexts.
e.zh: 许多人认为这个词在特定语境之外很冒犯。

e.en: His {niggardliness} made every dinner awkward.
e.zh: 他的吝啬让每顿晚餐都很尴尬。

e.en: The committee's {niggardliness} hurt the whole project.
e.zh: 委员会的过分小气损害了整个项目。

e.en: The rapper used {niggas} in the chorus.
e.zh: 那位说唱歌手在副歌里用了这个词。

e.en: They warned him that {niggas} could sound insulting.
e.zh: 他们提醒他，这个词可能听起来很冒犯。

e.en: The old clerk {nigged} over every small expense.
e.zh: 那位老职员对每一笔小开销都斤斤计较。

e.en: He felt the deal had been {nigged} unfairly.
e.zh: 他觉得这笔交易被人小气地压得很不公平。

nigger-brown.t: 旧时冒犯性深棕色称呼

e.en: The catalog listed the coat as {nigger-brown}.
e.zh: 那本目录把这件外套标成了带冒犯意味的深棕色。

e.en: Modern editors usually avoid {nigger-brown} in descriptions.
e.zh: 现代编辑通常避免在描述中使用这个冒犯性词语。

e.en: The memoir described a brutal {nigger-driver}.
e.zh: 回忆录描写了一名残暴驱使黑奴的监工。

e.en: Workers called the boss a {nigger-driver} behind his back.
e.zh: 工人们在背后骂老板像残酷监工一样。

e.en: Racists shouted {nigger-lover} at the activist.
e.zh: 种族主义者朝那名活动人士喊这种辱骂。

e.en: The slur {nigger-lover} appears in historical documents.
e.zh: 这种辱骂词出现在一些历史文件中。

niggerhead.t: 含冒犯词的旧称；黑色物体

e.en: The miner pointed to a {niggerhead} in the field.
e.zh: 矿工指着田里一块被旧称这样叫的黑色石块。

e.en: The term {niggerhead} is now avoided as offensive.
e.zh: 这个词现在因具有冒犯性而被避免使用。

niggerize.t: 用种族主义方式贬低黑人化

e.en: The pamphlet tried to {niggerize} its opponents.
e.zh: 那本小册子试图用种族主义方式贬低对手。

e.en: Scholars quoted {niggerize} only to discuss racist language.
e.zh: 学者只在讨论种族主义语言时引用这个词。

niggertoe.t: 巴西坚果的冒犯性旧称

e.en: Grandpa called Brazil nuts {niggertoes}, shocking everyone.
e.zh: 爷爷把巴西坚果叫成那个冒犯性旧称，大家都很震惊。

e.en: The dictionary marks {niggertoe} as offensive and dated.
e.zh: 词典把这个词标为冒犯且过时。

e.en: His {nigging} complaints slowed the meeting.
e.zh: 他那些鸡毛蒜皮的抱怨拖慢了会议。

e.en: She disliked his {nigging} attitude toward money.
e.zh: 她不喜欢他对钱那种小气计较的态度。

e.en: There are still some {niggly} problems with the app.
e.zh: 这个应用仍有一些烦人的小问题。

e.en: He became {niggly} about every tiny detail.
e.zh: 他对每个细枝末节都变得很挑剔。

e.en: The novel reproduces {niggra} in dialect speech.
e.zh: 那部小说在方言对白中再现了这个辱称。

e.en: Editors flagged {niggra} as a racist variant.
e.zh: 编辑把这个词标为种族主义变体。

e.en: The {nighest} village lay beyond the hill.
e.zh: 最近的村庄在山丘那边。

e.en: He chose the {nighest} seat to the door.
e.zh: 他选了离门最近的座位。

e.en: The doctor woke when the {night-bell} rang.
e.zh: 夜间呼叫铃一响，医生就醒了。

e.en: Guests used the {night-bell} after the desk closed.
e.zh: 前台关闭后，客人使用夜间门铃。

e.en: The {night-blind} driver avoided country roads.
e.zh: 那位夜盲的司机避开乡间道路。

e.en: Some birds are nearly {night-blind}.
e.zh: 有些鸟在夜里几乎看不见。

night-blinded.t: 患夜盲的；被夜色遮蔽的

e.en: The soldier was {night-blinded} after the injury.
e.zh: 那名士兵受伤后患上了夜盲。

e.en: They stumbled through the {night-blinded} streets.
e.zh: 他们在被夜色遮蔽的街道上踉跄前行。

e.en: She packed a wool {night-cap} for winter.
e.zh: 她为冬天带了一顶羊毛睡帽。

e.en: He poured a small {night-cap} before bed.
e.zh: 他睡前倒了一小杯酒。

e.en: Sailors crowded into the {night-cellar} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后，水手们挤进那家地下夜酒馆。

e.en: The police raided a noisy {night-cellar}.
e.zh: 警察突查了一家吵闹的地下夜店。

e.en: They danced at a {night-club} downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家夜店跳舞。

e.en: The singer performed in a small {night-club}.
e.zh: 那位歌手在一家小夜总会演出。

e.en: She bought a cotton {night-dress} for summer.
e.zh: 她买了一件夏天穿的棉质睡裙。

e.en: The child wore a long {night-dress}.
e.zh: 那个孩子穿着一件长睡衣。

e.en: The {night-flower} opened after sunset.
e.zh: 那朵夜间开放的花在日落后绽放。

e.en: Moths gathered around the pale {night-flower}.
e.zh: 飞蛾聚集在那朵浅色夜花周围。

e.en: Berlin is famous for its {night-life}.
e.zh: 柏林以夜生活闻名。

e.en: He missed the city's lively {night-life}.
e.zh: 他怀念那座城市热闹的夜生活。

e.en: A dark {nimbostratus} covered the valley all afternoon.
e.zh: 一大片阴沉的雨层云整个下午笼罩着山谷。

e.en: Pilots reported thick {nimbostratus} before the steady rain began.
e.zh: 飞行员报告有厚厚的雨层云，随后持续降雨开始了。

e.en: The room suffered from a {nimiety} of decorations.
e.zh: 这个房间装饰太多，显得过度了。

e.en: His speech had a {nimiety} of abstract terms.
e.zh: 他的演讲里抽象术语过多。

niminy-piminy.t: 矫揉造作的；过分讲究的

e.en: She disliked his {niminy-piminy} manners at dinner.
e.zh: 她不喜欢他吃饭时那种矫揉造作的举止。

e.en: The critic mocked the poem's {niminy-piminy} delicacy.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑这首诗过分讲究的纤细风格。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {nimodipine} after the brain hemorrhage.
e.zh: 脑出血后，医生开了尼莫地平。

e.en: Patients should take {nimodipine} exactly as directed.
e.zh: 患者应严格按医嘱服用尼莫地平。

e.en: The committee rejected such {nincompoopery} at once.
e.zh: 委员会立刻否决了这种愚蠢做法。

e.en: His explanation was pure {nincompoopery}, but everyone laughed.
e.zh: 他的解释完全是傻话，但大家都笑了。

e.en: The company reported a {nine-fold} increase in sales.
e.zh: 公司报告销售额增长了九倍。

e.en: The old tale describes a {nine-fold} gate.
e.zh: 这个古老故事描写了一道九重门。

e.en: He knocked down the last {nine-pin} with ease.
e.zh: 他轻松击倒了最后一个九柱戏木柱。

e.en: The broken {nine-pin} lay beside the alley.
e.zh: 那个坏掉的九柱戏木柱躺在球道旁。

e.en: She left her {nine-to-five} job to freelance.
e.zh: 她辞掉朝九晚五的工作去做自由职业。

e.en: A {nine-to-five} routine never suited him.
e.zh: 朝九晚五的日常从来不适合他。

e.en: He is a contented {nine-to-fiver} with weekends free.
e.zh: 他是个满足的朝九晚五上班族，周末有空。

e.en: The novel follows a bored {nine-to-fiver} in London.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述伦敦一个无聊上班族的生活。

e.en: We planted {ninebark} along the back fence.
e.zh: 我们在后围栏边种了九层皮灌木。

e.en: The {ninebark} blooms with clusters of pale flowers.
e.zh: 九层皮灌木开出一簇簇浅色花。

e.en: Membership increased {ninefold} in three years.
e.zh: 会员人数三年内增加了九倍。

e.en: The design used a {ninefold} pattern around the center.
e.zh: 这个设计围绕中心用了九重图案。

e.en: They played {nineholes} before lunch.
e.zh: 他们午饭前打了九洞高尔夫。

e.en: Children once played {nineholes} with small balls.
e.zh: 孩子们过去会用小球玩九洞游戏。

e.en: He bought a {ninepenny} loaf from the baker.
e.zh: 他从面包师那里买了一个九便士的面包。

e.en: The pamphlet was dismissed as {ninepenny} nonsense.
e.zh: 那本小册子被当作廉价胡话而遭到鄙视。

e.en: The ball struck the center {ninepin} first.
e.zh: 球先击中了中间的九柱戏木柱。

e.en: He stood stiffly like a {ninepin}.
e.zh: 他像九柱戏木柱一样僵直地站着。

e.en: They played {ninepins} at the village inn.
e.zh: 他们在村里的小旅馆玩九柱戏。

e.en: The soldiers fell like {ninepins} under the attack.
e.zh: 士兵们在攻击下像木柱一样纷纷倒下。

e.en: The book has {ninety-eight} pages.
e.zh: 这本书有九十八页。

e.en: She scored {ninety-eight} on the test.
e.zh: 她这次考试得了九十八分。

e.en: There are {ninety-nine} names on the list.
e.zh: 名单上有九十九个名字。

e.en: The jacket costs {ninety-nine} dollars.
e.zh: 这件夹克售价九十九美元。

e.en: Don't be such a {ning-nong} about it.
e.zh: 别在这件事上这么傻乎乎的。

e.en: He felt like a complete {ning-nong} after the mistake.
e.zh: 犯错后，他觉得自己真是个大笨蛋。

e.en: The geologist identified {ningyoite} in the rock sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在岩石样本中鉴定出宁阳石。

e.en: Small grains of {ningyoite} appeared under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下出现了细小的宁阳石颗粒。

e.en: The lab used {ninhydrin} to reveal fingerprints.
e.zh: 实验室用茚三酮显现指纹。

e.en: A purple color formed when {ninhydrin} touched the amino acid.
e.zh: 茚三酮接触氨基酸后形成了紫色。

niniteenth.t: 第十九的误拼或方言形式

e.en: The old letter used {niniteenth} where modern spelling says nineteenth.
e.zh: 那封旧信把现代拼作nineteenth的词写成了niniteenth。

e.en: He copied the dialect word {niniteenth} exactly from the manuscript.
e.zh: 他把手稿里的方言词niniteenth原样抄了下来。

e.en: Only a {ninnyhammer} would ignore such clear warnings.
e.zh: 只有糊涂虫才会无视这么明显的警告。

e.en: The comic servant was called a {ninnyhammer} by everyone.
e.zh: 那个滑稽仆人被大家叫作傻瓜。

e.en: They repaired the old {ninogan} before crossing the lake.
e.zh: 他们过湖前修好了那只旧的原住民独木舟。

e.en: A painted {ninogan} hung above the museum entrance.
e.zh: 一只彩绘的ninogan独木舟悬挂在博物馆入口上方。

e.en: The dress was made of pale {ninon}.
e.zh: 这条裙子是用浅色薄尼农绸做的。

e.en: Soft curtains of {ninon} moved in the breeze.
e.zh: 柔软的尼农薄纱窗帘在微风中飘动。

e.en: Older chemistry books sometimes call niobium {niob}.
e.zh: 较旧的化学书有时把铌称作niob。

e.en: The label used {niob}, an obsolete name for the element.
e.zh: 标签使用了niob这个元素的旧称。

e.en: The ore contained several {niobian} minerals.
e.zh: 这种矿石含有几种含铌矿物。

e.en: Researchers measured the properties of the {niobian} alloy.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种铌质合金的性质。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {niobic} acid solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一种铌酸溶液。

e.en: Several {niobic} compounds were tested for stability.
e.zh: 几种五价铌化合物接受了稳定性测试。

e.en: The collector bought a dark piece of {niobite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一块深色铌铁矿。

e.en: Miners once confused {niobite} with similar heavy minerals.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾把铌铁矿和类似的重矿物混淆。

e.en: The paper described a rare {niobous} compound.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种罕见的低价铌化合物。

e.en: A {niobous} salt formed during the reduction reaction.
e.zh: 还原反应中形成了一种亚铌盐。

e.en: The specimen of {niocalite} came from an alkaline complex.
e.zh: 这件niocalite矿物标本来自碱性岩体。

e.en: Bright crystals of {niocalite} lined the small cavity.
e.zh: 明亮的niocalite晶体布满了小空洞内壁。

e.en: The race was {nip-and-tuck} until the final lap.
e.zh: 比赛直到最后一圈都势均力敌。

e.en: It was {nip-and-tuck} whether the boat would reach shore.
e.zh: 那船能否靠岸一度很难说。

e.en: The gymnast finished with a clean {nip-up}.
e.zh: 体操运动员以一个干净利落的迅速起身动作收尾。

e.en: He practiced the {nip-up} until it looked effortless.
e.zh: 他反复练习nip-up，直到动作看起来毫不费力。

e.en: The village roofs were thatched with {nipa} leaves.
e.zh: 村里的屋顶用尼帕棕榈叶铺成。

e.en: They served sweet {nipa} after the meal.
e.zh: 饭后他们端上了甜味的尼帕棕榈酒。

e.en: Climbers wore goggles to avoid {niphablepsia}.
e.zh: 登山者戴护目镜以避免雪盲症。

e.en: After hours on the glacier, {niphablepsia} blurred his vision.
e.zh: 在冰川上待了数小时后，雪盲症使他的视线变得模糊。

e.en: The will named his {niphew} as the heir.
e.zh: 遗嘱把他的侄子列为继承人。

e.en: In the old diary, {niphew} clearly meant nephew.
e.zh: 在那本旧日记里，niphew显然指nephew。

e.en: The old {niple} refused to share even a candle.
e.zh: 那个老吝啬鬼连一支蜡烛都不肯分享。

e.en: She called him a {niple} after he counted every coin.
e.zh: 他把每枚硬币都数清后，她说他是个小气鬼。

e.en: She wore a {nipped-in} jacket over the dress.
e.zh: 她在裙子外穿了一件收腰夹克。

e.en: The coat has a sharply {nipped-in} waist.
e.zh: 这件外套的腰部收得很明显。

e.en: The wind blew {nippily} across the station platform.
e.zh: 寒风刺骨地吹过车站站台。

e.en: The waiter moved {nippily} between the crowded tables.
e.zh: 服务员在拥挤的餐桌间利落地穿行。

e.en: There was a real {nippiness} in the morning air.
e.zh: 清晨的空气里有一股明显的寒意。

e.en: Her {nippiness} on the court surprised the older players.
e.zh: 她在球场上的敏捷让那些年长球员很意外。

e.en: The sailors warmed themselves with {nippitate} after dark.
e.zh: 天黑后，水手们喝烈酒暖身。

e.en: He joked that the punch was more {nippitate} than dessert.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说那杯潘趣酒更像烈酒而不是甜点。

e.en: The inn served a {nippitaty} ale in small cups.
e.zh: 那家小旅馆用小杯供应一种酒劲很强的麦酒。

e.en: After one {nippitaty} sip, he pushed the glass away.
e.zh: 只抿了一口烈性的酒，他就把杯子推开了。

e.en: Yellow {nipplewort} grew along the shaded lane.
e.zh: 阴凉小路边长着黄色的乳头草。

e.en: The herbalist pointed out {nipplewort} among the weeds.
e.zh: 草药师在杂草中指出了乳头草。

e.en: The typo {nippped} should be corrected to nipped.
e.zh: 这个拼写错误nippped应改为nipped。

e.en: She noticed {nippped} in the draft and fixed it.
e.zh: 她在草稿里发现nippped这个误拼并改正了。

e.en: She chose to wear a {niqab} in public.
e.zh: 她选择在公共场合佩戴尼卡布面纱。

e.en: The debate focused on whether the {niqab} should be allowed in schools.
e.zh: 这场争论集中在学校是否应允许佩戴尼卡布面纱。

e.en: Cheesemakers use {nisin} to limit harmful bacteria.
e.zh: 奶酪生产者使用乳酸链球菌素来抑制有害细菌。

e.en: The label lists {nisin} as a food preservative.
e.zh: 标签上把乳酸链球菌素列为食品防腐剂。

e.en: The poem reveals a {nisus} toward spiritual freedom.
e.zh: 这首诗显露出一种追求精神自由的趋向。

e.en: His sudden {nisus} to confess surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他突然想要坦白的冲动让所有人都吃了一惊。

e.en: Please do not {nit-pick} every minor formatting choice.
e.zh: 请不要对每个细小的格式选择都吹毛求疵。

e.en: Editors sometimes {nit-pick} because small errors can distract readers.
e.zh: 编辑有时会挑小毛病，因为小错误会分散读者注意力。

e.en: The editor was a notorious {nit-picker} about punctuation.
e.zh: 这位编辑在标点上出了名地吹毛求疵。

e.en: Do not be a {nit-picker} during the first draft.
e.zh: 写初稿时不要做个吹毛求疵的人。

e.en: His constant {nit-picking} slowed the meeting down.
e.zh: 他不停挑小毛病，拖慢了会议进度。

e.en: She called the criticism {nit-picking} rather than useful advice.
e.zh: 她认为那些批评只是吹毛求疵，不是有用建议。

e.en: The metallurgist used {nital} to etch the steel sample.
e.zh: 冶金师用硝酸酒精腐蚀剂蚀刻钢样。

e.en: Fresh {nital} revealed the grain structure clearly.
e.zh: 新配的硝酸酒精腐蚀剂清楚显示了晶粒结构。

e.en: The shop will {nitemper} the gears after machining.
e.zh: 车间会在加工后对齿轮进行氮化回火处理。

e.en: Engineers chose to {nitemper} the steel for better wear resistance.
e.zh: 工程师选择给钢材做氮化回火处理，以提高耐磨性。

e.en: {Nitempering} improved the surface hardness of the shaft.
e.zh: 氮化回火处理提高了轴的表面硬度。

e.en: The manual describes {nitempering} as a controlled heat process.
e.zh: 手册把氮化回火处理描述为一种受控热处理工艺。

e.en: The old {nitery} supplied material for gunpowder.
e.zh: 那处旧硝石矿曾为火药供应原料。

e.en: Travelers mentioned a {nitery} near the dry valley.
e.zh: 旅人提到干谷附近有一处硝石产地。

e.en: The beetle had a {nitid} green shell.
e.zh: 那只甲虫有一层明亮发绿的外壳。

e.en: Her prose is unusually {nitid} and precise.
e.zh: 她的散文异常清晰明亮而准确。

e.en: The stent is made from flexible {nitinol}.
e.zh: 这个支架由柔韧的镍钛记忆合金制成。

e.en: {Nitinol} returns to its original shape when warmed.
e.zh: 镍钛记忆合金受热后会恢复原来的形状。

e.en: Early chemists sometimes called radon {niton}.
e.zh: 早期化学家有时把氡称作niton。

e.en: The textbook used {niton} in an obsolete table of elements.
e.zh: 那本教材在一张旧元素表中使用了氡的旧称。

e.en: The physician suspected {nitraemia} after the abnormal blood test.
e.zh: 血检异常后，医生怀疑是血液含氮过多症。

e.en: Severe {nitraemia} can indicate serious kidney failure.
e.zh: 严重的血液含氮过多症可能提示肾衰竭。

e.en: The chemist was {nitralising} the sample under a hood.
e.zh: 化学师正在通风橱下用硝酸处理样品。

e.en: They avoided {nitralising} the compound at high temperature.
e.zh: 他们避免在高温下硝化这种化合物。

e.en: The report identified a powerful {nitramine} explosive.
e.zh: 报告确认了一种威力很强的硝胺类炸药。

e.en: Researchers measured how the {nitramine} decomposed under heat.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种硝胺类化合物受热分解的方式。

e.en: {Nitration} added a nitro group to the molecule.
e.zh: 硝化反应给该分子加入了一个硝基。

e.en: The plant monitors {nitration} carefully because it releases heat.
e.zh: 工厂仔细监控硝化反应，因为它会放热。

e.en: The desert deposit contained pale {nitratite}.
e.zh: 这处沙漠矿床含有浅色的硝酸钠矿。

e.en: Miners once extracted {nitratite} for fertilizer production.
e.zh: 矿工过去开采硝酸钠矿用于生产肥料。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {nitrazepam} for short-term insomnia.
e.zh: 医生开了硝西泮来短期治疗失眠。

e.en: She avoided alcohol while taking {nitrazepam}.
e.zh: 她服用硝西泮期间避免饮酒。

e.en: Old recipes used {nitre} to cure meat.
e.zh: 旧配方用硝石来腌制肉类。

e.en: The cave walls were streaked with {nitre}.
e.zh: 洞壁上有一道道硝石痕迹。

e.en: The archive described a crude {nitre-explosive} used in mines.
e.zh: 档案描述了一种矿山里用过的粗制硝石炸药。

e.en: Handling any {nitre-explosive} required strict precautions.
e.zh: 处理任何硝石炸药都需要严格防护。

e.en: The coating contained a hard metal {nitrid}.
e.zh: 这种涂层含有一种坚硬的金属氮化物。

e.en: An old text spelled nitride as {nitrid}.
e.zh: 一本文献把nitride这个词拼作nitrid。

e.en: {Nitridation} formed a protective layer on the surface.
e.zh: 氮化处理在表面形成了一层保护层。

e.en: The team studied {nitridation} of silicon wafers.
e.zh: 团队研究了硅晶片的氮化过程。

e.en: The survey marked several {nitriferous} soils.
e.zh: 调查标出了几处含硝石的土壤。

e.en: Farmers avoided the {nitriferous} patch near the ruins.
e.zh: 农民避开了废墟附近那片产硝的地块。

nitrodimethylaniline.t: 硝基二甲基苯胺类化合物

e.en: The lab ordered {nitrodimethylaniline} for a dye intermediate study.
e.zh: 实验室订购了硝基二甲基苯胺，用于研究染料中间体。

e.en: Handle {nitrodimethylaniline} only inside a ventilated hood.
e.zh: 只能在通风橱内处理硝基二甲基苯胺。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {nitrodiphenylmethane}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量硝基二苯甲烷。

e.en: She compared {nitrodiphenylmethane} with related aromatic compounds.
e.zh: 她把硝基二苯甲烷与相关芳香族化合物作了比较。

e.en: Pure {nitroform} must be stored under strict safety controls.
e.zh: 纯硝仿必须在严格安全控制下储存。

e.en: The paper described {nitroform} as a highly acidic nitro compound.
e.zh: 论文把硝仿描述为一种强酸性的硝基化合物。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {nitrofuran} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的硝基呋喃衍生物。

e.en: Some {nitrofuran} drugs were once used against bacterial infections.
e.zh: 一些硝基呋喃类药物曾用于治疗细菌感染。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {nitrofurantoin} for her urinary tract infection.
e.zh: 医生给她开了呋喃妥因来治疗尿路感染。

e.en: Patients with kidney problems may not tolerate {nitrofurantoin} well.
e.zh: 有肾脏问题的患者可能不太耐受呋喃妥因。

e.en: Bacteria use {nitrogenase} to convert nitrogen gas into ammonia.
e.zh: 细菌利用固氮酶把氮气转化为氨。

e.en: Oxygen can damage {nitrogenase} in many nitrogen-fixing microbes.
e.zh: 氧气会损害许多固氮微生物体内的固氮酶。

e.en: The technician will {nitrogenise} the chamber before heating it.
e.zh: 技术员会在加热前给腔体充氮。

e.en: Some processes {nitrogenise} steel to harden its surface.
e.zh: 有些工艺会使钢材氮化，以硬化其表面。

e.en: They {nitrogenize} the package to slow oxidation.
e.zh: 他们给包装充氮，以减缓氧化。

e.en: The factory can {nitrogenize} metal parts for extra hardness.
e.zh: 这家工厂可以对金属零件进行氮化处理，提高硬度。

e.en: The {nitrogenized} container kept the oil fresh longer.
e.zh: 充氮后的容器让油保持新鲜的时间更长。

e.en: The surface became harder after it was {nitrogenized}.
e.zh: 表面经过氮化处理后变得更硬。

e.en: The machine {nitrogenizes} each sealed bag automatically.
e.zh: 机器会自动给每个密封袋充氮。

e.en: This treatment {nitrogenizes} the alloy at high temperature.
e.zh: 这种处理会在高温下使合金氮化。

e.en: The team is {nitrogenizing} the samples overnight.
e.zh: 团队正在连夜对样品进行氮化处理。

e.en: Careful {nitrogenizing} reduces unwanted oxidation during storage.
e.zh: 仔细充氮可以减少储存期间不必要的氧化。

e.en: The old experiment mentioned {nitroglucose} as a sugar derivative.
e.zh: 那项旧实验把硝基葡萄糖称为一种糖类衍生物。

e.en: Researchers analyzed {nitroglucose} under controlled laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 研究人员在受控实验室条件下分析了硝基葡萄糖。

nitrograph.t: 硝酸测定仪；氮氧记录仪

e.en: The technician calibrated the {nitrograph} before the test began.
e.zh: 测试开始前，技术员校准了硝酸测定仪。

e.en: A faulty {nitrograph} gave inconsistent readings all morning.
e.zh: 一台有故障的氮氧记录仪整个上午读数都不一致。

e.en: The formula included {nitroguanidine} as an energetic ingredient.
e.zh: 该配方把硝基胍列为一种含能成分。

e.en: Workers must avoid inhaling dust from {nitroguanidine}.
e.zh: 工人必须避免吸入硝基胍粉尘。

e.en: The textbook defines a {nitrol} as a nitroso derivative.
e.zh: 教材把硝肟定义为一种亚硝基衍生物。

e.en: This {nitrol} changed color during the reaction.
e.zh: 这种硝肟类化合物在反应过程中变了颜色。

e.en: The archive contained notes on preparing {nitrolevulose}.
e.zh: 档案中有关于制备硝基果糖的笔记。

e.en: Few modern papers discuss {nitrolevulose} in detail.
e.zh: 现代论文很少详细讨论硝基果糖。

e.en: The reaction formed a {nitrolic} acid as an intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种硝肟酸作为中间体。

e.en: A {nitrolic} compound may show distinctive color changes.
e.zh: 硝肟类化合物可能会出现明显的颜色变化。

e.en: Farmers once used {nitrolim} to enrich poor soil.
e.zh: 农民过去曾用石灰氮肥来改良贫瘠土壤。

e.en: The shipment of {nitrolim} was stored away from moisture.
e.zh: 这批石灰氮肥被存放在远离潮气的地方。

e.en: The field was treated with {nitrolime} before planting.
e.zh: 播种前，这片田施用了石灰氮肥。

e.en: Keep {nitrolime} dry because moisture reduces its quality.
e.zh: 石灰氮肥要保持干燥，因为潮气会降低其质量。

e.en: The report classified {nitromannitol} as a sensitive explosive.
e.zh: 报告把硝化甘露醇归为一种敏感炸药。

e.en: Only trained staff may handle {nitromannitol} in the lab.
e.zh: 只有受过训练的人员才能在实验室处理硝化甘露醇。

e.en: Older antiseptic formulas sometimes contained {nitromersol}.
e.zh: 较早的消毒剂配方有时含有硝汞酚汞。

e.en: The clinic stopped using {nitromersol} because of mercury concerns.
e.zh: 由于汞安全问题，诊所停止使用硝汞酚汞。

e.en: The synthesis yielded {nitromesitylene} after careful nitration.
e.zh: 经过谨慎硝化后，合成反应得到了硝基均三甲苯。

e.en: They measured the melting point of {nitromesitylene}.
e.zh: 他们测定了硝基均三甲苯的熔点。

e.en: The chemist used a {nitrometer} to measure released nitrogen gas.
e.zh: 化学家用氮量计测量释放出的氮气。

e.en: A clean {nitrometer} gives more reliable analytical results.
e.zh: 干净的氮量计能给出更可靠的分析结果。

e.en: Racing engines sometimes burn {nitromethane} for extra power.
e.zh: 赛车发动机有时燃烧硝基甲烷以获得更大动力。

e.en: Store {nitromethane} away from heat and open flames.
e.zh: 硝基甲烷应远离热源和明火储存。

nitron.t: 尼特龙；硝酸根沉淀试剂

e.en: The analyst added {nitron} to test for nitrate ions.
e.zh: 分析员加入尼特龙来检测硝酸根离子。

e.en: In older methods, {nitron} helped precipitate nitrate salts.
e.zh: 在较老的方法中，尼特龙可帮助沉淀硝酸盐。

nitrified.t: 已硝化的；已转成硝酸盐的

e.en: The soil was {nitrified} by bacteria over several weeks.
e.zh: 土壤在数周内被细菌硝化。

e.en: Engineers tested the {nitrified} wastewater before discharge.
e.zh: 工程师在排放前检测了已硝化的废水。

e.en: A {nitrifier} converts ammonia into nitrite in the tank.
e.zh: 硝化菌会在水箱中把氨转化为亚硝酸盐。

e.en: The lab identified the main {nitrifier} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室确认了样本中的主要硝化菌。

e.en: This bacterium {nitrifies} ammonia in wet soil.
e.zh: 这种细菌会在湿土中硝化氨。

e.en: The filter {nitrifies} waste before the water returns.
e.zh: 过滤器会在水回流前把废物硝化。

e.en: Certain microbes {nitrify} ammonia in garden soil.
e.zh: 某些微生物会在园土中把氨硝化。

e.en: The system is designed to {nitrify} wastewater efficiently.
e.zh: 该系统用于高效硝化废水。

e.en: The old paper used {nitril} for a nitrile compound.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文用nitril指一种腈化合物。

e.en: A chemist may recognize {nitril} as an older spelling.
e.zh: 化学家可能会认出nitril是旧式拼法。

nitritocobalamin.t: 亚硝基钴胺素；维生素B12衍生物

e.en: The researchers prepared {nitritocobalamin} under controlled light.
e.zh: 研究人员在受控光照下制备亚硝基钴胺素。

e.en: The spectrum of {nitritocobalamin} changed during the reaction.
e.zh: 反应过程中亚硝基钴胺素的光谱发生了变化。

nitrizing.t: 硝化的；进行氮化处理的

e.en: The factory used a {nitrizing} process to harden steel.
e.zh: 工厂采用氮化处理工艺来硬化钢材。

e.en: The {nitrizing} bacteria grew slowly in cold water.
e.zh: 硝化细菌在冷水中生长缓慢。

e.en: The report classified the compound as a {nitro-amine}.
e.zh: 报告把该化合物归为硝基胺。

e.en: A {nitro-amine} group can affect the molecule's stability.
e.zh: 硝基胺基团会影响分子的稳定性。

nitro-metals.t: 硝基金属化合物；含硝基金属盐

e.en: The archive mentioned {nitro-metals} in early explosives research.
e.zh: 档案提到早期炸药研究中的硝基金属化合物。

e.en: Some {nitro-metals} were too unstable for transport.
e.zh: 有些硝基金属化合物过于不稳定，无法运输。

e.en: The old cartridge contained {nitro-powder} instead of black powder.
e.zh: 那枚旧弹壳里装的是硝化火药，而不是黑火药。

e.en: Storage rules for {nitro-powder} were strictly enforced.
e.zh: 硝化火药的储存规定执行得很严格。

e.en: The dye plant used {nitroaniline} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 染料厂把硝基苯胺用作中间体。

e.en: They measured {nitroaniline} levels in the wastewater sample.
e.zh: 他们测量了废水样本中的硝基苯胺含量。

nitroaromatic.t: 硝基芳香族的；硝基芳香化合物

e.en: The soil contained several {nitroaromatic} pollutants.
e.zh: 土壤中含有几种硝基芳香族污染物。

e.en: A {nitroaromatic} compound often has strong electron-withdrawing groups.
e.zh: 硝基芳香化合物通常带有很强的吸电子基团。

e.en: The aquarium depends on {nitrobacteria} to process waste.
e.zh: 水族箱依靠硝化细菌处理废物。

e.en: Healthy soil usually contains active {nitrobacteria}.
e.zh: 健康土壤通常含有活跃的硝化细菌。

nitrobenzene.t: 硝基苯；有毒芳香化合物

e.en: The spill released {nitrobenzene} into the river.
e.zh: 泄漏事故把硝基苯排入了河中。

e.en: Factories use {nitrobenzene} to make aniline.
e.zh: 工厂使用硝基苯来生产苯胺。

e.en: Older labels sometimes call nitrobenzene {nitrobenzol}.
e.zh: 旧标签有时把硝基苯称为nitrobenzol。

e.en: The bottle of {nitrobenzol} had a strong almond-like odor.
e.zh: 那瓶硝基苯有很强的杏仁样气味。

nitrocarbonitrate.t: 硝基碳酸盐；含硝基碳酸盐

e.en: The mineral sample was described as a {nitrocarbonitrate}.
e.zh: 该矿物样本被描述为一种硝基碳酸盐。

e.en: A {nitrocarbonitrate} formula appeared in the old chemistry text.
e.zh: 旧化学书中出现了一个硝基碳酸盐的分子式。

nitrocarburizing.t: 氮碳共渗；氮碳共渗处理

e.en: The shafts underwent {nitrocarburizing} to improve wear resistance.
e.zh: 这些轴经过氮碳共渗处理，以提高耐磨性。

e.en: Gas {nitrocarburizing} can harden the surface of steel.
e.zh: 气体氮碳共渗可以硬化钢材表面。

nitrocellulose.t: 硝化纤维素；火棉胶原料

e.en: Early film stock made with {nitrocellulose} was highly flammable.
e.zh: 用硝化纤维素制成的早期胶片极易燃。

e.en: The lacquer contains {nitrocellulose} for a hard finish.
e.zh: 这种清漆含有硝化纤维素，可形成坚硬表面。

nitrochalk.t: 硝酸铵钙肥；硝化白垩肥

e.en: Farmers spread {nitrochalk} before the spring rain.
e.zh: 农民在春雨前撒施硝酸铵钙肥。

e.en: The bag of {nitrochalk} was stored away from moisture.
e.zh: 那袋硝酸铵钙肥被存放在远离潮气的地方。

e.en: The plant manufactured {nitrochlorobenzene} for dye production.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产硝基氯苯用于染料制造。

e.en: They monitored {nitrochlorobenzene} in the air near the site.
e.zh: 他们监测了现场附近空气中的硝基氯苯。

e.en: Historical fumigants sometimes contained {nitrochloroform}.
e.zh: 历史上的熏蒸剂有时含有硝基氯仿。

e.en: The chemist handled {nitrochloroform} only in a fume hood.
e.zh: 化学家只在通风橱中处理硝基氯仿。

e.en: The catalog listed several yellow {nitrocolors}.
e.zh: 目录列出了几种黄色硝基染料。

e.en: Some {nitrocolors} fade quickly in direct sunlight.
e.zh: 有些硝基染料在直射阳光下很快褪色。

e.en: The laboratory stored {nitrocotton} in a damp condition.
e.zh: 实验室把硝化棉以湿润状态储存。

e.en: Old propellants often used {nitrocotton} as a base.
e.zh: 旧式发射药常以硝化棉为基料。

nitrodicthylaniline.t: 硝基二乙基苯胺；染料中间体

e.en: The manuscript named {nitrodicthylaniline} among dye intermediates.
e.zh: 手稿把硝基二乙基苯胺列为染料中间体之一。

e.en: A sample of {nitrodicthylaniline} was sent for purity testing.
e.zh: 一份硝基二乙基苯胺样品被送去做纯度检测。

e.en: The metal complex contains a bound {nitrosyl} group.
e.zh: 这种金属配合物含有一个结合的亚硝酰基。

e.en: Researchers measured the {nitrosyl} signal in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样品中的亚硝酰信号。

e.en: The test detected {nitrosylhemoglobin} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 这项检测在血样中发现了亚硝酰血红蛋白。

e.en: Meat curing can produce {nitrosylhemoglobin} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 在受控条件下，肉类腌制可能产生亚硝酰血红蛋白。

e.en: The plant stored {nitrosylsulphuric} acid in sealed tanks.
e.zh: 工厂把亚硝酰硫酸储存在密封罐中。

e.en: Chemists handled the {nitrosylsulphuric} reagent with special care.
e.zh: 化学人员格外小心地处理这种亚硝酰硫酸试剂。

e.en: The lab analyzed traces of {nitrotoluene} in the solvent.
e.zh: 实验室分析了溶剂中的微量硝基甲苯。

e.en: Some dyes are made from {nitrotoluene} derivatives.
e.zh: 有些染料由硝基甲苯衍生物制成。

e.en: {Nitrotrichloromethane} was once studied as a chemical agent.
e.zh: 硝基三氯甲烷曾被作为化学剂研究。

e.en: The old report listed {nitrotrichloromethane} among toxic compounds.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把硝基三氯甲烷列为有毒化合物之一。

e.en: Divers used {nitrox} to extend their bottom time.
e.zh: 潜水员使用氮氧混合气来延长水下停留时间。

e.en: The instructor checked the {nitrox} tank before the dive.
e.zh: 教练在下潜前检查了氮氧混合气气瓶。

e.en: {Nitroxyl} behaves differently from nitric oxide in cells.
e.zh: 亚硝酰氢在细胞中的表现不同于一氧化氮。

e.en: The compound released {nitroxyl} under mild conditions.
e.zh: 这种化合物在温和条件下释放出亚硝酰氢。

e.en: The technician separated {nitroxylene} from the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 技术员从反应混合物中分离出硝基二甲苯。

e.en: {Nitroxylene} is used mainly in specialized chemical processes.
e.zh: 硝基二甲苯主要用于专门的化工过程。

e.en: The molecule includes a reactive {nitryl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个活泼的硝酰基。

e.en: {Nitryl} fluoride requires careful handling in the laboratory.
e.zh: 硝酰氟在实验室中需要小心处理。

nitty-gritty.t: 实质细节；关键具体问题

e.en: Let's get down to the {nitty-gritty} of the contract.
e.zh: 我们来谈谈合同里的关键具体问题吧。

e.en: She enjoys big ideas but avoids the {nitty-gritty}.
e.zh: 她喜欢宏大的想法，却回避那些实质细节。

e.en: In the local language, {niu} can mean coconut.
e.zh: 在当地语言中，niu可以表示椰子。

e.en: The guide pointed to the palm and said {niu}.
e.zh: 导游指着棕榈树说了niu这个词。

e.en: The botanist studied plants in the {nival} zone.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了雪线附近地区的植物。

e.en: {Nival} conditions delayed the mountain expedition.
e.zh: 多雪的环境耽误了这次山区考察。

e.en: {Nivation} slowly shaped the hollow below the ridge.
e.zh: 雪蚀作用慢慢塑造了山脊下方的凹地。

e.en: The paper explains how {nivation} affects alpine slopes.
e.zh: 这篇论文解释了雪蚀作用如何影响高山坡地。

e.en: The collection included a small piece of {nivenite}.
e.zh: 这批收藏品中有一小块尼文石。

e.en: Geologists identified {nivenite} in the mineral sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在矿物样本中鉴定出了尼文石。

e.en: The bird had soft, {niveous} feathers.
e.zh: 这只鸟长着柔软而雪白的羽毛。

e.en: A {niveous} mist covered the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，一层雪白的薄雾笼罩着山谷。

e.en: The old tale warned children about a {nixy} in the river.
e.zh: 这个古老故事告诫孩子们河里有水妖。

e.en: She painted the {nixy} with green hair and silver eyes.
e.zh: 她把那个水精灵画成绿头发、银色眼睛的模样。

nitronium.t: 硝酰阳离子；硝基正离子

e.en: The {nitronium} ion is a strong electrophile in aromatic nitration.
e.zh: 硝酰阳离子在芳香族硝化反应中是很强的亲电试剂。

e.en: Chemists generated {nitronium} under carefully controlled acidic conditions.
e.zh: 化学家在严格控制的酸性条件下生成了硝酰阳离子。

e.en: The solvent was classified as a {nitroparaffin} compound.
e.zh: 这种溶剂被归类为硝基烷烃化合物。

e.en: A simple {nitroparaffin} can be reduced to an amine.
e.zh: 简单的硝基烷烃可以被还原成胺。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {nitrophenol} after the reaction.
e.zh: 反应后样品中含有微量硝基苯酚。

e.en: Some forms of {nitrophenol} are used as chemical indicators.
e.zh: 某些硝基苯酚可用作化学指示剂。

e.en: Nettle is a common {nitrophile} in nitrogen-rich soils.
e.zh: 荨麻是在富氮土壤中常见的喜氮植物。

e.en: The survey recorded each {nitrophile} near the fertilized field.
e.zh: 调查记录了施肥田地附近的每种嗜氮生物。

e.en: The old paper described a yellow {nitroplatinate} salt.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文描述了一种黄色硝基铂酸盐。

e.en: They analyzed the {nitroplatinate} complex by spectroscopy.
e.zh: 他们用光谱法分析了这种硝基铂酸盐配合物。

e.en: The bacterium uses {nitroreductase} to metabolize nitro compounds.
e.zh: 这种细菌利用硝基还原酶代谢硝基化合物。

e.en: Researchers measured {nitroreductase} activity in the tumor cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了肿瘤细胞中的硝基还原酶活性。

nitrosalol.t: 硝基萨罗；硝化水杨酸苯酯

e.en: The pharmacist listed {nitrosalol} among obsolete antiseptic compounds.
e.zh: 药剂师把硝基萨罗列为已经过时的防腐化合物之一。

e.en: An early patent mentioned {nitrosalol} as a medicinal derivative.
e.zh: 一项早期专利提到硝基萨罗是一种药用衍生物。

e.en: The chemist watched the solution {nitrose} under acidic conditions.
e.zh: 化学家观察到溶液在酸性条件下发生亚硝化。

e.en: The dye showed a {nitrose} character in the analysis.
e.zh: 分析显示这种染料具有含亚硝基的特征。

e.en: The reagent bottle was labeled {nitrosilal} in the old laboratory.
e.zh: 旧实验室里的试剂瓶标着硝化水杨醛。

e.en: They prepared {nitrosilal} from a salicylaldehyde derivative.
e.zh: 他们由一种水杨醛衍生物制备了硝化水杨醛。

e.en: The textile sample behaved like {nitrosilk} when exposed to flame.
e.zh: 这份纺织样品遇火时表现得像硝化丝。

e.en: Nineteenth-century manuals described making {nitrosilk} from treated silk.
e.zh: 十九世纪的手册描述了用处理过的蚕丝制成硝化蚕丝的方法。

e.en: A {nitroso} group can change the color of an organic compound.
e.zh: 亚硝基可以改变有机化合物的颜色。

e.en: The team synthesized several {nitroso} derivatives for testing.
e.zh: 团队合成了几种亚硝基衍生物用于测试。

e.en: The test detected a harmful {nitrosoamine} in the sample.
e.zh: 检测在样品中发现了一种有害的亚硝胺。

e.en: Heating cured meat may form a {nitrosoamine} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 在某些条件下加热腌肉可能形成亚硝胺。

e.en: The filter relies on {nitrosobacteria} to process ammonia.
e.zh: 这种过滤器依靠亚硝化细菌处理氨。

e.en: Healthy soil often contains active {nitrosobacteria}.
e.zh: 健康土壤中常含有活跃的亚硝化细菌。

e.en: The reaction produced green crystals of {nitrosobenzene}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了绿色的亚硝基苯晶体。

e.en: They used {nitrosobenzene} as a trapping agent in the experiment.
e.zh: 他们在实验中把亚硝基苯用作捕获剂。

e.en: The dye intermediate was identified as {nitrosodiethylaniline}.
e.zh: 这种染料中间体被鉴定为亚硝基二乙基苯胺。

e.en: Handling {nitrosodiethylaniline} requires proper laboratory protection.
e.zh: 处理亚硝基二乙基苯胺需要适当的实验室防护。

e.en: Regulators monitor {nitrosodimethylamine} in drinking water.
e.zh: 监管机构会监测饮用水中的亚硝基二甲胺。

e.en: The recall began after {nitrosodimethylamine} was found in the medicine.
e.zh: 药品中检出亚硝基二甲胺后，召回便开始了。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {nitrosodimethylaniline} as a dye precursor.
e.zh: 化学家合成了亚硝基二甲基苯胺作为染料前体。

e.en: Old safety notes warned against inhaling {nitrosodimethylaniline} dust.
e.zh: 旧安全说明警告不要吸入亚硝基二甲基苯胺粉尘。

e.en: The precipitate contained several {nitrosoferricyanides}.
e.zh: 沉淀物中含有几种亚硝基铁氰化物。

e.en: Analysts once used {nitrosoferricyanides} in specialized color tests.
e.zh: 分析人员曾在专门的显色试验中使用亚硝基铁氰化物。

e.en: The lab stored {nitrosoguanidine} in a locked cabinet.
e.zh: 实验室把亚硝基胍存放在上锁的柜子里。

e.en: Scientists used {nitrosoguanidine} to induce mutations in bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家用亚硝基胍诱导细菌发生突变。

e.en: Cured meat gets part of its color from {nitrosohaemoglobin}.
e.zh: 腌制肉类的部分颜色来自亚硝基血红蛋白。

e.en: The study measured {nitrosohaemoglobin} levels in treated blood samples.
e.zh: 研究测量了处理后血样中的亚硝基血红蛋白水平。

e.en: The pink color of ham is linked to {nitrosomyoglobin}.
e.zh: 火腿的粉红色与亚硝基肌红蛋白有关。

e.en: Heat converts {nitrosomyoglobin} into a stable cured-meat pigment.
e.zh: 加热会把亚硝基肌红蛋白转化为稳定的腌肉色素。

e.en: The catalog grouped these pigments under {nitrosoo-dyes}.
e.zh: 目录把这些颜料归在亚硝基染料名下。

e.en: Some older {nitrosoo-dyes} were replaced by safer alternatives.
e.zh: 一些较旧的亚硝基染料已被更安全的替代品取代。

e.en: The oncologist discussed a {nitrosourea} drug with the patient.
e.zh: 肿瘤科医生和患者讨论了一种亚硝基脲药物。

e.en: A {nitrosourea} can damage DNA by alkylation.
e.zh: 亚硝基脲可以通过烷基化损伤DNA。

e.en: The old explosive mixture contained {nitrostarch}.
e.zh: 这种旧式爆炸混合物含有硝化淀粉。

e.en: Moisture made the {nitrostarch} less stable in storage.
e.zh: 潮气使储存中的硝化淀粉稳定性下降。

e.en: The process used {nitrosulphuric} acid as a nitrating agent.
e.zh: 该工艺使用亚硝基硫酸作为硝化剂。

e.en: Workers handled the {nitrosulphuric} mixture under a fume hood.
e.zh: 工人在通风橱下处理这种亚硝基硫酸混合物。

e.en: The sheriff called him a {no-account} drifter.
e.zh: 警长说他是个不中用的流浪汉。

e.en: She refused to trust that {no-account} excuse.
e.zh: 她不肯相信那个毫无价值的借口。

e.en: The umpire called {no-ball} after the bowler overstepped.
e.zh: 投球手越线后，裁判判了无球。

e.en: That wild pitch was ruled a {no-ball}.
e.zh: 那次乱投被判为未成局的一投。

e.en: The philosopher wrote about {no-being} and emptiness.
e.zh: 那位哲学家写到了不存在与空无。

e.en: For him, death meant {no-being}, not sleep.
e.zh: 对他来说，死亡意味着非存在，而不是沉睡。

no-brainer.t: 显而易见的事；很容易的决定

e.en: Choosing the cheaper plan was a {no-brainer}.
e.zh: 选择更便宜的方案是显而易见的事。

e.en: For a fan, buying tickets was a {no-brainer}.
e.zh: 对粉丝来说，买票根本不用犹豫。

no-brainers.t: 显而易见的事；容易的决定

e.en: Those two safety fixes are {no-brainers}.
e.zh: 那两项安全修复都是显而易见的事。

e.en: For experienced hikers, these routes are {no-brainers}.
e.zh: 对有经验的徒步者来说，这些路线很容易选。

e.en: The minister gave a brief {no-comment} reply.
e.zh: 部长简短地回答说无可奉告。

e.en: Her smile was a clear {no-comment}.
e.zh: 她的微笑明显表示不予置评。

e.en: They took a {no-compromise} approach to safety.
e.zh: 他们在安全问题上采取零妥协的做法。

e.en: The designer promised {no-compromise} quality.
e.zh: 设计师承诺质量上绝不让步。

e.en: Parliament held a {no-confidence} vote on Friday.
e.zh: 议会在周五举行了不信任投票。

e.en: The letter expressed {no-confidence} in the board.
e.zh: 这封信表达了对董事会的不信任。

e.en: His neighbors dismissed him as a {no-count} drunk.
e.zh: 邻居们把他看成一个不中用的酒鬼。

e.en: That was a {no-count} promise from the start.
e.zh: 那个承诺从一开始就毫无价值。

no-fly.t: 禁止飞行的；禁飞名单的

e.en: The area became a {no-fly} zone overnight.
e.zh: 该地区一夜之间成了禁飞区。

e.en: His name was added to the {no-fly} list.
e.zh: 他的名字被加入了禁飞名单。

no-frills.t: 朴实无华的；只提供基本服务的

e.en: We booked a {no-frills} hotel near the station.
e.zh: 我们订了车站附近一家只提供基本服务的酒店。

e.en: The airline offers cheap, {no-frills} flights.
e.zh: 这家航空公司提供便宜但没有额外服务的航班。

e.en: Without a permit, the plan is a {no-go}.
e.zh: 没有许可证，这个计划就行不通。

e.en: That street is a {no-go} area after dark.
e.zh: 天黑后那条街是禁止进入的区域。

e.en: The referee signaled {no-goal} after the review.
e.zh: 复核后，裁判示意进球无效。

e.en: A project with {no-goal} quickly loses direction.
e.zh: 没有目标的项目很快就会失去方向。

e.en: This charger is {no-good}; it keeps cutting out.
e.zh: 这个充电器没用，总是断电。

e.en: Everyone warned her about that {no-good} boyfriend.
e.zh: 大家都提醒她小心那个不靠谱的男朋友。

e.en: The old comic featured a charming {no-goodnik}.
e.zh: 那本老漫画里有个讨人喜欢的坏蛋。

e.en: Her uncle called every lazy clerk a {no-goodnik}.
e.zh: 她叔叔把每个懒散的店员都叫作不中用的人。

e.en: The company faces a {no-growth} market this year.
e.zh: 公司今年面对的是一个无增长的市场。

e.en: Analysts warned of a long {no-growth} period.
e.zh: 分析师警告说将有一段长期零增长时期。

e.en: The pitcher threw a {no-hit} game in June.
e.zh: 那名投手在六月投出了一场无安打比赛。

e.en: It was a {no-hit} search for the missing file.
e.zh: 那次搜索没有找到丢失的文件。

no-hitter.t: 无安打比赛；投出无安打者

e.en: She pitched a {no-hitter} in the final.
e.zh: 她在决赛中投出了一场无安打比赛。

e.en: The rookie celebrated his first {no-hitter}.
e.zh: 这名新秀庆祝自己首次投出无安打比赛。

no-holds-barred.t: 毫无限制的；无所顾忌的

e.en: The debate became a {no-holds-barred} attack.
e.zh: 这场辩论变成了一场毫无顾忌的攻击。

e.en: They promised a {no-holds-barred} investigation.
e.zh: 他们承诺进行一次不受限制的调查。

no-hoper.t: 毫无希望的人；没前途者

e.en: Critics called the young boxer a {no-hoper}.
e.zh: 评论人士说这名年轻拳手毫无希望。

e.en: He was tired of being treated as a {no-hoper}.
e.zh: 他厌倦了被人当成没前途的人。

e.en: Police obtained a {no-knock} warrant before dawn.
e.zh: 警方在黎明前取得了免敲门搜查令。

e.en: The raid followed a controversial {no-knock} policy.
e.zh: 这次突袭依据的是一项有争议的免敲门政策。

e.en: Measure the motor speed under {no-load} conditions.
e.zh: 在无负载条件下测量电机转速。

e.en: She chose a {no-load} mutual fund.
e.zh: 她选择了一只免手续费的共同基金。

e.en: It felt like a {no-lose} situation for us.
e.zh: 这对我们来说像是一个不会输的局面。

e.en: The contract gave them a {no-lose} deal.
e.zh: 这份合同让他们得到了一笔稳赚不赔的交易。

e.en: The trench opened onto a bleak {no-man} zone.
e.zh: 战壕通向一片荒凉的无人地带。

e.en: Old maps marked the marsh as {no-man} land.
e.zh: 旧地图把那片沼泽标成无人地带。

e.en: Soldiers crossed {no-man's-land} at dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明时穿过无人区。

e.en: The policy left renters in a legal {no-man's-land}.
e.zh: 这项政策让租客陷入法律上的灰色地带。

e.en: A {no-neck} guard blocked the doorway.
e.zh: 一个脖子短粗的保安挡住了门口。

e.en: The cartoon showed a {no-neck} bully shouting orders.
e.zh: 漫画里画着一个粗壮恶霸在发号施令。

e.en: Wearing jeans is a {no-no} at that club.
e.zh: 在那家俱乐部穿牛仔裤是禁忌。

e.en: Interrupting the judge is a serious {no-no}.
e.zh: 打断法官说话是非常不妥的事。

e.en: She gave us {no-nonsense} advice about money.
e.zh: 她给了我们务实直接的理财建议。

e.en: His {no-nonsense} tone ended the argument quickly.
e.zh: 他不废话的语气很快结束了争论。

e.en: The firm issued {no-par} shares last year.
e.zh: 这家公司去年发行了无票面价值股票。

e.en: Investors asked how {no-par} stock would be valued.
e.zh: 投资者询问无票面价值股票将如何估值。

e.en: They converted the shares into {no-par-value} stock.
e.zh: 他们把这些股份转换成无票面价值股票。

e.en: A {no-par-value} issue can simplify corporate accounting.
e.zh: 发行无票面价值股票可简化公司会计处理。

no-place.t: 不适合的地方；虚无之地

e.en: A courtroom is {no-place} for jokes.
e.zh: 法庭可不是开玩笑的地方。

e.en: The novel's town feels like a lonely {no-place}.
e.zh: 小说里的小镇像一个孤寂的虚无之地。

e.en: There is no such thing as a {no-risk} investment.
e.zh: 根本没有完全无风险的投资。

e.en: The clinic offers a {no-risk} screening test.
e.zh: 诊所提供一种低风险筛查检测。

e.en: A {no-see-um} bit my ankle by the lake.
e.zh: 湖边有只小蠓咬了我的脚踝。

e.en: The mesh keeps every {no-see-um} out of the tent.
e.zh: 这种网布能把咬人的小飞虫挡在帐篷外。

e.en: The doctor charged a fee for the {no-show}.
e.zh: 医生对这次爽约收取了费用。

e.en: Three passengers were {no-show} at boarding time.
e.zh: 登机时有三名乘客没有到场。

e.en: The union accepted a temporary {no-strike} agreement.
e.zh: 工会接受了一项临时不得罢工协议。

e.en: The pitcher started the inning with a {no-strike} count.
e.zh: 投手在这一局开始时还没有好球计数。

e.en: They offered a {no-strings} grant to the school.
e.zh: 他们向学校提供了一笔无附加条件的补助。

e.en: He wanted a {no-strings} relationship after the divorce.
e.zh: 离婚后他想要一段没有承诺牵绊的关系。

e.en: The farm switched to {no-till} planting this spring.
e.zh: 这家农场今年春天改用免耕播种。

e.en: {No-till} can reduce erosion on dry slopes.
e.zh: 免耕法可以减少干燥坡地的水土流失。

e.en: She opened the hand with one {no-trump}.
e.zh: 她开叫一无将牌。

e.en: A {no-trump} contract depends on careful counting.
e.zh: 无将牌定约取决于仔细算牌。

e.en: The mayor faced a {no-win} decision on taxes.
e.zh: 市长在税收问题上面临怎么选都难的决定。

e.en: Arguing with him is a {no-win} situation.
e.zh: 和他争辩是一种没有胜算的局面。

e.en: The word became a {noa} in village speech.
e.zh: 这个词在村民的话语中成了禁忌词的替代语。

e.en: Linguists studied each {noa} used for sacred animals.
e.zh: 语言学家研究了每个用于神圣动物的禁忌替代词。

e.en: The report described unusual {noasthenia} after exertion.
e.zh: 报告描述了劳累后异常地不觉虚弱。

e.en: Doctors noted {noasthenia} despite the patient's infection.
e.zh: 医生注意到患者虽有感染却没有虚弱感。

e.en: He was treated like a {nobady} in court.
e.zh: 他在法庭上被当成无足轻重的小人物。

e.en: The satire turns every proud official into a {nobady}.
e.zh: 这篇讽刺作品把每个傲慢官员都写成小人物。

e.en: He wore a {nobbie} jacket to the dance.
e.zh: 他穿了一件时髦外套去参加舞会。

e.en: That old bicycle looks surprisingly {nobbie} now.
e.zh: 那辆旧自行车现在看起来意外地漂亮。

e.en: She dressed {nobbily} for the village fair.
e.zh: 她为村里的集市打扮得很时髦。

e.en: The room was {nobbily} furnished but still cozy.
e.zh: 房间布置得漂亮讲究，但仍然舒适。

e.en: It was {nobbut} a scratch, he said.
e.zh: 他说那只不过是一道擦伤。

e.en: She's {nobbut} a child in his eyes.
e.zh: 在他眼里她不过是个孩子。

e.en: The philosopher wrote about {nobeing} and silence.
e.zh: 那位哲学家写到了非存在与沉默。

e.en: In the poem, love slips toward {nobeing}.
e.zh: 在诗中，爱逐渐滑向不存在的状态。

e.en: {Nobelium} is a synthetic radioactive element.
e.zh: 锘是一种人工合成的放射性元素。

e.en: The lab reported a trace of {nobelium} in the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室报告说实验中发现了微量锘。

e.en: The historian studied the family's {nobiliary} records.
e.zh: 那位历史学家研究了这个家族的贵族记录。

e.en: A {nobiliary} title did not guarantee wealth.
e.zh: 贵族头衔并不一定保证拥有财富。

noble-minded.t: 品格高尚的；心胸高洁的

e.en: Her {noble-minded} response impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她高尚的回应给所有人留下了深刻印象。

e.en: He made a {noble-minded} attempt to forgive his rival.
e.zh: 他以宽厚高洁的心态试图原谅对手。

e.en: His {noble-mindedness} made him refuse revenge.
e.zh: 他的高尚品格使他拒绝报复。

e.en: The novel celebrates {noble-mindedness} in ordinary people.
e.zh: 这部小说赞颂普通人身上的高洁心胸。

nobleite.t: 诺布尔石；一种稀有矿物

e.en: The sample was identified as {nobleite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这份样本在显微镜下被鉴定为诺布尔石。

e.en: Collectors rarely find good crystals of {nobleite}.
e.zh: 收藏者很少能找到品质好的诺布尔石晶体。

e.en: She showed the {noblest} kind of courage.
e.zh: 她表现出了最高尚的勇气。

e.en: Even the {noblest} families faced hard times.
e.zh: 即使最尊贵的家族也会遭遇艰难时期。

e.en: Several {noblewomen} funded the hospital.
e.zh: 几位女贵族资助了这家医院。

e.en: The portraits show {noblewomen} in formal dress.
e.zh: 这些肖像画展示了身着礼服的贵族妇女。

nocardamin.t: 诺卡达明；一种细菌产物

e.en: Researchers isolated {nocardamin} from the bacterial culture.
e.zh: 研究人员从细菌培养物中分离出了诺卡达明。

e.en: The paper describes how {nocardamin} binds iron.
e.zh: 论文描述了诺卡达明如何结合铁。

e.en: The patient was treated for pulmonary {nocardiasis}.
e.zh: 这名患者因肺部诺卡菌病接受治疗。

e.en: Doctors suspected {nocardiasis} after the unusual scan results.
e.zh: 看到异常的扫描结果后，医生怀疑是诺卡菌病。

e.en: The warning may have caused a {nocebo} effect.
e.zh: 这则警告可能引发了反安慰剂效应。

e.en: Researchers tried to reduce {nocebo} responses in the trial.
e.zh: 研究人员试图减少试验中的反安慰剂反应。

e.en: The lawyer argued that the act was {nocent}.
e.zh: 律师辩称这一行为是有罪的。

e.en: Old medical texts called the substance {nocent}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献称这种物质有害。

e.en: The geologist found {nocerite} in the old collection.
e.zh: 地质学家在旧藏品中发现了诺塞石。

e.en: A thin vein of {nocerite} crossed the rock.
e.zh: 岩石中穿过一条细细的诺塞石矿脉。

e.en: The experiment measured {nociassociation} in trained animals.
e.zh: 实验测量了受训动物的痛觉联想。

e.en: Clinicians discussed {nociassociation} after repeated painful stimuli.
e.zh: 临床医生讨论了反复疼痛刺激后的疼痛关联。

e.en: The drug reduced {nociceptive} pain in the study.
e.zh: 这种药在研究中减轻了伤害感受性疼痛。

e.en: These nerves carry {nociceptive} signals to the brain.
e.zh: 这些神经把痛觉信号传到大脑。

nocodazole.t: 诺考达唑；一种实验药物

e.en: The cells were treated with {nocodazole} overnight.
e.zh: 这些细胞用诺考达唑处理了一整夜。

e.en: Scientists use {nocodazole} to disrupt microtubules.
e.zh: 科学家用诺考达唑来破坏微管。

e.en: The doctor noted a {noctal} pattern in the symptoms.
e.zh: 医生注意到这些症状呈夜间发作的模式。

e.en: Old texts used {noctal} to describe night blindness.
e.zh: 旧文献用noctal来描述夜盲。

e.en: The test suggested mild {noctalbuminuria}.
e.zh: 检测结果提示有轻度夜间蛋白尿。

e.en: Doctors monitored {noctalbuminuria} during the sleep study.
e.zh: 医生在睡眠研究期间监测夜间蛋白尿。

e.en: Vitamin deficiency can cause {noctalopia}.
e.zh: 维生素缺乏可能导致夜盲症。

e.en: Her {noctalopia} made driving after dusk difficult.
e.zh: 她的夜盲症使黄昏后开车变得困难。

e.en: The child was sometimes {noctambulant} during stressful weeks.
e.zh: 在压力大的几周里，这个孩子有时会梦游。

e.en: A {noctambulant} figure moved through the hallway.
e.zh: 一个夜间行走的身影穿过了走廊。

noctambulation.t: 梦游；夜间行走；夜游症状

e.en: The doctor asked about his episodes of {noctambulation}.
e.zh: 医生询问了他几次梦游发作的情况。

e.en: Old travel notes describe the monk's quiet {noctambulation}.
e.zh: 旧游记描述了那位僧人在夜里安静行走的情形。

e.en: The nurse gently guided the {noctambule} back to bed.
e.zh: 护士轻轻把那个梦游者引回床上。

e.en: In the poem, the lonely {noctambule} crosses empty streets.
e.zh: 在诗中，孤独的夜游者穿过空荡的街道。

e.en: Childhood {noctambulism} often disappears with age.
e.zh: 儿童期梦游症常会随着年龄增长而消失。

e.en: The case report linked stress to his sudden {noctambulism}.
e.zh: 病例报告把压力和他突然出现的梦游症联系起来。

e.en: A {noctambulist} may seem awake but remain asleep.
e.zh: 梦游者看起来可能像醒着，其实仍在睡眠中。

e.en: The novelist follows a {noctambulist} through the city.
e.zh: 小说家描写一名夜间行走者穿过城市。

e.en: His {noctambulous} habits worried the whole family.
e.zh: 他梦游般的习惯让全家人都很担心。

e.en: The film has a slow, {noctambulous} rhythm.
e.zh: 这部电影有一种缓慢而夜游般的节奏。

e.en: The garden includes several {noctiflorous} plants.
e.zh: 花园里有几种夜间开花的植物。

e.en: Moths are drawn to the {noctiflorous} vine after dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏后，蛾子会被那株夜间开花的藤蔓吸引。

noctiluca.t: 夜光虫；发光海生微生物

e.en: A bloom of {noctiluca} made the waves glow blue.
e.zh: 夜光虫大量繁殖，使海浪泛出蓝光。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {noctiluca} looked like a tiny lantern.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，夜光虫看起来像一盏小灯笼。

noctilucae.t: 夜光虫复数；发光微生物

e.en: Many {noctilucae} drifted near the harbor wall.
e.zh: 许多夜光虫漂浮在港口堤墙附近。

e.en: The biologist counted the {noctilucae} in each water sample.
e.zh: 生物学家统计了每份水样中的夜光虫数量。

e.en: The bay's faint {noctilucence} amazed the visitors.
e.zh: 海湾微弱的夜光现象让游客惊叹。

e.en: Researchers measured the {noctilucence} after sunset.
e.zh: 研究人员在日落后测量了夜间发光现象。

e.en: We saw {noctilucent} clouds shining after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，我们看见夜光云在天空中发亮。

e.en: The sea became {noctilucent} when the plankton were disturbed.
e.zh: 浮游生物受到扰动时，海面变得会在夜里发光。

e.en: Her {noctiphobia} made sleeping alone difficult.
e.zh: 她怕黑，所以独自入睡很困难。

e.en: The therapist treated his severe {noctiphobia} gradually.
e.zh: 治疗师逐步治疗他严重的夜晚恐惧症。

e.en: A {noctivagant} figure moved along the riverbank.
e.zh: 一个夜间游荡的身影沿着河岸移动。

e.en: The essay praises the {noctivagant} who knows the city after dark.
e.zh: 这篇随笔赞美熟悉入夜后城市的夜游者。

e.en: The story follows a {noctivagous} traveler through alleys.
e.zh: 故事描写一名夜行旅人穿过小巷。

e.en: Some {noctivagous} insects avoid the daytime heat.
e.zh: 一些夜行昆虫会避开白天的炎热。

noctograph.t: 夜间书写器；暗中书写板

e.en: The officer used a {noctograph} to write without light.
e.zh: 那名军官用夜间书写器在无光处写字。

e.en: An antique {noctograph} appeared in the museum display.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里出现了一件古老的暗中书写板。

e.en: The device improves {noctovision} for security patrols.
e.zh: 这种设备能提升安保巡逻时的夜视能力。

e.en: Owls have remarkable {noctovision} in dim forests.
e.zh: 猫头鹰在昏暗森林里有出色的夜间视觉能力。

e.en: The guard adjusted his {noctovisor} before entering the tunnel.
e.zh: 守卫进入隧道前调好了夜视镜。
