e.zh: 论文把几种去甲水杨酸类化合物归为一组。

e.en: Some {norsals} showed activity in the assay.
e.zh: 一些去甲水杨酸类化合物在测定中显示出活性。

e.en: The poem used a stark {norsel} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗采用了冷峻的北欧式节奏。

e.en: His carving had a rough {norsel} character.
e.zh: 他的雕刻带有粗犷的北欧风格。

norsells.t: 诺斯式作品；北欧风格物

e.en: The archive listed several old {norsells}.
e.zh: 档案列出了几件旧的北欧风格作品。

e.en: Collectors argued about whether the {norsells} were genuine.
e.zh: 收藏者争论这些北欧风格物是否真品。

e.en: The {Norsemen} sailed across the North Atlantic.
e.zh: 古代北欧人曾横渡北大西洋。

e.en: Many legends describe fierce {Norsemen} in battle.
e.zh: 许多传说描写了战斗中勇猛的维京人。

e.en: The extract contained {norsenecionandione} and related compounds.
e.zh: 提取物含有去甲千里光烷二酮及相关化合物。

e.en: Researchers reported {norsenecionandione} in the plant sample.
e.zh: 研究人员报告植物样本中有去甲千里光烷二酮。

e.en: The geologist identified {norsethite} in the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在岩石中鉴定出钡白云石。

e.en: Crystals of {norsethite} formed in the carbonate vein.
e.zh: 钡白云石晶体形成在碳酸盐矿脉中。

northpaw.t: 左撇子；左手拳手或投手

e.en: The young boxer fought as a {northpaw} in his first match.
e.zh: 这名年轻拳手在首场比赛中以左手拳手的姿态出战。

e.en: As a {northpaw}, she found ordinary scissors awkward to use.
e.zh: 作为左撇子，她觉得普通剪刀用起来很别扭。

e.en: They reached the {northwesternmost} village before sunset.
e.zh: 他们在日落前到达了最西北的村庄。

e.en: The lighthouse marks the island's {northwesternmost} point.
e.zh: 那座灯塔标示着岛上最西北的地点。

nortriptyline.t: 去甲替林，一种抗抑郁药

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {nortriptyline} for chronic nerve pain.
e.zh: 医生给她开了去甲替林来治疗慢性神经痛。

e.en: Do not stop taking {nortriptyline} without medical advice.
e.zh: 不要在没有医嘱的情况下停止服用去甲替林。

e.en: The supplement label listed {norvaline} among its ingredients.
e.zh: 这款补充剂的标签把正缬氨酸列在成分中。

e.en: Researchers measured {norvaline} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样本中的正缬氨酸含量。

e.en: The old road ran {norward} across the moor.
e.zh: 那条旧路向北穿过荒原。

e.en: A {norward} wind chilled the harbor.
e.zh: 一阵北来的风让港口变得寒冷。

e.en: The herd moved {norwards} as the weather warmed.
e.zh: 天气转暖后，兽群向北移动。

e.en: They sailed {norwards} along the coast for two days.
e.zh: 他们沿海岸向北航行了两天。

e.en: The groom filled the horse's {nose-bag} with oats.
e.zh: 马夫把燕麦装进马的饲料袋里。

e.en: We grabbed a quick {nose-bag} at the roadside cafe.
e.zh: 我们在路边咖啡馆匆匆吃了一顿便饭。

e.en: He got a {nose-bleed} after the ball hit his face.
e.zh: 球打到他脸上后，他流了鼻血。

e.en: A dry room can sometimes cause a {nose-bleed}.
e.zh: 房间太干有时会引起鼻出血。

e.en: She often gets {nose-bleeds} in winter.
e.zh: 她冬天经常流鼻血。

e.en: Frequent {nose-bleeds} should be checked by a doctor.
e.zh: 频繁鼻出血应该请医生检查。

e.en: Engineers tested the rocket's {nose-cone} in a wind tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在风洞中测试火箭的头锥。

e.en: The aircraft's {nose-cone} was damaged by hail.
e.zh: 飞机的机头锥被冰雹损坏了。

e.en: The guide did a quick {nose-count} before the bus left.
e.zh: 巴士出发前，导游快速清点了人数。

e.en: Management wanted a {nose-count} of everyone attending lunch.
e.zh: 管理层想统计参加午餐的人数。

e.en: The plane went into a sudden {nose-dive}.
e.zh: 飞机突然进入俯冲状态。

e.en: Sales took a {nose-dive} after the price increase.
e.zh: 涨价后销售额暴跌。

e.en: The teacher told him that {nose-picking} was rude.
e.zh: 老师告诉他抠鼻子很不礼貌。

e.en: Parents often try to stop {nose-picking} in public.
e.zh: 父母常常会制止孩子在公共场合抠鼻子。

e.en: She wore a small silver {nose-ring}.
e.zh: 她戴着一个小小的银色鼻环。

e.en: The bull had a heavy {nose-ring} for control.
e.zh: 那头公牛戴着沉重的鼻环以便控制。

e.en: His {nose-thumbing} at the rules angered the committee.
e.zh: 他公然蔑视规则，激怒了委员会。

e.en: The cartoon showed a child {nose-thumbing} at authority.
e.zh: 那幅漫画画了一个孩子对权威做鬼脸表示蔑视。

nose-to-tail.t: 首尾相接的；整只利用的

e.en: Cars were lined up {nose-to-tail} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后，汽车一辆接一辆首尾相接地排着。

e.en: The restaurant promotes {nose-to-tail} cooking with local pork.
e.zh: 这家餐厅推广用本地猪肉从头到尾充分利用的烹饪方式。

e.en: She tightened the horse's {noseband} before the lesson.
e.zh: 上课前她把马笼头的鼻革系紧了。

e.en: A loose {noseband} can affect the bridle's fit.
e.zh: 鼻革太松会影响马笼头的贴合度。

e.en: The shop sells leather {nosebands} for riding bridles.
e.zh: 这家店出售骑马用笼头的皮质鼻革。

e.en: Some riders prefer padded {nosebands} for sensitive horses.
e.zh: 有些骑手更喜欢给敏感的马使用带衬垫的鼻革。

e.en: The missile's {nosecone} separated during the test.
e.zh: 导弹的头锥在测试中分离了。

e.en: Technicians inspected the aircraft {nosecone} for cracks.
e.zh: 技术人员检查了飞机机头锥是否有裂纹。

e.en: The factory produces composite {nosecones} for small rockets.
e.zh: 这家工厂为小型火箭生产复合材料头锥。

e.en: Several aircraft {nosecones} were replaced after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，几架飞机的机头锥被更换了。

e.en: We need a {nosecount} before ordering dinner.
e.zh: 订晚餐前我们需要清点人数。

e.en: The organizer kept a {nosecount} at the door.
e.zh: 组织者在门口统计人数。

e.en: The helmet had a metal {noseguard} to protect the face.
e.zh: 这顶头盔有金属护鼻甲来保护面部。

e.en: The player adjusted his {noseguard} before returning to the field.
e.zh: 那名球员回到场上前调整了鼻部护具。

e.en: The old statue looked {noseless} after centuries of damage.
e.zh: 经过几个世纪的损坏，那座旧雕像看起来没有鼻子。

e.en: The mask had a strange {noseless} face.
e.zh: 那个面具有一张奇怪的无鼻面孔。

e.en: Please don't {nosepick} at the dinner table.
e.zh: 请不要在餐桌上挖鼻孔。

e.en: The child tried to {nosepick} when nobody was watching.
e.zh: 那孩子趁没人看见时想挖鼻孔。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the bent {nosepipe} on the aircraft.
e.zh: 机修工更换了飞机上弯曲的鼻形管。

e.en: Air passed through a narrow {nosepipe} into the mask.
e.zh: 空气通过一根狭窄的鼻管进入面罩。

e.en: The helmet's {noseplate} protected the rider's face.
e.zh: 头盔的鼻部护板保护了骑手的脸。

e.en: Workers fitted a new {noseplate} to the front of the machine.
e.zh: 工人给机器前端装上了新的鼻部护板。

e.en: He pulled a dirty {noserag} from his pocket.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一块脏手帕。

e.en: Grandpa called every handkerchief a {noserag}.
e.zh: 爷爷把每块手帕都叫作擦鼻子的布。

e.en: The lecture introduced {nosetiology} to medical students.
e.zh: 这堂课向医学生介绍了疾病病因学。

e.en: His paper on {nosetiology} used very old terminology.
e.zh: 他关于疾病病因学的论文使用了很古老的术语。

e.en: She knitted a tiny {nosewarmer} for the ski trip.
e.zh: 她为滑雪旅行织了一个小小的暖鼻套。

e.en: The joke shop sold a red {nosewarmer} for winter.
e.zh: 那家玩笑用品店卖一种冬天用的红色暖鼻套。

e.en: The plane's {nosewheel} touched the runway first.
e.zh: 飞机的前轮最先接触跑道。

e.en: A damaged {nosewheel} delayed the flight for hours.
e.zh: 受损的飞机前轮让航班延误了好几个小时。

e.en: A small scar marked her left {nosewing}.
e.zh: 她左侧鼻翼上有一道小疤。

e.en: The doctor checked the swollen {nosewing} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了肿起的鼻翼。

e.en: The neighbor was a real {nosey-parker} about our guests.
e.zh: 那个邻居对我们的客人真是爱管闲事。

e.en: Stop being such a {nosey-parker} and close the diary.
e.zh: 别这么爱管闲事，把日记合上。

e.en: The old film showed a shadowy {nosferatu} in the doorway.
e.zh: 那部老电影里，门口出现了一个阴森的吸血鬼。

e.en: He jokingly called his pale roommate a {nosferatu}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地把脸色苍白的室友叫作吸血鬼。

e.en: We had a proper {nosh-up} after the match.
e.zh: 比赛后我们痛痛快快地大吃了一顿。

e.en: The family planned a big {nosh-up} for Sunday lunch.
e.zh: 这家人计划周日午餐吃一顿丰盛大餐。

e.en: My aunt is {nosier} than anyone on the street.
e.zh: 我姑妈比街上任何人都更爱管闲事。

e.en: Reporters grew {nosier} after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻曝光后，记者们变得更加爱追问隐私。

e.en: He is the {nosiest} person in the office.
e.zh: 他是办公室里最爱管闲事的人。

e.en: The {nosiest} questions came from the youngest reporter.
e.zh: 最刺探隐私的问题来自那名最年轻的记者。

e.en: She {nosily} read the note over his shoulder.
e.zh: 她爱管闲事地越过他的肩膀看那张便条。

e.en: The clerk {nosily} asked why I needed the medicine.
e.zh: 店员多管闲事地问我为什么需要这种药。

e.en: Her {nosiness} made every meeting uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她爱管闲事，让每次会议都很不自在。

e.en: Curiosity is useful, but {nosiness} can offend people.
e.zh: 好奇心有用，但过分打听会冒犯别人。

e.en: The old map marked the building as a {nosocomium}.
e.zh: 那张旧地图把这栋建筑标为病院。

e.en: In Latin texts, a {nosocomium} often means a hospital.
e.zh: 在拉丁文献中，nosocomium常指医院。

e.en: The practitioner recommended a {nosode} for prevention.
e.zh: 那名从业者建议用一种顺势疗法病源制剂来预防。

e.en: Doctors warned that a {nosode} cannot replace vaccination.
e.zh: 医生警告说，顺势疗法病源制剂不能替代疫苗接种。

e.en: The article discusses {nosogenesis} in chronic lung disease.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论慢性肺病的发病过程。

e.en: Early physicians used {nosogenesis} to describe disease origins.
e.zh: 早期医生用疾病发生来描述疾病的起源。

e.en: The study examined {nosogenetic} factors in the outbreak.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了疫情中的致病发生因素。

e.en: He used a {nosogenetic} model to explain the symptoms.
e.zh: 他用发病学模型来解释这些症状。

e.en: Her dissertation focused on nineteenth-century {nosography}.
e.zh: 她的论文关注十九世纪的疾病分类描述。

e.en: Modern {nosography} changed how doctors named disorders.
e.zh: 现代疾病分类描述改变了医生给疾病命名的方式。

e.en: The cases were grouped {nosologically} rather than by age.
e.zh: 这些病例是按疾病分类而不是按年龄分组的。

e.en: He argued {nosologically} that the syndrome was distinct.
e.zh: 他从疾病分类角度论证该综合征是独立的。

e.en: A careful {nosologist} revised the hospital's disease list.
e.zh: 一位严谨的疾病分类学家修订了医院的疾病清单。

e.en: The {nosologist} compared old diagnoses with modern terms.
e.zh: 这位疾病分类学家把旧诊断与现代术语进行了比较。

e.en: Psychiatric {nosology} has changed many times.
e.zh: 精神疾病分类学已经多次变化。

e.en: The textbook begins with a chapter on {nosology}.
e.zh: 这本教材以疾病分类学的一章开篇。

e.en: The rare {nosomycosis} affected the patient's lungs.
e.zh: 这种罕见的真菌性疾病影响了患者的肺部。

e.en: Veterinarians identified {nosomycosis} in several farm animals.
e.zh: 兽医在几只农场动物身上发现了霉菌病。

nosophen.t: 诺索芬，一种旧式消毒药物制剂

e.en: The old medical text listed {nosophen} among iodine compounds.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书把诺索芬列在碘化合物之中。

e.en: Few modern pharmacists would recognize {nosophen} today.
e.zh: 如今很少有现代药剂师会认得诺索芬。

e.en: Her {nosophobia} made every cough feel alarming.
e.zh: 她的恐病症让每一次咳嗽都显得吓人。

e.en: The therapist helped him manage severe {nosophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗师帮助他应对严重的恐病症。

e.en: The researcher studied {nosopoietic} factors in crowded housing.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了拥挤住房中的致病因素。

e.en: Polluted water can have a {nosopoietic} effect on communities.
e.zh: 受污染的水可能对社区产生致病影响。

e.en: The lecture discussed {nosotrophy} in ancient hospitals.
e.zh: 讲座讨论了古代医院中的疾病护理。

e.en: Good {nosotrophy} requires patience and careful observation.
e.zh: 良好的病人照护需要耐心和细致观察。

e.en: The technician marked the clip as {nosound}.
e.zh: 技术员把这段视频标记为无声。

e.en: A {nosound} alarm would be useless in that factory.
e.zh: 在那家工厂里，无声警报根本没有用。

e.en: She brushed tiny {nossels} of bread from the table.
e.zh: 她把桌上的小面包屑刷掉。

e.en: The carpenter found {nossels} of wood under the bench.
e.zh: 木匠在工作凳下发现了一些木头碎片。

e.en: As a {nostalgist}, he collected old train tickets.
e.zh: 作为一个怀旧者，他收藏旧火车票。

e.en: The film pleased every {nostalgist} in the audience.
e.zh: 这部电影让观众中的每个怀旧者都很满意。

e.en: After rain, {nostoc} formed green jelly on the path.
e.zh: 雨后，念珠藻在小路上形成了绿色胶状物。

e.en: The biology class examined {nostoc} under a microscope.
e.zh: 生物课上学生们用显微镜观察念珠藻。

nostologic.t: 返乡欲研究的；怀乡学的

e.en: His paper used a {nostologic} approach to homesickness.
e.zh: 他的论文用怀乡学的方法研究思乡情绪。

e.en: The doctor noted several {nostologic} symptoms in soldiers.
e.zh: 医生记录了士兵身上的几种怀乡相关症状。

e.en: Early {nostology} treated homesickness as a medical problem.
e.zh: 早期怀乡学把思乡看作一种医学问题。

e.en: She found the term {nostology} in an old psychology journal.
e.zh: 她在一本旧心理学期刊中发现了怀乡学这个词。

e.en: The sailor's {nostomania} grew worse during the voyage.
e.zh: 航行期间，那名水手的病态思乡越来越严重。

e.en: Old physicians sometimes diagnosed homesick soldiers with {nostomania}.
e.zh: 旧时医生有时会把思乡士兵诊断为强烈返乡欲。

nostopathy.t: 思乡病；因怀乡引起的病症

e.en: The diary described his {nostopathy} after leaving home.
e.zh: 日记描述了他离家后的思乡病。

e.en: Doctors once used {nostopathy} for illness linked to homesickness.
e.zh: 医生曾用思乡病来指与怀乡有关的疾病。

e.en: The neighbor is a real {nosy-parker} about our visitors.
e.zh: 那个邻居对我们的访客特别爱管闲事。

e.en: Stop being a {nosy-parker} and close the drawer.
e.zh: 别再做个爱管闲事的人了，把抽屉关上。

e.en: The physician recorded each {nosydrast} in careful detail.
e.zh: 医生仔细记录了每一种疾病表现。

e.en: An unusual {nosydrast} puzzled the medical students.
e.zh: 一种异常病征让医学生们很困惑。

e.en: I am {not-at-all} worried about the delay.
e.zh: 我一点也不担心这次延误。

e.en: The answer was {not-at-all} what she expected.
e.zh: 这个答案完全不是她所预期的。

e.en: She works for a {not-for-profit} health organization.
e.zh: 她在一家非营利医疗组织工作。

e.en: The event was run on a {not-for-profit} basis.
e.zh: 这项活动是按非营利方式运营的。

e.en: When the vase broke, everyone said {not-me}.
e.zh: 花瓶打碎时，每个人都说不是我。

e.en: That cold reply felt very {not-me}.
e.zh: 那种冷淡的回应很不像我。

e.en: I am {not-seeing} the problem with your plan.
e.zh: 我没看出你的计划有什么问题。

e.en: After {not-seeing} him for years, she felt nervous.
e.zh: 多年没见他之后，她感到有些紧张。

e.en: The scholar added a small {nota} beside the passage.
e.zh: 学者在那段文字旁加了一个小注记。

e.en: In the manuscript, each {nota} points to a correction.
e.zh: 在手稿中，每个标记都指向一处修改。

e.en: The editor listed the {notabilia} at the chapter's end.
e.zh: 编辑在章节末尾列出了值得注意的事项。

e.en: Her notebook was filled with {notabilia} from the trial.
e.zh: 她的笔记本里记满了审判中的要点。

e.en: The insect's {notal} plate was clearly visible.
e.zh: 这只昆虫的背板清晰可见。

e.en: He complained of {notal} pain after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后他抱怨背部疼痛。

e.en: The patient described persistent {notalgia} near the shoulder blade.
e.zh: 病人描述肩胛骨附近持续的背部神经痛。

e.en: Mild {notalgia} can still disturb sleep.
e.zh: 轻微背痛仍然可能影响睡眠。

e.en: The rare defect was classified as {notancephalia}.
e.zh: 这种罕见缺陷被归类为无头畸形。

e.en: A historical atlas illustrated {notancephalia} in malformed embryos.
e.zh: 一本历史图谱展示了畸形胚胎中的无头畸形。

e.en: The professor wrote several {notanda} in the margin.
e.zh: 教授在页边写下了几条应注意事项。

e.en: Before signing, review the {notanda} on the final page.
e.zh: 签字前，请查看最后一页的备忘要点。

e.en: The beetle's {nototheca} was described in the old entomology paper.
e.zh: 那篇旧昆虫学论文描述了甲虫的背板。

e.en: A damaged {nototheca} can help identify the specimen's condition.
e.zh: 受损的背部硬片有助于判断标本的状况。

e.en: The fossil belonged to a small {notoungulate} from South America.
e.zh: 这块化石属于一种来自南美的小型南蹄目动物。

e.en: Researchers compared the {notoungulate} jaw with modern herbivores.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种南蹄目动物的颌骨与现代食草动物作比较。

e.en: The pianist played a quiet {notturno} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后，钢琴家弹奏了一首安静的夜曲。

e.en: Her dark {notturno} showed the harbor under moonlight.
e.zh: 她那幅深色夜景画表现了月光下的港口。

e.en: The insect's {notum} bears two narrow stripes.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的胸背板上有两条窄纹。

e.en: He examined the {notum} under a microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下检查了昆虫的胸背板。

e.en: A large {notungulate} once grazed on these plains.
e.zh: 一种大型南蹄目动物曾在这些平原上吃草。

e.en: The museum displays a reconstructed {notungulate} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具复原的南蹄目动物骨架。

e.en: The chef topped the cake with crisp {nougatine}.
e.zh: 厨师在蛋糕上撒了酥脆的杏仁焦糖脆片。

e.en: She broke the {nougatine} into shards for decoration.
e.zh: 她把杏仁焦糖脆片掰成碎片作装饰。

e.en: That song was everywhere in the {noughties}.
e.zh: 那首歌在二十一世纪头十年到处都能听到。

e.en: Fashion from the {noughties} is coming back again.
e.zh: 二十一世纪头十年的时尚又开始回潮了。

e.en: Kant distinguished appearances from {noumena}.
e.zh: 康德把现象与物自身区分开来。

e.en: The lecture treated {noumena} as things beyond direct experience.
e.zh: 讲座把本体解释为超出直接经验的事物。

e.en: The philosopher discussed the {noumenal} world beyond perception.
e.zh: 那位哲学家讨论了感知之外的本体世界。

e.en: For Kant, {noumenal} reality cannot be known directly.
e.zh: 在康德看来，物自身的实在不能被直接认识。

e.en: His essay defended a form of {noumenalism}.
e.zh: 他的文章为一种本体论立场辩护。

e.en: The professor mentioned {noumenalism} only briefly.
e.zh: 教授只是简短提到了本体论立场。

e.en: A {noumenon} is not available to ordinary perception.
e.zh: 物自身无法由普通感知直接把握。

e.en: She used {noumenon} in a paper on Kantian philosophy.
e.zh: 她在一篇关于康德哲学的论文中使用了本体这个概念。

e.en: The suffix gives the verb a {nounal} function.
e.zh: 这个后缀使动词具有名词性功能。

e.en: Older grammars sometimes use {nounal} instead of nominal.
e.zh: 旧语法书有时用名词性的这个词代替nominal。

e.en: The phrase was coined for the {nounce}.
e.zh: 这个短语是为当时需要临时造出来的。

e.en: They kept a spare tool for the {nounce}.
e.zh: 他们留了一件备用工具以应付特定目的。

e.en: The sentence sounds oddly {nouny} after the rewrite.
e.zh: 改写后，这个句子听起来名词味重得有些奇怪。

e.en: Academic prose can become too {nouny} and abstract.
e.zh: 学术文体可能变得过于名词化和抽象。

e.en: The path ended at a windy {noup}.
e.zh: 小路尽头是一处风很大的海角。

e.en: They watched seabirds nesting on the {noup}.
e.zh: 他们看着海鸟在岬角上筑巢。

e.en: The child was left with a trusted {nourice}.
e.zh: 孩子被交给一位可靠的乳母照看。

e.en: In the old tale, the prince's {nourice} saves him.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，王子的养母救了他。

e.en: The seedlings are {nourishable} in this rich soil.
e.zh: 这些幼苗在这片肥沃土壤中能够得到滋养。

e.en: A weak body is still {nourishable} with careful feeding.
e.zh: 虚弱的身体仍可通过细心进食得到调养。

e.en: The manuscript spells the word as {nourishement}.
e.zh: 这份手稿把这个表示营养的词拼作nourishement。

e.en: He wrote that study provides {nourishement} for the mind.
e.zh: 他写道，学习能为心智提供滋养。

e.en: The fishermen pulled their boat into the {noust}.
e.zh: 渔民把船拉进了避风湾。

e.en: A stone wall protected the old {noust} from waves.
e.zh: 一道石墙保护着旧船只停泊处免受海浪冲击。

notandum.t: 应注意的事项；备忘条目

e.en: The editor marked the clause as a {notandum}.
e.zh: 编辑把这个条款标为应注意的事项。

e.en: Her notebook began with one urgent {notandum}.
e.zh: 她的笔记本开头写着一条紧急备忘。

e.en: His interest in {notaphily} began with old banknotes.
e.zh: 他对纸币收藏的兴趣始于一些旧钞票。

e.en: The museum hosted a small {notaphily} exhibition.
e.zh: 博物馆举办了一场小型纸币研究展。

notarikon.t: 犹太神秘文字缩略解读法

e.en: The scholar explained {notarikon} in medieval Hebrew texts.
e.zh: 学者解释了中世纪希伯来文献中的缩略解读法。

e.en: Some mystical readings used {notarikon} to form hidden meanings.
e.zh: 一些神秘主义解读用这种方法生成隐藏含义。

e.en: You must {notarise} the copy before sending it.
e.zh: 寄出前你必须把这份副本公证。

e.en: The solicitor can {notarise} your signature today.
e.zh: 律师今天可以为你的签名作公证认证。

e.en: The bank required {notarization} of the document.
e.zh: 银行要求这份文件经过公证。

e.en: Online {notarization} is accepted in some states.
e.zh: 有些州接受线上公证手续。

e.en: Please {notarize} this affidavit before Friday.
e.zh: 请在周五前把这份宣誓书公证。

e.en: A licensed official must {notarize} the agreement.
e.zh: 必须由持证官员认证这份协议。

e.en: The clerk {notarizes} contracts every afternoon.
e.zh: 这名办事员每天下午公证合同。

e.en: She {notarizes} signatures for international applications.
e.zh: 她为国际申请认证签名。

e.en: He is {notarizing} the deed in his office.
e.zh: 他正在办公室里公证这份契约。

e.en: The app supports remote {notarizing} for simple forms.
e.zh: 这个应用支持对简单表格进行远程公证。

e.en: Researchers once studied {notatin} as an antibacterial agent.
e.zh: 研究人员曾把notatin作为抗菌物质来研究。

e.en: The paper described {notatin} produced by certain molds.
e.zh: 论文描述了某些霉菌产生的这种物质。

e.en: The old sedan had a classic {notchback} profile.
e.zh: 那辆老轿车有典型的凹背式轮廓。

e.en: Buyers preferred the {notchback} over the hatchback model.
e.zh: 买家更喜欢这款三厢车，而不是掀背车型。

e.en: The carpenter fitted a {notchboard} along the stair wall.
e.zh: 木匠沿着楼梯墙装了一块带槽板。

e.en: Each shelf rested securely on the {notchboard}.
e.zh: 每块搁板都稳稳架在刻槽木板上。

e.en: The cabinet showed fine {notchery} around the edges.
e.zh: 柜子边缘有精细的刻槽装饰。

e.en: Traditional builders used {notchery} to join the beams.
e.zh: 传统工匠用刻槽工艺连接梁木。

e.en: The guide identified the moth as a {notchwing}.
e.zh: 图鉴把这只蛾认定为翅有缺刻的昆虫。

e.en: A small {notchwing} rested on the window screen.
e.zh: 一只小小的缺翅蛾停在纱窗上。

e.en: The blade left a {notchy} edge on the board.
e.zh: 刀片在木板边缘留下了参差的刻痕。

e.en: The old gearshift felt {notchy} in cold weather.
e.zh: 天冷时，这个旧换挡杆手感很卡顿。

e.en: Good {note-taking} helped her review for exams.
e.zh: 良好的记笔记习惯帮助她复习考试。

e.en: The meeting requires careful {note-taking}.
e.zh: 这次会议需要认真做记录。

e.en: Write each source on a separate {notecard}.
e.zh: 把每个资料来源写在单独的资料卡上。

e.en: She sent a handwritten {notecard} with the gift.
e.zh: 她随礼物附了一张手写便签卡。

e.en: He slipped the receipt into his {notecase}.
e.zh: 他把收据塞进自己的纸币夹里。

e.en: The leather {notecase} held only cash and cards.
e.zh: 这个皮质薄钱包只装现金和卡片。

e.en: The black {notehead} shows the pitch clearly.
e.zh: 黑色音符头清楚地显示了音高。

e.en: Students learned to draw each {notehead} on the staff.
e.zh: 学生们学习在五线谱上画每个符头。

e.en: The song became strangely {noteless} in the silent room.
e.zh: 在寂静的房间里，这首歌奇怪地变得没有音符。

e.en: A {noteless} lecture left students confused afterward.
e.zh: 一场没有记录的讲座让学生事后很困惑。

notelessness.t: 无音符状态；无记录状态

e.en: The poem evokes a haunting {notelessness}.
e.zh: 这首诗唤起一种萦绕不去的无声状态。

e.en: His {notelessness} during meetings caused problems later.
e.zh: 他开会时不做记录，后来造成了问题。

e.en: She left a polite {notelet} on his desk.
e.zh: 她在他的桌上留了一张礼貌的小便条。

e.en: The invitation came as a printed {notelet}.
e.zh: 邀请函是一张印好的短笺。

e.en: The team performed {noteworthily} under heavy pressure.
e.zh: 这支队伍在巨大压力下表现得值得注意。

e.en: Prices rose {noteworthily} after the policy changed.
e.zh: 政策改变后，价格显著上涨。

e.en: The discovery gained {noteworthiness} because of its timing.
e.zh: 这项发现因出现的时机而显得值得注意。

e.en: Editors judge the {noteworthiness} of each submission.
e.zh: 编辑会判断每篇投稿的显著性。

notgeld.t: 德国应急纸币；代用货币

e.en: Collectors prize colorful {notgeld} from the 1920s.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视二十世纪二十年代的彩色德国应急纸币。

e.en: The town issued {notgeld} during the currency shortage.
e.zh: 货币短缺期间，这座城镇发行了代用货币。

e.en: There was {noth} left after the fire.
e.zh: 大火之后什么也没剩下。

e.en: He cared for {noth} but his honor.
e.zh: 除了自己的荣誉，他什么都不在乎。

e.en: She asked for {nother} cup of tea.
e.zh: 她又要了一杯茶。

e.en: That is {nother} matter altogether.
e.zh: 那完全是另一回事。

e.en: They reached the {nothernmost} hut before dusk.
e.zh: 他们在黄昏前到达了最北端的小屋。

e.en: The map marks the {nothernmost} boundary of the estate.
e.zh: 地图标出了这片地产最北端的边界。

e.en: I heard {nothin} from him all week.
e.zh: 我整个星期都没听到他的消息。

e.en: There is {nothin} wrong with asking questions.
e.zh: 提问题没有什么不对。

e.en: He jokingly called himself a {nothingarian} in politics.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己在政治上什么派别都不属。

e.en: The preacher disliked the word {nothingarian}.
e.zh: 那位传教士不喜欢“无信仰者”这个说法。

e.en: The botanist mapped a {nothocline} between the two species.
e.zh: 植物学家绘出了两个物种之间的杂交渐变带。

e.en: A {nothocline} can blur the boundary between related plants.
e.zh: 杂交渐变带会模糊近缘植物之间的界线。

e.en: The timetable is pinned on the {notice-board}.
e.zh: 时刻表钉在公告板上。

e.en: Students crowded around the {notice-board} after class.
e.zh: 下课后学生们围在布告栏旁。

e.en: She bought thread at the {notion-counter}.
e.zh: 她在小百货柜台买了线。

e.en: The old store kept buttons behind the {notion-counter}.
e.zh: 那家老店把纽扣放在小百货柜台后面。

e.en: A small {notion-store} stood beside the bakery.
e.zh: 面包店旁边有一家小百货店。

e.en: She found rare ribbons in the {notion-store}.
e.zh: 她在那家针线杂货店里找到了少见的丝带。

e.en: The critic dismissed him as a mere {notionalist}.
e.zh: 评论家把他斥为只是个空谈观念的人。

e.en: As a {notionalist}, she valued ideas over institutions.
e.zh: 作为观念论者，她更重视理念而不是制度。

e.en: The essay tries to {notionate} freedom in modern terms.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图用现代术语来构想自由。

e.en: Children slowly {notionate} time through daily routines.
e.zh: 儿童通过日常规律慢慢形成时间观念。

e.en: He was a {notionist} with little patience for facts.
e.zh: 他是个满脑子观念却不太重视事实的人。

e.en: The old {notionist} proposed a cure for every illness.
e.zh: 那位爱出怪主意的老人给每种病都想出一种疗法。

e.en: The diagram labels the {notocephalon} of the specimen.
e.zh: 图中标出了标本的背头部。

e.en: Damage to the {notocephalon} was visible under magnification.
e.zh: 在放大观察下可以看到背头部的损伤。

e.en: The embryo develops a {notochord} before the spine forms.
e.zh: 胚胎在脊柱形成前会发育出脊索。

e.en: In some animals, the {notochord} remains throughout life.
e.zh: 在一些动物中，脊索会终生保留。

e.en: The worm's {notocirrus} is shown in the drawing.
e.zh: 图中显示了这条蠕虫的背须。

e.en: Researchers measured each {notocirrus} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下测量了每根背触须。

e.en: A gray {notodont} rested on the porch light.
e.zh: 一只灰色舟蛾停在门廊灯上。

e.en: The guide describes several {notodont} larvae found on oaks.
e.zh: 这本指南介绍了几种在橡树上发现的舟蛾幼虫。

e.en: The fly's {notopleura} bears several stiff bristles.
e.zh: 这只苍蝇的背胸侧区长有几根硬毛。

e.en: Taxonomists compare the {notopleura} when identifying the species.
e.zh: 分类学家鉴定该物种时会比较背胸侧区。

e.en: Each segment has a small {notopodium} on its upper side.
e.zh: 每个体节上侧都有一个小的背足叶。

e.en: The {notopodium} carries bristles used in classification.
e.zh: 背疣足上有用于分类的刚毛。

e.en: The specimen's {notopodiums} were carefully drawn.
e.zh: 标本的背足叶被仔细绘制下来。

e.en: Damaged {notopodiums} made the worm harder to identify.
e.zh: 受损的背疣足使这条蠕虫更难鉴定。

e.en: The aquarium displayed a young {notopterid}.
e.zh: 水族馆展出了一条幼年的弓背鱼科鱼类。

e.en: A {notopterid} swims with a long undulating fin.
e.zh: 弓背鱼科鱼类用一条长长的波动鳍游动。

e.en: The {notor} signed at the bottom of the deed.
e.zh: 签署人在契据底部签了名。

e.en: A careful {notor} marked each disputed passage.
e.zh: 细心的标记者标出了每一处有争议的段落。

e.en: The {notornis} was once thought to be extinct.
e.zh: 南秧鸡曾被认为已经灭绝。

e.en: Conservationists tracked a rare {notornis} in the valley.
e.zh: 保护人员在山谷中追踪一只罕见的塔卡赫鸟。

e.en: A hard {nubble} of clay stuck to the boot.
e.zh: 一小块硬泥粘在靴子上。

e.en: She felt a rough {nubble} under the fabric.
e.zh: 她摸到布料下面有个粗糙的小突起。

e.en: The old wall had a {nubbled} surface.
e.zh: 那面旧墙表面布满小疙瘩。

e.en: He chose a {nubbled} wool for the jacket.
e.zh: 他给夹克选了带颗粒纹理的羊毛料。

e.en: Tiny {nubbles} of wax covered the table.
e.zh: 桌上散着一粒粒小蜡块。

e.en: The pastry had crisp {nubbles} on top.
e.zh: 点心表面有些酥脆的小颗粒。

e.en: The astronomer noted a faint {nubecula} near the cluster.
e.zh: 天文学家记录到星团旁有一片淡淡的小云斑。

e.en: The doctor described the spot as a corneal {nubecula}.
e.zh: 医生把那处斑点称为角膜云翳。

e.en: The law once tied {nubility} to a fixed age.
e.zh: 这项法律曾把适婚状态和固定年龄相连。

e.en: Her novel questions old ideas of female {nubility}.
e.zh: 她的小说质疑关于女性婚嫁年龄的旧观念。

e.en: A {nubilous} sky made the valley look colder.
e.zh: 多云的天空让山谷显得更冷。

e.en: His {nubilous} answer satisfied no one.
e.zh: 他含糊不清的回答谁也没有说服。

e.en: The researcher studied {nucellar} cells in the ovule.
e.zh: 研究人员观察了胚珠中的珠心细胞。

e.en: Some citrus trees can produce {nucellar} seedlings.
e.zh: 有些柑橘树能产生珠心苗。

e.en: The slides showed several developing {nucelli}.
e.zh: 切片显示出几个正在发育的珠心。

e.en: Botanists compared the {nucelli} of different seeds.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了不同种子的珠心。

e.en: The embryo sac forms inside the {nucellus}.
e.zh: 胚囊在珠心内部形成。

e.en: Damage to the {nucellus} can affect seed development.
e.zh: 珠心受损会影响种子发育。

e.en: The recipe called for crushed {nuces}.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要压碎的坚果。

e.en: The lawyer focused on the {nuces} of the case.
e.zh: 律师把重点放在案件的核心要点上。

e.en: The rash spread across the {nucha}.
e.zh: 皮疹蔓延到了颈背部。

e.en: A dark band marked the bird's {nucha}.
e.zh: 一条深色带纹标出了这只鸟的项部。

e.en: The old families mocked his {nouveau-riche} manners.
e.zh: 那些老牌家族嘲笑他的暴发户做派。

e.en: She disliked the {nouveau-riche} display of wealth.
e.zh: 她不喜欢那种新富阶层炫耀财富的派头。

e.en: The knife was sharpened on {novaculite}.
e.zh: 这把刀是在硅质磨刀石上磨锋利的。

e.en: Arkansas {novaculite} is valued by craftsmen.
e.zh: 阿肯色的燧石岩很受工匠看重。

e.en: Several {novae} appeared in the survey data.
e.zh: 巡天数据中出现了几颗新星。

e.en: Ancient records sometimes describe bright {novae}.
e.zh: 古代记录有时会描述明亮的新星。

e.en: The telescope detected a {novalike} burst.
e.zh: 望远镜探测到一次像新星爆发的亮变。

e.en: Astronomers debated whether the {novalike} object was real.
e.zh: 天文学家争论这个新星状天体是否真实存在。

e.en: Doctors once used {novarsenobenzene} against syphilis.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用新胂凡纳明类药物治疗梅毒。

e.en: The paper mentions {novarsenobenzene} in early chemotherapy.
e.zh: 论文在早期化学疗法中提到新胂凡纳明类药物。

e.en: The parties agreed to {novate} the lease.
e.zh: 各方同意更替这份租约。

e.en: They needed consent to {novate} the contract.
e.zh: 他们需要取得同意才能更新合同主体。

e.en: The lender approved the {novation} in writing.
e.zh: 贷款方以书面形式批准了合同更替。

e.en: A {novation} replaced the old debtor with a new one.
e.zh: 债务更新把旧债务人换成了新的债务人。

e.en: Her first {novela} was published in Madrid.
e.zh: 她的第一部中短篇小说在马德里出版。

e.en: The evening {novela} drew a huge audience.
e.zh: 晚间肥皂剧吸引了大量观众。

e.en: The review mocked his purple {novelese}.
e.zh: 评论嘲笑他那种华而不实的小说腔。

e.en: She stripped the {novelese} from the dialogue.
e.zh: 她把对白里的矫饰文风删掉了。

e.en: The plot felt sentimental and {novelettish}.
e.zh: 这个情节显得多愁善感，像通俗短篇小说。

e.en: He avoided the {novelettish} ending she suggested.
e.zh: 他避开了她建议的那种通俗小说式结尾。

e.en: She plans to {novelise} the film script.
e.zh: 她打算把电影剧本改写成小说。

e.en: Publishers often {novelise} popular television dramas.
e.zh: 出版商常把热门电视剧改写成小说。

e.en: He described the trial {novelistically}, not journalistically.
e.zh: 他以小说家的方式描写审判，而不是新闻写法。

e.en: The historian writes {novelistically} about private grief.
e.zh: 这位历史学家以小说笔法书写私人悲伤。

e.en: They hired an author to {novelize} the game.
e.zh: 他们聘请了一位作者把游戏改写成小说。

e.en: It is hard to {novelize} a silent film well.
e.zh: 要把一部默片很好地改写成小说并不容易。

e.en: The {novelized} screenplay sold well.
e.zh: 那部被改写成小说的剧本销量很好。

e.en: She {novelized} the legend for young readers.
e.zh: 她把这个传说改写成小说，供年轻读者阅读。

e.en: He {novelizes} films for a living.
e.zh: 他以把电影改写成小说为生。

e.en: The series {novelizes} real political scandals.
e.zh: 这套作品把真实政治丑闻写成小说。

e.en: She is {novelizing} a famous radio play.
e.zh: 她正在把一部著名广播剧改写成小说。

e.en: {Novelizing} history can blur fact and invention.
e.zh: 把历史小说化可能会模糊事实与虚构。

e.en: The German {novelle} is tightly structured.
e.zh: 德国中篇小说通常结构紧凑。

e.en: He called the work a {novelle}, not a novel.
e.zh: 他称这部作品为中篇小说，而不是长篇小说。

e.en: The critic called him a careful {novelwright}.
e.zh: 评论家称他是一位细致的小说作者。

e.en: A patient {novelwright} revises every chapter.
e.zh: 耐心的小说作者会修订每一章。

e.en: A {novemdecillion} is far beyond everyday counting.
e.zh: 十的六十次方远远超出日常计数范围。

e.en: The scientist joked about a {novemdecillion} tiny particles.
e.zh: 那位科学家开玩笑说有十的六十次方个微小粒子。

e.en: The town revived its {novennial} festival this spring.
e.zh: 这个小镇今年春天恢复了每九年一次的节日。

e.en: They reviewed the {novennial} lease before signing.
e.zh: 签字前，他们审查了这份为期九年的租约。

e.en: The memoir describes a {novercal} household ruled by suspicion.
e.zh: 这本回忆录描写了一个像继母般苛刻、充满猜疑的家庭。

e.en: Critics called the policy {novercal} toward small farmers.
e.zh: 批评者说这项政策对小农户十分苛刻。

e.en: Her {noviceship} in journalism lasted only six months.
e.zh: 她在新闻业的新手见习期只持续了六个月。

e.en: During his {noviceship}, he made many basic mistakes.
e.zh: 在新手阶段，他犯了许多基础错误。

e.en: She entered the {noviciate} at nineteen.
e.zh: 她十九岁时进入修会见习期。

e.en: The {noviciate} lived under a strict daily rule.
e.zh: 那名见习修士按严格的日课生活。

e.en: The village held a {novillada} before the main festival.
e.zh: 村里在主节庆前举办了一场幼牛斗牛表演。

e.en: He watched his first {novillada} in a small Spanish arena.
e.zh: 他在西班牙一个小斗牛场看了第一场幼牛斗牛。

e.en: The young {novillero} practiced every morning.
e.zh: 那位年轻的见习斗牛士每天早晨练习。

e.en: A brave {novillero} can become famous quickly.
e.zh: 勇敢的斗幼牛见习斗牛士可能很快成名。

e.en: The rancher selected a strong {novillo} for breeding.
e.zh: 牧场主挑选了一头健壮的年轻公牛来配种。

e.en: The {novillo} charged across the ring.
e.zh: 那头斗牛用幼牛冲过了场地。

e.en: Her {novio} waited outside the church.
e.zh: 她的未婚夫在教堂外等着。

e.en: In the story, the {novio} brings flowers every Sunday.
e.zh: 在故事里，那位男友每个星期天都会送花。

e.en: The lab tested whether {novobiocin} stopped the bacteria.
e.zh: 实验室测试新生霉素是否能阻止这种细菌。

e.en: Doctors rarely prescribe {novobiocin} today.
e.zh: 如今医生很少开新生霉素这种抗生素。

e.en: The dentist used {novocain} before drilling the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医在钻牙前使用了奴佛卡因。

e.en: His lip felt numb after the {novocain} injection.
e.zh: 注射局部麻醉药后，他的嘴唇发麻。

e.en: Come here {now-now}, before the rain starts.
e.zh: 趁还没下雨，马上到这里来。

e.en: The repairman said he would arrive {now-now}.
e.zh: 修理工说他很快就会到。

e.en: It was a {now-or-never} chance to ask for funding.
e.zh: 这是申请资金的机不可失的机会。

e.en: She gave him a {now-or-never} look before boarding.
e.zh: 登机前，她给了他一个非现在不可的眼神。

e.en: The museum displayed a tiny sample of {nowackiite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一小块诺瓦基石样本。

e.en: Geologists identified {nowackiite} in the dark ore.
e.zh: 地质学家在深色矿石中鉴定出诺瓦基石。

e.en: {Nowaday}, few people write letters by hand.
e.zh: 如今，很少有人手写信件。

e.en: The word {nowaday} sounds old-fashioned to most readers.
e.zh: 对大多数读者来说，nowaday这个词听起来很老派。

e.en: {Nowanights}, the streets are quiet after ten.
e.zh: 近来夜里，十点以后街上很安静。

e.en: He works {nowanights} and sleeps through the morning.
e.zh: 他如今夜里工作，整个上午都在睡觉。

e.en: There is {noway} to finish this safely tonight.
e.zh: 今晚没有办法安全地完成这件事。

e.en: {Noway} will she accept such an unfair deal.
e.zh: 她决不会接受这样不公平的交易。

e.en: He is {noways} ready for the final exam.
e.zh: 他一点也没准备好期末考试。

e.en: The plan was {noways} as simple as it sounded.
e.zh: 这个计划决不像听起来那么简单。

e.en: The choir sang an old {nowel} by candlelight.
e.zh: 合唱团在烛光下唱了一首古老的圣诞颂歌。

e.en: She wrote {nowel} at the top of the holiday card.
e.zh: 她在节日贺卡上方写下“诺埃尔”。

e.en: The rumor seemed to come from {nowhence}.
e.zh: 这个谣言似乎无从而来。

e.en: Help arrived from {nowhence}, just when we needed it.
e.zh: 就在我们需要时，帮助像是没有来源地突然到了。

nowhither.t: 无处可去；不到任何地方

e.en: The road led {nowhither} after the bridge collapsed.
e.zh: 桥塌之后，这条路通不到任何地方。

e.en: He wandered {nowhither} through the empty station.
e.zh: 他在空荡的车站里漫无目的、无处可去地走着。

e.en: The apology was {nowise} enough to repair the damage.
e.zh: 这句道歉决不足以弥补损害。

e.en: She was {nowise} afraid of their threats.
e.zh: 她对他们的威胁毫不害怕。

e.en: Old poems say the sailor would {noy} in the storm.
e.zh: 古诗中说那名水手会在风暴中溺死。

e.en: The dialect word {noy} means to drown.
e.zh: 方言词noy的意思是淹死。

e.en: The doctor checked the {nuchal} fold during the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描时检查了胎儿颈背部皱褶。

e.en: He felt a sharp {nuchal} pain after the fall.
e.zh: 他摔倒后感到颈背部一阵剧痛。

e.en: The seed had a hard, {nuciform} shell.
e.zh: 这颗种子有坚硬的坚果状外壳。

e.en: A {nuciform} mass appeared in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 组织样本中出现了一个核状肿块。

e.en: Early biochemists described {nucin} in cell nuclei.
e.zh: 早期生物化学家描述了细胞核中的核素。

e.en: The paper used {nucin} as an old term for nuclear material.
e.zh: 那篇论文把核素作为细胞核物质的旧称。

e.en: The stain highlighted the {nucleal} structures clearly.
e.zh: 染色清楚地显示出细胞核结构。

e.en: Researchers compared {nucleal} changes in damaged cells.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了受损细胞中的核变化。

e.en: Dust can act as a {nucleant} for ice crystals.
e.zh: 尘埃可以作为冰晶形成的成核剂。

e.en: The alloy needs a stable {nucleant} during cooling.
e.zh: 这种合金在冷却时需要稳定的促成核物。

e.en: A {nuclear-armed} state joined the talks.
e.zh: 一个拥有核武器的国家参加了谈判。

e.en: The report warned about {nuclear-armed} submarines near the coast.
e.zh: 报告警告称海岸附近有携带核武器的潜艇。

e.en: The army tested a {nuclear-capable} missile.
e.zh: 军方测试了一枚具备核打击能力的导弹。

e.en: Officials denied sending {nuclear-capable} aircraft to the region.
e.zh: 官员否认向该地区派遣具备核打击能力的飞机。

e.en: The island declared itself a {nuclear-free} zone.
e.zh: 该岛宣布自己为无核区。

e.en: Activists called for a {nuclear-free} future.
e.zh: 活动人士呼吁建立一个没有核武器的未来。

e.en: The navy launched a {nuclear-powered} submarine.
e.zh: 海军下水了一艘核动力潜艇。

e.en: A {nuclear-powered} probe could travel farther into space.
e.zh: 核动力探测器可以飞向更远的太空。

e.en: The treaty limited {nuclear-tipped} missiles.
e.zh: 该条约限制装有核弹头的导弹。

e.en: Analysts discussed the risk of {nuclear-tipped} weapons being deployed.
e.zh: 分析人士讨论了部署核弹头武器的风险。

e.en: The essay criticizes Cold War {nuclearism}.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了冷战时期的核主义。

e.en: Her speech linked {nuclearism} with national prestige.
e.zh: 她的演讲把崇尚核力量与国家声望联系起来。

e.en: The regime tried to {nuclearize} its military program.
e.zh: 该政权试图使其军事项目核武化。

e.en: Some leaders feared the region would {nuclearize}.
e.zh: 一些领导人担心该地区会发展核武能力。

e.en: The border became a heavily {nuclearized} frontier.
e.zh: 这条边境变成了高度核武化的前线。

e.en: Scientists studied {nuclearized} policy debates after the crisis.
e.zh: 科学家研究了危机后被核问题主导的政策辩论。

e.en: The article used {nucleartipped} as an unhyphenated form.
e.zh: 文章把nucleartipped用作不带连字符的写法。

e.en: Editors changed {nucleartipped} to the standard hyphenated spelling.
e.zh: 编辑把nucleartipped改成了标准的连字符拼写。

e.en: The {nuclease} cut the DNA strand.
e.zh: 这种核酸酶切开了DNA链。

e.en: Researchers used a {nuclease} to edit the gene.
e.zh: 研究人员使用核酸酶来编辑这个基因。

e.en: The device served as a {nucleator} for crystal growth.
e.zh: 该装置充当晶体生长的成核器。

e.en: A protein can be a {nucleator} in actin assembly.
e.zh: 一种蛋白质可以在肌动蛋白组装中充当成核剂。

e.en: Miescher first isolated {nuclein} from white blood cells.
e.zh: 米歇尔最早从白细胞中分离出核蛋白。

e.en: Older textbooks used {nuclein} before the term nucleic acid spread.
e.zh: 较旧的教科书在核酸一词普及前使用核蛋白这个说法。

e.en: The old study mentioned {nucleinase} in yeast extracts.
e.zh: 那项旧研究提到了酵母提取物中的核蛋白酶。

e.en: Modern authors rarely use {nucleinase} for this enzyme.
e.zh: 现代作者很少用核蛋白酶来指这种酶。

e.en: The chemist prepared sodium {nucleinate} for analysis.
e.zh: 化学家制备了核酸钠用于分析。

e.en: Old medical formulas sometimes included iron {nucleinate}.
e.zh: 旧式药方有时含有核蛋白铁盐。

e.en: The virus has a spiral {nucleocapsid}.
e.zh: 这种病毒有螺旋形核衣壳。

e.en: Antibodies targeted the {nucleocapsid} protein in the test.
e.zh: 该检测中的抗体针对核衣壳蛋白。

e.en: The team used {nucleochronology} to estimate the star's age.
e.zh: 团队用核年代学估算这颗恒星的年龄。

e.en: Her lecture introduced {nucleochronology} as a dating method.
e.zh: 她的讲座把核年代学介绍为一种测年方法。

e.en: Uranium can serve as a {nucleochronometer} in ancient stars.
e.zh: 铀可作为古老恒星中的核年代计。

e.en: The model tested which isotope was the best {nucleochronometer}.
e.zh: 该模型测试哪种同位素是最佳核测年指标。

e.en: She studies {nucleocosmochronology} and early galactic history.
e.zh: 她研究核宇宙年代学和早期银河史。

e.en: The conference included a session on {nucleocosmochronology}.
e.zh: 会议安排了一个关于核宇宙年代学的专题环节。

e.en: The theory explains {nucleogenesis} in the early universe.
e.zh: 该理论解释了早期宇宙中的原子核形成。

e.en: Stellar {nucleogenesis} creates heavier elements over time.
e.zh: 恒星核生成会随着时间产生更重的元素。

e.en: The manuscript misspelled nucleogenesis as {nucleogenisis}.
e.zh: 手稿把nucleogenesis误拼成了nucleogenisis。

e.en: Search results for {nucleogenisis} usually point to the correct term.
e.zh: 搜索nucleogenisis的结果通常会指向正确术语。

e.en: The gallery displayed the {nudest} sketches in a separate room.
e.zh: 画廊把最裸露的素描放在单独的房间展出。

e.en: His final poem gave the {nudest} account of grief.
e.zh: 他的最后一首诗用最赤裸的方式写出了悲伤。

e.en: They giggled at a {nudey} postcard in the shop.
e.zh: 他们在店里看到一张裸露明信片，忍不住偷笑。

e.en: The film avoided {nudey} scenes despite its adult theme.
e.zh: 这部电影虽然题材成人化，却避免了裸体场面。

e.en: A bright blue {nudibranch} crawled across the coral.
e.zh: 一只亮蓝色的裸鳃类海蛞蝓爬过珊瑚。

e.en: Divers often photograph each tiny {nudibranch} they find.
e.zh: 潜水者常会拍下他们发现的每一只小裸鳃类海蛞蝓。

e.en: The biologist identified several {nudibranchiate} mollusks on the reef.
e.zh: 生物学家在礁石上认出了几种裸鳃类软体动物。

e.en: A {nudibranchiate} has exposed gills rather than a shell.
e.zh: 裸鳃动物有外露的鳃，而不是贝壳。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {nudicaul} flowering stem.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这株植物裸露的花茎。

e.en: A {nudicaul} specimen stood out among the leafy herbs.
e.zh: 一株裸茎标本在多叶草本植物中显得很突出。

e.en: The magazine once printed a famous {nudie} centerfold.
e.zh: 那本杂志曾刊登过一张有名的裸体跨页照片。

e.en: He joked that the beach was full of {nudie} tourists.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说海滩上全是裸体游客。

e.en: The old tabloid sold copies by promising celebrity {nudies}.
e.zh: 那份旧小报靠承诺刊登名人裸照来卖报。

e.en: The resort welcomed {nudies} during the summer season.
e.zh: 这家度假村夏季接待裸体主义者。

e.en: She wrote an article about {nudism} and body acceptance.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于裸体主义和接纳身体的文章。

e.en: The beach has a section reserved for {nudism}.
e.zh: 这片海滩有一块区域专供裸体主义者使用。

e.en: Stop being a {nudnick} and let me finish.
e.zh: 别当讨厌鬼了，让我把话说完。

e.en: Every office has one cheerful {nudnick} who asks too many questions.
e.zh: 每个办公室都有一个爱问太多问题的热心烦人精。

e.en: My uncle is a lovable {nudnik} at family dinners.
e.zh: 我叔叔在家庭晚餐上是个可爱的唠叨烦人精。

e.en: The clerk treated him like a {nudnik} for asking again.
e.zh: 他又问了一遍，店员把他当成讨厌鬼。

e.en: Please don't {nudzh} me while I am working.
e.zh: 我工作的时候请别一直烦我。

e.en: She had to {nudzh} the committee for an answer.
e.zh: 她不得不反复催委员会给个答复。

e.en: That's {nuff} talk for one night.
e.zh: 今晚说这些已经够了。

e.en: He said he knew {nuff} to stay quiet.
e.zh: 他说他知道得够多，所以选择闭嘴。

e.en: The museum labeled the dark crystal as {nuffieldite}.
e.zh: 博物馆把那块深色晶体标为硫铅铜铋矿。

e.en: A small vein of {nuffieldite} appeared in the ore sample.
e.zh: 矿石样本中出现了一小脉硫铅铜铋矿。

e.en: He shrugged and said he knew {nuffin} about it.
e.zh: 他耸耸肩，说自己对此啥也不知道。

e.en: There was {nuffin} left in the old biscuit tin.
e.zh: 那个旧饼干罐里什么也没剩。

e.en: The critic dismissed the subplot as pure {nugacity}.
e.zh: 评论家把这条副线斥为纯粹无价值的琐碎内容。

e.en: He mistook the proposal's brevity for {nugacity}.
e.zh: 他把这份提案的简短误认为是内容空洞。

e.en: The poet called his early verses {nugae}.
e.zh: 诗人把自己早年的诗称作无聊小品。

e.en: She filled the diary with gossip and other {nugae}.
e.zh: 她在日记里写满了八卦和其他琐事。

e.en: A wooden {nuggar} carried grain down the river.
e.zh: 一艘木制尼罗河帆船载着谷物顺流而下。

e.en: The old painting shows a {nuggar} with a high stern.
e.zh: 那幅旧画描绘了一艘船尾高高翘起的尼罗河帆船。

e.en: {Nuh}, I am not going back there tonight.
e.zh: 不，我今晚不会再回那里了。

e.en: She answered with a quick {nuh} and closed the door.
e.zh: 她迅速说了声不，然后关上门。

e.en: The loop is {nulhomotopic} in this topological space.
e.zh: 在这个拓扑空间中，这条环路是零伦同伦的。

e.en: A {nulhomotopic} map can be continuously shrunk to a point.
e.zh: 零伦同伦映射可以连续收缩成一个点。

e.en: The proof constructs a {nulhomotopy} of the boundary map.
e.zh: 这个证明构造了边界映射的零伦同伦。

e.en: Finding a {nulhomotopy} simplified the homology calculation.
e.zh: 找到一个零伦同伦简化了同调计算。

e.en: The vector lies in the matrix's {null-space}.
e.zh: 这个向量位于该矩阵的零空间中。

e.en: Computing the {null-space} helps solve the linear system.
e.zh: 计算零空间有助于求解这个线性方程组。

e.en: Rainwater rushed through the dry {nullah} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴雨过后，雨水冲过那条原本干涸的旱沟。

e.en: The village path followed a shallow {nullah}.
e.zh: 村里的小路沿着一条浅浅的季节性水道延伸。

nullificationist.t: 主张废止者；州权废止派

e.en: The senator was denounced as a {nullificationist}.
e.zh: 那位参议员被谴责为主张废止联邦法律的人。

e.en: A {nullificationist} pamphlet circulated during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，一本州权废止派的小册子流传开来。

e.en: The preacher called every skeptic a {nullifidian}.
e.zh: 那位传教士把每个怀疑者都称作无信仰者。

e.en: Her {nullifidian} outlook shocked the conservative village.
e.zh: 她不信教的观念震惊了这个保守村庄。

e.en: Bacterial DNA is packed inside the {nucleoid}.
e.zh: 细菌的DNA被紧密装在拟核区域内。

e.en: The {nucleoid} lacks a surrounding membrane.
e.zh: 拟核外面没有包围它的膜。

e.en: The mutation changed {nucleolar} organization in the cells.
e.zh: 这种突变改变了细胞中的核仁结构。

e.en: Researchers measured {nucleolar} size under stress.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了压力条件下的核仁大小。

e.en: The stained cells appeared clearly {nucleolate}.
e.zh: 染色后的细胞明显呈现有核仁的状态。

e.en: A {nucleolate} nucleus was visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到一个有核仁的细胞核。

e.en: A tiny {nucleole} appeared beside the main nucleolus.
e.zh: 一个小核仁出现在主核仁旁边。

e.en: The biologist marked each {nucleole} in the image.
e.zh: 生物学家在图像中标出了每个小核仁。

e.en: The {nucleolonema} became visible after special staining.
e.zh: 经过特殊染色后，核仁丝变得清晰可见。

e.en: Older papers describe the {nucleolonema} in detail.
e.zh: 早期论文详细描述了核仁网状结构。

e.en: Ribosome production begins in the {nucleolus}.
e.zh: 核糖体的生成始于核仁。

e.en: The {nucleolus} often looks darker than the nucleus.
e.zh: 核仁通常看起来比细胞核其他部分更深。

nucleometer.t: 核测量仪；细胞核测量器

e.en: The lab used a {nucleometer} to compare nuclear sizes.
e.zh: 实验室用核测量仪比较细胞核大小。

e.en: An old {nucleometer} stood beside the microscope.
e.zh: 一台旧的核测量器放在显微镜旁。

e.en: The detector measured {nucleonic} radiation from the sample.
e.zh: 探测器测量了样品发出的核子辐射。

e.en: The company developed {nucleonic} instruments for industry.
e.zh: 该公司为工业开发核能技术仪器。

e.en: He studied {nucleonics} before joining the reactor project.
e.zh: 他在加入反应堆项目之前学习过核子学。

e.en: Modern {nucleonics} supports many medical imaging systems.
e.zh: 现代核技术应用支撑着许多医学成像系统。

nucleonium.t: 核子物质；核素假想物质

e.en: The article used {nucleonium} as a theoretical term.
e.zh: 这篇文章把核子物质作为一个理论术语使用。

e.en: Physicists once discussed {nucleonium} in speculative models.
e.zh: 物理学家曾在推测模型中讨论核素假想物质。

e.en: The {nucleophile} attacked the carbonyl carbon.
e.zh: 亲核试剂进攻了羰基碳。

e.en: Water can act as a weak {nucleophile}.
e.zh: 水可以作为一种较弱的亲核体。

e.en: The reaction follows a {nucleophilic} substitution mechanism.
e.zh: 该反应遵循亲核取代机制。

e.en: Amines are often {nucleophilic} because of their lone pair.
e.zh: 胺类因有孤对电子而常具有亲核性。

nucleophilically.t: 以亲核方式；通过亲核作用

e.en: The oxygen atom reacts {nucleophilically} with the substrate.
e.zh: 氧原子以亲核方式与底物反应。

e.en: This reagent attacks {nucleophilically} at the less hindered site.
e.zh: 这种试剂会通过亲核作用进攻位阻较小的位置。

e.en: Proteins move through the {nucleoplasm} during gene regulation.
e.zh: 蛋白质在基因调控过程中穿过核质。

e.en: The {nucleoplasm} surrounds chromosomes inside the nucleus.
e.zh: 核质包围着细胞核内的染色体。

e.en: The enzyme has a mainly {nucleoplasmic} location.
e.zh: 这种酶主要位于核质中。

e.en: Stress altered the {nucleoplasmic} distribution of the protein.
e.zh: 压力改变了该蛋白在核质中的分布。

nucleoprotamine.t: 核精蛋白；核酸精蛋白复合物

e.en: Sperm chromatin contains tightly packed {nucleoprotamine}.
e.zh: 精子染色质中含有紧密包装的核精蛋白。

e.en: The sample showed traces of {nucleoprotamine}.
e.zh: 样品中显示出少量核酸精蛋白复合物。

nucleoprotein.t: 核蛋白；核酸蛋白复合物

e.en: The virus packages its genome with a {nucleoprotein}.
e.zh: 这种病毒用核蛋白包裹其基因组。

e.en: Researchers purified the {nucleoprotein} from infected cells.
e.zh: 研究人员从受感染细胞中纯化出核蛋白。

e.en: The chemist identified a rare {nucleose} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家鉴定出一种罕见的核糖类衍生物。

e.en: Older textbooks used {nucleose} for certain nuclear sugars.
e.zh: 旧教材用核酸糖基一词指某些核内糖类。

e.en: The {nucleosidase} breaks nucleosides into smaller parts.
e.zh: 核苷酶会把核苷分解成更小的部分。

e.en: They measured {nucleosidase} activity in the extract.
e.zh: 他们测量了提取物中的核苷酶活性。

e.en: DNA wraps around histones to form a {nucleosome}.
e.zh: DNA缠绕在组蛋白上形成核小体。

e.en: Each {nucleosome} helps compact genetic material.
e.zh: 每个核小体都有助于压缩遗传物质。

nucleosynthetic.t: 核合成的；元素核合成的

e.en: The star's {nucleosynthetic} history shaped its composition.
e.zh: 这颗恒星的核合成历史塑造了它的成分。

e.en: Scientists modeled {nucleosynthetic} yields from supernovae.
e.zh: 科学家模拟了超新星产生的元素核合成产额。

e.en: The {nucleotidase} removed phosphate from the nucleotide.
e.zh: 核苷酸酶从核苷酸上去除了磷酸基。

e.en: Doctors tested serum {nucleotidase} levels.
e.zh: 医生检测了血清核苷酸酶水平。

e.en: The {nucleotidyltransferase} adds nucleotides to the chain.
e.zh: 核苷酸转移酶会向链上添加核苷酸。

e.en: Mutations reduced {nucleotidyltransferase} activity in the enzyme.
e.zh: 突变降低了该酶的核苷酸转移酶活性。

e.en: The paper reported {nucleotropomyosin} in the cell nucleus.
e.zh: 这篇论文报道了细胞核中的核原肌球蛋白。

e.en: They compared {nucleotropomyosin} levels during development.
e.zh: 他们比较了发育过程中核原肌球蛋白的水平。

e.en: The chart shows {nuclidic} relationships among isotopes.
e.zh: 这张图显示了同位素之间的核素关系。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the sample's {nuclidic} composition.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了样品的核素组成。

e.en: The climbers spotted a dark {nunatak} above the ice.
e.zh: 登山者看见冰面上露出一座深色孤峰。

e.en: A {nunatak} can shelter plants from moving glaciers.
e.zh: 冰原孤峰能让植物避开移动的冰川。

e.en: The manuscript shows {nunation} in several old spellings.
e.zh: 这份手稿在几个古拼写中出现了用n代m的现象。

e.en: Linguists noted {nunation} before certain consonants.
e.zh: 语言学家注意到某些辅音前有n化现象。

e.en: He practiced with wooden {nunchaku} after class.
e.zh: 下课后他用木制双节棍练习。

e.en: The film made the {nunchaku} famous worldwide.
e.zh: 那部电影让双节棍在世界各地出名。

e.en: The fool calls Lear his {nuncle} in the play.
e.zh: 剧中弄人称李尔为他的叔父。

e.en: Old ballads sometimes use {nuncle} for uncle.
e.zh: 古老歌谣有时用nuncle表示叔伯。

e.en: The witness tried to {nuncupate} his final wishes.
e.zh: 证人试图口头说明他的遗愿。

e.en: They would {nuncupate} the child in a brief ceremony.
e.zh: 他们会在简短仪式上为孩子命名。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the {nuncupation} of the will.
e.zh: 律师质疑那份遗嘱的口头声明过程。

e.en: Ancient rites included the {nuncupation} of a new heir.
e.zh: 古代仪式包括对新继承人的命名。

e.en: A {nuncupative} will may be valid in rare cases.
e.zh: 在少数情况下，口头遗嘱可能有效。

e.en: The court rejected the alleged {nuncupative} declaration.
e.zh: 法院驳回了所谓的口头声明。

e.en: The calendar marked each {nundinal} day with a letter.
e.zh: 日历用字母标出每个古罗马集市日。

e.en: Farmers met on the {nundinal} cycle to trade grain.
e.zh: 农民按集市日周期会面交易谷物。

e.en: Merchants arrived early for the {nundine} outside Rome.
e.zh: 商人很早赶到罗马城外参加九日集市。

e.en: The village treated the {nundine} as a legal holiday.
e.zh: 村里把这个古集市日当作法定休息日。

e.en: She entered {nunhood} after years of reflection.
e.zh: 经过多年思考，她进入修女生活。

e.en: The memoir describes {nunhood} with unusual candor.
e.zh: 这本回忆录以少见的坦率描写修女身份。

e.en: Students learn {nunnation} when studying classical Arabic.
e.zh: 学生学习古典阿拉伯语时会学词尾鼻音化。

e.en: The printed text omitted {nunnation} in many words.
e.zh: 印刷文本在许多词中省略了词尾鼻音符号。

e.en: The sword guard was decorated with {nunome} inlay.
e.zh: 这件刀镡饰有日本布目纹镶嵌。

e.en: Collectors admire {nunome} for its woven texture.
e.zh: 收藏家欣赏布目纹金工的织物般质感。

e.en: He paid {nuppence} for the old pamphlet.
e.zh: 他花了九便士买下那本旧小册子。

e.en: I would not give {nuppence} for that excuse.
e.zh: 那个借口在我看来一文不值。

e.en: The report compares {nuptiality} across rural districts.
e.zh: 报告比较了各农村地区的结婚率。

e.en: Changes in {nuptiality} affected household size.
e.zh: 婚姻状况的变化影响了家庭规模。

e.en: The collar rubbed the {nuque} until it reddened.
e.zh: 衣领摩擦后颈，直到那里发红。

e.en: A dancer must keep the {nuque} relaxed.
e.zh: 舞者必须保持颈背放松。

e.en: We visited a Bronze Age {nuraghe} in Sardinia.
e.zh: 我们参观了撒丁岛一座青铜时代石塔遗迹。

e.en: The {nuraghe} stood above the valley for centuries.
e.zh: 那座撒丁石塔在山谷上方矗立了数百年。

e.en: The losses were {numerable} but still painful.
e.zh: 损失虽然可以数清，但仍令人痛心。

e.en: Only a few {numerable} items remained on the list.
e.zh: 清单上只剩下少数可数的项目。

e.en: The clerk checked the {numerary} symbols carefully.
e.zh: 职员仔细核对了那些数字符号。

e.en: Ancient tablets often used {numerary} marks instead of words.
e.zh: 古代泥板常用数字记号而不是文字。

e.en: The language has special {numerative} forms for people.
e.zh: 这种语言有专门表示人数的计数形式。

e.en: Her paper studied the {numerative} words in old records.
e.zh: 她的论文研究旧记录中的数词。

e.en: The report contained a {numercal} error in the total.
e.zh: 报告的总数里有一个数字错误。

e.en: Please enter the {numercal} code printed below.
e.zh: 请输入下方印出的数字代码。

e.en: The old ticket was marked {numero} seven.
e.zh: 那张旧票上标着七号。

e.en: She joked that he was problem {numero} one.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说他是一号麻烦。

e.en: A {numerologist} claimed the date was lucky.
e.zh: 一位数字命理学家声称那个日期很吉利。

e.en: The article interviewed a {numerologist} about birth numbers.
e.zh: 那篇文章采访了一位研究生日数字的数字命理学家。

e.en: Do not be a {numhead} about safety.
e.zh: 别在安全问题上犯傻。

e.en: He called himself a {numhead} after losing the keys.
e.zh: 丢了钥匙后，他骂自己是个笨蛋。

e.en: The forest seemed filled with ancient {numina}.
e.zh: 那片森林仿佛充满了古老的神圣力量。

e.en: Roman religion recognized many local {numina}.
e.zh: 罗马宗教承认许多地方神灵。

e.en: The chapel gave him a sense of the {numinosum}.
e.zh: 那座小教堂让他感到一种神圣的奥秘。

e.en: Her poems circle around fear, wonder, and the {numinosum}.
e.zh: 她的诗围绕恐惧、惊叹和神圣奥秘感展开。

e.en: The coin is {numismatically} important despite its scratches.
e.zh: 尽管有划痕，这枚硬币从钱币学角度看很重要。

e.en: He described the medal {numismatically}, noting its mint mark.
e.zh: 他从钱币学角度描述了这枚奖章，并提到铸币标记。

numismatologist.t: 钱币学家；钱币收藏研究者

e.en: A {numismatologist} identified the rare silver coin.
e.zh: 一位钱币学家鉴定了那枚稀有银币。

e.en: The museum hired a {numismatologist} to catalogue its collection.
e.zh: 博物馆聘请钱币学家为馆藏编目。

e.en: She studied {numismatology} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学学习钱币学。

e.en: Modern {numismatology} can reveal trade routes.
e.zh: 现代钱币学可以揭示贸易路线。

e.en: The archive preserves several {nummary} records from Rome.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着几份罗马时期的钱币记录。

e.en: His {nummary} interests began with one ancient coin.
e.zh: 他对钱币的兴趣始于一枚古币。

e.en: The workers stopped for a quick {nummet}.
e.zh: 工人们停下来吃了点午间小吃。

e.en: Grandmother packed bread and cheese for our {nummet}.
e.zh: 祖母给我们的点心准备了面包和奶酪。

e.en: The doctor noted a {nummular} rash on his arm.
e.zh: 医生注意到他手臂上有硬币状皮疹。

e.en: The fossil left a {nummular} pattern in the stone.
e.zh: 化石在石头上留下了硬币样的纹路。

e.en: The cabinet held his {nummulary} collection.
e.zh: 柜子里放着他的钱币收藏。

e.en: The shell had a small {nummulary} shape.
e.zh: 这个贝壳有小小的硬币状外形。

e.en: The lesion appeared {nummulated} under the lamp.
e.zh: 灯光下，那处病损呈硬币状。

e.en: Rain left {nummulated} marks on the dusty glass.
e.zh: 雨水在布满灰尘的玻璃上留下了硬币状痕迹。

e.en: The limestone contained a clear {nummulite}.
e.zh: 这块石灰岩里有一个清晰的钱币虫化石。

e.en: A single {nummulite} can look like a tiny coin.
e.zh: 单个钱币虫化石看起来可能像一枚小硬币。

e.en: The cliffs are rich in {nummulites}.
e.zh: 这些峭壁中富含钱币虫化石。

e.en: Geologists used {nummulites} to date the rock layer.
e.zh: 地质学家用钱币虫化石来测定岩层年代。

e.en: The temple was built from {nummulitic} limestone.
e.zh: 这座神庙由含钱币虫化石的石灰岩建成。

e.en: She mapped the {nummulitic} beds along the valley.
e.zh: 她绘制了山谷中含钱币虫化石的岩层。

e.en: She adjusted the {numnah} before tightening the saddle.
e.zh: 她先调整马鞍垫，再把鞍具勒紧。

e.en: A clean {numnah} helps protect the horse's back.
e.zh: 干净的马鞍垫有助于保护马背。

e.en: Only a {numpty} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会无视那个警告。

e.en: He felt like a {numpty} after missing the bus.
e.zh: 错过公交车后，他觉得自己像个笨蛋。

e.en: Do not call your brother a {numskull}.
e.zh: 别叫你弟弟笨蛋。

e.en: I felt like a complete {numskull} at the meeting.
e.zh: 在会议上我觉得自己像个十足的蠢人。

e.en: That was a {numskulled} thing to say.
e.zh: 那话说得真蠢。

e.en: His {numskulled} mistake delayed the whole team.
e.zh: 他愚蠢的错误耽误了整个团队。

e.en: The coach called the lazy players {numskulls}.
e.zh: 教练把那些懒散的队员叫作笨蛋。

e.en: Those {numskulls} forgot to lock the door again.
e.zh: 那些蠢人又忘了锁门。

e.en: The clause acted as a {nullifier} of the agreement.
e.zh: 这个条款成了使协议失效的因素。

e.en: He saw the veto as a constitutional {nullifier}.
e.zh: 他把否决权视为一种宪法上的废止手段。

e.en: The study compared pregnant patients with {nulligravida} volunteers.
e.zh: 这项研究把孕妇与从未怀孕的志愿者作比较。

e.en: Her medical chart described her as {nulligravida}.
e.zh: 她的病历写明她从未怀孕。

e.en: The clinic recorded her as a {nullipara}.
e.zh: 诊所记录她为从未分娩的女性。

e.en: A {nullipara} may still have been pregnant before.
e.zh: 从未分娩的女性以前仍可能怀过孕。

e.en: Researchers examined whether {nulliparity} affected cancer risk.
e.zh: 研究人员考察未曾分娩是否影响癌症风险。

e.en: The form included age, smoking, and {nulliparity}.
e.zh: 表格包含年龄、吸烟情况和未曾分娩状态。

e.en: The doctor noted that she was {nulliparous}.
e.zh: 医生注明她未曾分娩。

e.en: The trial recruited only {nulliparous} participants.
e.zh: 这项试验只招募未曾分娩的参与者。

e.en: The fossil showed a mostly {nullipennate} limb.
e.zh: 化石显示那条肢体大多没有羽毛。

e.en: Early sketches labeled the insect as {nullipennate}.
e.zh: 早期草图把这种昆虫标为无翅羽。

nulliplex.t: 遗传上无该等位基因的

e.en: The plant was {nulliplex} for the resistance gene.
e.zh: 这株植物不含该抗性基因的等位拷贝。

e.en: A {nulliplex} parent cannot pass on that allele.
e.zh: 无该等位基因的亲本不能传递那个等位基因。

e.en: Divers found pink {nullipore} on the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石上发现了粉色珊瑚藻。

e.en: Old naturalists mistook {nullipore} for coral.
e.zh: 早期博物学家曾把珊瑚藻误认为珊瑚。

e.en: The embryo showed {nullisomy} for chromosome seven.
e.zh: 这个胚胎显示第七号染色体成对缺失。

e.en: Complete {nullisomy} is often lethal in animals.
e.zh: 完全缺失一对同源染色体在动物中常是致命的。

e.en: The old database used {nullo} for empty fields.
e.zh: 旧数据库用空值表示空字段。

e.en: Programmers treated {nullo} as a special token.
e.zh: 程序员把空值视为一种特殊标记。

e.en: The report left a {nully} impression on readers.
e.zh: 这份报告给读者留下空洞无物的印象。

e.en: That argument feels {nully} without evidence.
e.zh: 没有证据时，那个论点显得空泛无力。

e.en: The {numbat} eats termites during the day.
e.zh: 袋食蚁兽白天以白蚁为食。

e.en: Conservationists released a {numbat} into the reserve.
e.zh: 保护人员把一只袋食蚁兽放归保护区。

e.en: The campaign hired a {number-cruncher} to study voters.
e.zh: 竞选团队聘请了一名数据分析员来研究选民。

e.en: Ask the {number-cruncher} before changing the budget.
e.zh: 改预算前先问问那个算账高手。

e.en: The {number-crunchers} found a costly error.
e.zh: 数据分析员发现了一个代价高昂的错误。

e.en: Wall Street {number-crunchers} watched the report closely.
e.zh: 华尔街的数据分析员密切关注这份报告。

e.en: The job involves endless {number-crunching}.
e.zh: 这份工作要做没完没了的大量计算。

e.en: After some {number-crunching}, the plan looked risky.
e.zh: 经过一番数据处理后，这个计划显得很冒险。

e.en: The camera read the car's {number-plate}.
e.zh: 摄像头识别出了那辆车的车牌。

e.en: His {number-plate} was covered with mud.
e.zh: 他的车牌被泥巴盖住了。

e.en: Only clearly {numberable} items were included.
e.zh: 只有明确可计数的项目被纳入其中。

e.en: Each seat in the hall was {numberable}.
e.zh: 大厅里的每个座位都可以编号。

e.en: A cracked {numberplate} can fail inspection.
e.zh: 破裂的车牌可能通不过检查。

e.en: She memorized the taxi's {numberplate}.
e.zh: 她记住了那辆出租车的车牌号。

e.en: The fisherman avoided touching the {numbfish}.
e.zh: 渔夫避免触碰那条电鳐。

e.en: A {numbfish} can stun prey with electricity.
e.zh: 电鳐能用电击麻痹猎物。

e.en: Don't be a {numbhead}; read the sign.
e.zh: 别犯傻，看看那个标志。

e.en: He called himself a {numbhead} after losing the keys.
e.zh: 弄丢钥匙后，他骂自己是个糊涂虫。

e.en: The cook simmered {numbles} for the pie.
e.zh: 厨师把动物内脏慢炖后用来做馅饼。

e.en: In old recipes, {numbles} meant edible entrails.
e.zh: 在旧食谱里，numbles 指可食用的动物内脏。

e.en: Her hands were cold but {numbless}.
e.zh: 她的手很冷，但没有麻木感。

e.en: The patient remained {numbless} after the injection.
e.zh: 注射后，病人仍没有出现麻木感。

e.en: The poet sensed a {numen} in the grove.
e.zh: 诗人感到树林中有一种神秘的神灵气息。

e.en: Ancient worshippers honored the river's {numen}.
e.zh: 古代信徒敬奉这条河的守护神灵。

nurdle.t: 牙膏等的一小团；塑料颗粒

e.en: She squeezed a {nurdle} of toothpaste onto the brush.
e.zh: 她把一小团牙膏挤到牙刷上。

e.en: Tiny plastic {nurdles} washed onto the beach after the spill.
e.zh: 泄漏后，细小的塑料颗粒被冲上了海滩。

e.en: The old household employed a {nurse-maid} for the children.
e.zh: 那个旧式家庭雇了一名女仆照看孩子。

e.en: In the novel, the {nurse-maid} carries the baby downstairs.
e.zh: 小说里，那名育儿女仆把婴儿抱下楼。

e.en: A {nurse-practitioner} can prescribe medicine in many clinics.
e.zh: 在许多诊所，执业护士可以开药。

e.en: She saw a {nurse-practitioner} instead of a doctor.
e.zh: 她看的不是医生，而是一名专科护士。

e.en: The diver spotted a {nursehound} resting near the rocks.
e.zh: 潜水员看见一条护士鲨类的鱼在岩石旁休息。

e.en: A {nursehound} is harmless unless it is disturbed.
e.zh: 这种猫鲨只要不被打扰，通常没有危险。

e.en: The wealthy family hired a {nursekeeper} for the infant.
e.zh: 那个富裕家庭雇人照料婴儿。

e.en: Her duties as {nursekeeper} kept her beside the cradle.
e.zh: 作为看护婴儿的人，她总守在摇篮旁。

e.en: The tired mother rocked her {nurseling} to sleep.
e.zh: 疲惫的母亲摇着吃奶的婴儿入睡。

e.en: The young poet was treated as a {nurseling} of the court.
e.zh: 那位年轻诗人被当作宫廷扶持的宠儿。

e.en: The {nursery-maid} dressed the children before breakfast.
e.zh: 那名育儿女仆在早餐前给孩子们穿好衣服。

e.en: A {nursery-maid} appears briefly in the Victorian story.
e.zh: 这篇维多利亚时代的故事里短暂出现了一名育儿女仆。

e.en: My grandmother taught me a funny {nursery-rhyme}.
e.zh: 祖母教了我一首有趣的童谣。

e.en: The advertisement borrowed a familiar {nursery-rhyme} tune.
e.zh: 那则广告借用了大家熟悉的儿歌曲调。

e.en: The {nurserygirl} waited outside with the pram.
e.zh: 那个照看孩子的女孩推着婴儿车等在外面。

e.en: As a {nurserygirl}, she spent long days with small children.
e.zh: 当育儿女工时，她整天和小孩子待在一起。

e.en: The {nurserymaid} carried clean blankets upstairs.
e.zh: 育儿女仆把干净的毯子拿到楼上。

e.en: He remembered his childhood {nurserymaid} with affection.
e.zh: 他深情地记得童年时照顾他的保姆。

e.en: The hungry {nursling} cried until his mother returned.
e.zh: 饥饿的吃奶婴儿一直哭到母亲回来。

e.en: The academy called him a {nursling} of classical art.
e.zh: 学院称他是古典艺术培养出来的人才。

e.en: Her {nut-brown} hair shone in the afternoon light.
e.zh: 她坚果褐色的头发在午后阳光里发亮。

e.en: The old table had a warm {nut-brown} finish.
e.zh: 那张旧桌子呈现出温暖的坚果褐色光泽。

e.en: A large {nut-tree} grew beside the farmhouse.
e.zh: 农舍旁长着一棵高大的坚果树。

e.en: They planted a {nut-tree} for shade and food.
e.zh: 他们种了一棵坚果树，既遮阴又结果。

e.en: The botanist noted the flower's {nutant} stem.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到那朵花的茎呈下垂状。

e.en: A {nutant} head of grain bent in the wind.
e.zh: 一穗低垂的谷物在风中弯下。

e.en: As a {nutarian}, he avoided meat and most cooked food.
e.zh: 作为坚果素食者，他不吃肉，也很少吃熟食。

e.en: The article described a {nutarian} diet based on fruits and nuts.
e.zh: 文章介绍了一种以水果和坚果为主的坚果素食饮食。

e.en: The spinning top began to {nutate} as it slowed down.
e.zh: 陀螺慢下来时开始摆动。

e.en: Young sunflower stems {nutate} while they grow.
e.zh: 向日葵幼茎在生长时会作摆动运动。

e.en: The axis {nutated} slightly during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中轴线轻微地作了章动。

e.en: The plant tip {nutated} as it searched for support.
e.zh: 植物尖端一边摆动，一边寻找支撑物。

e.en: The planet's axis {nutates} under small gravitational forces.
e.zh: 在微小引力作用下，行星轴会发生章动。

e.en: A climbing shoot {nutates} until it touches a support.
e.zh: 攀缘嫩枝会摆动，直到碰到支撑物。

e.en: The {nutating} gyroscope traced a small circle.
e.zh: 正在章动的陀螺仪画出一个小圆。

e.en: A {nutating} vine tip slowly swept through the air.
e.zh: 摆动的藤蔓尖端缓慢扫过空中。

e.en: Astronomers measured the moon's slight {nutation}.
e.zh: 天文学家测量了月球轻微的章动。

e.en: The seedling's {nutation} helped it find the pole.
e.zh: 幼苗的摆动运动帮助它找到杆子。

e.en: The model includes a small {nutational} correction.
e.zh: 这个模型包含一个很小的章动修正。

e.en: Researchers filmed the plant's {nutational} movement overnight.
e.zh: 研究人员整夜拍摄了植物的摆动运动。

e.en: She ordered a {nutberger} with salad for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐点了一个坚果汉堡配沙拉。

e.en: The cafe makes its {nutberger} from walnuts and lentils.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆用核桃和扁豆做坚果饼。

e.en: A male {nyala} has spiral horns and shaggy hair.
e.zh: 雄性尼亚拉羚羊有螺旋形的角和蓬松的毛。

e.en: We saw a {nyala} near the waterhole at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时我们在水坑旁看见了一只尼亚拉羚羊。

e.en: Each {nybble} contains four binary bits.
e.zh: 每个半字节包含四个二进制位。

e.en: The old debugger displayed memory one {nybble} at a time.
e.zh: 旧调试器一次显示半字节大小的内存。

e.en: The lab recorded a {nychthemeral} cycle in the animal's activity.
e.zh: 实验室记录到该动物活动中的二十四小时昼夜周期。

e.en: Her sleep chart showed a stable {nychthemeral} rhythm.
e.zh: 她的睡眠图显示出稳定的昼夜节律。

e.en: The patient reported {nyctalgia} that woke him before dawn.
e.zh: 病人说夜间疼痛常在黎明前把他痛醒。

e.en: Persistent {nyctalgia} can make recovery feel much slower.
e.zh: 持续的夜间疼痛会让康复过程显得慢得多。

e.en: Vitamin A deficiency can cause {nyctalopia} in children.
e.zh: 维生素A缺乏可能导致儿童患夜盲症。

e.en: Because of {nyctalopia}, she avoids driving after sunset.
e.zh: 由于夜盲症，她避免日落后开车。

e.en: The doctor used {nyctalopy} to describe his poor night vision.
e.zh: 医生用夜盲症来描述他夜间视力差的问题。

e.en: In older texts, {nyctalopy} may refer to unusual night sight.
e.zh: 在较旧的文献中，nyctalopy可能指异常的夜视能力。

e.en: The garden includes several {nyctanthous} plants with pale blossoms.
e.zh: 花园里有几种夜间开花、花色浅淡的植物。

e.en: A {nyctanthous} species may rely on moths for pollination.
e.zh: 夜间开花的物种可能依靠蛾类授粉。

e.en: Bean leaves show {nyctinasty} by folding at night.
e.zh: 豆类叶片夜间合拢，表现出昼夜性开合运动。

e.en: Researchers measured {nyctinasty} under different light conditions.
e.zh: 研究人员在不同光照条件下测量植物的昼夜性运动。

e.en: Some leaves make {nyctitropic} movements as darkness falls.
e.zh: 夜幕降临时，有些叶子会做出向夜性运动。

e.en: The botanist studied the plant's {nyctitropic} response.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了这种植物的夜间趋性反应。

e.en: The seedlings displayed {nyctitropism} when the lights were dimmed.
e.zh: 灯光变暗时，幼苗表现出夜间趋性运动。

e.en: Darwin wrote about {nyctitropism} in certain sleeping leaves.
e.zh: 达尔文曾写到某些睡眠叶的夜间趋性运动。

e.en: Her {nyctophobia} made camping in the woods difficult.
e.zh: 她的黑暗恐惧症让林中露营变得很困难。

e.en: Therapy helped him manage his childhood {nyctophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他控制了童年留下的黑暗恐惧。

e.en: The specialist diagnosed {nyctotyphlosis} after several vision tests.
e.zh: 经过几项视力检查后，专家诊断为夜间失明。

e.en: Severe {nyctotyphlosis} left him unable to walk outside at night.
e.zh: 严重夜盲使他夜里无法在户外行走。

e.en: The minister gave a firm {nyet} to the proposal.
e.zh: 部长对这项提议给出了坚决的拒绝。

e.en: She answered with a curt {nyet} and closed the door.
e.zh: 她冷冷地说了声“不”，然后关上了门。

e.en: A {nylghai} moved slowly through the dry grass.
e.zh: 一只蓝牛羚慢慢穿过干草地。

e.en: The reserve protects the {nylghai} from illegal hunting.
e.zh: 保护区保护蓝牛羚免遭非法捕猎。

e.en: The {nylghau} is one of Asia's largest antelopes.
e.zh: 蓝牛羚是亚洲体型最大的羚羊之一。

e.en: Visitors photographed a {nylghau} beside the thorn trees.
e.zh: 游客在荆棘树旁拍到了一只蓝牛羚。

e.en: The surgeon examined the swollen {nympha} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了肿胀的小阴唇。

e.en: An old entomology text called the insect pupa a {nympha}.
e.zh: 一本旧昆虫学书把昆虫的蛹称为nympha。

e.en: The ruined {nymphaeum} still had traces of painted marble.
e.zh: 那座废弃的古罗马喷泉神龛仍留有彩绘大理石痕迹。

e.en: Tourists gathered near the {nymphaeum} in the ancient villa.
e.zh: 游客聚集在古别墅里的喷泉神龛附近。

e.en: The insect's {nymphal} stage lasts only a few weeks.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的若虫阶段只持续几周。

e.en: A {nymphal} skin clung to the reed after the dragonfly emerged.
e.zh: 蜻蜓羽化后，若虫蜕皮还附在芦苇上。

e.en: The orange {nymphalid} rested on a sunlit stone.
e.zh: 那只橙色蛱蝶停在阳光照着的石头上。

e.en: Collectors identified the specimen as a common {nymphalid}.
e.zh: 采集者认定这个标本是一种常见的蛱蝶科蝴蝶。

e.en: Her {nutbrown} hair caught the afternoon light.
e.zh: 她坚果棕色的头发映着午后的光。

e.en: The old desk had a warm {nutbrown} shine.
e.zh: 那张旧书桌泛着温暖的坚果棕光泽。

e.en: The cafe serves a spicy {nutburger} with salad.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应配沙拉的辣味坚果汉堡。

e.en: He sounded like a total {nutburger} on the radio.
e.zh: 他在广播里听起来像个十足的怪人。

e.en: The ink was once made from {nutgall} and iron salts.
e.zh: 这种墨水过去用五倍子和铁盐制成。

e.en: A {nutgall} forms when insects irritate the oak tissue.
e.zh: 昆虫刺激橡树组织时会形成虫瘿。

e.en: The gardener struggled to remove {nutgrass} from the beds.
e.zh: 园丁费力地清除花坛里的莎草类杂草。

e.en: {Nutgrass} spreads quickly through small underground tubers.
e.zh: 莎草类杂草会通过地下小块茎迅速蔓延。

e.en: He said he knew {nuthin} about the missing keys.
e.zh: 他说自己对丢失的钥匙一无所知。

e.en: There was {nuthin} left but a few crumbs.
e.zh: 除了几粒碎屑，什么也没剩下。

e.en: She used a {nuthook} to pull down the high branches.
e.zh: 她用取坚果钩把高处的树枝拉下来。

e.en: The playwright calls the thief a {nuthook} in the old scene.
e.zh: 剧作家在那段旧场景里把小偷称作nuthook。

e.en: Each tiny {nutlet} held one hard seed.
e.zh: 每个小坚果里都有一粒坚硬的种子。

e.en: The botanist counted the {nutlets} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大镜下数这些小瘦果。

e.en: The roasted seeds had a {nutlike} flavor.
e.zh: 烤过的种子有一种像坚果的味道。

e.en: A hard {nutlike} shell protected the fruit.
e.zh: 坚硬得像坚果的外壳保护着果实。

e.en: Add chopped {nutmeat} to the cake batter.
e.zh: 把切碎的坚果仁加入蛋糕面糊。

e.en: The squirrel carried the {nutmeat} into its nest.
e.zh: 松鼠把坚果仁叼进了窝里。

e.en: Many {Nutmeggers} commute by train to New York.
e.zh: 许多康涅狄格州人坐火车通勤到纽约。

e.en: The article jokingly called local voters {Nutmeggers}.
e.zh: 那篇文章开玩笑地称当地选民为康涅狄格州人。

e.en: Use a {nutpick} to loosen the walnut pieces.
e.zh: 用挑坚果仁的小工具把核桃仁挑松。

e.en: The silver {nutpick} came with the old serving set.
e.zh: 这把银制挑坚果仁小工具是旧餐具套装的一部分。

e.en: The soup was simple but {nutrimental}.
e.zh: 这汤很简单，但有营养。

e.en: Doctors valued the drink for its {nutrimental} effect.
e.zh: 医生看重这种饮品的滋养作用。

e.en: She studied {nutriology} before working in public health.
e.zh: 她在从事公共卫生工作前学过营养学。

e.en: The old textbook used {nutriology} where we now say nutrition science.
e.zh: 那本旧教材用nutriology来表示现在说的营养科学。

e.en: The report included detailed {nutritionary} advice for athletes.
e.zh: 报告为运动员提供了详细的营养方面建议。

e.en: Some {nutritionary} claims on the label were misleading.
e.zh: 标签上一些营养方面的说法具有误导性。

e.en: The workshop covers the {nuts-and-bolts} of grant writing.
e.zh: 这个工作坊讲授资助申请写作的具体操作。

e.en: Before the launch, we reviewed the {nuts-and-bolts} again.
e.zh: 发布前，我们又检查了一遍各项基本细节。

e.en: The crowd went {nutso} after the winning goal.
e.zh: 制胜球出现后，人群疯狂起来。

e.en: He has a {nutso} theory about hidden tunnels.
e.zh: 他有个关于秘密隧道的疯癫理论。

e.en: The plan sounded {nutsy}, but it worked.
e.zh: 这个计划听起来很古怪，但确实奏效了。

e.en: She gets a little {nutsy} before every exam.
e.zh: 每次考试前她都会有点发疯似的紧张。

nuttiest.t: 最疯狂的；坚果味最浓的

e.en: That was the {nuttiest} idea he had all week.
e.zh: 那是他这一周最疯狂的主意。

e.en: This batch tastes the {nuttiest} of all the granola.
e.zh: 这批格兰诺拉麦片的坚果味最浓。

e.en: He grinned {nuttily} and opened the strange package.
e.zh: 他怪里怪气地咧嘴一笑，打开了那个奇怪包裹。

e.en: The cookies smelled {nuttily} rich after baking.
e.zh: 饼干烤好后散发出浓郁的坚果香。

e.en: The cabinet was built from dark {nutwood}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用深色坚果树木材做的。

e.en: Carvers liked {nutwood} because it held fine detail.
e.zh: 雕刻匠喜欢坚果树木材，因为它能保留精细纹理。

e.en: The old receiver used a {nuvistor} in its tuner.
e.zh: 那台旧接收机的调谐器里用了一个微型电子管。

e.en: Collectors prize radios fitted with a working {nuvistor}.
e.zh: 收藏者很看重装有可用微型电子管的收音机。

e.en: The dancer moved with {nymphean} grace across the stage.
e.zh: 那位舞者以仙女般的优雅掠过舞台。

e.en: Poets praised the spring as a {nymphean} retreat.
e.zh: 诗人把那处泉水赞为仙境般的隐居地。

nymphish.t: 像仙女的；少女般妩媚的

e.en: She had a {nymphish} charm in the old portrait.
e.zh: 旧画像里的她带着少女般妩媚的魅力。

e.en: The garden looked almost {nymphish} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时的花园几乎有仙女般的气息。

e.en: Her {nymphlike} figure appeared beside the lake.
e.zh: 她轻盈美丽的身影出现在湖边。

e.en: The actor gave the spirit a {nymphlike} innocence.
e.zh: 演员赋予那个精灵仙女般的纯真。

e.en: The tabloid cruelly called her a {nympho}.
e.zh: 那家小报恶毒地称她为荡妇。

e.en: He used {nympho} as an insulting joke.
e.zh: 他把“性欲狂”这个词当作侮辱人的玩笑。

e.en: The scholar compared their visions to ancient {nympholepsies}.
e.zh: 那位学者把他们的幻象比作古代的迷狂。

e.en: His sudden {nympholepsies} made the quiet valley seem enchanted.
e.zh: 他突如其来的狂热迷恋让静谧山谷显得像被施了魔法。

e.en: The poem describes {nympholepsy} as a beautiful madness.
e.zh: 这首诗把迷狂写成一种美丽的疯狂。

e.en: His {nympholepsy} began after one glimpse of the fountain.
e.zh: 他只看了一眼那座喷泉便陷入狂热迷恋。

e.en: A {nympholept} wandered the hills searching for visions.
e.zh: 一个迷狂者在山间游荡，寻找幻象。

e.en: The critic called the young painter a {nympholept}.
e.zh: 评论家称那位年轻画家是被美迷住的人。

nympholeptic.t: 迷狂的；如着魔般迷恋的

e.en: His {nympholeptic} gaze unsettled the villagers.
e.zh: 他那如着魔般迷恋的目光让村民不安。

e.en: The essay has a {nympholeptic} fascination with wild places.
e.zh: 这篇文章对荒野有一种迷狂般的着迷。

e.en: Victorian doctors often misused the term {nymphomania}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生常常滥用“女性性欲亢进症”这个词。

e.en: The diagnosis of {nymphomania} is now considered outdated.
e.zh: “女性性欲亢进症”这一诊断如今被认为已经过时。

e.en: The novel uses a {nymphomaniacal} stereotype that feels dated.
e.zh: 这部小说使用了一个显得过时的性欲亢进刻板形象。

e.en: She rejected the {nymphomaniacal} label as sexist gossip.
e.zh: 她拒绝接受这个“淫欲狂”的标签，认为那是性别歧视的闲话。

e.en: The comedian used {nymphos} in a deliberately offensive routine.
e.zh: 那名喜剧演员在刻意冒犯的段子里用了“荡妇”这个词。

e.en: Old tabloids loved calling rebellious women {nymphos}.
e.zh: 旧式小报喜欢把叛逆女性称作性欲狂。

e.en: The doctor noted {nystagmic} movements during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查中注意到眼球震颤样运动。

e.en: Alcohol can sometimes cause a {nystagmic} response.
e.zh: 酒精有时会引起眼球震颤反应。

e.en: The clinic bought a new {nystagmograph} for balance testing.
e.zh: 诊所买了一台新的眼球震颤记录仪用于平衡测试。

e.en: A {nystagmograph} recorded the patient's rapid eye movements.
e.zh: 眼球震颤记录仪记录了患者快速的眼动。

e.en: The specialist ordered {nystagmography} after the dizziness continued.
e.zh: 头晕持续后，专科医生安排了眼球震颤描记检查。

e.en: Video {nystagmography} can help evaluate inner ear problems.
e.zh: 视频眼球震颤描记法可帮助评估内耳问题。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {nystatin} for the oral infection.
e.zh: 医生开了制霉菌素治疗口腔感染。

e.en: Shake the {nystatin} suspension before each dose.
e.zh: 每次服用制霉菌素混悬液前都要摇匀。

e.en: His constant {name-dropping} made the interview feel awkward.
e.zh: 他不停炫耀认识名人，让面试显得很尴尬。

e.en: She avoided {name-dropping} and let her work speak for itself.
e.zh: 她避免攀名人关系，而是让作品说明一切。

name-drops.t: 提名人抬身价；炫耀交游

e.en: He {name-drops} famous directors whenever he meets investors.
e.zh: 他每次见投资人都会提起名导演来抬身价。

e.en: The article {name-drops} several chefs without explaining their relevance.
e.zh: 那篇文章提到好几位厨师，却没有说明他们有什么关系。

e.en: A brass {name-plate} was fixed to the office door.
e.zh: 办公室门上装着一块黄铜名牌。

e.en: The machine's {name-plate} listed its voltage and serial number.
e.zh: 机器铭牌上列出了电压和序列号。

e.en: Please wear your {name-tag} during the conference.
e.zh: 会议期间请佩戴你的姓名牌。

e.en: Her {name-tag} was missing, so nobody knew her role.
e.zh: 她的名签不见了，所以没人知道她的职责。

e.en: Every tool in the kit was {nameable} by shape and use.
e.zh: 工具箱里的每件工具都能按形状和用途说出名称。

e.en: The fear was real but not easily {nameable}.
e.zh: 那种恐惧是真实的，却不容易说出名字。

e.en: The shop's wooden {nameboard} swung above the narrow street.
e.zh: 店铺的木制招牌在狭窄街道上方晃动。

e.en: Each desk had a small {nameboard} for the delegate.
e.zh: 每张桌子上都有给代表用的小姓名牌。

e.en: The debate collapsed into {namecalling} after ten minutes.
e.zh: 辩论十分钟后就变成了互相辱骂。

e.en: Teachers should stop {namecalling} before it becomes bullying.
e.zh: 老师应在起蔑称发展成霸凌前加以制止。

namecheck.t: 提到名字以核实或炫耀

e.en: The host would {namecheck} every sponsor before the show began.
e.zh: 节目开始前，主持人会逐一提到每位赞助商的名字。

e.en: She casually {namechecked} two famous directors during lunch.
e.zh: 午餐时她随口提到了两位知名导演的名字。

e.en: The article {namechecks} several young poets from the city.
e.zh: 这篇文章提到了城里的几位年轻诗人。

e.en: Security {namechecks} every visitor at the front desk.
e.zh: 安保人员在前台核对每位访客的姓名。

e.en: He likes to {namedrop} celebrities he barely knows.
e.zh: 他喜欢炫耀地提起那些其实不太熟的名人。

e.en: Please do not {namedrop} clients in public meetings.
e.zh: 请不要在公开会议上随意提客户的名字。

namesmanship.t: 借名人抬高自己的手腕

e.en: His speech relied more on {namesmanship} than on real evidence.
e.zh: 他的演讲更多靠搬出名人撑场，而不是真凭实据。

e.en: In that industry, subtle {namesmanship} can open many doors.
e.zh: 在那个行业里，巧妙借名人关系有时能打开很多门路。

e.en: Each module has its own {namespace} to avoid conflicts.
e.zh: 每个模块都有自己的命名空间，以避免冲突。

e.en: The XML file declares a {namespace} at the top.
e.zh: 这个 XML 文件在顶部声明了一个命名空间。

e.en: The workers stopped for {nammet} in the field.
e.zh: 工人们在田里停下来吃午餐。

e.en: She packed bread and cheese for her {nammet}.
e.zh: 她带了面包和奶酪当点心吃。

nance.t: 娘娘腔男人；同性恋男子

e.en: The old film used {nance} as a cruel insult.
e.zh: 那部老电影把这个词当作刻薄的侮辱。

e.en: He reclaimed {nance} in a playful stage routine.
e.zh: 他在一段俏皮的舞台表演中重新使用了这个词。

nances.t: 娘娘腔男人；同性恋男子

e.en: The comedian mocked the word {nances} as outdated abuse.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员嘲讽这个词是过时的辱骂用语。

e.en: Older newspapers sometimes described performers as {nances}.
e.zh: 旧报纸有时会把一些表演者称作这个带侮辱色彩的词。

e.en: He dismissed the new uniforms as {nancified} and impractical.
e.zh: 他把新制服贬为娘娘腔又不实用。

e.en: The word {nancified} now sounds dated and offensive.
e.zh: 这个词现在听起来既过时又冒犯人。

e.en: The chemist identified a {nitrile} group in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家在这种化合物中识别出了腈基。

e.en: The nurse put on {nitrile} gloves before the procedure.
e.zh: 护士在操作前戴上了丁腈手套。

e.en: The paper describes a new synthetic {norsteroid}.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了一种新的合成去甲甾体化合物。

e.en: Researchers compared the {norsteroid} with related hormones.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种去甲甾体化合物与相关激素作了比较。

north-country.t: 北方地区的；英格兰北部的

e.en: She spoke with a strong {north-country} accent.
e.zh: 她说话带有浓重的英格兰北部口音。

e.en: The song preserves an old {north-country} tradition.
e.zh: 这首歌保留了一种古老的北方地区传统。

e.en: The village lies to the {north-east} of the city.
e.zh: 这个村庄位于城市的东北方。

e.en: A cold wind blew from the {north-east}.
e.zh: 一阵冷风从东北方向吹来。

e.en: The boat followed a {north-easterly} course along the coast.
e.zh: 小船沿着海岸按东北方向航行。

e.en: A {north-easterly} wind brought colder weather overnight.
e.zh: 一股来自东北的风一夜之间带来了更冷的天气。

e.en: The storm hit the {north-eastern} coast first.
e.zh: 风暴首先袭击了东北部海岸。

e.en: They studied farming methods in {north-eastern} China.
e.zh: 他们研究了中国东北部的耕作方法。

e.en: As a {north-easterner}, she was used to heavy snow.
e.zh: 作为东北部居民，她早已习惯大雪。

e.en: The candidate spoke like a proud {north-easterner}.
e.zh: 这位候选人说话时像个自豪的东北部人。

e.en: Many {north-easterners} travel south during winter.
e.zh: 许多东北部居民冬天会去南方。

e.en: The policy affected {north-easterners} more than others.
e.zh: 这项政策对东北部居民的影响比其他人更大。

e.en: The lighthouse marks the {north-easternmost} point of the island.
e.zh: 这座灯塔标志着该岛最东北端的位置。

e.en: They surveyed the {north-easternmost} village in the district.
e.zh: 他们勘察了该地区最东北端的村庄。

e.en: The refugees moved {north-eastward} after the bridge collapsed.
e.zh: 桥塌后，难民们向东北方转移。

e.en: The storm is expected to turn {north-eastward} tonight.
e.zh: 预计这场风暴今晚会转向东北方。

e.en: They drove {north-eastwards} until the road ended.
e.zh: 他们一路向东北方开，直到道路尽头。

e.en: The smoke drifted {north-eastwards} across the valley.
e.zh: 烟雾向东北方飘过山谷。

e.en: The ship sailed {north-north-east} through the fog.
e.zh: 船在雾中朝北东北方向航行。

e.en: The cabin stands {north-north-east} of the lake.
e.zh: 小屋位于湖的北东北方向。

e.en: The plane turned {north-north-west} after takeoff.
e.zh: 飞机起飞后转向北西北方向。

e.en: A storm was forming {north-north-west} of the island.
e.zh: 岛的北西北方向正在形成一场风暴。

e.en: The trail runs {north-northeast} toward the ridge.
e.zh: 这条小路朝北东北方向通向山脊。

e.en: They spotted lightning {north-northeast} of the farm.
e.zh: 他们在农场的北东北方向看到了闪电。

e.en: The wind shifted {north-northwest} by evening.
e.zh: 到傍晚时风向转为北西北。

e.en: The old fort lies {north-northwest} of the town.
e.zh: 那座旧堡垒位于小镇的北西北方向。

e.en: The mountains are in the {north-west} of the country.
e.zh: 这些山位于该国西北部。

e.en: We walked {north-west} until we reached the river.
e.zh: 我们朝西北方向走，直到到达河边。

north-westerly.t: 向西北的；来自西北的；西北风

e.en: A {north-westerly} wind chilled the harbor.
e.zh: 一股西北风让港口变得寒冷。

e.en: They followed a {north-westerly} course across the hills.
e.zh: 他们沿着向西北的路线穿过群山。

e.en: The storm hit the {north-western} coast first.
e.zh: 暴风雨最先袭击了西北海岸。

e.en: She grew up in a {north-western} province.
e.zh: 她在一个西北部省份长大。

north-westward.t: 向西北方的；朝西北方地

e.en: The boat made a {north-westward} turn after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，那条船转向西北方。

e.en: They began moving {north-westward} through the valley.
e.zh: 他们开始穿过山谷向西北方前进。

e.en: The clouds drifted {north-westwards} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午，云层都向西北方飘去。

e.en: We drove {north-westwards} until the road ended.
e.zh: 我们一路向西北方开，直到道路尽头。

e.en: The vessel sailed {northabout} to avoid the storm.
e.zh: 那艘船经北方绕行，以避开风暴。

e.en: Explorers searched for a {northabout} route to Asia.
e.zh: 探险者寻找一条经北方通往亚洲的路线。

e.en: The lighthouse marks the {northeasternmost} point of the island.
e.zh: 那座灯塔标示着岛上最东北端的位置。

e.en: Their camp stood in the {northeasternmost} corner of the park.
e.zh: 他们的营地位于公园最东北角。

e.en: The ship was {northering} slowly in rough seas.
e.zh: 那艘船在汹涌海面上缓慢向北行驶。

e.en: The map recorded each day's {northering} by latitude.
e.zh: 地图按纬度记录每天向北推进的距离。

e.en: The villagers feared raids by the {northmen}.
e.zh: 村民害怕北方人的劫掠。

e.en: Old poems describe the {northmen} as skilled sailors.
e.zh: 古诗把古代北欧人描写成技艺高超的水手。

e.en: The {northmost} cabin was buried in snow.
e.zh: 最北边的小屋被雪埋住了。

e.en: They reached the {northmost} edge of the forest.
e.zh: 他们到达了森林最北端的边缘。
